name: Power Versatility
description: This ability will allow the user to make their other abilities work in any situation even in a situation that would be highly illogical. An example would be if someone was injured,and the user only has fire manipulation. The user with this ability could change this ability to use it in way to heal them. It is still fire manipulation just used in odd way. That is how illogical this ability can make it. It can only do one situation at a time and one ability at a time.
summary: The ability to make any ability apply to any situation.
strengths: Make any ability become useful in any situation.
weaknesses: One situation at a time.
One ability at a time

name: True Sword Mastery
description: The user imagines themselves as holding a sword and focuses their resolve to cut something within the range of that "sword". The "sword" will cut what the user intends and other weapons can be parried with that "sword". "Sword" can be any length but posture will have to be adjusted. The user can also increase the "cutting range" of any object held in their hand and use it as a sword. Intangible objects like fire and abstracts can be wielded if user has required secondary abilities.
summary: The ability to use anything as a sword including nothing
strengths: Not handicapped by the lack of a weapon and no need to carry one
Can increase the cutting range of smaller objects--useful if that object is something's weakness
The "sword" is not solid and only what the user intends to cut will be cut
weaknesses: Must be able to physically wield the sword(or wield it using other powers)
People with good instinct can sense the "sword" and avoid it
Requires ability to imagine the sword in your hands and decent swordsmanship

name: Waveform Manipulation
description: It is the ability to change the energy of a wave into another. Like sound into light, heat or gamma ray and vice versa. It is the ability to change any type of wave found on the electromagnetic spectrum to another and manipulate anything that follows a wave pattern.   Rule: New wave/energy will follow its inherent nature.
summary: The ability to convert one form of energy wave into another.
strengths: Adaptable and versatile
Can intensify or weaken to power of other energy
weaknesses: Must carry a source or create with your body.
Can only convert into 1 energy form at a time.
Controller can be overwhelmed by multiple energy/waveforms at once

name: Materialized Luck
description: The user will have great luck. This luck will appear in the form of a specific element like earth, fire, water, substance like acid, chlorine, or any other materials. Everything good that happens will always involve it in someway. This ability gives partial control over the power to sense luck is coming from an element.
summary: The ability to possess extraordinary luck that takes on the form of a material.
strengths: Gain powerful luck.
Since this luck is more mundane, you will control more of your luck.
weaknesses: This luck may be weaker than real luck.

name: Tactile Cryokinesis
description: This ability is extremely powerful. A person can control ice in whatever way they desire. Ice shards and slabs can be formidable weapons. Advanced users can even overcome fire, heat, or even lava-based powers, provided they are in proximity of any ice or water source. This power allows regeneration at advanced levels.
summary: The ability to control ice while either in direct contact with it, or in close proximity
strengths: Be a near-invincible fighter!
Use ice trails to escape from enemies faster, and also slow them down.
Enemies will find you to be a VERY tricky opponent to fight!
weaknesses: Takes time to learn to control.
This power requires either direct physical contact, or a proximity of no more than 200 feet to work

name: Elemental Iris
description: You can control elements such as fire, water, earth, air. And can change elements just by blinking and thinking of an element, which will change your iris color to that elements color. Power can be evolved to control more than the classical elements, for example lightning, metal etc.
summary: The ability to control elements
strengths: Can burn, freeze, or electrocute by blinking.
No side-effects
Powers won't work unless you want them to.
weaknesses: Takes lots of practise to evolve to power

name: Infinite Supply
description: The ability to give an item or container an infinite supply.  I. E: An infinite amount of water in a bottle
summary: The ability to give any item/container an infinite supply.
strengths: Limitless supply of ammunition in a magazine
Feed Africa
Unlimited McDonalds
weaknesses: Concentration is needed for larger objects
Not all effects are permanent
Taxes

name: Petrifactive Hibernation
description: The user can transform themselves into a statue in order to heal and be prevented from further harm, and returns to normal when they have fully healed.
summary: The ability to enter a dormant state as a statue, from which the user emerges fully rejuvenated.
strengths: Cannot feel any pain when in statue form.
Advanced users may be able to become unbreakable stone (thus negating the first con).
weaknesses: In statue form, the user may be chipped, damaged or completely fragmented.
If the user is not experienced, they may not be able to restore themselves.
Others may be able to restore the user before they have fully healed.

name: Ultimate Kinesis
description: You can fully control any element or substance, such as fire, water, metal, space, time, blood, and many others.
summary: The ability to control any element known to man.
strengths: Can defeat anyone.
Controlling any power is easy.
Impressing your friends could never get any easier.
weaknesses: You can only control five elements at a time.
Combining powers takes time.
You can be a threat to your loved ones.

name: Lexiconicy
description: How cool would it be to have any object you ever wanted? With the Lexiconicus power, that is possible! All you have to do is write the word out, and clap your hands together, and presto the written word actually becomes what it stands for. No pencil or paper necessary! You can write the word in mid-air with your finger! Need to escape a sticky situation? No problem, just "write" the word 'jetpack', clap your hands together and you instantly have a jetpack to blast out of the area with!
summary: The ability to transform a written word into the actual object
strengths: You can have anything
Add on an adjective to enhance the word
weaknesses: Must be able to spell, major backfire if spelled incorrectly
Only works with nouns (people, places, things)

name: Answers
description: With this power whenever you ask someone a question while looking directly at them they will automatically give you a truthful answer. If you're looking at a person through a window, glasses, or a screen this power does not work.
summary: The ability to cause people to truthfully answer any question you ask them while look at them
strengths: You can make people answer any question truthfully
weaknesses: You have to be looking at them

name: Elemental Weapons
description: With this power you can create weapons out of air, water, fire, and earth, along with variations of the elements like storm or ice. As long as you are near the element, you can create any type of melee weapon you want. You could make a whip out of storm clouds, a mace out of rock, a trident out of water, or a sword of fire. The weapons are solid, but they retain properties of the element you created it from. For example, fire weapons can burn, ice weapons freeze, and storm weapons can shock.
summary: The ability to form weapons out of the elements
strengths: Can create any type of melee weapon you want, including shields
The weapons are solid and nearly indestructable
Weapons keep elemental properties (fire burns, ice freezes, etc. )
weaknesses: Need to be near the element to create a weapon
Limited to melee weapons, no guns, bows, etc

name: Bullet Generation
description: The power holder is able to actually make/create bullets for firearms or various reason, of all types, and sizes, from nothing or by shaping the existing matter or energy.
summary: The ability to generate bullets
strengths: Make bullets anytime
Carried firearms can be loaded with bullets
weaknesses: Bullets have to be fired to be effective
May be limited to only making what the user knows

name: Water Bender
description: (Water is the element of change) you can manipulate water at will. The source of your power is the moon. With the moon you are ate are strongest. With the full moon you are unbeatable. During the sun you are at your weakest. Air is your weakness. When you master water bending you can blood bend. Know your history
summary: The ability to become a water bender from Avatar the Last Air bender the animated television
strengths: You the power to heal
You can blood bend at higher levels
You can manipulate water
weaknesses: You have a deep distrust and hatred at the fire benders
You hate all fire benders
Blood bending is the most darkest of bending (be afraid)

name: Seasonal Elements
description: This power allows you to control the major elements as well as the minor elements, depending on the season of the year. Summer: Earth/Nature; Fall: Fire/Lava; Winter: Water/Ice; Spring: Air/Lightning.
summary: The ability to control the elements based on the seasons.
strengths: Control many different elements.
Control the major elements along with the minor elements.
weaknesses: You can only control them when it's the right season.
You can only control one element at a time.
Example: you cannot control air and lightning at the same time, even if it is spring.

name: Manipulate Water
description: You can do anything with water. Freeze it, make it burn, make it steam, have a drink, use it for travel, form ice for making a magnifying lens, use a magnifying lens to burn stuff. Uses any water available to do your bidding to the molecular level. Like arrange the molecules so adhesion brings something up a wall, make stairs or a bridge, or bend light
summary: The ability to manipulate water into anything
strengths: You can make shields of ice or water, lens of ice, steamers, etc
You can force water from or into something like the air
You can control the density, location, temperature, and molecules
weaknesses: Some stuff comes with the water
Doesn't work in very dry areas
The more water you try to manipulate, the more concentration needed

name: Avatar Abilities
description: Can control air, fire, earth, and water
summary: The ability to control the four main elements
strengths: Can control elements
Also have super speed and "blood bend"
Can unleash unimaginable power when in "Avatar State"
weaknesses: Can't release self from the world

name: Tactile Magnokinesis
description: This is a very rare form of magnetic manipulation. You can control metal by physical contact with it, or by close proximity to a magnetic field. You can never be harmed by your power, and this is a versatile ability in combat. You can even control the metal in the Earth's core by willpower. A secondary aspect of this ability is flight, which works through magnetic repulsion, exactly like Magneto's ability from 'X-Men'.
summary: The ability to create & control magnetic fields through physical contact or close proximity to metal
strengths: One of the strongest forms of magnetic manipulation known to exist
Is a passive ability, so concentration is never needed to use and maintain it
You can be an extremely skilled and deadly fighter to any enemy!!
weaknesses: You have to touch a metal object to create the energy connection
Flight takes time to learn to control

name: Weaponry Intuition
description: Any object that you hold in your hands can be turned into a weapon by you. The point is that you will know stuff like how to perfectly create a weapon and know how to use it. An example would be sharpening the end of a toothbrush perfectly and using it as a stabbing weapon or modifying a staple gun to fire staples with as much force as a shotgun. Anywhere, anytime, anything, you will find a way to transform the object into a weapon.
summary: The ability to use any object as a weapon
strengths: Best. Assassin. Ever.
Knowledge on how to perfectly use your newly made weapon.
Anything you wield. (paperclip of DOOM)
weaknesses: It doesn't make you Peak Human.
It's only objects small enough that you can actually wield. (No skyscraper weapon)
The power might go to your head and make you become an assassin.

name: Rainmaker
description: With a thought, rainmakers can create, control, or disperse rainstorms. They can help people across the world by ending droughts or averting storms. This power also has combative applications. Rain can be used to blind opponents and make fighting difficult. Floods can wash your enemies away. Summon hail to crush your opponent, or bury them in snow. Experienced rainmakers can solidify their rain into constructs. Rain water meteors or spikes, use rain as shields, the possibilities are endless.
summary: The ability to summon and manipulate rainstorms
strengths: Help avert natural disasters by relieving droughts or preventing storms and floods
Create conditions that make it impossible for your enemies to fight while you are unaffected
True masters can create aquatic blades, dragons, and other constructs to descend on foes
weaknesses: Controlling rain in an area requires your physical presence
Not full water manipulation or full weather manipulation
Until you learn how to evaporate your rainwater, there's a risk of creating floods when you fight

name: Vision Of Fictional Situation
description: This superpower allows its owner to see how they behave and how they react fictional characters in the position you want, for example Mario departed too fat or Mickey this in a storm only indoors. The results of these situations can be seen.
summary: The ability to see a fictional character in any situation you want
strengths: You can see a fictional character in any situation you want
This superpower only allows viewing and not make it happen, it can be as advantageous as awful
There are no limits to find out to see what would happen with any fictional character
weaknesses: This superpower only allows viewing and not make it happen, it can be as advantageous as awful
You can see things that can only be seen by mature or adult.
This superpower no use to attack

name: Tactile Sensory Absorption
description: By touching an object the user emits a field that gathers information based on the surface area. A whole newspaper can be read by one sustained touch by understanding the ridges of ink and indentations. People can be detected by touching the floor and emitting field, though if they are suspended in air they would be undetected.   at low levels works in pulses on small objects high levels capable of large areas, radar, vibro-analysis, stresspoint exposure
summary: The ability to gather all information of a surface from a single touch
strengths: High spatial awareness & 3d mind imaging
Able to identify weakspots on touch
weaknesses: Sensory overload if untrained in use

name: Control Elements Of Nature
description: With this ability, you can use fire, water, wind, earth, and lightning bolts to your advantage as long as that element was around you. For example, in a rainstorm, you could create water walls. If it's windy out, use the air to fly! Etc...
summary: The ability to control the wind, earth, fire, water, and lightning around you
strengths: These elements are almost ALWAYS available.
This power is great for revenge jokes, or just plain revenge.
weaknesses: Have the potential to cause a tornado, hurricane, typhoon, etc..
Having this power comes with great responsibility.

name: Ancient Element Manipulation
description: The ancient elements go in categories starting with the main ones: 1)water, fire, earth, and wind. 2)ice, metal, and lightning. 3)pure light and pure darkness. 4)spirit and mind. This order is also the order of easiest elements to master to hardest elements to master and the order in which the user masters the elements.
summary: The ability to manipulate the ancient elements
strengths: Water, fire, earth, wind, ice, metal, lightning, pure light, pure darkness, spirit, mind
weaknesses: Order of elements: easiest to master to hardest to master

name: Anabolic Power
description: This ability allows one to tamper with their own powers. They can take two or more simple powers (powers that have only one effect, like basic Pyrokinesis or Aerokinesis) and combine them together to form a more complex and powerful ability, i.e. Pyrokinesis + Aerokinesis gives you the ability to create flaming winds.
summary: The ability to synthesise a new complex power from two or more simple powers.
strengths: Make more complex and powerful abilities.
Can combine multiple powers.
weaknesses: Only works with simple powers.

name: The Shield Of Time
description: The shield of time is a mechanism that can control time. It takes concentration to control it, and mastery over it can make you nearly unstoppable.
summary: The ability to control time.
strengths: Never have to wait, you can speed forward to when it is your turn.
Never be late
Can be used as real shield
weaknesses: You don't know what happened during the time you skip
It stops time only in this dimension
Freezing everything including yourself will result in a permanent stop in time

name: Force Absorption
description: Abiltiy to absorb and stockpile physical force/kinetic energy in any form, including gravity and telekinesis. Can stockpile this force to use in any way desired like transferring it to a mountain and making it shoot to the moon (depending on how much has been stored. Can use power to freeze things by absorbing the movement of the atoms. This relies on forces that potentially influence user, and user must be in direct contact with the force.
summary: The ability to absorb any physical force like momentum, gravity, kinetic energy, heat,... Etc.
strengths: 100% projectile and cut proof, basically impenetrable.
Can be used to fly
weaknesses: Useless against energy attacks like fire or electricity

name: Blacksmith's Hands
description: A master blacksmith uses the heat of a forge to form metal into any shape he wants. This power lets you do that with your bare hands. At will, your hands are covered in fire, allowing you to heat and then physically bend any metal you want. You are unaffected by the heat. As you grow stronger, you can shape metal with your mind; simply touch it and imagine what you want in to look like. You can bend metal, break it, stretch it, crumple it, the possibilities are only limited by your imagination
summary: The ability to create heat and shape metal with just your hands
strengths: You can bend, break, or reshape anything made of metal: weapons, locked doors, cars
At higher levels, users can develop pyrokinesis, allowing them to control the flames they create
At higher levels, you can simply touch metal and will it to assume whatever shape you want
weaknesses: Requires physical contact with metal even at higher levels
You are only immune to the heat you create, not to other sources of heat
At lower levels you have to physically shape metal; you only gain mental control at higher levels

name: Resurrection Man
description: Death is the final obstacle and you've dodged it. When anyone with this ability dies, they resurrect shortly after, but changed. They will have a new superpower. The new ability is completely random, but sometimes it has something to do with how they die. For example, if you die in a fire, you might resurrect with the power to control fire. But if they were to die again, they would lose the fire power and resurrect with a new one. Also, the first time you die, you won't age past that point.
summary: The ability to resurrect each time you die with a new ability.
strengths: Even in this strange form, it's immortality.
Gaining new powers after each resurrection.
Sometimes the power relates to the death.
weaknesses: You must die to gain a new power
Losing a power you liked.
Immortality is a gift and a curse.

name: Dragon Lord
description: This power gives you the abilities of a dragon. Also, you can control dragons as well. You can breathe fire, create fire balls, and grow and retract wings.
summary: The ability to have the powers of a dragon and control dragons.
strengths: You can grow wings.
You can make instant toast.
Dragons will be at your command.
weaknesses: You might accidently burn people or things.
The dragons might destroy people or places.
Your back will be sore after retracting your wings.

name: Nature Manipulation
description: The basic elements of nature are earth, water, wind, and light. The user can manipulate or blend in with: stone, sand, dirt, most liquids, ice, snow, wind, weather, light, and natural disasters. Because this power is nature-based, insects and animals appeal to the user. Light is tricky, the user can generate and bend light to a certain extent. The user can survive in any natural environment on earth. This power also gives the user healing abilities.
summary: The ability to manipulate the elements of nature
strengths: Manipulate earth, water, wind, light, and heal.
Appeal to insects and animals
Survive in any natural environment on earth and/or blend in with different environments
weaknesses: You may be considered a Tree Hugger

name: Omni Gas Manipulation
description: This is a deadly and powerful ability. With it, you can control ALL gases. Chlorine, oxygen, plain air, etc. You could bring down any manner of disaster by the air (tornadoes, air blasts, places without ANY gases at all, etc.), even rip out the air from someone's lungs. In addition' the user can solidify and compress gases into weapons, armor, etc., that can easily repair themselves. Even sound can be manipulated by manipulating the vibration of gases. Even some complicated things come easily.
summary: The ability to manipulate any and all gases.
strengths: Have control of all the air in the atmosphere.
Cause huge disasters, bring or destroy clouds via air barriers, etc.
Form weapons or armor out of gasses and repair them instantly.
weaknesses: You can only manipulate gases with this power.
It takes some concentration to manipulate whole atmospheres.
If you are in outer space with no gasses

name: Blind Luck
description: Go on and try giving the dice a roll, just remember to close your eyes and you'll get any number you hope for every time. With this power you create your own luck. Getting shot at? No problem, just run forward with your eyes closed and you'll be unscathed every time. Nuclear bomb about to go off above you? Close your eyes and a satellite will knock it out of the air and into some remote location where it won't cause trouble. If your already blind, you won't even need to close your eyes.
summary: The ability to be extremely lucky when you can't see
strengths: Ridiculously lucky
Need i say more?
weaknesses: Need to have eyes closed for this power to work, or be blind

name: Fire And Ice
description: Not much to describe here; you use the power of fire AND ice simultaneously. It has unlimited uses and various effects. Sometimes, it will even summon the two dragons Ergolek and Kralissan. This power is more for show than for go, considering it is almost impossible to control. Fortunately, the worst backfire is cross-cancellation where one cancels the other effects, though you won't even get hurt by it, except by 2 degrees (inside a building, collapse the roof and get buried in debris)
summary: The ability to simultaneously use the powers of fire and ice for various effects.
strengths: Occasionally summons the Great Dragon of Fire Ergolek and the Great Dragon of Ice Kralissan
Has various effects
Looks cool
weaknesses: Difficult to control
Occasional cross-cancelation (fire melts ice but the ice freezes the fire at the same time)
Dragons may fight each other instead of an enemy

name: Ultimate Authority
description: With this ability anything you can order anything to do what you want. This includes inanimate objects. However, the longer the command the less the power your command has, so it's best to stick to a few words. This ability takes intense concentration to work. The level of concentration varies, depending on if the object could normally do this. Meaning that living objects are easier to control than inanimate objects, or space. Orders can also include effects such as, Burn, Freeze, or Age.
summary: The ability to order anything to do what you want.
strengths: Order anyone to do anything
Can also convey orders telepathically.
weaknesses: Takes intense concentration.
Refrain from cursing at all times, they may be considered orders.

name: Elemental Influencers
description: Fire, water, earth, air. In a way, these are the substances that make up our world. Anyone with this ability can empower and weaken the elements in their natural forms. Influencers could turn a ripple into a tsunami, build a spark into a roaring fire, or force a breeze to grow into hurricane level winds. The flip side to this gift is that the user can also dampen and weaken the elements, stopping choatic earthquakes, gusting tornadoes, and distructive fires in their tracks.
summary: The ability to empower and weaken the natural elements
strengths: Influencers can empower and weaken the elements to their advantage
Can create various effects
Unique power.
weaknesses: Can only control the elements to a degree.

name: Elemental Transmogrification
description:
Ability to transform parts of your body or your entire body into any of the basic elements. You can use more than one ability at once, so long as they're not touching (ie. Fire on one arm, electricity on the other). 

Usable elements include: Fire, Water, Air, Electricity, Metal, Earth
summary: The ability to take on the form of the basic elements at will
strengths: You are the master of the elements
Can adapt to many different scenarios
Be the life of all the parties
weaknesses: Contradicting elements can harm you when used together
Certain elements are harder to control than others (ie. Rock slows you down)

name: Invisible Force Manipulation
description: There are many invisble forces of nature. There is wind (or air), gravity, and even heat. This ability will allow you to control it.
summary: The ability to control any invisible forces of nature.
strengths: Able to control invisible forces.
weaknesses: You won't control any invisible creatures, people, or spirits.

name: Ground Manipulation
description: Also called Ground Control, this is the power to manipulate the earth BENEATH ONE'S FEET. The user can't pull rocks up from the earth, and can't manipulate any AIRBORNE or HELD earthen objects. However, the user isn't at a disadvantage with this power; they can still cause monstrous tremors, make the ground ripple and cause constructs to be formed from the earth, as long as they remain in contact with the ground. You can even cause the earth to part, for easy tunneling.
summary: The ability to control the ground beneath your feet
strengths: Make the ground shake, crumble and ripple at will
Displace ground for effective digging
Form constructs (spikes, walls, pillars, etc.) as long as they stay in contact with the ground
weaknesses: Can't hurl rock through the air (or above ground AT ALL)
Can't manipulate rock that is hurling (or being hurled) at you
Power may be untamed at first, causing earthquakes, tremors, etc.

name: Supreme Earth Elementalist
description: You can summon Earthquakes of any size. You can Geologically change the grounds and the mountains within minutes. You can make grounds fertile from years of famine. You can grow trees that are higher than redwoods. Your body can transform into trees, rocks, metals or into soil. You can grow very nasty thorns from your own body. You can mold any soil into any rock, stone, or gem.
summary: The ability to rule over every aspect of Vegetation, Minerals and Soil
strengths: You can create seeds of new species of plants from your mind
You can easily make a path through a mountain
Making precious metals and stones are as easy as making pies
weaknesses: Fire is deadly
You'll make dirty footprints on someone's clean carpet
Doing Geology manipulation can kill someone if you're not careful

name: Inertia Manipulation
description: Inertia is the resistance of any physical object to a change in its state of motion or rest when it is acted upon by an external force. Those who can control inertia are able to control the outside resistances and make the object immune to such things like wind resistance or gravity, allowing them to redirect, speed up, slow down, or even entirely halt an object in mid-air. This can be used to hit harder, run faster, and even curve the direction of things like bullets.
summary: The ability to control the inertia of any object.
strengths: Able to halt incoming attacks
Able to choose a destination an object is going
Able to increase the user's own physical speed and strength
weaknesses: Without any resistance, the object will continue on forever
The user moving at superhuman speeds doesn't mean the user can perceive at a superhuman rate
An object must be in motion before it can be redirected, stopped, or sped up

name: Diamond Water
description: With this power you can transmute water into diamonds at will. It doesn't matter what kind of water, it all becomes the same kind of diamond. Not ruby, not emerald, not amethyst or that topaz crap. Diamonds. Not gold, not silver, not any other metals. Not to mention, the diamonds generated from the water, you can manipulate to form constructs, shoot at foes, and other cool stuff. 'Nuff said.
summary: The ability to transmute water into diamond, and manipulate the diamond you made from the water
strengths: Um, hello...DIAMONDS!
Water is one of the most abundant elements on earth
Control the diamonds you form from water
weaknesses: Only works with liquid water
Only makes diamonds (if you don't like diamonds, too bad)
Only manipulate diamond that is made from water

name: Freeze Time
description: With this power, you can freeze time, except for yourself, for up to one hour.
summary: The ability to freeze time.
strengths: Freeze time.
Not be bothered by anyone.
Get places fast (but not to you).
weaknesses: You can't drive anywhere.
Nothing will work. E.g. Your pages won't turn or the computer won't turn on.
It is only for an hour.

name: Overpower
description: Control Gravitation, Nuclear forces & Electromagnetism. You could manipulate every item in the known universe. Well, everything you can see at least. You sense, control & alter subatomic particles. Change the properties of matter. Convert energy into gravity or vice versa. Change ice to flame in a blink of an eye. If you are brave, you could even create subatomic particles. All this power will have dire consequences, like everyone thinking you are a god.
summary: The ability to manipulate subatomic particles
strengths: Strip energy, gravity, matter, nuclear forces down to subatomic levels & change them into any form
See everything at a subatomic level, invisibility, diguises & shape-shifters cannot fool you
Separating subatomic particles will produce unlimited raw energy which, of course, you control
weaknesses: You can not change yourself. You must physical see the object you are affecting.
Complex organisms (like humans) tend to die if shape-shifted incorrectly, you cannot create life
Creating new particles makes you feel like you are being ripped apart & burning alive simultaneously

name: Ultraviolet Pyrokinesis
description: A person with this power can wield flames that can only be seen in the ultraviolet spectrum. This means that the flame is practically invisible except for the hint of distorted air currents. The flames are so hot and powerful that they can cause most things to sublime instead of melt. The user is aware of the location of their own flames and with practice can focus their flame so that it needn't be so destructive. The flame is fueled by user willpower as opposed to O2 and does not harm the user.
summary: The ability to create and control flames that can only be seen in the ultraviolet spectrum
strengths: Practically invisible to the naked eye except for distorted air patterns
Can sublime substances instantly---turn to gas
The user has required secondary powers
weaknesses: Its very dangerous to use
Can't use it to light torches----it will burn it out

name: Shadow Kinetics
description: The user can use anything solid to get potiental energy: rocks, objects, people. It only works if they stand still enough. Once the energy is absorbed, the user gains more kinetic energy which boosts their speed and agility. The reason why I called it "Shadow Kinetic" is because not only the victim of this ability can't move because there isn't enough potiential energy to turn into kinetic energy, but when they see the user moves, it'd be like they were a living shadow because they can't move.
summary: The ability to indirectly vampirize the potential energy of any solid thing to boost the user's speed and agility.
strengths: Boost speed and agility.
Immobilizes opponents.
weaknesses: Works only when the solid isn't moving.

name: Earth Bender
description: (Earth is the element of substance) you can manipulate the earth. The source of your power  Is the earth. Water is your weakness. When you master earth bending you can metal bend.
summary: The ability to become a Earth bender from the Avatar the Last Air bender animated television series
strengths: You can sand bend
You can metal bend at higher levels
You can earth bend
weaknesses: You have a deep hatred and mistrust against fire benders
You like to eat bugs
You have a deep desire to kill fire benders

name: Supreme Fire Elementalist
description:
You have control of anything hot and burning. From magma to lightning. You can manipulate fire, or you can generate fire from your own body. You can mold magma with your bear hands you can walk over magma with your bear feet. You also can turn your body into a mass made of Magma. You can redirect lightning, as well as become a body of lightning. 
you can breath fire, as well as throwing fire.
summary: The ability to have supreme powers of Fire and extreme heat.
strengths: Fire cannot burn you
You can control it
(If your powerful enough) you can master lightning
weaknesses: It takes a while to master lightning
Objects and people around you are more likely to get burned
You have to have super reflexes in order to redirect lightning

name: Heat Manipulation
description: Heat is one of the main forms of energy. This power allows you to manipulate it in almost any way you can think of, giving you tremendous power. You can shoot blasts or waves of pure heat. You can will heat into shapes or weapons  You could even freeze something by removing the heat from it. Naturally, you are also immune to the effects of heat, so you can never be burned again.
summary: The ability to manipulate heat.
strengths: You can completely control heat
You can create shapes and weapons out of heat
You can't be hurt by heat
weaknesses: Heat shapes wont be totally soild
There is such a thing as too warm

name: Water Control
description: You can control water sources and alter the physical state between its phases. You can bring it from air, ground, trees, plant and obvious areas. It can be used to walk on water, travel underwater, grab objects and control people.
summary: The ability to control all forms of water, i.e. mist, fog, ice, steam, etc.
strengths: You control an element
Looks really cool if you have control
weaknesses: Lack of water in area
Lack of control of larger attack

name: Reactive Adaptation
description: Reactive Adaptation allows the person using this power to "react" to their environment or other factors relativly quickly. In the same way that insects become immune to a pesticide over several generations, the user of Reactive Adaptation becomes immune to whatever they are exposed to. For example, if burned multiple times, the person may become fireproof...or they may develop the ability to expel water to put out the fire
summary: The ability to become immune to whatever you are exposed to
strengths: Hard to be hurt the same way more than a few times
Can easily develop superhuman atributes by need
weaknesses: If killed, the power is useless

name: Molecule Manipulation
description: You can make things out of thin air. For example, to imprison anyone in a cage, etc. You can control molecules and atoms, meaning you can turn metal into gold, water to petroleum, carbon dioxide to oxygen, speed up and slow down their vibrations and anything you can think of.
summary: The ability to control molecules and atoms
strengths: Make things out of thin air
Turn water to ice
Deadly
weaknesses: Powered by emotion and concentration (mostly emotion)
Can't control energy particles

name: Energy Transfer
description: This is a simple, complex, and powerful ability. It allows you to transfer energy of any kind to anything else. For example, if you had a lit candle and a ball. You could transfer the energy from the flame to the ball, causing it to burst into flames or move(you can also change the type of energy). Or you could use the energy to promote change around you. If you could generate enough energy, you could create a powerful storm, send yourself through time, or even create new life-forms.
summary: The ability to transfer energy from one thing to another
strengths: Very powerful and has almost limitless uses
Can do almost anything if you have the energy
Can heal yourself and others with the energy around you.
weaknesses: The bigger the transfer of energy, the harder it is.
Can only do as much as the amount of energy you have allows

name: Nosokinesis
description: One with this ability can psychically control microscopic pathogens of any kind. This means the user can generate any kind of bacteria or virus at will, alter their numbers, their potency and their speed of production. The user can also intensify/suppress illness (in self and others) or intensify/suppress their symptoms. At the higher levels, one can even turn one kind of pathogen into another, make new ones, change how they are spread (airborne, contagious, etc) or kill them at will.
summary: The ability to manipulate disease-inducing pathogen (bacteria, viruses, etc. )
strengths: Generate and manipulate any kind of microscopic pathogen (virus, bacteria, rogue protein, etc. )
Become immune to them (and have the ability to kill them at will)
Change their properties for one's own purposes
weaknesses: Disease Immunity
Disease Absorption
At the lower levels, you'd better stick with lesser illnesses (no immunity)

name: Substance Transmutation
description: This ability allows you to change the substance material of anything you come in contact with. You could turn air into laughing gas, lead into glass, or water into soda. Imagine making gold nuggets out of gravel, or vanilla ice cream out of snow. You can turn foes into iron statues, mud into gasoline, carbon dioxide into helium, or ice into plutonium. The possibilities are endless!
summary: The ability to change an article from one substance to another.
strengths: You can generate a lot of valuable material.
You would never run out of food.
weaknesses: The object you transmute will still have the same size and shape as it did before.
The object you transmute will still be the same temperature it was before.

name: Mending
description: Also called Reconstruction/Rebuilding/Repair or the Fix-It Effect, this is the psychic ability to fix broken/damaged inanimate objects, by touch, word, thought or gesture. One with this ability can fix bent/scratched/dented/warped/melted items back to perfect working condition, at will. In addition, one can undo cracking damage, or cause broken parts to pull back together. One can also undo water, burning or acid damage, at will. One can even repair complex systems (ie electronic devices).
summary: The ability to repair and fix damaged inorganic matter, at will
strengths: Repair any bent/dented/scratched/warped/melted item, at will (even uncrumples paper, ie dollars)
Repair cracked items; if broken, item's pieces can rejoin, or each piece regenerate a new copy
Undo water/fire/acid damage; replair complex systems like electronics
weaknesses: Put other mechanics and repairmen out of business (awful for the economy)
Does not affect living/organic matter (to use on plant matter, must be processed wood/paper) (NCN)
Erases electronic information stored in the broken part, unless accompanied by Technopathy (NCN)

name: The Ice Dragon
description: The user has the power to transform at will into a huge ice blue dragon that can control ice, water, and high temperature blue fire at will, and also use these powers to heal both oneself and others, regardless of their ailment or injury. The user can also live forever if they desire. They also have extremely powerful telepathic and telekinetic abilities.
summary: The ability to shift into a powerful 'ice dragon' form with power over fire, ice, and water
strengths: Can control ice, water, and blue fire at will, and also be granted immunity to any lethal force
Can control every aspect of the human mind with their telepathy
Can move and control objects with their mind via telekinetic 'vectors', and also fly in human form
weaknesses: The three elemental powers(ice, fire, and water) are all hard to manifest and control at first
Can be lethal to other people when used offensively
Healing of either oneself or others is slow to work at first

name: Earth Empathy
description: Like a tree with water, an Earth Empath sucks up raw energy from the planet's core. While standing on dirt, they can bench press 70 tons; on asphalt or something man-made, 30 tons; while wearing shoes, 10. They are also mildly invulnerable while exercising their power. However, prolonged seperation from the planet can kill them and soil pollution has an adverse affect on them.
summary: The ability to draw power from standing on the ground
strengths: While standing barefoot on dirt, can bench 70 tons
Mildly invulnerable while standing on the ground
Become unmovable just by taking a strong stance
weaknesses: Less strength/invulnerability while in the city, wearing shoes, etc.
Soil pollution has a physical affect on you
Prolonged seperation from the planet can kill you

name: Object Summoning
description: You can make any object appear anywhere by saying a noun. Proper nouns are not allowed. As an example you could say "desk" and cause it to fall on your enemy. You could also say "fire" and set your enemy ablaze. Adjectives are allowed; for instance, "flaming desk". However, the object has to come from somewhere so it has to exist, and it also takes that object away from its owner. Also, anytime you say a noun without concentrating, it appears at a random location near you.
summary: The ability to make an object appear by saying its name
strengths: Very low effort ability
Easy to use
Can also be used for teleportation
weaknesses: Difficult to speak normally
Restricted to the boundaries of reality
Not allowed to summon Jessica Alba (hahahahahah)

name: Motion Termination
description: A person with motion termination is able to cause anything that is in motion to completely stop moving. For example if a ball is thrown and this power is used to stop the ball, it will freeze in mid air. Having the power is like having access to an on/off switch. The object remains stopped until the user decides to allow it to move again. More advanced users would be able stop every object or person within a certain area without having to think of every individual thing in that space.
summary: The ability to cause objects or people that are in motion to cease moving
strengths: Stop harmful projectiles in mid air
Stop anything, including people, from moving
Can be used to kill people by stopping their hearts
weaknesses: If you forget that you stopped something, it will remain stopped until you remember to allow movemnt

name: Geokinesis
description: Geokinetics can turn the ground they stand on into a weapon. They can mentally cause rocks to levitate, cause shockwave damage with a seismic stomp, and even know where the fault lines in an area are.
summary: The ability to manipulate rocks, soil, and earth
strengths: Looks awesome
Can bring down a building in all of two seconds
Become the best constructor ever
weaknesses: Useless against metals
Useless against processed earth, i.e. bricks
Useless if seperated from ground

name: Metal Materialization
description: You can pull metal out of thin air and bend it. Your hands must be free to use this power.
summary: The ability to make any metal out of thin air and twist it into shape
strengths: Don't need any in the environment
Metal can capture enemies without you moving
weaknesses: Must use hands

name: Reality Changing
description: The ability to make what you want to happen from what really should happen. For example, if a bookcase fell over, before it hit the floor you could make it reappear in the same spot with a wave of a hand. Other things you could do are make a light explosion and control others' powers. For example, if someone can phase through objects, you could get them stuck in the object they're phasing through.
summary: The ability to change what could happen into what you want to happen, which is something someone least expects.
strengths: Control power
Can fix anything
weaknesses: Can never unwarp what you have already warped

name: Energy Leech
description: You can live forever or heal your wounds with energy outside your body. You can take energy from organisms or other energies, like fire, light or wind. This should only be done in great need as taking energy from organisms, no matter how small the amount of energy taken, kills any organism you use it on instantly. Needs physical contact to work. It takes years of practice to touch people without killing them.
summary: The ability to live forever and heal your own wounds with energy outside your body
strengths: Can live forever through energy transfusions
Can kill enemies with a single touch
Can heal yourself and others
weaknesses: Needs physical contact to work
Kills instantly
Needs years of practice to be able to touch people

name: Enchanted Elements
description: The 4 Enchanted Elements are as follows: Watch-Fire, a fireball that will find a target and attempt to kill them; Dancing-Seas, a hypnotizing water that will entrance a target and drown them; Vile-Vines, living plants; Anger-Winds, which will paralyze a victim entirely.
summary: The ability to produce the 4 Enchanted Elements
strengths: Dancing-Seas is a good way to kill somebody
Anger-Winds will paralyze the victim and they can't fight back
All 4 Enchanted Elements obey their master/summoner and will not attack anyone on your side
weaknesses: Watch-Fire can miss a target
Dancing-Seas will not work on people who are immune to hypnosis
Vile-Vines can't catch someone with super speed

name: Psammokinesis
description: Sand is just a material composed of small finely divided rock. Psammokinesis allows you to control it. You could cause sandstorms, create beaches at lake-fronts or use sand to grab your opponents. Surf the desert like it's the sea, create a giant sand castle or simply keep the stuff out of your shoes. This ability has limitless applications.
summary: The ability to manipulate sand
strengths: Can manipulate sand
weaknesses: Can't control glass or larger rocks

name: Instantaneous Evolution
description: The user of this power is able to instantly adapt or evolve to survive in the current environment that he or she is in. This power cant be used at the user's will. This power only becomes active when the user is in danger. For example, if the user if in a burning room , the user will gain fire proof skin to protect him or her from the flames
summary: The ability to instantly adapt or evolve to survive in a current environment
strengths: Can survive in any environment
Great defense
weaknesses: Can't call up power unless in mortal danger

name: Telesynthesis
description: With this power, you can use raw materials to assemble and create objects with your mind. All you need to do is gather the ingredients, think of the item you'd like to synthesize, and the ingredients will be transformed into the object. The more complex the object, the more practice and concentration required. So when you need a toothbrush, grab a few plastic bags and you're all set. Sunny out? Make a ridiculously gigantic sombrero! Need a glass of water? Use rocks and the water in the air!
summary: The ability to create objects with your mind using raw materials
strengths: Endless possibilities for synthesizing objects
Life threatening situations become walks in the park
Transforming your Ford Focus into a Ferrari
weaknesses: All ingredients must be present, otherwise synthesis will be incomplete
Complex objects (like electronics) require great skill and concentration
Synthesizing life costs other lives

name: Planetary Avatar
description: Control the acid rains of Venus, the volcanoes on Mars, the hurricanes on Jupiter, the storms of Neptune and all others.
summary: The ability to generate and control any natural phenomena from any planet
strengths: Can travel through and survive in outer space
Can control weather on earth
Can keep oneself comfortable
weaknesses: Aliens are always trying to capture your powers.
When you die, your powers go to the closest person.

name: Soundwave Control
description: A person with this powercan control all forms of pressure waves in the air. They can project sound as a weapon as well as change their voice. They can also use sound wave as a boost to reach near sonic levels of speed. Sonic boosted jumps are possible. Soundwaves can be amplified or distorted. They can even prevent sound from occuring for a 1 mile radius as well as produce wonderful music rivalling the best musicians. They also can sense any disturbances within soundwaves for a 5 mile radius.
summary: The ability to create and control soundwaves for various effects
strengths: Sonic weapons
Find out where people are through soundwave disturbance (sort of like super-hearing)
Boost your own abilities by using sonic energy
weaknesses: You can break the eardrums of bystanders
Doesn't work in space
Soundproof material

name: Controlled Time Manipulation
description: One with this ability can reverse, pause, or slow time in any given area. This ability could be used to heal fatal wounds, and repair bridges and buildings. The ability only affects the object or person of focus. One with this ability could accelerate the aging of an enemy, making them crumble to dust, or could freeze them where they stand, without affecting time as a whole.
summary: The ability to control time in a given area
strengths: Excellent for combat and high risk scenarios
Healing teammates when they are injured by reversing the wound's timeline
Any obstacle can be easily dispatched
weaknesses: Requires massive concentration for smaller scale use

name: Velocity
description: The ability to control velocity, pure and simple. Velocity is the speed and direction a object is moving. You can do many things with it. You could simply move things around, but the more creative the better. By controlling your own velocity, you could make yourself fly into the air. Or you could cancel somethings velocity, make it freeze where it is, even if it's in the air. You might even use velocity as a sort of force blast, blasting things away from you at high speeds.
summary: The ability to control velocity
strengths: Controlling one of the most powerful forces in the world
Many uses
weaknesses: Velocity control will leave you tired at first, but the more you use it, the less tired you will be.
Might accidently cancel your own velocity sometimes

name: Terra Forming
description: The ability to control any rock element (can raise or lower a solid landmass), any liquid element (can multiply liquid to create a lake or ocean), any wood element (can manipulate one plant root to stretch as far as you want to create an ecosystem). You can manipulate the weather and climate around an area to make it foggy, rainy, or hot.
summary: The ability to manipulate the elements to create a perfect "world" of your desire
strengths: To create an entirely new world based on what you want it to be
Can upraise a landmass out of the ocean and create an island with any type of ecosystem
weaknesses: Cannot create wildlife to roam free in your world

name: Weather Manipulation
description: If its raining, you can make it rain 10 times harder; if it's hot and sunny, you can make the rays of the sun more intene and thus raise the temperature. But you can also do the opposite, make it rain less hard or make the weather less summer-like
summary: The ability to manipulate the conditions of the current weather
strengths: You can get more of the current weather-type
You can get less of the current weather-type
weaknesses: You can only increase the current weather
It can be dangerous

name: Ambidextrous Elements
description: This power is designed to combine the four traditional elements. Combining the elements can also enhance (Water and air become a hurricane) or decrease (Fire and water become steam) their combat effectiveness. With concentration, you can use two elements at the same time to defeat your opponents.
summary: The ability to control a different element with each hand.
strengths: Great for combat.
Control over Air, Water, Fire, and Earth.
Affecting air pressure can change the weather.
weaknesses: Combining elements in one spray can disable their effect. (mainly water and fire)
Overuse can lead to fatigue.
You must always be within sight of the element you plan to use.

name: Pyromaniacal Form
description: With this abilty, you can switch into a pyromaniacal form, which allows you to grow and gain power from fire. Once in this state, your body represents a figure completely engulfed and shaped in flame. You gain more fire-like abilties as you feed off fire, and they also adapt as you feed. These abilities include fire breathing, fire balls, and surges of flame. You can revert to normal form at any time, however, if you're cooled down enough, you will automatically revert.
summary: The ability to switch into a form where you grow and gain power from fire
strengths: You gain abilities such as fire-breathing, fire-balls, and releasing fire.
You are immune to most physical attacks
You can revert to your normal form at any time.
weaknesses: At the beginning of your form, you will be vunerable to most harm, espescially water.
Once you revert to normal form, your pyromaniacal form resets in size.
Mental attacks can still easily damage this form.

name: Phoenix Ability
description: The ability to use the abilities of a phoenix. You can create fire, lift 10x your own weight, your tears have healing powers, and when you die you will turn into ashes and be born again.
summary: The ability to use the abilities of a phoenix
strengths: Cook popcorn in your hands
No need to use stoves
You will always have a light
weaknesses: Without practice you could burn someone else
Born again means that you turn into a baby

name: Energy Ball
description: This ability allows the user to basicly create energy balls. The energy appear very similar to cosmic energy, but it comes in more than just orange. It comes in red, blue, orange, green, yellow, black, grey and others. Each color can do different things. After creating the sphere, if it comes into hard contact with something, it will burst. Lets say you made a red ball. If it bursts, whatever it hit will burst into flames.
summary: The ability to create and manipulate spheres of energy of varying kinds.
strengths: Tons of colors can be used.
Spheres can be made around your hands(Red sphere/human flamethrower)
weaknesses: Stranger colors will be a surprise the first time you use them.

name: Weather Control
description: With this ability, you can change the weather to be sunny, rainy, cloudy, snowy, icy--you name it.  Just as long as it isn't catastrophic.  None of this Noah business.
summary: The ability to have full control over weather.
strengths: Great weather when you want it
Be the best weather reporter in the world
weaknesses: Causing draughts
Flooding if you let it rain too long
Crazy wedding planners

name: Instant Hypnosis
description: You'll be able to stand and emit hypnotic waves from your eyes. If the waves hit the opponent then they shall start to walk up to you, then they let you command them to do whatever you want.
summary: The ability to unleash ultrasonic waves from your eyes then to control people affected
strengths: You can tell them their most secrets.
weaknesses: It'll wear off once they snapped out or splahed on with water.

name: Earth Bio Power
description: With this power you have the ability of every species on Earth and you also have powers of viruses as well. A person with this power has unlocked his own genetic code giving him every ability possible by genetic manipulation. They can access all biologically possible powers within nature including flight. However the user is blocked off from powers not observed in nature, such as telekinesis.
summary: The ability to have the abilities of every living species on earth-(all naturally occuring powers)
strengths: You can access all the powers naturally occuring in nature
You will have immunity to diseases and viruses-since you have their powers as well
You still look human-but can shape shift to gain body parts like wings or extra arms
weaknesses: Cannot use any other power-this one power is already too powerful
Can still be beaten by superpowered means or by technological means

name: External Duplication
description: Can copy anything you are in physical contact with that does not exceed 15ftx15ft(objects exceeding will be created incomplete). While in contact with object you perform a "psychic scan" which creates an identical copy that is stored within your subconscious, and can be recreated anytime you wish.
summary: The ability to create a copy of almost anything you are in physical contact with.
strengths: Infinite resources (Water, Food, Money, Weapons, Fuel)
Recreate precious/rare items (Antimatter, Superpowered Items)
Never need to carry anything on you (Entire wardrobes, sheds full of items, etc.)
weaknesses: Remembering everything you store! Be sure to write it all down just in case.
Copying a broken/potentially dangerous object ex. A leaking nuclear missle.
Can only create any item if there is enough space for it to appear in.

name: Kinesis Adaptation
description: Kinesis Adaptation, also called Adaptive Kinesis is a variation of Reactive Adaptation in which the user's "kinesis" power changes, based on the materials he comes into contact with; if the user were to touch water, he would gain the power to manipulate water (the power to manipulate fire if he touched fire, and so on). However, if the user touched an obscure material, he could choose between just manipulating that substance/material/element and going back to normal Telekinesis
summary: The ability to gain different "kinesis" powers based on the materials one touches
strengths: Touch water, control water; touch fire, control fire, and so on
Touch the most prevalent element in one's environment (never at a total disadvantage in fights)
Also gain adaptations against that element (water: aquatic adaptation, fire: fire resistance, etc. )
weaknesses: One element at a time
If an object has Telesthetic Immunity, you can't control it
No touching people to control them (unless the power is HIGHLY developed)

name: Mirror Portals
description:
In the same style as using Floo powder to get from fireplace to fireplace in Harry Potter, this power allows you to enter mirrors and teleport instantly into another mirror of your choice. 
Training would allow you to use less and less reflective surfaces; windows, puddles, TV screens, pianos, the possibilities are endless!
summary: The ability to use mirrors as portals to get to other mirrors
strengths: You can easily get away from your foes, especially if you always carry a waist-size mirror with you.
If you only put your eye through the mirror, you can spy on others.
You can build a secret warehouse that is only accessible with a mirror.
weaknesses: Mirrors are usually only found in bathrooms.
The mirror has to be big enough for you to fit through; it better not break!
For it to be really useful you'll have to carry a heavy mirror around with you.

name: Cold Absorption
description: Though previously thought to be a violation of the laws of physics, one with this ability can literally absorb cold. If the particles in the air move slow enough that they only produce a temperature less than 70 degrees Fahrenheit, they can be absorbed into the body with no harm to the user. This makes room for warmer particles in the air (thus raising the temperature). In addition, the cold may be released at will as blasts of frigid "cold energy".
summary: The ability to absorb cold from surroundings and unleash absorbed cold
strengths: Violate one of the laws of physics!
Good to raise the temperature in a cold place.
Release absorbed cold (radiating it from the skin, through a touch, or through Freezing Breath)
weaknesses: Violate one of the laws of physics (Poor eggheads will go crazy trying to figure out how it's done)
Absorb too much, and lower-leves users could freeze.
Temperature manipulators can limit how much cold you have to absorb

name: Blue Pyrokinesis
description: Blue flames are hotter than red flames. A person with this power can create and manipulate blue flames. Aside from the usual perks of pyrokinesis this ability also gives you the required secondary powers to not burn yourself with this ability.
summary: The ability to create and control blue flames
strengths: Much hotter than red flames
You have the required secondary powers
It looks way cooler than red or yellow flames(in my opinion)
weaknesses: It is hotter so unless you are good at using it you might burn others

name: Firefox & Thunderbird
description: The person with this power is able to call upon either the fire spirit Firefox or the thunder spirit Thunderbird. However, the user cannot use both spirits at the same time. The basic form of this power is that the user can use the powers associated with the spirit of fire or thunder. The ultimate form is that the user can transform into the element spirit themselves.
summary: The ability to use the fire spirit, Firefox and the thunder spirit, Thunderbird
strengths: Can transform into the animal spirit of fire or thunder
Can control fire
Can control thunder/ lightning
weaknesses: Cannot use to power simultaneously
Powerful magic users can disable power with powerful spells

name: Supreme Water Elementalist
description: You can manipulate water, or generate it from your body. You are always Hydrated, and can turn into a body of liquid to seep in through tiny cracks or holes in walls or floors. You can summon rogue waves with your mind. You can absorb water from anything wet. You can turn into ice, as well as into a Jelly consistency (however if you're in cold regions and turn into ice, it will take almost forever to move). You can surf with your bare feet and can also walk on water.
summary: The ability to possess every aspect of water and liquid
strengths: No surfboards or wipeouts anymore
You can last 500 times in the desert than a camel.
You can sense vibrations miles away
weaknesses: You might have overactive sweat glans
You have a hard time moving in cold regions if you choose to turn in water
The far away vibrations can disturb your sleeping at night

name: Aerokinesis
description: A person with Aerokinesis has control over the air in their immediate area. They can generate 200 mph gusts and make 50 yard air-boosted leaps. Even air pressure is not outside their range. They can make it greater and crush things, or decrease it so they can do things with less air resistance (i.e. run fast).
summary: The ability to manipulate air and other gases
strengths: Very versatile
Not easy to fight against
Allows user to go to many inaccessible places
weaknesses: Cannot fly
Cannot create air/gases
Cannot destroy air/gases

name: Alchemy
description: You can alter the natural elements, changing them from one substance into another.  Scientists have studied the science of "alchemy" for years, attempting to transmute iron into gold, or other elements into gold.  Now you can!  Remember chemistry?  You can change any element into another element with no thinking involved!
summary: The ability to change matter into other forms of matter, such as sand into gold.
strengths: Become rich by changing things into gold, silver, platinum, etc.
Pimp your ride--everything chrome!
weaknesses: Too much gold in the world reduces its value.
If your power becomes public, you will probably need protection

name: Mentally Triggered Explosions
description:
Fire is fun! But explosions are better. With this ability a person could concentrate on what it is they want to blow up, and then, depending on the strength of their focus, an explosion would rock the object.

Think about this ability, you could come across an impenetrable wall of stone keeping you out of the enemy's base. Boom! No more wall.
Peons are shooting at you! Boom! Disabled the guns.
Plus, the explosions don't harm you, but the shrapnel might...
summary: The ability to make explosions with your mind
strengths: Revenge, blow up the neighbor's mailbox
The detonation can be anywhere
You control the size of the explosion
weaknesses: The detonation can be anywhere
The first few tries might injure somebody. Bad.

name: Seasonal Powers
description: This power gives you different abilities for each season. In the spring, you can control plant life, talk to animals, and heal people. In the summer you can control light and summer storms (rain, wind, lightning, etc. ) In the fall you can wield red-gold flames and control darkness. In the winter you can control water, ice, and winter storms (snow, sleet, hail, wind, etc. ). It gives you a wide range of abilities that would be strong in each season.
summary: The ability to have different powers depending on the season
strengths: Stop hurricanes and blizzards
Hide in shadows and scare people for Halloween
Start awesome gardens in the spring
weaknesses: Needing another season's powers
You might not want a garden

name: Think Fire
description: With this power you can set people on fire with your mind just by thinking of the person on fire. You can even put the fires you create out with your mind. You could also change the colors of the fires you create for your own amusement.
summary: The ability to set people on fire with your mind
strengths: You can set enemies on fire with your mind
You can put the fires you create out with your mind
You can change the colors of the fire
weaknesses: You can only use fire to set people on fire
You can only put out fires you created with this power
You can only change the colors of the fires you create with this power

name: Emotion Commotion
description: It uses the emotion and converts it into any element blast by physical contact or you can throw it onto an enemy. Emotion - Element: Anger - Fire; Depression - Ice; Fear - Lightning; Love - Purity; Evil - Corruption; Courage - Earth. However, some emotions cancel each other out. Example, Depression and Anger, Love and Evil, Courage and Fear
summary: The ability to create elemental attacks (depending on the current emotion).
strengths: You can keep foes at bay.
Can help express emotions.
Help in serious situations (ex: Gang fight)
weaknesses: Need to control emotions
Might hurt friends/family (if lost control)
In trouble, if one has emotion problems

name: Godlike Craftsmanship
description: It is a Godlike power in which the user can skillfully make ALL kinds of objects by ALL forms of medium and bestow them with powers that are vast and other worldly. Example: One can make a pitcher that NEVER runs out of fresh water (ever). Or one can make a sword that can slice through anything. Or one can make a coat that is impervious to ALL harm.
summary: The ability to skillfully make objects and bestow them with vast, otherworldly powers.
strengths: The user can make ordinary objects or supernatural objects entirely by his/her own will.
It is the user's wish to choose what power(s) to bestow upon the object.
They make priceless gifts to your most trusted friends.
weaknesses: The user can not place a power that doesn't match the object. Example: a Pitcher that slices.
If the otherworldly weapons are at the wrong hands, they can cause chaos to the world.
Most corrupted people would be willing to kill you over these objects.

name: The Illusionist
description: With this ability, you can conjure illusions that are visible to you and others.  Any illusion goes--a chair, a snowball, a car, a naked hobo, a swarm of bees--you're only limited by your imagination. You can control every aspect, from how they move to when they appear/disappear.  While other people won't be able to touch them, if you'd like, you can make certain illusions tangible to you.  That way, you can realistically manipulate them.  But for everyone's sake, no naked hobos please.
summary: The ability to conjure illusions.
strengths: Amaze your friends.
Mess with people who deserve it.
Impressive, and potentially lucrative.
weaknesses: People may become afraid of you.
While the illusions look real, they are merely illusions.

name: Parakinesis
description: The ability to move space around an object, or person, or whatever allows you to move the object without affecting it at all.  EXAMPLES: A section of water can be moved without warping the water. Fire can be moved without being affected by the air. An object in motion will stay in motion, but won't actually leave the manipulated space. Because of that, it overrides things like telekinesis.
summary: The ability to move space.
strengths: Overrides things like telekinesis.
Don't have to worry about spilling your drink.
Can fly and turn upside down without all the blood going to your head.
weaknesses: Can't warp things around.
It's harder to separate apart solid objects than not solid objects. Like rock vs water.
Bigger objects use more energy.

name: Energy Redistribution
description: If you put your hand into a socket, you can make fire shoot out your other hand. If you put your hand in a fire, you can shoot electricity out the other. If you walk into a room you can turn the lights off by absorbing their energy, or you can make the room go sub-zero (or hot if you've absorbed energy from someplace else), etc. However, if you absorb too much energy, you go supernova/nuclear, and there is a massive explosion that destroys everything around you for 1km radius, and you might die.
summary: The ability to redirect into or away from you, and change energy forms as they pass through you
strengths: Turning off lights REALLY scares people :P
Putting your hand in a socket and making a flamethrower come out of the other is awesome
You can freeze an entire room just by willing it
weaknesses: Everywhere you go it fluctuates from hot-cold (but usually cold)
Lights sometimes inadvertantly turn off and on around you
Too much energy absorbtion leads to nuclear supernova explosion.

name: Color Power
description: You can wield and choose new abilities that represent each color, for my example. Red for fire, blue: ice/water, yellow: lightning, green: plants, pink: wind, purple (Violet): poison, orange: solar radiation, grey: petrifaction, indigo: gravity, brown: rock, gold: alchemy, silver: mercury, bronze: matter rearrangement, scarlet: disintegration and crimson: teleportation & intangibility.
summary: The ability to gain new powers represented by each colors.
strengths: Could come in handy.
Activate the power and surprise your enemy
weaknesses: You don't know what kind of power you are going to get

name: Ice Power Set
description: Read the good, the bad and the overview.
summary: The ability to use many different ice powers
strengths: You can freeze people with a simple touch and thought (externally, they live; internally, they die)
You can make ice spikes come out of your palm by saying the words CYROmancy
You can make an ice path beneath your feet to go in many directions. Good transport (like Iceman)
weaknesses: People may use it for evil

name: Earth Teleportation
description: When in battle or just because you're able to, you can merge into the Earth's surface. Trees, rocks, etc... Anything plant-like or earth related, you can merge through it to another desired area. But, you have to know where you want to leave to and picture it in your mind before you can disintegrate into the Earth.
summary: The ability to transport into the Earth and appear in a desired area.
strengths: Escape to anywhere on Earth anytime
Doesn't use a lot of concentration
A good addition to the user if they are normally associated with nature itself
weaknesses: Cannot use on anything dead (cut down trees, paper, etc.)

name: Terrain Manipulation.
description: Turn a mountain into a sea. Desert to jungle. A hill into a lake. Love disasters-raise and turn the atlantic ocean into a vast mountain range. Any living things that can't adapt to changes you make will die. This power requires a natural area at least 300 ft. by 300 ft. to work and focus. Bigger changes will take longer time to happen. This power wouldn't change ice or snow at the south pole into water but it would turn the land under the ice or snow into water.
summary: The ability to change any type of terrain to any other type.
strengths: Turn deserts into plains and help people grow food.
Have a world government pay you a billion dollars not to cause an environmental disaster.
weaknesses: Too many permanent changes could shift the climate of the earth or wipe out entire species.
If you need a stable planet to live on, you can't make that many permanent changes.

name: Flaming Web
description: This can work with good or evil. If your enemy has ice powers this may take their ice powers.
summary: The ability to generate flaming webs to keep your enemies from escaping
strengths: Defeats enemies
Since web take ice powers, you get new powers!
STICKY!!!
weaknesses: If your enemy has fire powers they could brake the web
Sometimes webs come out uncontrollably
May stick to you

name: Ailment Manipulation
description: This power is randomised, so you can't control what ailment you give to people, however this power can make people either, sleep, poisoned, blinded, paralysed, confused, frozen and burn. This power's effect will wear away after a few minutes, depending on how long you touched them for or how much force you used on them.
summary: The ability to cause status effect to others by touch or energy waves
strengths: You can either affect one person or many with the energy waves
You can watch the people you hate suffer
You can turn this power on and off
weaknesses: You could hurt the people that you love
If you touch someone for too long it could kill them
You can't control what ailment you give to what person

name: Spatial Aid View
description: This ability allows the user see the world, literally, in a different way to solve problems or to any kind of difficult. For example, the user needs shut off several hidden overheated generators, but he can't find them. With this ability, the user changes his visual perception from the building he was in to a visual perception that is simple like a barren wasteland with these big rocks that represent the generators. This ability can change the boring view of the user to something more fun.
summary: The ability to change one's visual perception in order to solve, overcome obstacles or just for pleasure.
strengths: Help solves problems
Good in fights to find enemy weak point
Makes life more interesting
weaknesses: Overuse will result temporary damage to eyes (glasses needed in healing).

name: Animal Enchantment
description: Animal enchantment is a very rare power. An animal enchanter can combine an element with an animal. Ex: fire plus wolf equals a wolf with fire for fur who can breathe a jet of flames. The animal you enchant will be your protector and your friend. However you may only enchant 3 animals at a time. If you try to enchant a fourth animal the first will lose his/her power.
summary: The ability to give an animal an elemental power.
strengths: Having pets with powers.
Having powerful guardians.
weaknesses: You need to enchant the right animal with the right element.
The enchantment process can take up to 90 mins.
You can only enchant 3 animals at a time.

name: Fire Proof Skin
description: This is a type of immunity! Fire cannot burn your skin. However, extremely hot temperatures (hotter than 350 degrees Fahrenheit) can still hurt you! So Beware!
summary: The ability to not be burned by mere fire
strengths: Mere fire cannot burn your skin.
You can withstand temperatures up to 350 degrees Farenheit without taking damage.
weaknesses: Temperatures hotter than 350 degrees Farenheit can still cook you.
You're more vulnerable to ice attacks.

name: Bizarre Hydrokinesis
description: A person with this power can give bizzare properties to water. For example they can make ice be soft. People will sink into it like water but cant get out because they are stuck in ice-not snow. The can make the layer outside of water be separated by dimensions so to be uncuttable and intangible. They can also make steam solid like a wall. Water plasma can simulataneously combust and snow is hot. These characteristics cannot be turned off but the user can switch water states easily.
summary: The ability to control water while giving it abnormal characteristics
strengths: Goes against conventional knowledge of water
Ride on steam, trap people in ice, uncuttable water structures, exploding water plasma
Other parts of the water such as heat, speed, or direction can be controlled normally
weaknesses: You must have water
You have to use the bizarre properties when controlling water
You have to remember the properties or else you might do the wrong thing

name: Elemental Infusion
description: This ability is a real gift. It allows you to infuse anything with any of the elements. This includes fire, air, water, earth and lightning. It also includes the other elements such as darkness and light. For example, infusing a spear with lightning. The spear will then crackle with electricity, and electrocute anything it touches. It can then also shoot lightning from its tip. This can be done to anything and with any element.
summary: The ability to infuse things with any of the elements.
strengths: Creating elemental weapons
Can even be used on animals
With practice, you can even do this to yourself
weaknesses: Cannot be reversed
If the object is destroyed, it loses its element

name: Cat Landing
description: With this ability, you can jump from the highest buildings and be completely unharmed if you land on your feet. You can jump from an airplane and be perfectly fine by landing on your feet. If you don't land on your feet, the impact of the fall could hurt you.
summary: The ability to be unharmed from any landing if you land on your feet.
strengths: Not get hurt from the impact of the fall.
Jump from the highest places and be perfectly fine.
weaknesses: You have to land on you feet, or the impact of the fall might hurt you.

name: Light Speed
