description: When used, every person place or thing will seem to stop moving except for you. Breathing in air will feel like breathing in molasses and the ground will feel like ice, but you will put out so much force that  your touch will be able to destroy objects.
summary: The ability to exist on the borderline of time temporarily by moving fast as the speed of light
strengths: Stop existance
Destroy anything with a touch
Become more powerful then The Juggernaut
weaknesses: Hard to breathe
Very hard to control movement
And could destroy someone you care about

name: Hot Matter Manipulation
description: With this power, you can control anything! The catch: It needs to have a lot (or at least a mild amount) of heat in it for you to control it. You control matter with varied difficulty, but the less heat it has, the harder it is to control, until it's impossible. This means you can control anything that is hot easily, but beginners only start with atoms and not subatomic particles.
summary: The ability to manipulate all matter, provided it has some degree of high temperature.
strengths: Control things like steam, plasma, lava and things at thousands of degrees easily!
Control matter as hot as the sun.
You can also control colder matter, but it could be very difficult.
weaknesses: You can also control colder matter, but it could be very difficult.
You can't make things hot with this power, only control them if they are there.
Useless in a really cold scenario, unless it has something warm in it.

name: Accelerated Evolution
description: There are certain places on the planet where humans cannot live easily. Accelerated Evolution allows the user to manifest ways to get around that. Gills and webs for under the sea, reduced water usage for the desert, more efficient lungs and a hairy coat for Mt. Everest, etc.
summary: The ability to quickly develop adaptations to harsh environments
strengths: Never be hot or cold again
Be the best mountain climber, marathon runner, etc.
Live comfortably anywhere
weaknesses: Pretty disturbing to watch
Obvious
Involuntary

name: Elemental Body
description: The usable elements are fire, water, earth, wind, spirit, ice, energy, metal and life. You can use the element to make constructs of the same element i.e. a wind shield, an earth horse. Once the user loses conciousness, the wreathing element will disappear. Each element has an ability that goes with it: fire-heat resistance; water-water breating; earth-stone skin; spirit-6th sense; ice-cold resistance; metal-iron skin; energy-high metabolism; life-living things.
summary: The ability to wreath the body in an element of choice
strengths: It is a great offensive and defensive power
It can be used to create physical constructs of elements
Each element has an accompaning ability that is accessed by constant use of the element
weaknesses: Takes a while to switch from one element to another
Once an element is unused, the constructs made with that element disappear
Constant use of a certain element will weaken the other elements or change them

name: Energy Claws
description: With this power you can create huge waves of blue cutting energy from your fingers, just by moving them. Those waves are one of the sharpest blades that ever existed and they are powerful enough to cut adamantium. If you don't be careful while using this power you will destroy everything around you in seconds.
summary: The ability to create huge waves of cutting energy from your fingers just by moving them.
strengths: You can destroy nearly anything
The energy waves are really big, and dodging them is not easy.
weaknesses: Hard to control.
Greatly tires you.

name: Clear Pyrokinesis
description: Blue fire is supposed to be the hottest flame humans can produce with modern technology. Well, now you can with your mind create a flame that burns hotter than any other flame. However, the flame has no visible coloring on any type of vision, not even thermal imaging.
summary: The ability to create and control fire that is so hot it cannot be seen
strengths: You can use a flame that trumps all flames that have come before it.
weaknesses: Not even you can see the flame.
Your enemies will be laughing until they're burned by an invisible flame.
'Hahaha! Your stupid power has no effect on me! You're totally use-AAAAH WHY DOES IT BURN?!?

name: Naturespeak
description: One with this ability can communicate psychically with nature itself. This means that one can become instantly familiar with his surroundings, talk to plants and tell them to grow, and even talk to the skies to change the weather. In addition, the connection is so deep that the earth can respond to one's emotions and desires (blossoming with flowers and calming weather when happy, making skies stormy when angry, shifting the landscape to gain the advantage in a fight, etc. )
summary: The ability to communicate psychically with nature
strengths: Communicate with and command earth's environment psychically
Earth responds to your emotions
Earth will defend you from potential threats (and is aware of how to tell friend from foe)
weaknesses: If your power is weak, emotions may overreact and the power may go out of control
Doesn't allow you to communicate with animals (go figure, hehe)
DO NOT pollute if you have this power

name: Voice Of Destruction
description: This ability is a complex one, in that it is both sonic and not sonic. It is sonic because it indicates the voice, and yet not sonic because it does not amplify sound in order to attack. Instead it converts the user's voice into entropic kinetic energy. In effect, it destroys or distorts matter anytime the user opens his mouth to utter a sound. Even a loud sigh disrupts the air. In addition, it makes the user's voice harsh and dissonant to anyone within range of hearing it.
summary: The ability to produce a powerful and destructive sound with one's voice
strengths: Voice disintegrates matter for as long as you speak (and the louder, the greater the damage)
Surpass any silly sound resistance or manipulation
Disorient hearing beings without need for sonic-level volume
weaknesses: Invulnerability (until the power develops to the higher levels)
Vibration Channeling and Protected Hearing
Until the power is honed, it is best you keep your mouth shut...

name: 12 Elements
description: My 12 elements: water, fire, earth (plants, metals, rock (processed or not)), wind/air, lightning, ice, light, darkness, spirit, illusion, creation (conjuring, inventing), and psychic (telekinesis, telepathy, levitation, foreseeing, psychic energy). The first six are easiest to master. The four after that are more difficult. The last two are the hardest to master, especially psychic. Creation allows the user to conjure solid objects only, but can be used to conjure some of the other elements.
summary: The ability to manipulate my 12 elements
strengths: Lots of elements to control
Some elements are easy to control
weaknesses: Some of the elements are hard to control

name: Night Color Vision
description: You can reap the awe inspiring benefits of this superpower. You can finally see the beauty and colors of a moonbow, instead of seeing things in black and white in the dark. However, this is not night vision. Night vision is black and white, although clearer. Special cameras are the only anything that can detect this awesome spectrum of colors. You will finally see the different colors of a nocturnal rainbow! Enjoy.
summary: The ability to see in color at night even in really dim light
strengths: See the color spectrum at night! See in color even in dim light.
See the colors of a moonbow. See a nocturnal rainbow instead of a white streak of light.
The perfect compliment to night vision(which is colorless).
weaknesses: The colors may not be too bright in a moonbow
You don't have night vision
You don't see better at night or see shapes any better

name: Elemental Resistance
description: A lesser form of invulnerability. Allows the user to completely resist any elemental damage, no matter how great. Does not apply to physical damage unless elementally charged in some way.
summary: The ability to resist any elemental force (fire, cold, lightning, etc. )
strengths: Can't be hurt by fire.
Can't be hurt by cold.
Can survive lightning strikes.
weaknesses: You can still get shot.
You can still get stabbed to death.
Only works for the five elements: Fire, Water, Earth, Air, and Lightning damage

name: Positive Compulsions
description: You will be compelled to do exactly the perfect thing at any given moment. For example, if a building near you is going to be set on fire at 5:00pm, from the time you wake up till the time the fire is set you will have the urge to go to the building and stop the fire before it gets out of control--even though you don't know about the fire yet. You won't be compelled to do anything you are incapable of doing, like running in the building at 5:20 and carry out 50 people on your back.
summary: The ability to have the urge to do whatever leads to the overall best outcome
strengths: Always "know" to bring an umbrealla even if seems like a sunny day
Can't lose in a video game if you don't even need to learn the controls
If you meet your soulmate you won't let them slip through your fingers
weaknesses: People may suspect you setting things up so you can fix them
May be compelled to do odd and seemingly pointless things
You might not like the Greater Good (Charmed / Smallville)

name: Cryokinesis
description: This is the power to generate and manipulate ice and cold. Lower the temperature to as much as -200 degrees Celsius. Form constructs like armor, weapons, shields, barriers and slides by freezing moisture in the air. Control ice, snow, hail, and cold air with frigid precision. Even start avalanches and snowstorms, given the right environment and proper training.
summary: The ability to generate and manipulate cold and ice
strengths: Use cold and ice as a powerful weapon
Cold Immunity (Immune to own power and external cold)
Pretty impressive ability (even potentially alter weather or stop all activity in the region)
weaknesses: Not particularly spectacular
Heat and fire are a big weakness
Fueled by concentration, not emotion

name: Super Jumping
description: This power allows you to jump to a height of up to a mile. This is useful to get an aerial view of a target. A direct landing on a target causes them damage, yet you will be unharmed. When you land, the impact will cause tremors that extend to 3 miles away from the landing zone. When in midair, you are immune to air resistance. Plus, it's fun!
summary: The ability to jump to great heights and cause tremors when you land.
strengths: Jump to a height of a mile.
You can cause tremors.
It's Fun!
weaknesses: None

name: Physics Distortion Waves
description: With this power you disperse waves of energy like substance that has the ability to distort the physics of whatever it hits. For instance, if you shoot someone, anything you can thing of (that is against the laws of physics) will happen. The person could turn inside out, his weapon could melt, he could be frozen right at the spot! But there's a catch, the result is unpredictable. So you could make him a living fire ball, or if you hit yourself you could turn into talking chicken!
summary: The ability to send out waves that can distort physics
strengths: Freeze enemy's in their tracks
Break the laws of physics to be better at things, like sports
You could make yourself fly
weaknesses: Make enemy's more powerful
Possibly freeze or doom yourself
Effects unpredictable

name: Fire Manipulation
description: A person with this power can use existing heat source & amplify it & manipulate it. They can't create fire, just control it. Craft it into shapes & move it. You can even surround yourself, but you can still get burnt & die of smoke inhalation.
summary: The ability to mentally control fire
strengths: Control fire
Amplify heat source
Move & make shapes out of fire
weaknesses: Not immune to burns
Not immune to smoke inhalation

name: Vehicle Transformation
description: This power allows you turn a vehicle into another vehicle. Got an old, battered car that needs replacing? Just turn it into a brand new one, whatever kind of car you want! Or you could turn a rotting rowboat into a motor boat, or a cruise shp! Need to go into battle? Turn your vehicle into a tank, a fighter jet, a battleship! Turn a bad guy's get-away car into an old horse and carriage. Respond to an emergency with a police car, ambulance, or fire truck. You can even use a rocket.
summary: The ability to turn any vehicle into any other vehicle
strengths: Free Ferraris, cruise ships, and private jets from broken cars, rowboats, etc.
Fight on land, on sea, and in the air
Make enemy vehicles useless
weaknesses: Can only transform vehicles into other vehicles
Can't turn something into a vehicle that doesn't exist

name: Liquid Neon Hydrant
description: With this superpower, you can shoot liquid neon out of your palms and freeze things instantly. You can shoot up to 25 gallons of liquid neon per second. You are limited to 1000 gallons of neon per day. At first, you can only dispense 10 ounces per second of liquid neon.
summary: The ability to shoot liquid neon out of your palms and freeze things instantly.
strengths: Shoot liquid neon out of your palms.
Freeze things.
It's supercold.
weaknesses: You have to practice to develop this superpower.

name: Immunity
description: You will never get sick ever again.  You will always be healthy in terms of viruses and diseases.
summary: The ability to be immune to all viruses and diseases.
strengths: Never have the flu, a cold, or get sick for that matter.
Immune to cancer
Less co-pays!
weaknesses: You can still get injured (but with no infection!)

name: Water Adaptation
description: Also, when you are in the water flaps of skin will come out from between each finger and toe in order to increase your swimming ability.
summary: The ability to be able to breathe underwater and withstand any level of water pressure
strengths: You can swim better.
You can stay underwater as long as you need.
weaknesses: The pressure part only applies to water.

name: Ecokinesis
description: Anything that has to do with nature like "storms" or anything that relates to storms and their effects you can control with this power. You can become a "Force of Nature."
summary: The ability to become one with nature and control it. "Force of Nature"
strengths: You can control the weather
Dazzle your onlookers
weaknesses: Can get out of control

name: Alter
description: With Alter, you can change into nearly any other substance. Don't like all the traffic? Become fire and melt everything in your way. Gone fishing and dropped your stuff in a lake? Become iron and sink to the bottom, then become air and float back up. Other forms include Ether, Sand, Light, Argon, and Electricity. You always retain your shape, however.
summary: The ability to turn your body into different substances
strengths: Gain a variety of powers
Limited by your creativity
weaknesses: You retain your human shape

name: Hammerspace Manipulation
description: Hammerspace is, in essence, a storehouse of a dimension. Thus, if you have absolute control of it, you are able to do things like produce things from thin air, make objects vanish, and even teleport by putting yourself into hammerspace.
summary: The ability to completely control hammerspace.
strengths: Teleporting is possible.
You can produce things from thin air.
You can create a void that sucks in things like bullets into hammerspace.
weaknesses: You're not immortal.
You're easily susceptible to sniper rifles and the latter.
If you don't concentrate on what you're pulling out of hammerspace, you might not get what you need.

name: Summon Transportation
description: With this power you can summon any form of transportation such as vehicles and mounts. The transportation can be for land, air, water, or even space and does not have to exist normally such as a UFO or dragon. The rides can only be used for transportation purposes meaning that you can not make the dragons breath fire on people or run over things in your vehicle. You can unsummon the transportations at will as long as you can survive without them, so you can not unsummon UFO in Space.
summary: The ability to summon any form of transportation.
strengths: Always have a way to travel.
Have a better ride than your friends or enemies.
Create your own collection of vehicles.
weaknesses: Have to know how to drive what you summon.
Can only be used for transportation purposes.
Larger forms of transportation are harder to summon.

name: Hands Of Hephaestus
description: Using your hand to grab, or hold, or to place it, the area underneath it will melt, and it will be able to hold to only you. Think of your hands as anvils to metal only, being able to shape small chunks of it and even add it together. Although if you attemp to touch/melt copper or iron your hands will burn up and have serious burns for 3 weeks. You can also cool the metal on demand.
summary: The ability to melt and cool a metal surface with your hand.
strengths: Create a weapon anytime.
Could stop bullets or any metal weapon by putting hands in the way.
Open doors and metal boxes by sticking hands through.
weaknesses: Could try to do it without knowing it's copper or iron you'll burn up.
May not always have metal near you.
May be attacked by wooden or plastic weapons and rubber bullets.

name: Universal Armor
description: Iron Man? Not if you don't want to be. Make armor of elements (minerals), fluids (any for of water, acids, gases), base energy (sunlight, fire). Cover yourself with iron, diamond, ice, fire, the list is almost endless. You could increase your armor size if there is enough of the element around you. If someone counters your armor you could shed it and conjure up new armor. Do you like money? Your shed armor can be collected and sold.
summary: The ability to use basic natural elements, minerals, fluids and energy as armor.
strengths: You can make armour of any single element, energy, fluid on earth
Gaseous armour give you the ability of flight, hard mineral superstrength, energy speed
Each element you use allows you immunity against that element while in armour
weaknesses: One element at a time & the element must occur in nature. Alloys like steel are prohibited
You are taking the elements from the earth and your surroundings, be careful of what you deplete
Another element could counter your armour

name: Ultimate Reasoning
description: Described in Sherlock Holmes as "The ultimate reasoner would be able to infer the existence of Niagara falls from seeing a raindrop on the other side of the world." It's like sudoku. Most people only know a few numbers and where they fit and so are occasionally able to deduce something, but the ultimate reasoner would be able to, using only a handful of numbers, figure out everything about everything in the universe. This person would then be able to predict the future, and calculate the past.
summary: The ability to litterally infer everything possible from what you already know.
strengths: Predict the future.
Know everything.
Know the consequences of all actions, so they can effectively do anything.
weaknesses: Become alienated.
World may lose meaning.
Depends on deterministic universe for effectiveness.

name: Spectrumal Vision
description: You can have the power to fire beams of colorful solid light beams that produce various effects through force of will. Here are the variety of effects: green -disintegration, black - corruption, pink - confusion, yellow - paralysis, red - burnt skeletons, orange - blindness, blue - freeze vision, white - healing, violet - seduction, and gray - petrification.
summary: The ability to fire a laser of multicolored light-based energy from your eyes.
strengths: The effect of the color brown can turn anyone into dust.
The effect of the color indigo can cause your opponents to dissapear.
weaknesses: None.

name: Kinetic Energy Redirection
description: You can take kinetic energy from any object and take it for your self or redirect it inti something else. Kinetic energy can be taken from physical movement of something, down to the molecular movements of particles(heat)
summary: The ability to absorb/redirect kinetic energy from anything
strengths: You can become really fast, really quick
You can increase the heat or cool things quickly (combustion to absolute zero)
You can stop a fast object dead in it's tracks
weaknesses: You may be propeled involuntarily
You may suddenly burst into flames or freeze
Contact is needed

name: Seismic Shockwave
description: A person with this power can create shockwaves that can travel through any medium including the earth, water, and air. At first the user can only disorient people but soon if they realize their destructive potential they can create shockwaves that are on par with grenades and soon shockwaves that can cause tsunamis and earthquakes.
summary: The ability to create seismic shockwaves that can travel through earth, sea, and air
strengths: As long as you aren't in a vacuum this can be used
You control the epicenter of where the shockwave is
It is a AoE effect
weaknesses: Another Pro: It's invisible unless you are making earthquakes or tsunamis
It is an AoE effect(you can hit your own teammates)

name: Null Vision
description: The null vision is capable of negating your foe's powers and abilities, whether they are good or evil, by firing put lavender beams from your eyes at them. Can be temporary or permanently.
summary: The ability to fire light purplish beams from your eyes that will disable your opponent's powers.
strengths: Whether your foes' powers are permanently or temporary disabled, you can devastate your opponent.
Can utterly take advantage of your foes.
weaknesses: It does not work on ghosts
If the target has protection against negation

name: Fresh Breath
description: Using your own powerful lungs you take in a mighty breath, and exhale it into a chilling wind. You form ice all over anything your chilling breath caresses. Though it will not automatically kill opponents.
summary: The ability to breath a chilling cold air that will form ice whatever it touches.
strengths: Freeze opponents.
Put out fires.
Let it snow!
weaknesses: Can be used accidentally.
No effect on icy opponents.
In effective if you can't breath out of your mouth.

name: Mystic Language
description: Ancient mystics knew that all things have their own language and that if they could learn those languages, they could speak to and control them. This ability allows you to access some of the knoweldge of ancient mystics. Through mental exercises or even hypnosis you might be able to learn some of the languages of things around you. For example, you might learn the languages of trees,fire,rocks, or even time.
summary: The ability to know the languages of all things.
strengths: You could converse with things around you
The more you learn the more powerful you will become
weaknesses: It takes time to learn even the simplest languages.

name: Tactile Telekinesis
description:
Tactile Telekinesis is the ability to move objects with your mind, but you have to touch them first.

Uses of this power would be firing projectiles from you hand without having to throw them. Rocketing people away with a hand to hand attack or if they hit/touch you. Jumping through a window and firing the shards of glass back at your pursuers. 

You can use this power for flight by riding an object you are controling. You can only control something for a limited time before needing to touch it
summary: The ability to move objects with your mind but you have to touch them first
strengths: Versatile
You can make anything into a weapon
Can be used defensively and offensivley
weaknesses: Need to touch objects first
Limited time frame of control
Need objects at hand to have a ranged attack

name: Apportation
description: Similar to object teleportation this lets you bring objects to you but this is different in execution. For example you can apport an avalanche of concrete and road signs to rain down from the sky as long as these objects were withing 50 km from you and you have enough room to not get hit. If you wanted to you can also apport your enemies so they can't escape. In addition you can apport objects into your hand. However there is no distinction when apporting so you can't do precision apports.
summary: The ability to apport any object into your general location as long as the object is within 50 km from you
strengths: Rain debris on unsuspecting enemies.
Don't need to know the location of the items-just think what the general shape looks like
"You will not evade me"
weaknesses: Can only bring objects to you--and cannot send them back to where they came from
Can't teleport organs--because you might get your own-but can apport people--but might get the twin

name: Spontaneous Cryostasis
description: This power is really "cool"! Hahaha! It's a joke, see? You know, freezing, "cool", it's funny right? No?  with this power, you can freeze absolutely anything within your line of sight, just by thinking about it. Of course, some people develop a flair while using it, such as pointing at the object to be frozen. This power can be used to freeze air as well, creating ice out of water vapor or changing the weather.
summary: The ability to freeze anything
strengths: Never have to actually fight
Never be too hot
Never have melty ice cream
weaknesses: You don't inherently have immunity to cold
If you think about popsicles and look at your friend...

name: Energy Bender
description: (This power does not have an evolved level) we bent not the elements, but the energy within ourselves.  With this power you can transfer knowledge by physical contact, remove bending permanently by physical contact, restore bending by physical contact. This power easily corrupts its user. If the person is even slightly weak, or even bendable, then they will be infectedby by the one they are bending. Know your history
summary: The ability to become a energy bender from avatar the last air bender the animated television series
strengths: You can remove bending permanently by physical contact
You restore bending by physical contact
You transfer knowledge by physical contact
weaknesses: This power easily corrupts its user
You need physical contact at all times
This power does not have an evolved level

name: Power Improvement
description: One with this ability thinks of a superhuman power (or physical feature) that they currently possess, and in an instant, the ability upgrades/downgrades into something more fun, more desirable (more manageable, powerful or effective). Say, for example, one had the power CrackTart. Instead of making poptarts come out of their behind, their subconscious desire to have a cooler power would allow them to instead summon poptarts from anywhere, making them as hot or cold as desired in the process.
summary: The ability to turn a no-good power into something one would consider much more useful
strengths: Make useless powers more cool, fun, effective or powerful
Powers that have harmful side effects will be made more manageable
This power cannot be stolen, negated or mimicked (and prevents the same effects on the target power)
weaknesses: Guided by the subconscious (even with Con Negation)
Only effects one power until developed
Will NEVER develop faster than normal, even with Power Negation

name: Magician's Power
description: The Magicians Power is the ability to manipulate magical energy. Magicians draw energy from force lines, streams of magical energy that run through the earth and sky. Once they have this energy, they can use it for magic or store it inside them for later use. Some of the basic ways they can use the energy is levitation, fire-starting,and dimension-hopping. But there are hundreds of other ways they can use it too. The best part is that magicians dont need anything but their minds to do magic.
summary: The ability to manipulate magical energy
strengths: You can do magic
There are hundreds of different spells you can do, and you don't need anything but your mind
You might have the Magician's Touch.
weaknesses: Hopping to a dimension with few force lines
You have to teach yourself magic through experiments

name: Flux
description: This ability allows the user to continue any source of energy at maximum capacity until it taps out. With this, one could keep a fire going underwater, or keep a person moving until they can no longer muster up the energy even to breathe (or for their heart to beat). As one can imagine, this ability is especially effective against superhumans with energy abilities (as the use of energy abilities often exhausts the user after extensive use).
summary: The ability to induce the continual flow of any form of energy
strengths: Continue the flow of any kind of energy (heat, light, kinetic, metabolic, psionic,electrical, etc. )
Keeps the energy flow efficient (no disruptions of energy flow until no energy is LEFT)
Can be used positively (heightened stamina, cognition, etc.) or negative (forced energy discharge)
weaknesses: Does not provide perpetual energy (just maximizes flow, and flow efficiency until source taps out)
Does not allows you to otherwise manipulate energy (cannot suppress or absorb energy, etc. )
Does not work if the system is already at peak operation capacity

name: Pluviokinesis
description: You can make it rain any time of any day, even if it's sunny outside. You can also stop, start, increase, decrease, and manipulate rain. You can focus rain onto one person or the entire world if you wanted too. You can even change the molecular structure of rain, making it poison rain, or acid rain, or even electric rain.
summary: The ability to control rain
strengths: You can manipulate rain.
You can change the molecular structure of rain.
Put out fires, start rainstorms... The possibilities are endless.
weaknesses: Unless I'm mistaken.... There isn't any bad side that I can see.

name: Anti Theft
description: A person with this power cannot have anything taken from them unless it was allowed. Normally only a defensive type power that bends reality to make it impossible for anyone to steal from you, it can also be used offensively. For example, you are breathing my air. No one can take your life unless you willed it and your belongings are protected. This power can be used to protect other people-cannot take family away. However, you cannot bait people to steal your stuff-counts as permission.
summary: The ability to never have anything taken from you without your permission
strengths: No one can steal from you, unless you let them steal it-protects your belongings
No one can take your life away unless you willed it. -works on concepts like freedom and life
Can expand to things that belong to everyone like air
weaknesses: People can still give you things, like pain
You must have a clear concept of what is yours in order to make it work
People can destroy stuff you have instead of taking them

name: Static Wind
description: You are creative in control of all things related to wind and electricity, you can Fire a horizontal electrical cyclone of air which can strike enemies and annihilates everything in its path. The electrically-charged tornado is generated exactly at the point where you stand, while in you are in a long distance forward.
summary: The ability to concentrate a huge wave of electromagnetic wind that lifts and shocks the opponent.
strengths: Works well against water-type supervillains.
weaknesses: Not effective on wood and steel.

name: Cold Matter Manipulation
description: With this power, you can control anything! The catch: It needs to have no (or very little)heat in it for you to control it. You control matter with varied difficulty, but the more heat it has, the harder it is to control, until it's impossible. This means you can control anything that is cold easily, but beginners only start with atoms and not subatomic particles.
summary: The ability to manipulate all matter, provided it has some degree of low temperature.
strengths: Control things like liquid helium, liquid nitrogen, dry ice and things at absolute zero easily!
Control matter as cold as ice.
You can also control warmer matter, but it could be very difficult.
weaknesses: Beginners can't control subatomic particles, but start at atomic level.
You can't make things cold with this power, only control them if they are there.
Useless in a really hot scenario, unless it has something cool in it.

name: Temperature Control
description: The user of this ability has the power to control the temperature of anything. They could target a specific person or object, or target everything within a certain radius of them. The farther away they change the temperature from the objects normal temperature the more the user must exert themselves. This power could have many applications if the user knows what they are doing. They could lower the temperature of every object and person in the area to absolute zero, effectively freezing time.
summary: The ability to control the temperature of anything including people, objects, surrounding air, etc.
strengths: Other powers could stem from this one like freezing time(explained above), weather control, and more
It has a very versatile and powerful amount of applications
Always be at a comfortable temperature
weaknesses: Hard to control
Must be able to see their target (unless targeting an area)

name: Ballistic Wind
description: Ballistic Wind is the ability to make bullets out of air. For a volume of air to act like a rifle bullet in speed, accuracy, firing rate, and etc, it requires the ability user to concentrate. More practice, less time the ability users has to concentrate over time. Depending on what kind of bullet the user wants (from a pin to a cannon fire) ithe amount of concentration varies.
summary: The ability to make bullets out of air
strengths: No need for a weapon.
weaknesses: Less practice, more time required to make a bullet to fire.

name: Molecular Power
description: With a wave of your hands, atoms of an object or person freeze (stop moving) for a limited time or explode.
summary: The ability to freeze atoms and explode atoms.
strengths: Powerful
Annoyances can be dealt with
Fun
weaknesses: Strong Emotions can trigger power
Dangerous
Limit to area of power

name: Clear Flame
description: The flame literally has no color and heals any living organic matter that it touches. The flame will heal anything up to near-fatal wounds and weak diseases.
summary: The ability to create and control a flame that heals
strengths: Heal your allies with something that looks like it would kill.
weaknesses: Automatically heals living organic matter and cannot burn it.

name: Statue Sentinels
description: Statue Sentinels are stone statues you can summon to protect a specific area. They can be people, animas, or mythical creatures. When an enemy or someone with bad intentions comes within 50 feet of a Sentinel, it will animate and attack that person. The Sentinel's are still made of stone, so they're very hard to destroy but can be a bit slow. They will continue to guard an area until you dismiss them or they're destroyed.
summary: The ability to create statues to guard an area
strengths: Statue Sentinels offer strong protection for an area
They look like statues, so an enemy won't suspect anything until it's too late
You can guard as many areas as you want
weaknesses: You can only have up to 10 Sentinels guard the same area
Sentinels won't attack anyone outside of their 50 foot radius
Because they're made of stone, Sentinels can have slower reactions

name: Omni Forcefield
description: Say there is an intergalactic problem and ships are shooting the Earth. If you have the power of Omni-Forcefield, you can shield the whole Earth.
summary: The ability to create extremely large force fields.
strengths: Spectacular defensive power.
weaknesses: Not the best offensive power.

name: Dust Manipulation
description: With this power you can control dust such as sand soil dirt natural dust of any other small particle that fits in that category this power can be used for many this such as taking the dust off of an object of cleaning the air it can also be used as offensive by making duststorms or sandstorms
summary: The ability to manipulate The Particles Of Dust
strengths: Can clean the air
Can blind people with dust
weaknesses: Sometime dust goes evertywhere and can attack you

name: Space Time Forcefield
description: A space-time forcefield works by sending any physical attack-a bullet,a sword,someone punching you,a thrown chunk of building-to some other time and place in the space-time continuum. This other time and place is random every second and beyond your control. Thrown explosives that hit you will be affected if they don't go off on impact. Things like nanites are too small to be affected unless they form a solid mass. Water or air attacks even if shaped to look solid will still hurt you.
summary: The ability to withstand physical attacks by sending the attack somewhere/some time else.
strengths: Say goodbye to the Hulk.
Stand under an asteroid.
The look on your opponent's faces as his watches his demon sword vanish.
weaknesses: There's always a chance a grenade could reappear right where it disappeared.
Everything sent to another other time or/and place could damage the continuum.
Energy attacks still hurt you.

name: Perfect Counter Ability
description: A person with this power has an everchanging ability that instantly becomes any ability that can counter another superpowered being's ability. For example, against a time manipulator, this power will prevent alterations in space-time or copy their alterations. Against a pyrokinetic, it will either become fireproof, fire control, cyrokinesis, or eating flames. The counter power you get is random. You can choose which ability you want to counter. Most of the time, the counter only stops the power.
summary: The ability to always have a random ability to perfectly counter anyone's single ability
strengths: You can beat any superpowered being with a single power
You can beat a group of superpowered beings with the same single power
You can choose which ability this counter ability works on
weaknesses: Can only work on one ability-less useful against someone with multiple powers
You can't get this power twice(unless you are WHD)-no offense just a joke
The counter ability is random and can be different every time you fight the same person

name: Cloud Hopper
description: With this ability, you can summon a cloud that reaches earth. You ride the cloud and it takes you to the clouds in the sky. You can actually touch the clouds. You can jump on the clouds in the sky and it acts like a trampoline. You can climb clouds to reach higher clouds. You can sleep on a cloud. The clouds always move and change shape. If you fall from the cloud, a cloud will go right under you and bring you back to the sky. You can ride the cloud to go back to earth. Time waster!
summary: The ability to go to the clouds and jump on, walk on, sleep on them as though they were tangible.
strengths: You can jump on clouds.
You can sleep on a cloud.
No one knows where you are (except pilots and passengers).
weaknesses: Time waster!
If it's a clear sky.
You can't change the shape of the clouds in the sky.

name: Flamethrower Palms
description: Be careful of what you're doing, so you don't accidently set anything on fire. Don't get too upset or mad and make sure you dont set yourself on fire, because you are not fireproof.
summary: The ability to have a stream of fire come out of your palms
strengths: Flying using the flames
Blowing stuff up
weaknesses: Setting something on fire you didn't mean to (like yourself)
Blowing up buildings
Running out of flames

name: Iceworks
description: Cryotechnis, freezing glory, cal them whatever you want, but these ice-cold energy globules that varied in degrees of power and intensity that'll obey you mentally, traveling whereever you direct them, arranging themselves in balls, streamers, and other shapes, and exploding whenever you wish for. These combinations could result in anything from a multitude of light colorful sparkles capable of freezing anything & anyone around you whenever you throw these things at them.
summary: The ability to generate plasmatic energy of the cold which you could fire your hands as any other shape.
strengths: You will be able to generate the largest amounts of ice and snow.
You can have the potential to detonate matter at a sub-zero-atomic level.
weaknesses: Won't work in the summertime, but it can work indoors.

name: Omni Liquid Manipulation
description: You have complete control over all liquids: Water, tears, rain, battery acid, blood, tree sap, honey, milk, lava, petrol, you name it. You have the ability to pull blood out of a man's skull, stop volcanoes from erupting, force volcanoes to erupt, move the entire planet to avoid being hit by a comet, stop rain from falling, cause rain to fall. This power does require intense training before you can execute some of the more complicated feats, but when mastered you become a god... Or more.
summary: The ability to control all liquids
strengths: No more rain on your picnic or romantic date
You can control yourself and never have to bleed
Awesome party tricks
weaknesses: People will begin to rely on you to fix world problems
You can still get charged for murder
Moving the entire planet could alter its solar path

name: Timeless Lightning
description: The lightning will cause whatever it hits to be frozen in time for half an hour. It will also be a bright pink in color. Using the lightning will also drain away your stamina.
summary: The ability to fire lightning that freezes time from one's fingertips
strengths: Keep enemies frozen to deal with them one by one.
weaknesses: Bright pink lightning might look ridiculous.
Can't use the lightning rapidly.

name: Timebombing
description: This power grants the user the ability to create bombs that can freeze time for a preset amount
summary: The ability to create bombs that freeze time
strengths: Can freeze time
Good for escaping tight situations
Keeps everything outside the field frozen
weaknesses: Can only freeze time
Must be specific about amount of time you want to be frozen

name: Flaming Spikes
description: You can snap in a fit of rage and start firing long, sharp, burning spikes that will scorch and impale the opponent. The spikes are capable of igniting anything in their path, including burning up walls and ceilings when it sticks to them. Sometimes, the spikes are emitted from your body smeared with a toxic matter in order to spread infection throughout the wound.
summary: The ability to shoot fiery spikes that will burn & impale the opponent.
strengths: Effective against plant and bug type foes.
weaknesses: None

name: Hydromaniacal Form
description: With this ability, you transform into a form which grows and gains power from water. You become a monstrous elemental formed out of water. As you absorb water (by bathing in it, or touching it), you grow, and gain abilities such as blasting water, water-breathing, and controlling water. You are susceptible to freezing temperatures, however, and must revert if you begin to freeze.
summary: The ability to transform into a state where you grow and gain power from water.
strengths: Absorb water, which increases your size and power.
You gain abilities such as water-breathing, water-blasts, and manipulating water.
Bathing in the ocean would give you an unlimited amount of power.
weaknesses: Freezing cause you to revert to normal form.
If you revert, you lose all of the abilities and size that you gained while in this form.
Absorbing the ocean could become dangerous

name: Deconstructive Energy
description: With this power, you can send out waves of energy that can deconstructe anything they come into contact with. This extends to the ability to break down other objects like concrete and steel to elements such as breaking the bonds of water molecules to make gas. You can even negate gravity by breaking down gravitons.
summary: The ability to send waves of deconstructive energy.
strengths: Deconstruct objects
Bust down any door
weaknesses: Range is limited to 320 meters
Power is useless if hit by a reserved force
Elemental break downs require energy and control

name: Matter Absorption
description: With this ability, you are able to absorb the physical structure of any material at will. If you touch flame, you become living and burning flame. If you touch metal, you can become dense, organic metal. Your cells absorb the structure of matter but remain connected, so if you absorb water, your cells won't drift apart.
summary: The ability to absorb the structure of different materials.
strengths: You can become metal from a bullet.
Turning into air provides transportation.
Your body becomes your weapon.
weaknesses: You can become combustible.
You can be lost in the ocean or the atmosphere as a liquid or gas.
You could cause damage as certain substances ie. Fire, acid, etc.

name: Arctic Touch
description: With this power, you can flash freeze someone by just slapping them. When you rub your hands together, they start to glow a frost blue. Then, the next thing you touch will freeze instantly. The more force applied, the better the effect. If you slap someone with the power in effect, the person will be frozen solid, and is given the appearance of being slapped. Do not confuse slapping with punching. If you punch someone with the power in effect, they won't freeze. They will transform into ice!
summary: The ability to freeze someone solid with just one touch.
strengths: Stops enemies instantly.
Great for rigging floors.
They can never thaw unless the person who froze them says "Unfreeze. "
weaknesses: Can be lethal if used out of anger.

name: Reverse Butterfly Effect
description: The Butterfly Effect says that if a butterfly flaps its wings, a storm occurs on the other side. A superhuman with this power has this ability in reverse. When a change occurs around the user, the user is able to use that change to enhance themselves. Example: The wind blows and the user is able to increase their speed OR fly. Abilities must be related to the changes: If a fan is on, the user may not get fire powers. If a fire is on, the user can have fire powers. Powers leave when changes do.
summary: The ability to make changes to yourself relative to the changes occurring around you.
strengths: Makes you close to unbeatable in hand-to-hand combat.
You can have powers similar to and (slightly) stronger than the powers of your opponent.
weaknesses: Powers and abilities limited by what is around you.
Powers die down as soon as the changes you are using go away.

name: Research Chemical Regeneration
description: You cancrete any research chemical out of thin air by just thinking about it. We all know that some research chemicals are difficult to obtain and that could stop important research into finding cures for illnesses and biological uses. With this superpower, these research chemicals seem to come to you and sometimes magically appear! The purity of these mentally created materials are always 99. 99% pure or purer! You can even attract gallium (an expensive and valuable element)!
summary: The ability to create any existing research chemical by just thinking.
strengths: 99. 99% purity of research chemicals or purer
Create research chemicals at will with thought
Be able to find cures for most "incurable diseases"
weaknesses: There will be issues on where you get these things from.
The pharmaceutical industry might go out of business.
The cops might arrest you if they work for evil

name: Theorem Reality
description: There have been many theories over the years, and most are still today just theories that don't work. With this ability, you just need to create a theory, explain it to yourself or others, then do your theory and it will succeed. An example would be "If I mix water and oil with glue it will form a new and eco-friendly resource." Once you explain it, it will come true.
summary: The ability to make crazy theories that can work in real life.
strengths: This can help everyone in life.
It can make pervious theories that failed work as explained.
weaknesses: You have to explain your theories before they can come true.

name: Shadow Empathy
description: Humanity has a natural fear of the dark, with a few marked exceptions. A Shadow Empath has an emotional link to shadows; darkness will always be found near them like water at the beach. This means that when they are distressed, afraid, or angry, the shadows will rise up and flood the area. The target of the negative emotions gets cut off from light, sound, and air so long as the user is distressed. With practice, the user may even be able to shape the shadows into tendrils or shadowballs.
summary: The ability to possess an empathic connection to darkness
strengths: When distressed, shadows will rise to protect
Cuts off all light, sound, and air to the target of the negative emotions
With time, the user can form tendrils or shadowballs
weaknesses: Automatic, like a reflex
May not be able to save an airless victim in time
With darkness surrounding you all the time, might become ostracized

name: Pyric Mimicry
description: Your flesh and blood body is limited; subjective to gravity, physical damage, and other forces. Fire is nothing but energy. A person with Pyric Mimicry can turn their body into a fiery, human-shaped form at will. This renders them mostly invunerable to physical damage, lets them fly, ignite objects, and discharge blasts of fire. However, it also makes them very vunerable to cold and extinguishers.
summary: The ability to turn your body into fire
strengths: Fly
Shooting flame jets
Can use fire to heal your flame body
weaknesses: Intense cold can kill you
Fire extinguishers can kill you
Unable to safely touch people in flame form

name: Magic Creation
description: There are a lot of different types of magic. Each needs energy to work them. Anyone with Magic Creation can supply that energy and direct it into anything. People, weapons, jewelry, clothes, & anything else you can think of. For example, you could take a necklace and hold it in one hand. With the other hand you would create fire magic energy (it would appears as a glow, red in this case) and then direct it into the necklace. Now anyone who wears it can use fire magic until the energy runs out.
summary: The ability to generate different types of magic energy and store the energy in objects.
strengths: Can use any type of magic
Can give magical powers, weapons, clothing, or objects to anyone
No limit to how much energy you can make
weaknesses: There is a limit to how much energy stuff can contain though
Can't directly give yourself energy; you have to use other stuff
You can't take energy away from something. You have to use it up.

name: Mental Intunement
description: Psychics are people with their brainwaves intuned to something other than their own bodies. A pyrokinetic's brainwaves are intuned to heat and fire. A hydrokinetic's are intuned to water. This ability allows you to intune your own brainwaves to anything around you. This is basically the abilily to gain any psychic ability there is, one at a time.
summary: The ability to intune your brainwaves to different things
strengths: You can gain almost any psychic ability
Can become very powerful
weaknesses: Can only gain one power at a time.

name: Sonokinesis
description: Also known as Sonokinesis and Audiokinesis, this ability allows you to produce any level of sound and control any sounds. this ability can be used to amplify sounds, diminish or deplete sounds, block sounds, carry sounds over extreme distances and at high enough levels produce tremors through sound vibration. At extraordinary levels, may break the sound barrier, resulting in phenomenal effects (Sonic Boom, etc).
summary: The ability to generate or manipulate sound waves.
strengths: Control thunder.
Want some quiet time? Put up a sound blocking barrier.
Too cheap to pay your cell phone bill? You don't need one!
weaknesses: The body can only sustain so high a level of sound.
May unintentional harm others.
I hope your windows are shatter-proof.

name: Empathic Terrakinesis
description: Users of this ability have vast control over the earth and it's elements via empathic links to others, such as friends and family. Their ability is unaffected by a person's physical presence or absence as long as they maintain the empathic link to that person. A user can even control mineral-based substances such as ink to create drawings/tattoos. Someone can also telekinetically lift, move, and propel dirt and rocks, and move vast amounts of earth with only their mind.
summary: The ability to control geological elements and substances through empathy
strengths: A very useful power for an empath
Always be a formidable fighter, with the power of the earth under your feet, in your control!
Use this power for both self-regeneration and healing of others
weaknesses: Creation of mineral inks takes practice and knowledge

name: Aeromaniacal Form
description: With this ability, you can transform into a creature which grows and gains power from air. As you become stronger, you can cause tornadoes, cause furious winds in a certain direction, suck objects into the center of your body, and blast them out. If fire enters the spinning vortex, you can send it out as a fire storm. You also have the ability to levitate.
summary: The ability to change into a form which grows and gains power from absorbing air.
strengths: Grow and gain power / abilities from absorbing air.
Cause tornadoes, cause furious winds, suck in air, release it, and levitate.
You aren't affected by most methods of barm.
weaknesses: Once you revert, you lose all the effects you gained while in this form.
You are susceptible to mental harm and psychic attacks.
You can only levitate to a certain height above the ground. (Depending on your size. )

name: Shadow Soldier
description: With this ability, you can make your shadow 3D, solid & have it completely under control. While your shadow is doing stuff it would have all the powers of a shadow mimic, but it can be separated from the wall. Your shadow does have a will of its own. Its only will is to follow your commands, so you don't have to always focus on it. You can tell it to do anything from making you sandwich to beating up someone, it's fair game. When your shadow is doing something for you, you don't have a shadow.
summary: The ability to control your own shadow.
strengths: When people ask "Where's your shadow?" you can say he's out
Always have a friend. That just happens to be under your control.
Have you own servant with powers.
weaknesses: When using your power, your shadow is gone
If there is no light touching you, your shadow fades just as it does normally

name: Phantasm
description: By utilizing electical power to speed up molecular motion one could phase through solids, merge with liquids, vanish into the air, etc. Could render earthly attacks useless like fire, water/ice/wind, weapon basically tangible techniques. Spacial distortions, voids, time and even sound and light can still damage.
summary: The ability to accelerate molecules to acquire a ghost effect.
strengths: Contact with enemies can cause seizures
Can be used as a possession
Others can be made this way through contact
weaknesses: Avoid touching loved ones
May accidentally phase through the ground
Anything that can damage can also trap you in this state

name: Air Empowerment
description: The person with this power is able to gain abilities and superpowers depending on the quality of air that he or she breathes in. If the air they breathe in clean mountain air, they will get superhuman abilities, if they breathe in air with only moderate or little amounts of pollutants they will only get enhanced capabilities. If they are exposed to air with high smoke and pollutant content they will be powerless
summary: The ability to be empowered by the air that we breath in.
strengths: Air is ever present throughout the world
weaknesses: Cleanliness of air is not what is used to be
Can be easily defeated by people who use smoke powers

name: Ice Blasts
description: Freeze your enemies in their tracks with ice from your hands.
summary: The ability to shoot blasts of ice from your hands
strengths: Stop enemies,
Make icicles to stab your enemies,
Make awesome ice sculptures,
weaknesses: Licking the ice would be a bad idea,
Doesn't work well against fire,
Ice will eventually thaw,

name: Energy Bow
description: When activated, you can create a ball of energy. Then, you can pull on the ball to create an arrow. Finally, release it to fire an energy arrow.
summary: The ability to create a ball of energy out of which you can shoot arrows
strengths: Fire pure energy arrows
weaknesses: If you're facing a fast opponent

name: Water Combustion
description: You can cause nearby bodies of water to combust, making the water burn similarly to oil. Larger masses of water require greater focus. You can ignite the amount of water in an Olympic-sized swimming pool with difficulty and extreme focus.
summary: The ability to cause water to combust
strengths: The human body is about 57% water. What would happen if you combusted all of that.
Droplets of water suspended in air will create an explosion when combusted
Can turn any stream of water into a flamethrower, so carry around a super-soaker for self-defence
weaknesses: You can't ignite very large bodies of water eg. Lakes
Having the power to kill others at will could make people fear you

name: Vector Terrakinesis
description: This ability lets a person control earth, like normal terrakinesis, but with a big difference: "vectors", or invisible telekinetic appendages, allow the user far more dexterity and control than the normal form of this ability, letting them control rocks or earth far too heavy for a normal terrakinetic to handle. The vectors also allow you to effortlessly slice rocks, even granite, in seconds!! This ability can even still work if a person using it is physically separated from earth.
summary: The ability to use telekinetic vectors, or energy appendages, to control geological elements
strengths: Have extremely strong and precise control over geological elements!
You can use the vectors to channel earth energy into others, to heal them
You can be an extremely skilled and deadly fighter to any enemy!!
weaknesses: Using more than 4 vectors at once causes both physical and mental strain
Evil people with this ability are extremely dangerous!
Your power is weakened sufficiently if you are in an urban environment

name: Contemporary Magic
description: A person with this power has the ability to do magic to create any effect that is currently possible with current technology. For example they can shoot fire in an arc that looks like a flamethrower and can blow dry their hair using magic.. Anything that you can do with current technology is possible for you to do. The user is limited by current technology because although you can mow your lawn with magic it is only just as fast as the highest technology lawnmower that there currently is.
summary: The ability to use magic to create any effect as long as it is possible with current technology
strengths: Easy to hide your powers--people probably think you are some sort of Batman
Your power is only limited by current technology
You can use the effects of the best technology for free
weaknesses: Kinda useless since you can't really do anything technology can't already do
Don't really know what current technology can do so you have to read magazines to learn new "spells"

name: Void Lightning
description: The lightning will create empty space when it hits something, but air is unaffected by the lightning. You still need a medium for the lightning to travel through.
summary: The ability to fire lightning from one's hands that creates a void when it hits something
strengths: This lightning doesn't cauterize wounds. Good if you want to kill.
weaknesses: Creates an opening for someone to use 'Lightning Void'.

name: Particle Accelerator
description:
With this power you can speed up the molecules to produce various effects. 
For, example you can create heat by speeding molecules in the air or you can make things explode by speeding up their molecules. 

You can also create a vibrating saw by making the molecules around your hand speed up so you can plow through anything, and as the name implies you can create a particle gun to shoot particles by speeding up particles that are already slowly moving toward the target
summary: The ability to increase the speed of molecules and atoms and other subatomic particles
strengths: Explosions and Fire(Heat)
Particle gun and saw
Alchemy, by particle acceleration
weaknesses: You can only speed up particles but you cannot change the direction
If you creates an explosive element with the particle gun you could very well blow off the earth

name: Impenetrable Field
description: This power is the ultimate gift, and the ultimate CURSE! You are surrounded by a permanent shield that is impenetrable. No power can get through it. It takes care of all your needs like air, food, water, warmth, keeping you cool, bathroom, etc. But nothing can get in, and you can't get out. That means you can't enjoy much anything. No sex, no kissing, no wine, nothing. Not even snacks. Your clothes are always different when you wake up.
summary: The ability to have absolutely nothing happen to you.
strengths: The ULITMATE SHIELD
Nothing can get through it
Can't die by trauma
weaknesses: The ULTIMATE SHIELD
Nothing can get through it
Can't kill yourself.

name: Telekinetic Storm
description: If this power is activated, the user will begin to levitate, along with all objects within the user's vicinity. These objects will suddenly start moving at high speeds around the user in a large cylinder shape. Telekinetic waves will start to blast outwards from the user, which resemble powerful gusts of wind, but affect others internally, as well as externally, and can cause a number of affects on the human body, varying from telekinetic force, to cuts, to disintegration of the body.
summary: The ability to create a telekinetic storm
strengths: Levitation (of user and other objects)
Telekinetic waves/blasts
Can cause telekinetic force, cuts, disintegration (on others)
weaknesses: Can be destructive to suroundings

name: Energy Void
description:
Rules:
1. You do not get the energy it is gone.... Forever
2. You must come into contact with said energy or the energy's source, however you are not damaged by the energy... Example: put you hand into a fire you will not get burned. 
3. Energies include: magic, elemental, life, so on so forth. 

 This power is not something you can turn on or off once your body comes into contact with the energy or it's source it will be absorbed. This can be canceled by clothing
summary: The ability to absorb forms of energy
strengths: Immune to being hurt by said energy
Automatic cannot be switched off : considered both
weaknesses: Cannot cast magic or use any magical powerful items
Automatic cannot be switched off : considered both

name: Circlism
description: By drawing a circle in the air with your fingers and imagining it to be whatever it will form, it is only limited by your imagination.
summary: The ability to make circles of anything
strengths: Can create circle weapons of any type
Can create circle anything from what ever substance
Can create multiple circles at any one time
weaknesses: Size is restricted to the ability to draw with fingers
You have to think about what it is going to be made from
You need to have a clear picture inside your head in order for the circle to form

name: Ancient Beast: Phoenix
description: The power is split into three types; Phoenix-form, Human-form and Hybrid-form.   The Phoenix-form allows flight, control over fire and reincarnation.   The Human-form allows control over fire and reincarnation.   The Hybrid-form allows control over fire, flight and reincarnation but the powers are much more powerful than in Human- or Phoenix-form.
summary: The ability to have the powers of a phoenix.
strengths: Unkillable.
If someone disagrees, burn them to ashes!
You can FLY!
weaknesses: Eternal life isn't very fun after a couple of thousand years.
The burns on your clothes aren't very funny.
Watch out for heavy rain fall.

name: Enemy Skill
description:
The person with this ability is like a copycat or a mimic, but with a difference. They can use the skills and abilities of their enemies, when their enemy uses that particular skill on them. You can only use the last ability used on yourself. 
E. G. A fire breather uses their ability on you so you can breather fire until someone shoots lightning at you, then you can shoot lightning. 
This power isn't just limited to your enemies, your allies could heal you, giving you healing powers.
summary: The ability to learn and successfully manipulate the skills and abilities of your enemies.
strengths: Copy the previous power used on oneself, to its full potential.
Can copy any ability used on yourself, as long as it doesn't kill you in the process.
weaknesses: Can only use the most recent ability, used on oneself.
Can only copy up to one skill at a time, they change each time a new ability is used on you.

name: Cold Current
description: You can do everything like firing out cryobolts. It shocks and freezes the opponent solid at full force. Also, you can create large frostbolts that will sweep across everywhere, damaging your opponents and leaving them paralyzed and frozen.
summary: The ability to fire bolts of ice that freeze and electrocute your enemies.
strengths: You can give your enemies the shocking chills.
weaknesses: None.

name: Paralysis Point
description: With this power you can paralyze people by pointing at them. The victim will be unable to move as long as you are pointing at them. It doesn't matter how far away you are from them or which finger you use to point at them. You also can't turn this power off so whenever you point at anybody they become paralyzed. You can also point at multiple people at once and they will all become paralyzed.
summary: The ability to cause people to become paralyzed when you point at them
strengths: You can paralyze people by pointing at them
You can do it with any finger and from as far away from the person as you want
You paralyze multiple people by pointing at multiple people at the same time
weaknesses: You cannot turn this power off
Once you stop pointing they unfreeze

name: Psychic Bubbles
description: A film of psychic power wraps around the air and forms a sphere, in the same way that soap creates bubbles. Any number or sizes of bubbles can be made, but they are all perfect spheres. Change the size of the bubble to create a super-dense marble, or a low-pressure atmospheric bubble that will create a gust of wind when popped. Or just make a large one around yourself for a quick, 1HP forcefield. The possibilities are endless.
summary: The ability to wrap spheres of psychic power around portions of the atmosphere and control everything within.
strengths: Very versatile - only your imagination limits what you can do with the bubbles, really
Perfectly transparent - only you or other psychics will know what's going on
Quick shield - doubles as a weak forcefield, dust screen, underwater air bubble, whatever!
weaknesses: You can't control what it is you capture in the bubble - whatever's in the air, is in there
The bubbles are flimsy against other psychic power, and another psychokinetic can pop them with ease
Who would be intimidated by invisible bubbles, really?

name: Elemental Archer
description: Bow and arrows formed from such elements such as fire, water, earth, etc. Years of practice are needed to harness more the elements.
summary: The ability to form a bow and arrow out of the elements
strengths: Never run out of ammuniton
Long and close range weapon
Can be any form of a bow such as long bow bow or cross bow
weaknesses: Accuracy and proficiency do not come with the bow
More advanced elements harder to control

name: Color Shirt Power V2
description: With this power you can gain powers depending on the color or colors of the shirt or shirts you are wearing: Maroon: fire breath. Silver: invincibility. Gold: money rain. Violet: shapeshifting. This list applies to all shade of the color in question. Once you take off the shirt, you lose the powers. The colors of your pants, shoes, socks, hat, jewelry, other types of clothing do not have any effect on this power.
summary: The ability to gain powers based on the color(s) of the shirt(s) you are wearing
strengths: You can get cool powers just for wearing a shirt.
If you wear more than one shirt or your shirt has more than one color, you get more than one power.
weaknesses: The color of your pants does not have any effect on this power.
If you're not wearing a shirt, you get no powers (unless you have other powers).

name: Micro Gravatic Fissure
description: You can throw or leave suspended in the air small 'time bombs' that will cause an implosion of gravimetric force. This force creates shock waves that pull towards the 'time bomb' causing kinetic damage and causing loose objects to be drawn towards it. The 'time bombs' go off after you stop concentrating on them / at your command. The larger the bomb you create, the more draining it is upon you. Tiny 'time bombs' can be thrown in a spray with an effect of bantering at your enemy. Chargeable.
summary: The ability to create small balls of Gravity Implosion like micro black holes.
strengths: Causes Kinetic Damage proportional to how close the target is to the 'time bomb'
Can cause loose objects to be flung in the direction of the imploding 'time bomb'
Used in series, it can cause someone / something to be pulled. (e.g. Pulled off roof)
weaknesses: Collateral Damage.
Gravity implosion affects everything nearby, trailing off effect with increasing range.
If boosted, blackholes might not self-collapse immediately.

name: Fire Walking
description: With this power, any fire becomes a doorway. You can step through fires as small as match-heads and appear out of any other fire in the world. In addition, this power renders you and anyone you teleport with immune to the fire's harmful effects, such as burning and smoke inhalation.
summary: The ability to teleport through fire
strengths: Teleport between any two points of fire.
Become the ultimate firefighter.
weaknesses: Must have fire to teleport through.
Any fire you set to teleport will stay where you set it. You could burn something down.

name: Effect Empathy
description: This ability allows you to absorb and mimic a power's effects or side ability. For example, if someone had the ability to turn to water. The user of this ability will mimic the hidden powers of that power. The user would gain the power to be as unstable as water or to slip through cracks, but not turn to water. Another example would be, if you copy Rogue's side effects of her power, you would be able to have people's memories and powers without the need to touch to absorb their life force.
summary: The ability to gain the powers of the effects and hidden abilities of a primary ability.
strengths: Able to mimic the hidden powers of other powers.
Won't need to do any conditions to use the hidden power.
weaknesses: Beware of mimicking bad side effects.

name: Air Bender
description: (Air is the element of freedom) you can create and manipulate air. Your power source is the air. Your weakness is fire. You have an advantage over the other elements. As a Air bender You are peaceful and forgiving
summary: The ability to become a Air bender from the Avatar the Last Air bender animated television series
strengths: You have an advantage over the other elements
As a Air bender you are peaceful and forgiving (pro & con)
you can shadow bend at higher levels
weaknesses: You have more hatred against the fire nation than the other nation
Shadow bending is one of the darkest forms of bending
Air feeds fire

name: Weather Controlled Powers
description: It all matters on the weather outside. If you are in the desert you would be able to control fire, if there is a tornado going on you will have wind powers, if there is a hurricane you will have wind and water powers.
summary: The ability to have a power that matches the weather
strengths: You will never be bored of the same power
A lot of choices to save the world with
All really good powers
weaknesses: If you live in a climate that doesn't change that much you will have it until it changes
If you are say flying because of your wind powers and the weather changes you will probably fall
You might have a power that won't help you in the situation

name: Elemental Prosthetics
description: When this ability is active, you are capable of utilizing the four classical elements, plus the periodic table elements, as replacements for lost limbs. The prostheses are capable of retaining the abilities; meaning, if you replace your arm with fire, you would be able to absorb fire and project it. If an elemental prosthesis is destroyed, you can create another one. Your genetic code has been modified to the extent where you have all the elements in memory.
summary: The ability to replace severed limbs with elemental prostheses.
strengths: Can instantly select another element.
Use the environment to your advantage.
Create a titanium prosthesis and crush your foes.
weaknesses: The elements can still be destroyed or extinguish.
You are still vulnerable.
Some elements don't mix. (resulting in an EPIC FAIL)

name: The Sandman
description: With this ability, you can have full control over dreams, whether they're yours or someone else's.  You name it--you can make anything happen.  You can create pleasant dreams, confusing dreams, or nightmares if you feel it necessary, and you can use your ability on someone from any distance away.
summary: The ability to have full control over your dreams and other people's dreams.
strengths: Have some pretty damn good dreams
Never have a nightmare again
Communicating with people through their dreams
weaknesses: Only trouble is, gee whiz, you might want to dream your life away.

name: Ice Walking
description: Ever wanted to be like Ice Man and make a path of ice to skate on in mid air? Well, now you can. Freeze the ground under your feet and build it up so you can make a path above the ground. Slide/skate around, cross a lake in the middle of summer and never fall into water. It can be turned on and off at will.
summary: The ability to freeze anything that touches your feet
strengths: Instant skate ring
Make a path of ice in the air (transportation/hard to reach places)
weaknesses: Only works with feet
Intense heat/fire

name: Elemental Reconfiguration
description: You're at a disadvantage in an elemental battle? Simply change your or your opponent's elemental type to get the upper hand. However, the changes follow a very precise order. Every possible element is arranged in an immutable cycle, which can be followed in either direction. For example, if you want to change a fire mimic into a water mimic, you can see them progressively change to a wood mimic, then a smoke mimic, a plasma mimic, a tornado mimic and a sound mimic before becoming a water mimic.
summary: The ability to change the elemental attribute of a superpower, a spell or even a magical artifact.
strengths: Combine this power with an elemental one, and you can have many elemental version of that power.
Change a defensive fog-type power to the offensive lava-type or poison-type version.
Choose any element from a wide variety, such as darkness, shadow, radiation, sand, stone, mud,...
weaknesses: There's no logic behind the cycle, so it can take some time to get a desired element.
Some "elements" aren't counted, and you must be in the vicinity to keep the changes active.
You could give your opponent a very strong element before reaching the desired weaker one.

name: Vacuum Simulation
description: This ability can be deadly for the user can make space come to Earth. They will be able to suffocate any living creature with power. The mist will cover everything in a blanket of darkness and airlessness. The user, of course, can survive this, training his lungs up to the point that they will gain "Vacuum Adaptation" so they can live in real space. The user can manipulate it and make it solid.
summary: The ability to create a mist-like void that imitates the effects of space and manipulate it.
strengths: Suffocate or knock people out.
Manipulate it.
Eventually gain "Vacuum Adaptation".
weaknesses: Doesn't effect those who have "Vacuum Adaptation".

name: Disaster Manipulation
description: You can stop a storm, control earthquakes, and change tsunamis into tiny waves. You can control any natural disaster and also cause them.
summary: The ability to control any type of disaster.
strengths: You can make a storm so you don't have school
Save millions of lives
weaknesses: Might accidentally create one
This is powered by 30% concentration and emotion for the rest

name: Fusion
description: Tired of having to go to the bathroom every ten minutes? Tired of having to leave the tv during commercials to go into the kitchen to get a snack? Well say no more, because with this power, you can fuse the toilet with a lay z boy chair and your remote with the fridge. It even works on people. Make your brother a sandwich. Literally! The possibilities are endless. The only way to change 'em back is by concentration on the two separate targets. No one will be able to change them back otherwise.
summary: The ability to fuse anything or any two people with anything within 5 feet
strengths: Fuse a cat and a dog for twice the fun and ignorance.
Fuse a gun with a sword in case the zombie apocalypse starts.
No one can reverse it but you.
weaknesses: Concentration to defuse things
Could fuse the wrong things, like a tank and an air bus
Takes about five seconds to charge for each use.

name: Petrifaction
description: One with this power can transmute a subject into solid stone with a look, touch or some other method. If a subject is turned into stone, the affect can usually be reversed by the user as long as the subject remains intact, i. E. Not broken, smashed, weathered, etc.
summary: The ability to turn matter into stone.
strengths: An effective way to get rid of an enemy or nuisance
The 'statue' might go nice with the garden
To be rid of someone for good, just get a sledgehammer
weaknesses: If the 'statue' is destroyed the effect cannot be reversed
May be triggered subconsciously (acidental petrifaction)
Would be difficult to move or destroy

name: Tangibility
description: A person with this power can make things that are intangible become tangible/solid just by touching it. Make ghosts tangible and attack them as if they were real persons, learn how to shape tangible/solid balls of air and use them as weapons; the possibilites are endless...
summary: The ability to make intangible things tangible/solid
strengths: Literally grab/touch air - use it as monkey bars, platforms or as offensive balls of air
Intangibility is useless against you
Make ghosts real, never fall in a pit etc.
weaknesses: Only make things tangible - can't make things intangible

name: Gust
