description: With a flick of your hand, you can ride the wind to your wildest destinations, blow all the leaves from your lawn, or blast away the bad guys in your way.
summary: The ability to project powerful gusts of air in any direction.
strengths: Easy outdoor travel.
weaknesses: Limited control of element.

name: Telepathic Alarm
description: A passive form of telepathic power, that alarms you when anybody on Earth plans to do you harm. If one of your enemies is thinking about hurting you, your telephatic sense will give you a signal.
summary: The ability to know when anyone wants to do you harm
strengths: You have more time to get ready to any attack against you.
weaknesses: If you have too many enemies, you may get a headache because of the "voices".

name: Wind Absorption
description: The user is able to absorb the wind in his or her surrounding and release it upon the enemy. The power of the wind released is dependent on how strong the wind is. If it is a mild breeze than the user can only release a jet of compressed air, if the wind is gale and strong, the user can release a human sized tornado.
summary: The ability to absorb wind from the surrounding
strengths: Wind is ever present
Eco friendly
weaknesses: Weak against fire
Not very powerful if there is no powerful wind

name: Energy Solidification
description: This ability isn't right for those who are really attached to their electronics, but if you are not, then you can use it in many ways. You can use energy to create a solid construct, like turning off a nuclear bomb by changing it's core into a solid rock.
summary: The ability to turn energy into solid matter.
strengths: Make the energy into a solid weapon.
Able to expand the energy before it becomes solid.
This ability affects all sources of energy.
weaknesses: If not trained, it could destroy or shut down electronics.

name: Vehicle Shapeshifting
description: From flesh to metal, you can be any vehicle on land, sea and in the air.
summary: The ability to change to any vehicle you want
strengths: Go anywhere you want
weaknesses: Last one hour a day

name: Tailor Maker
description: You can design the most  practical and stylish costume for anyone with a power. The costumes you make, conjures itself around the person you are tailoring for. The costume you design works practically for the kind of power they have for example someone who generates flame and hot fire, their costume will be heat-resistant. With time your costumes can enhance and boost the power of the individual you are tailoring for. You can also control whether the person can no longer wear your costume.
summary: The ability to make the most efficient, practical and stylish costume for anyone who has a power.
strengths: Costumes tailored are practical, and can be as stylish as you choose to design.
With enough practice the costume can enhance or boost the power of the individual you make the costume for.
You can also 'turn off' this power on the individuals you tailor for. Example: If you can boost the power of the individual, you can also stop that enhancement.
weaknesses: A background power for someone on a super hero team. No real, personal, combative capabilities.
If you enhance a person's power with the costume they design, they could turn against you, if they went rogue.

name: Repair Fire
description: This power allows the user to summon golden flames that revert broken objects to their 'repaired' state. For example, using them on a broken window will repair the window. The power allows for a fairly arbitrary definition of 'repaired' - if the flames are used on ordinary glass, it is possible to revert it to its 'unprocessed' state of sand and assorted chemicals as long as the user decides that they're applying the flames to 'broken' sand, rather than fixed glass.
summary: The ability to summon golden flames that fix broken things.
strengths: Fix broken objects with ease.
Heal peoples injuries.
weaknesses: If the flames are used on computers or other electronics, it will wipe the data on them.
Excessive use of the flames will tire the user out.

name: Matter Conversion
description:
The ability to change the state of matter of any living or non-living matter.
Example: You can cause people to melt or you can turn steam into ice.
You can even change objects to their plasma state.
summary: The ability to change the state of matter with any object.
strengths: You can melt people you hate.
You can make ice cubes instantly on a hot day.
weaknesses: Might by accident melt someone you like.

name: Weekly Wonder
description: With this power, every new day means a new power for you. Each day of the week brings you a specific new power untill the day ends.  Monday - Increase Gravity on others, making them slow and sluggish.  Tuesday - Control wind.  Wednesday - Aquakinesis, control water.  Thursday - Geokinesis, ability to control earth.  Friday - Laser Vision.  Saturday - Electricy Generation, generate and control electricity.  Sunday - Pyrokinesis, ability to control fire. Power wanes with the setting sun.
summary: The ability to have a different power depending on the day of the week
strengths: Each day is a new power
Control over multiple elements and powers (over different days)
weaknesses: You have to plan based on what power you'll have the next day
Somtimes hard to remember what power you have.

name: Reaper's Light
description: This ability allows you to create a bright light that paralyzes anyone caught in its glow. Paralyzed victims become frozen in whatever position they were in when the light appeared. When the light is has waned, victims do not rember it happened and continue as if it never happened. You can enter the light after it has been activated and not be affected. Killing the user of this ability while it is active will kill all caught in it.
summary: The ability to generate a bright light that paralyzes anyone caught in its glow
strengths: Freeze victims for a clean getaway or a clean kill
weaknesses: Some can avoid being frozen by blocking the light when it is first deployed.
Dying while it is active kills all affected by it.

name: Typhoon Master
description: This ability is about calling a typhoon whenever or wherever you want it. You can tell where the storm will be but you can control where the lightnings will strike, the direction of the wind blow and the hardness of the rain. Well you can call a storm far away from you, where you know your enemy is. Useful when it's hot outside, LOL! Every minute that the typhoon is summoned will decrease your strength as a human being. When the typhoon you created is so strong, you can't control it anymore.
summary: The ability to call a typhoon whenever, wherever.
strengths: It's useful when it's hot outside.
Can use it far away from you.
You can feel so powerful with this!
weaknesses: You can also be hurt when not properly controlled.
You can kill a person or thousands of them.
You can destroy a whole nation!

name: Elemental Wolves
description: The wolves will be composed completely out of the element of your choice and have sharp fangs and claws. Choosable elements are Fire, Water, Earth, Wind, Wood, Ice Lightning, Metal, Sand, and any element on the Periodic Table. You only get to choose one element for ALL the wolves you make. Once the choice is made it cannot be changed. The wolves can go for a range of up to 50 metres from your position.
summary: The ability to create and control wolves of any one element
strengths: You can choose your wolves' element.
The wolves can be powerful soldiers.
The wolves have all the strengths of their element.
weaknesses: The wolves have all the weaknesses of their element. Alteration powers have no effect on this power.
Element chosen cannot be changed even with other powers nor can the number of elements be increased.
Your wolves can be hijacked by someone who can control the wolves' element.

name: Draconic Fire
description: The fire of an extremely powerful dragon is such that only regular fire can put it out. The holder of this power can use this extremely powerful flame for any cause that they may desire.
summary: The ability to create and control a fire that can only be put out by other fires
strengths: Enemies have to literally fight fire with fire.
Water just makes this fire stronger.
weaknesses: The weakest flame from Pyrokinesis can put out your fires.

name: Elemental Arms
description: You are able to turn your arms into rocks or tornadoes. You can also have arms of water. You can't have elements on your arms for a long time, and there's a 1-hour cooldown when you're done. It can become dangerous if you put 3 elements together.
summary: The ability to turn your arms into some of the elements
strengths: Can have two different elements like one fire arm and one stone arm
Can combine two elements
Can use both arms as an element
weaknesses: 1-hour cooldown
If you put more than two powers together, chances are it would amputate your arm

name: Force Of Balance
description: Balance is a force to be reckoned with. When a part of our world is unbalanced, it has a certain effect. For example, when you unbalance the energy in the air, it will re-balance itself, and doing so, will discharge energy, in the form of heat or, if enough energy is disturbed, lightning. Or you could unbalance the land and cause earthquakes, or unbalance the functions of the body, and cause disease and sickness.
summary: The ability to balance and unbalance various things
strengths: Can control a force of nature
Very powerful and has many uses
weaknesses: If you can't control your powers, you could destroy everything

name: Mystical Hourglass
description: The user with this special hourglass pendant, that can be rotated for the sands of time to count down, can be a paragon until the time runs out. After that, the user must turn back the hourglass in the other direction and wait until the sands of time count downs again before using it again. Usually the power would last for an hour, and the time taken to recharge the power will also take an hour
summary: The ability to become a paragon until the sand in the hourglass finishes
strengths: You are a paragon.
Can go head to head with most powerhouses.
weaknesses: When the time runs out, you are in deep trouble
Takes the same to restore the user's power

name: Reforming Psionic Entity
description: When this power activated, your human body was disintegrated and you became an incorporeal psionic entity as your true form. You automatically telekinetically draw in and hold together objects from nearby surroundings to form a new humanoid body, such as sand, water, earth, plants and masonry.  When this body is destroyed, you automatically begin to make another one. Your appearance stays very similar, you just appear to be made of a mix of debris. When angry, you create a larger, stronger form.
summary: The ability to create a body from the surrounding environment
strengths: You are now immortal. If you are destroyed physically, you rebuild yourself
Your environmental forms have advantages, e.g. steel muscles, rock skin
Cannot tire as you have no actual muscles, and cannot get ill or age
weaknesses: You will no longer be able to pass as a human
Cannot commit suicide if immortality becomes too much
Cannot taste food, experience touch, etc.

name: Hell Jump
description: This ability allows the user to jump extremely far, extremely quick. Not only that but the user can "rebound" in mid-air to redirect his/herself. Another, and key element of this ability, is that while in use, the person becomes "supercharged", where their atoms spin in place, causing them to "push" away anything in their path, with enough force to rip a man in half, or turn a tank inside out. At the highest level of mastery, the user can wrap through objects/beings, and continue the jump.
summary: The ability to jump high and quickly, tearing through any obstacles.
strengths: Similar to and faster than the Flight ability
Highly offensive ability
Multiple uses.
weaknesses: Extremely hard to control at first.
Hazard to allies unless user is an experianced user. (15 years +)
Uses the users energy.

name: Entity Inability
description: With this ability, you can freeze a living person or entity, disabling their ability to act in any way. All of their senses will be turned off - basically it's as if they're not alive. Once in this state, it cannot be reversed unless the user reverses the effect, or the state wears off. (Depending on skill level, it can take 5 hours to a month for it to wear off. )
summary: The ability to freeze a living person/entity into a state where they can't do anything.
strengths: Freeze someone in motion to make an escape.
They can be moved. You could think of them as either 'dead' or paralyzed. It's a mix of the two.
You can do whatever you choose to them while they're in this state. *Eheheheh*
weaknesses: Effect wears off either when the user chooses it to, or when it wears off. (Varies by skill level)
Not one of the most 'moral' powers in the world. (Lol)

name: Arcana: 1 The Magician
description: With this ability, you have the capacity to manipulate any kind of energy after you figure how. This means repeated observation of the energy. Watching it naturally (a fire or lighting) could take weeks. A faster method is observing someone manipulating it. Once the power is learned, you don't gain the control most get. You have to learn how to control it. The upside is that there is virtually no limit to how strong the manipulation can get. You can go from lighting matches to burning cities.
summary: The ability to learn how to manipulate energy.
strengths: Learn any kind of energy manipulation.
Use kinetic energy to use super-strength, Biological Energy for healing, even Psionic Energy.
weaknesses: Can't directly manipulate matter.
Can't learn all kinds of super powers.
Can take a while to learn the ones you want to learn.

name: Aerial Combustion
description:
You aim, you focus(think the air explodes) and it explodes! 
Although you can only do this once every 289 minutes, it is possible to destroy anything as long as you have a visual feed of the location, for example camera feed is sufficient. WARNING : The explosion reaches as far as your sight so if you trigger the explosion from your own eyes, you might want to be behind a shield.
summary: The ability to make air explode.
strengths: You can make air just go boom!
Perfect for hitting people who have shields, as long as there is air behind that shield.
Air is everywhere so you can pretty much make any location go kabooom!
weaknesses: Selfdamage is possible.
Useless in space.
Does not pentrate shields but explodes from within the shield so don't aim next to your victim.

name: Elemental Shield
description: With this ability, you are able to create a shield of nateral elements. Don't be upset if you're thinking that all you can do is create a shield, because you can take chunks of your shield and toss them like missles at your opponent. You can also create shields for things other than yourself. Wind can be created at your feet to make you fly. Don't forget that you can mix elements like water and earth to create mud.
summary: The ability to create a shield of natural elements
strengths: You can block almost anything
You can escape attacks
weaknesses: You can only use elements that you are around.
Each shield has a weakness

name: Bullet Of Compression
description: You can absorb anything into your hands (five objects each) that gets stored in each of your fingers (thumb included). Then, at will, you can open up the "cap" on the end of your finger and either fire the compressed object like a bullet, of just let it fall out. With the latter, you can then return to normal size the object you compressed without having any harm be done to it.
summary: The ability to store compressed things in your hands and shoot them
strengths: Shoot bullets from your fingers: "finger gun"
Can store anything in a compressed space
Can absorb any solid (including bullets that somebody else shot or somrthing they threw)
weaknesses: Can only store 5 things
If you get your finger cut off, it won't work for that finger (you lose storage space permanately)
It has to be absorbed through your hans, so don't get those cut off...

name: Heat Absorption
description: A person with this power has a power similar to Heat Eater but is more advanced. Instead of taking in heat energy for food, the user uses up stored heat energy for the use of releasing it at a later time. The user can control both how much heat they can absorb and how much heat they give off with practice. Also, with practice, the user can manipulate pressure and wind to a certain degree by heating and cooling air.
summary: The ability to absorb heat from surroundings and unleash absorbed heat
strengths: You can absorb heat from surroundings-causes temperature to be cool or freeze things
Can release stored heat either slowly like a hairdryer or quickly like a heat ray
Can also manipulate pressure/wind with practice
weaknesses: You have to absorb heat first in order to release heat-set pattern in using power
Less useful in cold climates for obvious reasons
Stored heat slowly dissipates from the body when not using the heat for other purposes

name: The Midas Touch
description: Just imagine it. You could turn anything you want into gold, silver, platinum, diamond, pearl, white gold and so much more. You could turn a plain old stick into a gloden scepter just by the wave of your hand. You could have untold riches.
summary: The ability to turn any object into any mineral of your choosing
strengths: You will become rich
When you touch an object it only changes if you want it to
You could turn your house to gold
weaknesses: There aren't any

name: Evolver
description: Evolution is a very powerful tool of life. With this ability, your genetic structure is programmed to continue to evolve and mutate in positive ways. This means every once in a while, you'll develop a random genetic based ability. You will know when this happens because every time it happens you'll feel flashes of hot and cold. These mutations are uncontrollable and are almost always positive. So you'll never know when or how you will evolve.
summary: The ability to randomly evolve and mutate.
strengths: You might develop an anti-aging mutation.
Could become very powerful
Almost any ability is geneticly possible
weaknesses: Some mutations are just plain useless

name: Geometric Perfection
description: Although one might think this is useless, if it were to be applied to a user of projectiles, this person would become godly. Perfect Geometric recognition would allow someone to bounce bullets off of almost any solid object. Like Cyclops from Marvel, he could almost be the perfect sniper, as now wind, drag, objects, and any physical thing is now instantly added into his or her immmediate thought process. Basically, it almost ensures never missing a target, without really needing to concentrate.
summary: The ability to have a perfect understanding of physics and geometry.
strengths: Become a scientist/scholar/researcher
Can easily predict where projectiles are going
Instantaneous reactions since thought process is no longer a variable
weaknesses: Based on number of projectiles
Still not the most amazing power

name: Seismokinesis
description: You can create and manipulate earthquakes. No one can come close! You can make quakes anywhere and can even creake sinkholes. Your shockwaves will scare your enemies.
summary: The ability to create and manipulate earthquakes
strengths: Amazingly powerfull
Destructive prowess with little effort
weaknesses: Could kill everyone
Overuse results in lack of control

name: Powerful Breath
description: You can blow fire, ice, gas, or wind at any pressure or force. Fire can range from melting ice to evaporating water, ice can range from freezing solids to freezing gasses, gas can poison your target in seconds, and wind can range from bending trees to causing storms. The effect of your breath is actually almost infinite, since you have large lungs and you can suck in large amounts of air to charge up the pressure/force at one time. Can also increase the maximum volume of your voice.
summary: The ability to blow different types of breath, such as fire, ice, gas, wind, etc.
strengths: Cool down your dinner instantly.
Warm up the cold weather
Blow sulfur on some jack.
weaknesses: Easily noticed

name: Invictus
description: This power is based on your growing inner energy. Belief in yourself, confidence and ego power you to great extremes. You are as strong and indomitable as you believe. Immunity to fire, cold and disease if you believe you are. If you boost your confidence enough, you will be able to defy gravity, physics, logic. No one can tell you what you can and cannot do.
summary: The ability to be powered by your own confidence and ego
strengths: Initially you will be as strong, as fast, and as tough as you believe
Boost your ego enough and you will be able to fly, walk up walls, crap gold, drink lightning
Enemies and projectiles will bounce off you when they feel your awesome aura
weaknesses: Doubt is your greatest weakness
Beings with Telepathic, Superiority, Surpass or Evolutionary powers give you problems
Aging will slowly cause your confidence to wane no matter how powerful you become

name: Elemental Fist
description: The user, with the aid of a special gauntlet, is able to form an elemental fist using an element that is nearest to him. The elements are fire, earth, wind & water.
summary: The ability to transform your fist into whatever element you want
strengths: Able to counter almost element
weaknesses: Easily defeated if up against the wrong element

name: Statue Animation
description: This power allows you to channel your own life energy into statues. The abilities of the statues are dependent upon what they depict: a horse will not be sentient but a human will, a gargoyle or bird will be able to fly, and statues of gods or superhumans will retain their powers. The statues can be made of anything from stone to ice.
summary: The ability to bring statues to life under your control.
strengths: Army of statues for you to command
Statues can appear inanimate and ambush enemies
Statues are stronger and more durable than real-life counterparts if made of rock or metal
weaknesses: Only works on statues of animals, not abstract sculptures or other inanimate objects
If broken once, statues cannot be reanimated
Statues are fragile if made of ice or glass

name: String Manipulation
description: You can control any physical string. The string can be of any material, whether it is cotton, cow hide, steel, diamond, etc. You can only manipulate strings within a radius of 1000 metres.
summary: The ability to manipulate physical strings
strengths: All strings of all materials are under your control.
If you can make fire strings they are under your control.
weaknesses: Effective range of 1 kilometre.

name: Power Mix
description: Because of this power, the greatest powers could be combined. But, contrasting powers may take more than just power, one must have creativity and imagination. An example is fire plus water. A liquid which burns is acid. Also, combining great powers may drain out a person's energy. Using combined powers may also take time and energy. It is also forbidden to combine powers not of one's level and combine power plus a combined power.
summary: The ability to mix different superpowers.
strengths: One could use a very powerful combo of attacks based on opponent's weakness.
Powers around may be sources of ideas.
Defense can be combined with offense.
weaknesses: Drains energy.
Time-consuming.
Many rules to follow.

name: Glaciation
description: This is not the power to freeze; the user actually psychically transmutes matter into ice. One with this ability may do it by touch, look or just mental power (depending on the user's genetics). It affects the subject in the same way one is affected by the power Petrifaction, but, instead of stone, the subject turns into ice. In addition, if a subject is turned into ice, they can be returned to normal at will, as long as the ice hasn't melted or been shattered.
summary: The ability to turn matter into ice
strengths: If you don't want a person to be turned into ice, you can use the power to just freezer-burn them
May be accompanied by an immunity (or at least high resistance) to cold
User may sometimes be able to also affect non-living matter
weaknesses: You can't return a person to normal if they shatter or break
Sometimes only affects living matter (or only non-living matter)
It can also be triggered subconsciously (accidental glaciation)

name: Position Switching
description: This power enables you to instantly exchange your physical location with anything or anyone you are pointing at and concentrating on. It is not possible to only affect a part of an object, a person or a group of objects which are tightly fixed to each other, they will be moved as a whole. It works on any thing, except if it is bound to the Earth, i.e. if it is so heavy it cannot be humanly possible to move or if it is interlinked with the ground or something also bound to the Earth.
summary: The ability to exchange your position with anything or anyone you want
strengths: Like teleportation, except you have a finer and safer control on your moves.
Escape any situation AND put something or someone else in your place.
weaknesses: You must have a direct visual contact with whatever you want to switch with.
You can only teleport within your visual field.

name: Water Works
description: With this power you are able touch and join with water at its various phases: Liquid, Solid or Vapor, changing your body into water. You control each and every water molecule you bond with. You could easily control your body at varying temperatures. You are able to combine with other water molecules and become stronger. You could become tsunami sized tidal waves, artic glaciers, a giant iceberg or pounding rain, or an avalanche.
summary: The ability to merge with water at any of its phases
strengths: Touch a form of water and become that form of water, controlling its strength and motion
Merge with various sizes of water becoming enormous tidal waves, jagged icebergs or storm systems
Virtually invulnerable as a polymorphic liquid, a super-heated vapor or any size or form of iceberg
weaknesses: In fluid forms you could be contained
Unwillingly be changed to different states by one with temperature manipulating abilities
If submerged or buried in a form of water you subconsciously merge with that form of water

name: Mastery Of The Great Ice Aura
description: This superpower allows you to become a master of the art of using ice as a power. This ability is acknowledged by a glowing aura of faint ice around the possessor. This superpower is extremely hard to master and therefore only the best can use it. Upon mastering it, go to the Temple of the Ice Being. There, you will be granted by the Ice Being the legendary Frostmane. This icy cloak gives the wearer invincibility to frost, water and fire. It also designates them as a master of ice.
summary: The ability to completely control ice as a weapon
strengths: The ability to use ice as a combat tool
The ability to forge weapons and armor out of ice, as well as variants of ice walls.
The Cloak of the Ice Being, Frostmane
weaknesses: Extremely hard to master
Fire is a sworn enemy of Ice

name: Vacuum Control
description: You can create spaces devoid of any air in any shape or size you want.
summary: The ability to create and manipulate vacuums
strengths: You could put out any fire instantly
The human body doesn't do well in vacuums, so you could fight with that
Using your control over vacuums, you could propel yourself in any direction
weaknesses: Hopefully, there weren't any people in that burning building you just sealed inside a vacuum
You, unfortunately, are human as well
You had better pack an airbag and parachute, you aren't impervious to falling damage

name: Icy Crysmal Detonation
description: This ability allows you to detonate an explosion of ice around your target. You can also channel a small portion of the explosion to your fists for minimal damage. When the torrents of ice hit your target, it will consume them and spread all over them, devouring them like tar. You are also capable of projecting the ice in missile-like constructs.
summary: The ability to discharge an explosive corrosive mass of ice.
strengths: Detonate yourself like an "icy nuke".
Consume the target with ice.
The ice is incapable of harming you, so no worries.
weaknesses: The explosion technique is dangerous to use around civilians.

name: Temperature Manipulation
description: The more heat you absorb, the more you can release from yourself. However, if you do not have any excess heat absorbed, you cannot use this ability. Unless you have mastered this skill, you cannot really absorb a significant amount of heat from objects below room temperature. You can also freeze things so cold that they can snap as a result. Heightened adrenaline levels may also result in inadvertent heat bursts
summary: The ability to absorb and release excess heat from yourself
strengths: You can cool down a hot object without any problems
The excess heat you gain from the above can be stored for later uses
You are immune to excess or deficient body heat-related problems
weaknesses: If you absorb too much heat, you begin to burn up inside
To fully heat up or cool down an object, you must be touching it
If you get too hot, you start to glow red, and this is not good for subtlety

name: The Musician
description: Pick up any musical instrument or sing any song and it becomes a solid sound-energy construct, anything your mind can conceive of for offense or defense. A concussive blast, blades, loyal soldier(s), a hammer the size of a building, vice grips, steps so you can walk on air. The constructs are only visible if you want them to be or if your opponent has some type of above normal senses. All you need is one note. Assassin, Hero, or incredibly rich entertainer. You choose.
summary: The ability to convert sound into any type of solid sound & energy construct(s)
strengths: You can create constructs of any size or shape. Most effective with lots of ambient noise and energy
Sing and play simultaneously & continually for your strongest weapons, shields, etc.
Intuitively play any musical intrument & sing any song perfectly
weaknesses: Ability must begin as music, you need air & surrounding energy to create constructs
Useless in a vacuum (outer space). Weak effectiveness vs the deaf or vs the blind
Can never play or sing for fun. Again, it will always become a construct capable of hurting someone

name: Walking Panacea
description: With this power, you can transform water into a drinkable cure for any affliction. For all intents and purposes, it's still water, but it also contains the cure. To use this power, you need to be touching someone or something with the affliction. The water can only "hold" one cure at a time, and the afflicted person must drink one cup of your cure for it to work. You can make unlimited quantities.
summary: The ability to develop a cure for any affliction.
strengths: Cure the world's diseases
You may be seen as holy
Your presence isn't required after the cure has been made
weaknesses: One cure at a time
Requires you to be touching someone with the affliction
You need water to start with

name: Gift: Flames
description: Basically, someone with this power is better at controlling fires and flames than other beings. Thus their fire- or flame-based powers are stronger than most other being's powers and it is harder to take control of fire from them. However, someone with this power can only receive fire-based powers, nothing else.
summary: The ability to be gifted at the control of flame and fire
strengths: Almost no one has as good control over fire as someone with this power.
Fire-based powers are boosted slightly.
weaknesses: Can only have one gift.
Two beings with the same gift will cancel out the control aspect.
Pretty much restricted to only fire-based powers now.

name: Elemental Opposites
description: With this power you can send out an aura that can turn anything you wish into its elemental opposite. An elemental opposite would be things like Light to Dark, Fire to Ice, and Wood to Metal. The object that is changed will still function like it originally was but will be made out of a new substance. A tree will still grow like a tree but would be made of metal. Changes can be reversed with aura as well. Changes are permanent unless affected by another power.
summary: The ability to change an element into its elemental opposite.
strengths: Can change anything into its elemental opposite.
Change things into the opposite of what people can control.
Changes are permanent unless you or another person uses powers to change substances back.
weaknesses: Can only change a substance into its opposite, nothing else.
Changing substances of attachs does not necessarily mean you will not get hurt.
The opposite of a substance might be no more help to you than the origenal.

name: Seasonal Wings
description: These wings are able to change to match the season each one comes with a different ability and appearance.  Spring: green wings blooming with flowers which grants botanokinesis Summer: wings made of fire which grants pyrokinesis Autumn: wings made from autumn leaves which grants geokinesis Winter: wings made from solid ice which grants cyrokinesis
summary: The ability to get wings that change during to match the current season
strengths: Comes with multiple abilities
Can easily fly
May be worshipped as a deity
weaknesses: Other season wings and powers can only be accessed during their season
Need to learn to fly
Get annoyed of being a deity

name: Shockwave Distribution
description: Shockwave distribution includes being able to fire destructive sound waves from your hands. These sound waves can break through walls, blow up cars and kill people.
summary: The ability to create and fire very destructive sound waves.
strengths: Break through walls
Clear blockades
weaknesses: The afteraffects can be bad
You might go deaf

name: Card Stack Abilities: Jack
description: Access the powers of the elemental spirit of the physical realm and have control over matter. You can alter matter at a subatomic structure at will. This includes feats such as turning a lake into fire, shape shifting yourself and others, and molding a rock into a beautiful sculpture simply by touching it.
summary: The ability to control matter
strengths: Create almost anything out of almost anything, except spirits.
Cause your enemies to break down into pure energy by disassembling their molequles
Breath in space by turning photons into oxygen
weaknesses: Accidentally altering the molecular structure of your friends.
People with the Card Stack Ability: Jester are not affected by your powers
Con 2 is only valid when they are of an equal of higher power level.

name: Fire Bender
description: (Fire is the element of power). You can create fire. The source of your power is the sun. During   the lunar eclipse you are powerless. During the moon your are at your weakest. During the sun you are at your strongest. With the comet you are unbeatable. Water is your weakness. When you master fire banding you can create and redirect lightning
summary: The ability to become a fire bender from the Avatar the Last Air bender animated television series
strengths: Cook people alive
You are unbeatable with the comet
You can create and redirect lightning at higher levels
weaknesses: Water benders and earth benders will hate you
You will be blamed for many deaths
It takes time to master fire bending
tags: Fire is the element of power

name: Trait Sliding
description: Everything has opposite traits: hot or cold, light or dark, acidic or basic, etc. With this power, you can alter these kind of traits like you had them set to slider controls. You can make ice hot or fire cold, or make water an acid, or even up your grades a bit. No matter what it is, every scalar property is under your control with the push of a finger, so long as you know how to work it properly.
summary: The ability to alter the traits of anything in one direction or another
strengths: Can slide some really weird properties, like happiness and IQ points
If you have the imagination, you can do quite a lot - even bring back the dead
Sliding light wavelengths can get you the best raves ever known to man
weaknesses: The further away you slide a trait from its natural position, the harder it is to do
Every slide has other consequences: hot ice won't stay solid, for example
Works only on properties you know have some kind of scale to

name: Sands Of Time
description: You have the vast granted ability to use this cursed sand to make your opponent grow old or turn them young, but also you can send your enemies way back into the past or way out in the future. The Sands Of Time can cause limited blindness and is most famous use is to rust out corrupted Technology.
summary: The ability to send your enemies way back into the past or future and/or make them grow old or turn them young.
strengths: It's very powerful for the time & space travellers to use.
weaknesses: It doesn't work on Androids, and Golems.

name: Optional Breathing
description: You never have to breathe, but you can if you want to.  That way, people won't think you're weird.  You'll never suffocate or drown, and you can stay underwater as long as you'd like.
summary: The ability to live without needing to breathe.  Breathing is optional.
strengths: Never drown or suffocate
Choking isn't a big deal
Win all of the underwater breath-holding records.
weaknesses: Never get CPR from a hot lifeguard

name: Eschaception
description: The ability to sense/know the end of something. This includes (but is not limited to): the end of a statement, conversation, era, storm, and war. It also allows the user to sense death (the end of a life). It is a specialized form of claircognizance and does not involve any visual aspects.
summary: The ability to sense the end.
strengths: Useful for road trips and removes the necessity to harass the driver by stating "are we there yet"?
PROFIT from telling people when they will die.
Know when a war will end.
weaknesses: The end of something is never a surprise.
Fatalistic in nature.
Be aware of when the world will come to an end, but not HOW.

name: Tactile Pyrokinesis
description: A person can control fire by touching something associated with it (a lighter, paper, wood, etc.), and mentally focusing on the fire it could fuel, thus absorbing the object's power. The air around their free hand will start heating, eventually igniting. They can create fire over one or both hands, without touching the object, and create floating fireballs to launch, alongside blazing jets!! Orange fire is the most common created, and creating rarer high-temperature blue fire takes time.
summary: The ability to mentally control fire by touching objects associated with it and focusing on fire
strengths: Generate fire by absorbing the power of anything that is flammable, with no need for outside sources
Play with blazing fireballs, and launch jets of searing flame at enemies!
A user cannot in any way be harmed by their own fire, and can also choose to pass immunity to others
weaknesses: A very dangerous power in the wrong hands
The person has to touch an object, and mentally focus on the source of their power
Can manifest unintentionally under stress(anger, fear, etc. ), but only with a fire-related object

name: Gift Of Apollo
description: With the Gift of Apollo you'll have perfect aim with a bow and arrow so you could be a pro hunter and get lots of money! Also, you could show off your perfect body without having to worry about getting burned! And finally, you can impress anyone with your amazing talent with any instrument you want to play!
summary: The ability to have perfect aim with a bow, be good with any instrument, never get sun burned
strengths: Fire a bow with perfect accuracy
Play any instrument like a pro
Never get sun burned!
weaknesses: Not as cool as the other gifts of the gods.
Not really any bad after that

name: Time Hollow
description: Can be used by Demon Transformation #3 Black Demon. You take out an hourglass, throw it in the air and destroy it (gun, slashing with sword, etc. ) The sand flies in all direction and each grain turns into a portal. By going through one portal, you can exit in any other. Therefore, you can be jumping in between the portals, and while you are doing so, you can slash your enemies to pieces because your movement is so fast they will no be able to block your attacks.
summary: The ability to create time-space portals in a small area.
strengths: By repeatedly going in and out, you build up great speed.
Great way to finish a fight fast.
weaknesses: If you go too fast, you will have trouble seeing your targets, thus risking to hurt your friends.
Foes, can move out of the portals area, and since the portals do not move, this will...
... render the attack useless.

name: Oxykinesis
description: A person with this power has the ability to manipulate the element of oxygen with their mind. Not only can the user use it to take oxygen from someone's lungs, they can also create carbon dioxide by having it react with a person's insides as well as induce oxygen poisoning. They can also start many oxidation reactions. Also, pure oxygen can be use to start a path of flame, which you can then direct by manipulating the oxygen in the room.
summary: The ability to control the element of oxygen, including creating reactions and changing its phases
strengths: Can create oxidation reactions
Steal oxygen from people's lungs or induce oxygen poisoning
Can redirect the flow of oxygen in the air so you can start a path of flame
weaknesses: Need to rip out oxygen to use it
Less usable when trapped in a burning building, since the flames keep on taking your oxygen away

name: Fire Eater
description: With this power a person has a heat resistant mout and heat resistant innards so that he can eat fire. The fire has to be on something though (a stick, a cookie etc. ) and when you ingest it you gain all the nutrients you need for the next 365 days.
summary: The ability to eat fire and gain all the nutrients a person need for a year
strengths: You have a heat resistant mouth and heat resistant innards
When you eat fire you gain all the nutrients you need for the next 365 days
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat
Only your mouth and innards are heat resistant not the rest of your body

name: Water Empathy
description: 'Swims like a fish' barely covers the extent of a Water Empath's abilities. When they are covered in water, their healing, strength, speed, and reflexes are doubled. They also: know their exact location (latitude/longitude) while on water, have a natural "Waterproofing" that keeps them and anything they are touching warm and dry and oxygenated underwater, and can even find underwater people. Also, they swim like a fish. However, they do not have hydrokinesis and are powerless without water.
summary: The ability to gain various enhancements by being in contact with water
strengths: Doubled strength, speed, and healing
Know where they and other people are while at sea
Have a "waterproofing" that keeps them dry and breathing
weaknesses: No hydrokinesis
Powerless when out of water
Physically hurt by water pollution

name: Primordial Sense
description: The Primordial sense is a sixth sense possessed by animals in nature that alerts them of dangerous weather like hurricanes. It's not a premonition or predicition it's more of a feeling or sense that alerts you of near future danger or when danger is lurking around you.
summary: The ability to sense near-future danger in time to flee.
strengths: You are able to flee from the danger in time.
You can save other people from the danger.
weaknesses: People might not believe in the danger you sense.

name: Planet Energy Absorbsion
description: The ability to absorb energy from plantets. The kind of energy you absorb depends on what planet it comes from. Example: Neptune: Water, Mars:Rock, Earth:Life, Venus:Plants. You can project the energy at foes, surround yourself with energy,or make a sheild with the energy. When you are finished with the energy, you must return it to the planet in which it came, or else the planet will die. With Earth's life energy, you may heal people to a certain extent.
summary: The ability to absorb enegy from planets
strengths: Absorbtion time is really fast
The more planets you know, the more types of energy you can use
Heal people to a certain extent
weaknesses: You must return the energy
After keeping the energy for a long period of time, it grows weaker
You may not use more than one planet's energy at a time

name: Air Cannon
description: Capability to compress air around the user to create a dense sphere of compressed air. The sphere will explode when touched, releasing an energy equal to 10 High Explosive Grenades.
summary: The ability to compress air to get a very dense sphere of compressed air
strengths: Very powerful ability to cause a wide area damage
Become hell pitcher (throw the sphere and see what remains from your enemies)
Become an untrackable terrorist
weaknesses: The sphere is unstable, could explode even with a light touch
Unusable when the air is not present (in space or underwater)
Require a very intense concentration to maintain the stability of the sphere

name: Emotion Absorption
description: By using eye contact, you can absorb the emotions of those around you and turn it into a variety of powers. Superstrength for anger, water manipulation for depression, invisibility for fear, superspeed for happiness or nervousness, etc.
summary: The ability to absorb the emotions of those around you and turn them into superpowers.
strengths: The more people around, the better
The innocent people are your power source
Even your enemies give you a power
weaknesses: Depressed people will become suicidal
Many people become emotionless
Those close to you are affected

name: Autopyro
description: By thinking of something on fire, it will light on fire for real. That something will not burn, but the fire can burn other people or things.
summary: The ability to light things on fire (including yourself) without physically harming them/you
strengths: You can light yourself on fire to fight, a la Human Torch
You will be fine afterwards
The fire is still real and can burn other people
weaknesses: The fire can still burn other people
It can cause immense panic
It can expose you

name: Air Travel
description: You turn into air and can ride air currents or create your own to travel on. It can be difficult to turn back to your original form again the first time. It takes practice to create your own air currents.
summary: The ability to turn into air to travel extremely fast
strengths: Can escape dangerous situations.
Can't fall to your death.
weaknesses: Is difficult to revert to your original form the first time you change
Takes practice to create air currents

name: Cardboard Enhancement
description: Have you ever pretended that a cardboard tube was a sword, or spyglass? Have you ever gone on an imaginary flight in a cardboard box rocket ship, or used one as a time machine?   This power makes it so that cardboard takes on the properties of what you imagine it to be. A tube really is a spyglass, a cardboard sword will really cut, a cardboard box "drives" along the ground like a race-car, and the walls of a cardboard box fort really will stave off attack.
summary: The ability to have cardboard act as the thing you're pretending it is.
strengths: If you can imagine something that cardboard can imitate, it acts as that thing.
Operatinbg a cardboard box is as easy as it was when you were a kid.
As in, you don't need to know how to fly a real rocket ship to fly a cardboard box imitating one.
weaknesses: Cardboard reverts back to normal if it gets wet.

name: Temporal Artifact: Matchbook
description: The matchbook contains any number of matches you choose. You can make as many of the books as you want, and anyone can use them and the matches within. You must use up or destroy a book to be rid of it though. When a match is lit, time pauses for everything save the holder, anyone touching them, anything they're carrying, and the air around them. You can move objects, but you can't bring new things into paused time. When the *FLAME* goes out, time is restored, but a match can only be used once.
summary: The ability to spawn time-pausing matchbooks at will
strengths: True time pausing, in a convenient gift form. You can have unlimited matches in a book.
The flame carries the power, so you can have a lot of extra time if you can get a candle.
You can steal, kill, work, etc. in zero seconds. Or, even better... You can light a dark area!
weaknesses: The summoned books can be stolen, watch out in particular for books with unlimited matches.
Water doesn't flow. If you start a fire, it can take a while to put out and get people killed.
If you're not careful when moving things/people, they'll go flying/break bones.

name: Internet Celebrity
description: You can control, summon, and manipulate the Internet/Internet-related things. You can go inside the Internet into a Tron-type world of websites, summon Internet memes, and other stuff. For example, you could summon the 'Stop the rock' meme and cause a huge boulder to chase your enemies.
summary: The ability to control, summon, and manipulate the Internet.
strengths: Nearly limitless due to the Internet's expanse
This website is included, so you can grab any power off of here!
Transportation into other computers
weaknesses: Your strength depends on the connection in the area.
Must have a browser installed, working, and open to move around computers
Some memes would be extremely chaotic to bring into the real world.

name: Tornado Teleport
description: You are in a praying position spinning like a tornado, literally drills yourself into the floor & reappear in front or behind of your foe. You can even spin and vanish to another location.
summary: The ability to spin & disappear in front or behind your opponent.
strengths: It can be of great use to confuse and surprise your enemies.
weaknesses: None

name: Electrified Fire
description: Anyone it touches will be electrified and burned simultaneously. The fire is of a medium temperature, closer to normal fire than the blue of stars. The temperature differs for each person.
summary: The ability to create and control fire that has lightning surrounding it
strengths: Getting burned/electrocuted is bad enough separately but simultaneously has to be 100 times worse.
weaknesses: You can never separate the lightning from the fire (may be a pro).

name: Steam Blaster
description: You could send out a flow of radiating steam to damage opponents. Can be used both in the air & on the ground. It is extremely effective against water and ice type adversaries. Against fire, not so much...
summary: The ability to send out waves of steam to damage foes.
strengths: Extremely useful for melting frozen obstacles.
weaknesses: It does not affect fire type foes.

name: Vacuum Seal
description: With a touch, you can seal/unseal an object in a vacuum. When used on food, it can keep it fresh and bacteria-free. Vacuum-sealed objects are also completely insulated, and as such are incapable of being affected by wind, sound, fire, or any other thing that is dependent on air to exist or move. When used on living beings, it suffocates them, and causes various other disturbances to their biological systems. You, however, are immune to the effects of vacuums (although you still need to breath).
summary: The ability to seal objects in a vacuum, preserving them and insulating them from the air
strengths: Can keep food fresh simply by touching it
Can make objects insulated against air-related things
Can incapacitate most enemies with a touch
weaknesses: If sealing yourself, you better take a big breath first
Needless to say, enemies who can survive vacuums are unaffected by this power
If you seal yourself, you won't be able to hear anything, since sound is reliant on air

name: Dark Flame
description: This ability allows you to generate dark energy in the form of black fire or any dark colors (again nothing bright). You can project dark flames from your entire body and even cause objects to melt. You can also shoot dark fireballs of course. With practice you could fly by channeling the dark energy through your body. You won't be able to control fire in any way, so you will still get burned.
summary: The ability to generate dark energy in the form of fire
strengths: Do like the human torch, "Flame on! "
Can intimidate your foes
Can fly but needs practice
weaknesses: Lose control of your power
Running out of energy to burn
This is not pyrokinesis so you won't control fire and are not immune to it

name: Ice Lightning
description: The lighting is so cold that the bolts may freeze. It's light blue in color.
summary: The ability to make ice cold lighting
strengths: Freezes
weaknesses: May kill!

name: Friendship Powered Abilities
description: A person with this power has the ability to gain powers everytime they make a friend. Also they start with the ability to make people more likely to be friendly towards you after talking to them. You can get good powers by meeting great friends. Caring personality equals healing, aggressive personality equals pyrokinesis, cold personality is ice. Shocking personality is electricity. The list goes on and on and no two powers are completely identical. You can only use one ability at a time.
summary: The ability to gain an ability every time you make a friend as well as make friends more easily
strengths: You start with heightened charisma when you have this power.
You get more powers everytime you make a friend
Powers reflect your friends' personality
weaknesses: If your new friend has a disgusting personality, the power you gain will be disgusting too
You can't change people's personalities but all the powers are expected to be positive effects
Some people just won't become your friend and losing friends or your memories means loss of power

name: Ice Mimicry
description: You're like Iceman but you don't have cryokinesis, you just turn into freezing ice. Everything you touch will be frozen. The colder it gets, the more strength & mass you gain. You can even protrude spikes from your body bad of icicles & you can heal instantly from injuries like knife & bullet wounds. Of course, heat will be your downfall & if you gets to hot, you turn back to normal, weak & exhausted.
summary: The ability to convert your body into freezing ice
strengths: Turn into walking super snowman
Produce icicle spikes on your body
Freeze injuries & heal instantly
weaknesses: Heat
Too much heat & you turn back to normal, weak & exhausted

name: Vending
description: With this ability, you will be able to create vending machines out of thin air, for literally any item.
summary: The ability to create vending machines for anything.
strengths: Vending machines for anything.
Literally.
They are created out of thin air.
weaknesses: Need exact change
1 cent per trade (money for object).
Need enough room.

name: Blessing Of Gaea
description: Gaea is the oldest goddess there is. She is the earth goddess and her blessing allows you to gain powers over the earth as well. Besides basically controling it, you can use the earth to heal. Whenever you are wounded, instead of blood, sand will pour out. That sand will then collect over the wound, heal it, and fall away. You can also turn things into any material from the earth and sense things using vibrations from the ground.
summary: The ability to have the blessing of Gaea
strengths: You can control the earth and anything from it
You can change anything into any material from the earth
You can heal and sense things through the earth
weaknesses: It looks weird whenever you get hurt

name: Game God: Card
description: With this ability the user can become basicly omnipotent with card games.  This allows Summoning beings/objects from cards, into the real world to serve you you can summon six thousand copies of each card. You can also designate one copy as a leader, and dominate its mind, making a copy of your mind, you can act through it.  Beings cannot battle each other, you can dismiss them at will, they do not require food, water, and you can revive the dead beings.
summary: The ability to summon monsters from card games.
strengths: Armies of pokemon if you want.
Mind copies.
Normal armies will wet their pants.
weaknesses: You need cards.
You will look childish.
Good cards cost money.

name: Matter Trait Inducement
description: This ability will allow you to create new breeds of matter with their own special characteristics. Take a glass of water; just by touching it, think of the flammability of gaseous matter and it will become flammable, but still be drinkable.
summary: The ability to give one form of matter the traits of a different form of matter.
strengths: Able to make new breeds of matter.
weaknesses: The effects might last forever.

name: Underwater Exploration
description: As soon as you hit water, you turn invisible or turn into a mermaid/merman. Your choice!
summary: The ability to become a mermaid/merman or turn invisible once you hit the water.
strengths: You can breathe underwater
Perfect for sneaking up on your friends in the pool
You can talk to fish
weaknesses: People might get freaked out if they see someone swimming around with a fin

name: Undersea Adaptation
description: With this power, you can get various phenotypes to survive under the sea, which depend on the environment and your needs, e.g. a smooth skin to reduce drag, webbed hands and feet, strong arms and legs for speed, a dorsal fin for stability, oxygen extraction through skin, gills, increased oxygen storage for breath holding, echolocation, an electric organ, an ink sack, camouflage ability, claws, sharp teeth, adaptation to high pressure, a layer of fat to survive in cold waters, and much more!
summary: The ability to adapt your body to any undersea environment.
strengths: Live and survive inside any body of water.
Non exhaustive list of phenotypes. Not limited to existing ones.
Become an excellent swimmer and discover the wonders of the seas.
weaknesses: Can only be activated inside a body of water.
You can only obtain phenotypes that are scientifically plausible.
Changes you into a humanoid aquatic monster.

name: King's Seal
description: With this power you will have a seal that will cause something to happen when it is placed on a object. The seal is unique for each person so each has a different affect. For one person the seal might cause a house to appear while for another it might cause a fire to start. If the seal is broken though the effects of the seal vanish. Each person will have a perfect mental image of what their seal looks like and its effects.
summary: The ability to have a personalized seal that has a unique effect.
strengths: The seal is unique and personal to each person.
Seal can only be used by its owner and will activate when the owner wishes.
Larger seals have increased effects.
weaknesses: Your personalized seal can not be changed.
If seal is broken its powers vanish.
Must be able to recreate your seal in order to use it.

name: Color Bending
description: Really it goes by color. Red-heat Blue-freeze Green-aging things Yellow-light source Orange-slows things down Black-cause total darkness where only you can see Purple-energy amplify Brown-energy drain White-random.
summary: The ability to control different forms of energy
strengths: Multiple uses
Using white is always a surpise
Purple can recharge your powers
weaknesses: People who have battled you before will know what's coming
Using white could become purple which would only help your enemies.
Don't try and mix them together. Trust me.

name: Thermokinetic Bombs
description: Thermokinesis can increase and decrease temperature that results in combustion, melting or freezing. However, this might take long to do because the user has to concentrate until they can reach the boiling or freezing point of the objects, but with Thermokinetic Bomb, the user simultaneously HEATS AND FREEZES THE MOLECULES resulting in a clash of energies ending with a big explosion that can destroy almost ANYTHING!!!
summary: The ability to explode things up through thermokinesis
strengths: Awesome offensive power
Even if the enemy has a shield or armor, they can be attacked on the inside by...
...manipulating the body's thermal energy
weaknesses: Harder to mix opposing HOT AND COLD temperatures in extreme...
...environments, like volcanic areas or in the North and South pole
If emotionally frustrated, a large area can be destroyed, so use with extreme caution

name: Spiked Wings
description: You can project some razor-sharp lead-like quills from the back of the metallic feathery wings which can puncture foes and anything that is in your way.
summary: The ability to fire small nail-like spikes from the back of the metallic wings.
strengths: Could look cool and scary.
weaknesses: Beware of the ones who can manipulate metal.

name: Elemental Dragon
description: This ability allows a person to create and control dragons from the natural elements of rock, fire, wind, water, lightning, or metal. Each dragon created has control over the element they are made from, but are primarily in the control of the user. Empathic connections with each dragon allow the user to merge with the dragon, thus granting such abilities as flight, hydrokinesis, telekinesis, etc.
summary: The ability to create a dragon from various natural elements
strengths: Have control over your desired element.
If your dragons are destroyed, their merging to you will grant you near-immortality!
You can use a dragon's power on your own if you desire.
weaknesses: Each dragon can be destroyed by the polar opposite of their element.
You are vulnerable to counteractive forces (magnetism to metal, heat to water, etc. )
If all your dragons are destroyed, they will merge back into you.

name: Shamanic Mind
description: Man has always felt a connection to his home (my tree, my horse, my TV). A Shaman can communicate with their claimed home, influencing events diverse as weather patterns, wildlife, and even stochastic fields--that is, luck. However, it takes time for them to be able to influence an area; until they feel comfortable, nothing will happen. Shamanism is also a two-way street--the environment holds a great deal of sway over them as well, compelling them to aid it in any way it requires.
summary: The ability to commune with your surroundings
strengths: Influence weather patterns, luck, wildlife, etc.
Works anywhere you feel is your home
May become very influential over environment
weaknesses: Will not work unless you are comfortable with surroundings
Takes time to fully master
Environment influences user as well

name: Blade Creation
description: If you have a broken blade and if you touch steel, the steel will travel from where you touch to the handle and rebuild the blade. If you touch magma, you will be burned, but you will have a magma blade. Any material will work, even water or any liquids will solidify into sharp solids.
summary: The ability to use any material you touch to make blades on handles
strengths: No broken swords and Gatorade blade XD
Magma Blade!!!
If you have pain immunity or healing powers, you're set
weaknesses: When you dont have healing or pain immunity
Will have scars from harmful materials

name: Targeted Lightning Strike
description: They say "lightning never strikes twice in the same place." But with this power, you prove them wrong. All you have to do is point to & focus where you want lightning to strike. The cons of this power is it has to be natural lightning, not man-made & you can't create a lightning storm, one most already be naturally forming. So you would have live in an area where storms occur frequently & also watch the weather news. Also not immune to lightning strikes yourself.
summary: The ability to make lightning strike where you want it to
strengths: Make someone or thing a lightning rod by pointing at them
weaknesses: Not immune to lightning, so don't be to close to where ever you target
Have to be in a stormy area with lightning

name: Cosmic Seeker
description: This is like a heat seeking rocket but it's in a form of an orb that tracks and destroy. First, you must absorb a great amount of cosmic rays to use this. It's a guaranteed hit, even if someone will evade it with superhuman reflexes or superspeed.
summary: The ability to absorb cosmic rays and turn it into an energy orb weapon.
strengths: A sure hit of the target no matter what.
weaknesses: Cannot use if no cosmic rays to absorb and.
Orb can be destroyed/absorbed

name: Wind Walk
description: You are able to walk in the air without falling.  This is not an ILLUSION!  It's not flying, either.  You walk through the air!!!
summary: The ability to walk in air.
strengths: Can escape from bad guy/good guy
You can avoid traffic
Good way to impress friends
weaknesses: Umm... none

name: Energy Disc
description: The disc are formed and controlled by your thoughts. They can be held like a shield deflecting projectiles, or used as a projectile. You can levitate on them and you are immune to your own disc.
summary: The ability to fire energy based discs
strengths: Immune to your own discs
Fire energy based disc...'nuff siad
weaknesses: Not immune to discs of others

name: Magma Ring
description: With this power you call forth a ring to manipulate and control Molten lava. While you have the ring on you are immune to the effects of Molten lava and the ring will not come off. You make things out of lava. You can walk right through a river of Molten lava without getting hurt but, anyone else will get hurt.
summary: The ability to call forth a ring that can manipulate and control the element of Molten lava.
strengths: With the ring on you are immune to the effects of Molten lava
Ring will not come off.
You can walk right through river of Molten lava with getting hurt
weaknesses: Ring will not come off.
The ring has the power not you
People may fear you

name: Viscosity Control
description: With this power you can change the viscosity of any liquid, meaning you can make it flow slower or faster. You can throw enemies in bodies of water and then speed up the current in order to injure them, you can cause honey to come out of the dang bottle faster or you can cause a bleeding person's blood to flow very fast so that they bleed to death before their platelets can react.
summary: The ability to change the rate of flow of any liquid
strengths: You can control the rate of speed at which a liquid flows
weaknesses: You can only make liquids move faster

name: Solar Fueled
description: With this ability, you become more powerful by the amount of sun rays you're exposed to. On a mild day, as long as the sun is out, it would allow you to knock over a truck, run the speed of a car, have extremely quick reflexes, and superhuman stamina. In the summer, you become fully-charged, and these abilities can multiply by 5. However, cloudy and rainy days leave you at normal human ability. This also supercharges any superpowers you have, if you happen to have any.
summary: The ability to become potentially superhuman varying on the weather.
strengths: Become supercharged in the sun, gaining super strength, speed, stamina, and reflexes.
A hot, summer day could increase thes abilities by a maximum of 5.
Also supercharges any superpowers that you may have.
weaknesses: Cloudy, rainy days leave you at normal power.
You're most likely not going to have much power during the winter, or in cloudy areas.
An overload of power could cause you to become dangerous, destroying things by accident.

name: Power Malfunction
description: Any superpowered being that goes against you will have to do so at their own risk since they do not know the results of their own abilities. For example, a person with pyrokinesis may accidentally create an explosive flame in front of themself. Also, this may cause people to use another power by accident. When using superstrength, they may accidentally use healing touch or alternatively fire breath.
summary: The ability to make superpowers malfunction temporarily
strengths: When someone with superpowers goes against you, their powers are out of their control
Some of the results may be funny, such as creating a stuffed bear when they wanted to make a monster
You may not need to fight at all, letting the other person blow themself up.
weaknesses: The results are out of your control and people can improvise
The person may find a new use for their powers afterward, i.e. ice making from water manipulation
This can happen to your own powers as well

name: Opposite Power Absorption
description: When you touch someone with a super power, you will absorb their power but it is inverted, e.g. fire balls would equal snow balls, and vice versa. If the power does not have an opposite, you will not absorb it and you can only hold one power at a time.
summary: The ability to absorb the opposite of other people's powers
strengths: You get superpowers
They can be really powerful
weaknesses: If there is no opposite, you will not get one.
You can only hold onto one at a time.

name: The Greek/Roman Effect
description: You can warp reality by Sayning two or three different Greek Alphabets or Roman Numerals which you can use to create dimensional portals, force fields, transmute objects, freeze objects, burn objects or simply etc. If you say Phi Beta - You get Tactile Aerokinesis, Alpha Gamma Sigma - Green Geyser Ground-Shaker.
summary: The ability to call on a different power by shouting out 2 or 3 Greek Alphabets or Roman Numerals.
strengths: You can warp reality by Sayning two or three different Greek Alphabets or Roman Numerals
create dimensional portals, force fields, transmute objects, freeze objects, burn objects
Green Geyser Ground-Shaker
weaknesses: None.

name: Waveform Mimicry (Wave Form)
description: Instead of being able to manipulate different kinds of waves, one with this ability can become a living wave and use his own body as an attack. Become a carrier wave and dive into the ground to become a living earthquake; dive into the water and become a living tidal wave; fly through the air as a normal vibration or a living sound wave; if one is really talented, they could even turn into a thought wave to dominate a foes thoughts (and use minds for a quick, convenient mode of travel).
summary: The ability to assume the form of any kind of energy wave
strengths: Turn into any kind of wave (radio wave, light wave, sound wave, magnetic wave, carrier wave, etc. )
Extremely powerful attacks, and extremely fast and efficient travel
Sometimes allows you to perceive different types of waves in human form
weaknesses: Better know the properties of that wave (don't turn into a soundwave in a soundproof room)
People who can manipulate waves
Some with this ability can only become one type of wave

name: Power Shambles
description: An example: suppose someone has two super powers, the ability to shoot heat rays from their eyes and the ability to freeze things via touch. When effected by Power Shambles, the mechanics of these powers would randomize so that they were shooting freeze rays from their eyes and heating things via touch. The more superpowers someone has the more opportunities arise for things to be switched around, and this power leaves no superpower alone when invoked. Every power someone has is changed.
summary: The ability to shuffle the mechanics of someones superpowers.
strengths: Switch up the machanics of peoples superpowers, disorienting them.
Get through an unbreakble defence by randomising what the defence protects that person from.
Shamble yourself to try and get better powers.
weaknesses: The powers are shambled randomly, you have no control over it.
This power is not exempt from its effect. If you shamble yourself you may not be able to go back.

name: Mega Light Beam Vision
description: With this power you can shoot a mega light beam out of your eyes. A mega light beam is a yellow beam that burns right through the person/object it is aimed at and blinds all of the people around him/her. The beam cannot burn or blind you.
summary: The ability to shoot a mega light beam from your eyes
strengths: You can burn/blind your enemies
Your beam cannot affect you
weaknesses: You cannot make the beam less painful

name: Brainwave Manipulation
description: Every function of our body is controlled by our brain and the electrical signals it produces. A Brainwave Manipulator can speed up or slow down these signals, and thus the thinking processes, of other people. They can slow a person down so much that they seem to be frozen, or speed them up to computer-like levels. However, they must be careful. Speeding someone up for too long can burn out their neurons, and keeping them slow can slow their breathing and deprive them of air.
summary: The ability to manipulate the speed of thinking processes
strengths: Can affect up to 10 people
Help people during tests or other situations
Slow your foes and easily defeat them
weaknesses: Cannot be used on yourself without painful feedback
People who are slowed see the world as extremely fast (pretty obvious)
People who are speeded still limited by their bodies (no light-speed reflexes)

name: Centrifugal Force Manipulation
description: With this power you can make anything spin faster or slower or make things spin. You can make the air spin to create tornadoes. You can make projectiles spin to change its trajectory. You can also create artificial gravity by spinning the air around you. You can also soften dirt by making a select portion of the ground spin if you train enough.
summary: The ability to control centrifugal force
strengths: You can make anything spin
You can become dizzy if you make yourself spin or look at spinning things too long
You can be creative with this power
weaknesses: You can only make things spin you cannot move the objects by itself
If you spin parts of your body that is not supposed to spin they will break

name: Transferring Injuries
description: If a person was hit with a baseball bat, the person possessing this power could transfer the pain from their friend to a rock, or a mirror, relieving the persons pain and shattering or cracking the rock/mirror.
summary: The ability to move Injuries From One Person/Object To Another
strengths: You can save pain from pain
You can hurt others at the same time
You can heal yourself
weaknesses: If you loose concentration, the isn't transferred
Initially, you can't move the pain very far

name: Aesthetic Assimilation
description: Imagine a hero whose 'base power' is pyrokinesis. By this I mean what s/he is known for, what their essential, underlying ability or theme (fire) is. If this hero suddenly teleported away, or began to fly, it could appear out of character. This power, allows you to use additional powers in the style of your basic ones. The pyrokinetic could teleport in a blast of flame, or the water manipulator could fly with a trail of mist following them. No strict rules on this one. Use your imagination!
summary: The ability to carry out additional powers in the aesthetic style of your 'base' superpower or theme.
strengths: Helps to sustain a hero's image in their day to day hero-ing actvities.
Not a practical power, but a useful one if you're concerned about the public face you present.
Think of the way the Human Torch's flight is linked in with his Pyric Mimicry. It's awesome.
weaknesses: Has no effect on mental abilities or ones which are purely physical, like super strength or agility.
Would also have no effect if the hero has no discernible base power or theme.
If you are unfortunate enough to be a Jelly-kinetic, it could make everything a bit ridiculous...

name: Heated Touch
description: A person with Heated Touch can make their hands hot. Like 10,000 degrees C hot. Like disintegrating things because they burn so fast hot. Sadly, this ability is not a projectile. Around an inch from your hands and the temperature is normal.
summary: The ability to generate heat from your hands
strengths: Cook bacon on your palm
Escaping confinement
Fights don't happen much
weaknesses: Is not ranged, have to touch
Fueled by concentration
Cannot make any other body part hot

name: Form Reversal
description: Just point at something and think. Glass is now sand. Wine is now grapes. A pillow is now a duck. OK, that last one does break some laws of logic, but it's all good. This can be very useful. If you throw a chair and change it into a tree in mid-flight, the effect can be devastating. Turn tires into tree sap, thwarting any getaway attempts. You can even go back multiple steps. Ex: Plastic into Oil; Oil into Dinosaur.
summary: The ability to revert an object to its previous form
strengths: Nothing is immune
Good for mulligans
Can heal teammates by reversing them to pristine state
weaknesses: Cannot reverse the direction of objects; bullets just become really fast rocks
Cannot move anything forward
Requires some massive leaps of logic

name: Nitro Kinesis
description: A person with this power has the power to control the element of nitrogen. Not only can the user rip out nitrogen from the air which is pretty much 75% nitrogen and nitrogen compounds, the user can also create reactions using nitrogen. For example, the user can create highly unstable compounds that explode and cause nitrogen to react with carbon producing cyanide. They can also produce laughing gas. Nitrogen in its elemental form can be used as liquid nitrogen to freeze your enemies.
summary: The ability to control the element of nitrogen, including shifting its phases and creating chemical reactions
strengths: Liquid nitrogen can be used to freeze people because it is a cryogen
Extremely versatile reactions-too many to list here in the pros
It is abundant in the Earth's atmosphere-it's basically 75%
weaknesses: You still need to breathe. So, a nitrogen armor isn't such a good idea
You need to be extremely skilled and know chemistry to create the correct chemical reactions

name: Random Reality Warp
description: You can fire energy bolts from your hands , which when they impact on an object, can cause random reality warps. You have little control of the unlikeliness of the reality change. It can range from making someone trip over by bad luck, to erasing someone from existence or turning a cloud into a gold bar. If you calculate the theoretical odds of an event occuring, you cause that exact outcome, for example making a coin land heads up, which has a 1 in 2 chance.
summary: The ability to fire energy bolts that cause random reality warps
strengths: You are a very unpredicatable, and potentially very powerful fighter
If you're lucky, you could have just the warp you want
When you wish for something with all your heart, a warp has a greater chance of causing it
weaknesses: This power can be incredibly dangerous, if a warp occurs that you don't want
Due to the random nature of your power, any bad warps are practically impossible to undo
Your bolts may be lethal to a foe, when you wish only to stun them

name: Pagokinesis
