description: Unlike Cryokinesis which controls ice, Pagokinesis controls the Cold Air that turns water into ice. It grows stronger with the natural cold air around you. Also, the more you use the ability in a specific area, the colder your environment gets.
summary: The ability to control the Cold Air.
strengths: It's like manipulating water and air
The colder it is, the stronger it is
Can be used for flight and speed as well
weaknesses: Cannot manipulate water, only the ice
Grows weaker in warmer temperatures

name: Blessing Of Poseidon
description: Poseidon is the Greek god of the sea. His gift allows you to channel the power of the sea in different ways. You can manipulate sea water and even breath underwater. You can also speak to sea creatures, gain strengh when in sea water, and know your position when at sea. Another thing, when you come in contact with water it will crawl along your skin and heal any wounds you have. And you only get wet when you want. The power of the sea is in your hands.
summary: The ability to have the gift of the sea god, Poseidon.
strengths: You can control sea water and breath .
You can speak to sea creatures, and know your position at sea.
You can heal and gain strengh from the sea.
weaknesses: You are drawn to the sea
You can only use your powers with sea water

name: Reed In The Wind
description: There is a short story about trees and reeds in a storm and the tree is knocked over because it won't bend to the might of the storm but the reeds are absolutely fine because they bent when they needed to. The user (a reed) of this power applies the lesson taught by the reeds in the story to superpowered attacks(storms). Basically the user has to act as if there is no need to defend in mind and body causing the attack to go through them without causing any harm.
summary: The ability to be unaffected by a superpowered attack by acting as though one has no need to defend oneself
strengths: Can be used against any attack caused with a superpower.
Good example of this is in the manga Shaman King.
weaknesses: Won't help with getting past defensive powers.
Can't remember if it was willows or reeds in the story. Please change name and text if I'm wrong.
Really hard to act as if there is no need to defend.

name: Magma Kinesis
description: A person with this power has the ability to create and control magma. The user does not have a magma body. In addition they are immune to the heat and effects of their own magma. Using magma they can burn things and if they let it cool it can also petrify things. The user with practice can even create magma constructs and force the magma to cool faster to form mineral constructs.
summary: The ability to create and control magma
strengths: Burn things
Petrify things
You are immune to the heat
weaknesses: Might destroy the things you want to petrify---ie heat damage
Only you are immune to the heat and damage so you might leave a trail of collateral damage

name: Wave Control
description: The power to control and manipulate all waves in the universe. You can control a person's brainwaves. Send sound waves back or even negate them. Control heat waves and bend them to your whim. All things that are waves are yours to control in any way you see fit.
summary: The ability to have complete control over all waves, from water waves to brainwaves and every other ones.
strengths: The power to manipulate forces to your will
The power to control energy and electromagnetic waves
The power to manipulate the waves on the sea
weaknesses: Is not an automatic ability and requires one to be awake.

name: Hydro Monster
description: With this power, you can create monsters out of water. You can also create a monster around you and control it. Being able to control the monsters, you can turn them into ice. You can also breathe under water. You can use anything that has water. A juice monster would be kind of funny
summary: The ability to create monsters made of water
strengths: You do not need to use the water around you
You can turn the water into ice
weaknesses: The ice can shatter

name: Aura Attune: Fire
description: With this power, you may attune your aura with Fire. While active, all mystical and spiritual abilities related to fire or heat are greatly empowered, but all water related ones are weakened. You also become more resistant to Fire powers, but weaker to Water-related powers. This power also makes your aura like that of a powerful Fire Elemental, causing fire-aligned beings to treat you with respect. Water-aligned beings, however, fear or hate you. Luckily, this power can be turned on and off.
summary: The ability to attune your aura with the element of Fire.
strengths: Empower your spiritual or magical fire powers.
Have fire-aligned creatures treat you with respect or friendliness.
Become more resistant to harmful fire powers.
weaknesses: Weakens magical and spiritual water powers.
Water-aligned creatures hate or fear you.
Weaker to harmful water powers.

name: Matter Mimicry
description: With this power you can turn into a gas, liquid or solid. So, now you can turn in to a puddle of water and go into the girl's locker room!
summary: The ability to turn yourself into any state of matter.
strengths: Go into the girls locker room as a puddle of orange crush
weaknesses: Can only liquefy of turn yourself into a gas. Can't shapeshift.

name: Invidia
description: This is a power that allows the user to imitate another person's powers or abilities. The powers copied however are at a lesser degree to the the original. For example, if copying a fire user's power, one may not be able to use it as effectively as the original person copied from. However, the user may be able to use the power more effectively if their envy takes over. The more envious of the original the more powerful it becomes. The power is timed however and the effect won't last forever.
summary: The ability to copy another's powers or abilities to a certain degree
strengths: Can copy any power or ability no matter what it is
Gets stronger as one's envy of the original increases
weaknesses: Is only temporary and the copied power will wear out eventually
Usually always inferior to the original
Can't copy more than one power at a time due to the strain put on the user

name: Water Jets
description: A person with this power does not have hydrokinesis, instead they have the ability to shoot water from their pores like a water gun. However, not just any water gun-you can control the pressure of the water shot by your pores from being a simple water gun to the point that it can shatter stone and kill people. The user can fire water out indefinitely. In addition the user can use the jets as a means of propulsion if mastered, though you will likely hit bystanders on the ground-try jumps instead.
summary: The ability to shoot out high pressurized water from your pores
strengths: You can shoot the water out of any of your pores and from your retina as well.
You can control the pressure from being a water gun to being able to shatter stone and kill
You can "fly" with this ability, except it is very easy to hit bystanders and kill them
weaknesses: This doesn't come with hydrokinesis, so it's only a shot of water (albeit strong)
It conducts electricity so-just a warning
You might accidentally flood the town while trying to save it (very likely for beginners)

name: Freezing Fire
description: This gives you the ability to shoot fire that freezes on contact. It is useless against some abilities.
summary: The ability to shoot fire that turns into ice.
strengths: Works underwater.
You can burn then freeze opponents.
weaknesses: Is useless against magic.
Cannot work against people with the abilities of pyrokinesis and cryokinesis

name: Heat Shock
description: With this ability, you can create powerful electrical blasts on a sweltering hot day. You are immune to heat with this power. Say if someone lit you on fire, you'd absorb all those flames and channel it into killer electrical shocks at your foe. A master could walk into lava and turn all that heat into electrical attacks. This power is fueled by heat, so one would be at a disadvantage in the extreme cold.
summary: The ability to turn heat into electricity
strengths: Never get burned again!
Power up your cellphone just by putting on hand on the stove and the other on your phone.
weaknesses: Powerless if in extreme cold.
Not immune to acid or lightning.
Can be a bit draining.

name: 100 Obsidian Shards
description: Obsidian is one of the sharpest or the sharpest material on Earth known to mankind. It can hold a perfect-looking edge as small as a few nanometres. While using this power you can create shards of obsidian with edges of 1 nanometre in sets of 100 and fire them in any direction you choose.
summary: The ability to create and fire off 100 shards of obsidian
strengths: The shards will be around 1 metre long.
weaknesses: It has to be in sets of 100 shards.
Obsidian is very brittle.

name: Wound Change
description: This power allows the user to change any injury into a different injury of the same severity. For example, a huge bleeding gash across someones leg could be changed into a broken leg, or a burn spread across the leg. You can also move the injury when you change it, like turning a bloody nose into a nasty bruise on someones arm. You can also change old injuries, such as scars and amputations, into something else so long as they are visible.
summary: The ability to change one type of injury into another.
strengths: Change injuries that you don'y know how to, or are difficult to, treat into simpler ones.
Broken leg? Bleeding badly? Change them and get moving.
If something gets choped off, just swap around which body part you're missing.
weaknesses: It does nothing to diminish the pain, and in some cases may make it worse.
You can't save anyones life with this power alone.
If a wound was fatal before you changed it you'll only be able to change it to other fatal wounds.

name: Prop Realism
description: Say you have to work on a Harry Potter movie. You can make wands for the characters that actually fire off spells. It doesn't just stop there though. Think of the possibilities. The Dagger from Prince of Persia; The Car from Back to the Future; The whole of Hogwarts! You can even make sets that are real, or, as long as the person in question agrees, you can make anyone crumble to dust, burn to ashes or age to a skeleton. There are no limits. Forget the sky: Your imagination is the true limit!
summary: The ability to make props for a movie that actually work.
strengths: Make anything you could possibly imagine.
You can recall anything that you don't like.
If you don't have good imagination, just copy from movies.
weaknesses: Still causes, even if only a little, pain to the people you fake kill

name: Microconcussion Inducing Eyes
description: A person with this power has the ability to emit a wave from their eyes that can travel like light and can be reflected off reflective surfaces. When seen, the target receives a selective microconcussion in their brain. The microconcussion can range from loss of motor functions to loss of superpowers to disabling of senses. All effects are temporary.
summary: The ability to instantly cause a microconcussion on the conscious parts of the brain through eye contact
strengths: Disable motor functions
Disable superpowers
Disable pain receptors etc.
weaknesses: Does not work on subconscious-no killing with this power
Is only a microconcussion, not an instant knock out
Eye contact needs to be made

name: Whistling The Wind
description: Anyone who has this power may be able to conjure up a wind from the direction their facing by making a noise. Commonly this is done by whistling,but can also be done by clapping, singing, playing a musical instrument or even clicking your tongue. The more intense the noise, and the more intense the effort, the stronger the wind summoned.
summary: The ability to call up wind via a noise.
strengths: With practice, the user may even be able to cause winds to blow weather towards or away them.
Always have a cool breeze in summer.
Will always win in sailing competitions.
weaknesses: The user can only summon the wind, not control it.
The user can't summon a southern wind if they're facing north.
If you're unable to make a noise, or are not outside.

name: Ghostly Permafrost
description: This power allows you to release an ectoplasm wave that freezes any liquid permanently. The liquid turns into an ice that never melts and is as strong as a diamond. The hyper cooled ectoplasm has the same consistency as a ghost (Ghosts are made of ectoplasm, right? ) and passes through any solid thing, but not liquids. Using this power you can kill an enemy by freezing the blood inside him. The Permafrost Ice is really strong, but a well-placed attack can shatter it.
summary: The ability to shoot waves of hyper cooled ectoplasm that can permanently freeze any liquid.
strengths: Can freeze any liquid
Makes you nearly unbeatable against liquid-powered enemies (including beings with blood).
The Permafrost Ice is as strong as a diamond.
weaknesses: Works only on liquids, and your emotions can make your power stronger or weaker
You can freeze liquids, but you can't control ice.
Astrakinesis, Hydrokinesis AND Cryokinesis can control the ectoplasmed water

name: Paper Manipulation
description: Paper carried around can be manipulated in size and strength, and if skillful enough, can be manipulated in a telekinetic-like fashion. It's portable and allows a variety of uses.
summary: The ability to manipulate paper
strengths: Portable and unexpected. Who's gonna think you're actually armed when all they find on you is paper?
Transportation. If you're too lazy to walk, resize and ride it like a flying carpet.
Weapon and shield-resilient against blades and various other attacks, can be folded into weapons.
weaknesses: Weakness against water. The paper softens and weakens immensely like regular paper.
Death against fire. Paper burns to a crisp like regular paper.
Energy in energy attacks counteracts the paper magic and rips it like regular paper.

name: Property Intensification
description: Property Intensification allows the user to intensify, or make a property of any matter that they come in contact to, except living organisms. They can make a razor blade sharp enough to cut through diamond with the flick of a wrist, or make a piece of wood harder then diamond. They can also intensify other properties, making some thing yield far more or less explosive power then its capable of, or even intensify a weakness, making steal as brittle as a mirror, or making rock flexible.
summary: The ability to the ablility to intensify the properties of matter.
strengths: Instantly sharpen or harden any object, or weaken it (among other things.)
Walls really can't stop you.
Not directly dangerous to living organisms.
weaknesses: Must come in to physical contact with  the matter
The effect wears off after a minute after the user is no longer touching it or activating the power.
Must be used indirectly to be used offensively.

name: Burning Air
description: You can heat the air in an area. Everything within it will keep getting hotter until stopped. The objects or people in the area will either start to burn or melt. Metal and other meltable materials will melt, while unmeltable objects or organisms will be turned to ashes. The area you can burn things in will increase with practice. Will only affect objects or organisms you want it to affect in that area. If you choose to leave something in that area unaffected they won't even notice the heat.
summary: The ability to heat the air in an area
strengths: No more need for lighters or matches
Can heat a cold room
Burn enemies
weaknesses: Hard to control at first
Must concentrate on what you want to get burned within that area
Can cause damage to the climate of your location within fifty miles

name: Surface Morphisis
description: A person with Surface Morphisis can absorb when in physical contact with a substance. E.g when touching iron you become iron. when touching concrete you become concrete. when touching rock you become rock. There is so much potential with this ability you can become any element or compound as long as you are in physical contact with it. You add it to you biology then you can revert back to normal.
summary: The ability to take the form of a surface, by touching it.
strengths: Can become as strong as any material you surface morph into.
Can morph into any solid material you are in conact with.
weaknesses: Must be in physical contact with the material.
The materials must be solid. No liquids like water.

name: Ice Ball
description: Using a drop of water on the palm as a catalyst, can form and levitate a ball of pure ice between one half inch and nine feet across. Up to several hundred small balls (with running water over the hands) or 1-3 large balls can be formed depending on will.
summary: The ability to form perfect spheres of ice.
strengths: Ball of ice 9' in diameter.
Never run out of ice for the party.
Hundreds of small balls of ice can be used as a shield.
weaknesses: Never turns off.
Too slippery to be used for flight.

name: The Exion Knight
description: With Exion Knight ability, you can control and summon many swords and shields at once. The swords summoned can be as small or as large as possible. The shields can be as sturdy or as flimsy as needed too. Both swords and shields can be telekinetically moved through the air at will. Controlling multiple swords is generally much easier than controlling multiple shields purely because of their vast size differences.
summary: The ability to control both multiple swords and multiple shields at once.
strengths: Has a powerful defense and offense
Can make many shapes out of swords
Shields can be used as transportation
weaknesses: It is very destructive, even if the user means well
Controlling too many of either can cause a mental breakdown
The strength of the shields comes from the strength of the user

name: Myth Power: Poseidon's Prestige
description: Poseidon, in Greek myth, was the god of the waters, horses and earthquakes; he was also King of the Oceans and Seas. As such, channeling him allows one to control water; summoning moisture out of thin air to form water, causing tidal waves and the like. In addition, one gains command over all the creatures of the sea (fish, shellfish, whales, dolphins, otters, turtles, etc); furthermore, one can breathe underwater, swim with amazing power, walk on water and to teleport through water.
summary: The ability to channel Poseidon's command over the forces of water, the oceans and the seas
strengths: Gain the ability to manipulate water, bending it to one's will, regardless of its physical state)
All sea creatures are at your command, and so are horses
Breathe underwater, walk on water, teleport through water, swim well and withstand water pressure
weaknesses: Cannot disrupt or negate aquatic/water/sea/ocean-based MythPowers until the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot induce earthquakes until the higher levels (no Con Negation)
Absence of moisture or sea critters/horses (and you can only compel them, not speak with them)

name: Bullet Catch
description: This ability allows you to catch bullets with your bare hands. Of course, you can catch other fast moving objects as well, as long as it's within reason. No trains or anything. Time will slow down when the bullet comes near you, giving you time to react to it. Other things to catch include large shrapnel, rocks, and flung monkey poop.
summary: The ability to catch any fast-moving object, bullets included.
strengths: Stop bullets from hitting you.
Save people from getting hit.
weaknesses: The military will want to probe your ass with very uncomfortable prods.

name: Myth Power: Chione's Kindness
description: Chione (Khione), in Greek myth, was the goddess of cold, ice and snow. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive the onset of winter and similarly cold weather, at will. In addition, one may psychically teleport to any cold, icy or snowy environment at will, as well as gain physical power when in said environment. Furthermore, one can psychically perceive, generate and manipulate cold, ice and snow at will. One can even withstand cold, and share this immunity, by touch, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Chione's command over the essence of the cold, ice and snow
strengths: Psychically perceive the onset of winter, and similarly cold weather, at will
Teleport self and others to any cold environment; gain physical power in cold environments
Psychically perceive and generate/manipulate cold/ice/snow; withstand cold (may be shared by touch)
weaknesses: Cannot assume an ice form (or turn others to ice via touch) until developed (NCN)
Cannot induce or manipulate cold weather AT ALL; it's covered by MythPower: Horae (Seasons1) (NCN)
Cold Immunity and MythPower: Way of the Winds provide immunity (NCN)

name: Water Mimicry
description: A water mimic can become one of the most powerful forces on planet Earth at will. They can flow around objects, through pipelines, and generate crushing water jets from their hands.
summary: The ability to turn your bodily tissues into water
strengths: Awesome spy
Never get trapped
Unnerving to your foes to watch
weaknesses: Freezing temperatures
Boiling temperatures
The desert

name: Modder
description: Modders, or Modifiers, are people who create their own custom modifications for certain games. With this power you can tweak real life, creating things with your power. You can't grant life, or destroy it directly, but you can create entire cities, entire lakes, and even seas. You can kill indirectly however, such as modifying it so a small pocket of air is created inside a man's arteries, or someone might accidentally slip on an unseen object.
summary: The ability to mod in real life.
strengths: Can modify almost anything.
weaknesses: Incredibly, incredibly, hard to use.

name: Fire Wall
description: This wall is an 8x8x1 wall of fire. Anything can go through the wall, but will more than likely be caught on fire and/or turned into ash, depending on what goes through. The wall will last for as long as the user wishes. The wall cannot be moved in any way, so if the wall is needed in a different place, the user will have to dismiss the wall and re-create it at the desired location. The user cannot create more than one wall at a time.
summary: The ability to create a wall that is made of nothing but fire.
strengths: Catches your enemies on fire if they try to go through.
Lasts forever if the user wishes.
Protected from projectiles.
weaknesses: Can't create more than one Fire Wall.
Water can put it out.
Can't move the wall freely.

name: The Paths Of Magic:The Sorceror
description: The Path of the Sorceror, or the Path of the Write, is the forth Path of Magic. Sorcerors use the written form of the original magical language magicians used. These symbols, however,were never the base for any language, and were sometimes recorded in ancient books. When used, they cause different changes in their surroundings. For example, when the symbol for fire is written and energized, the air(or whatever else)above it, will ignite. The affects of some symbols won't be what you expect.
summary: The ability to have special talent for sorcery.
strengths: You have special talent for sorcery
The symbols can be written anywhere
weaknesses: The symbols weren't recorded often
Sorcery takes time to prepare, even if it is powerful

name: Black Powder Manipulation
description: You can make the black powder move around as you wish, cause it to explode as if it was ignited in a small space, and create up to 5 liters of black powder from the air at will.
summary: The ability to create and control black powder
strengths: Instant weapon.
weaknesses: Black powder isn't as good as modern combustion materials.

name: Medicine Water
description: With this power you can turn any amount of water into any kind of liquid medicine. You also instantly know all of the properties, side effects and proper dosages of the medicine that you the water into. You cannot turn the medicine back into water.
summary: The ability to turn water into any liquid medicine
strengths: You can turn water into medicine
You know the properties, side effects and proper dosages of the medicine
If an enemy is drinking water you can turn the water into medicine and possibly make them overdose
weaknesses: You cannot turn the medicine back into water

name: Fragarach
description: This sword can do four things. 1) No one can tell a lie as long as this sword is at there throat. 2) Command the winds. 3) Cut through any shield and wall. 4) Inflict wounds from which no man could recover.
summary: The ability to summon a sword that can do four things
strengths: Cut through any shield and wall
Possess a legendary sword
People will be afraid of you ( pro & con )
weaknesses: Can only do four things
Can only be destroyed by any immortal
People will try to steal the sword

name: Mirror Mirror Beam
description: You can shoot a beam out of your hands to reverse a person's personality, ethics, powers. For example, think of it like this: The average power user and his abilities are Fire and he is really serious all the time and he fights for justice. Now, he is an Ice user and he just relaxes and goes with the flow. Oh yeah, did I mention he just killed a puppy?
summary: The ability to change a person's personality, ethics and powers.
strengths: Mess with you Opponent's psyche
If your opponent's power is super-strength, now his power is Super weakness
Super Villains and Super Heros will change sides
weaknesses: They might become a better fighter
If people have a neutral ability that can't change, you will be given extreme pain
Super Villains and Super Heros will change sides

name: Banish
description: If someone is pissing you off or whatever, all you have to do is blink once at them & they will be teleported to somewhere else. The restrictions are that it has to be on earth, you have to know the place you are banishing them to, & they will be placed in a safe place. Not in a dangerous area.
summary: The ability to teleport someone somewhere far away
strengths: Get rid of someone instantly
weaknesses: Has to be teleported on earth
Have to know where the location is you're exiling them to

name: Equillibrium Effects
description: A person with this power can create something as long as the correct opposite was created at the same time. For example, creating a hero will also create a villain. To emit a heat wave you will also create a cold wave. Creating matter will create antimatter. With practice the user can create one effect and hold a charge and later enact the opposite effect. Alternatively the effects can be fired at different directions. The amount of charges you have depends on your willpower.
summary: The ability to do anything as long as the opposite is also done
strengths: You can heal and inflict pain at the same time
You can shoot fire and ice at two different directions
You can fly as long as you dig the same amount of time afterwards
weaknesses: You only have limited amount of charges depending on willpower
Some things have no opposites
Antimatter is very dangerous-so it is not a good idea to actively materialize things

name: Plasma Walk
description: You can walk or run straight through all obstacles by plasma burning right through them.
summary: The ability to walk or run in a straight line and burn through everything in your path.
strengths: No obstacles can stop you.
"bump" people in a hall and disintegrate them.
weaknesses: Must deactivate to turn.
Cannot go up stairs.

name: Cochlear Hair Cell Mimicry
description: A type of Neuron Mimic. When activated, you'll have a much better sense of hearing than the average human being. You can also convert vibrations you perceive, such as soundwaves, into electricity and/or special neuronal signals. By sending those signals to someone's auditory cortex (near the temples in humans), you allow them to hear what you hear as long as you want. You can also hear things more clearly than normal when you're under water because the vibrations are enhanced.
summary: The ability to hear better, convert vibrations into electrical impulses and allow people to hear what you hear.
strengths: You will never suffer from decreased hearing sensitivity due to aging or damages.
You have a much better sense of hearing than normal people.
It could help you acquire absolute pitch through training.
weaknesses: You can be deafened by extremely loud or very high-pitched vibrations.

name: Deltakinesis
description: A chemical reaction is a process which leads to the transformation of one set of chemical substances to another. You can control these things. So let's say you have some eggs. You could crack them on any suface and make them start cooking without any heat. Or you could make water start to boil. You could even cause something to start sizzling as if it was covered in acid.
summary: The ability to control chemical reactions.
strengths: You could simulate and control any chemical reaction.
You could be very powerful.
weaknesses: You should learn more about chemicals before attempting anything big.

name: Gift: Wind
description: Basically, someone with this power is better at controlling winds and air than other beings. Thus their wind- or air-based powers are stronger than most other being's powers and it is harder to take control of air from them. However, someone with this power can only receive air-based powers, nothing else.
summary: The ability to be gifted at the control of wind and air
strengths: Almost no one has as good control over air as someone with this power.
Air-based powers are boosted slightly.
weaknesses: Can only have one gift.
Two beings with the same gift will cancel out the control aspect.
Pretty much restricted to only air-based powers now.

name: Telekinetic Virus
description: This power is a strange one. Instead of normal telekinesis the user gains telekinetic control over anything that a virus they spread infects. The viruses can infect people, objects, even things such as fire and water(however you cannot things that deteriorate like it from doing so). Eventually the viruses will die out and create a "set" that you can manipulate. Each set is the total number of things that have been infected and are under your control.
summary: The ability to create supernatural viruses that give telekinetic control over what they affect.
strengths: Once something is infected you can manipulate it no matter the distance.
You can control as many infected objects as you want at once.
Infect pieces of the terrain to use against enemies.
weaknesses: Is things in a set are destroyed/die then you can no longer manipulate them(except for their corpse)
You cannot control how the virus spreads.
The virus dosen't infect things with telesthetic immunity.

name: Witch Fire
description: Witch Fire is magical fire that can be used for different effects. For example, the smoke produced can give (when breathed in) people temporary magical abilities. Also, the ash it creates has magical properties. When sprinkled on someone, that person is able to fly for a day. If that ash is mixed with water and consumed, the consumer would able able to become whatever they want for a short period. Also, the user can use the fire as a Pyrokinetic would.
summary: The ability to control magical fire.
strengths: The fire has many uses
Could gain many other abilities
Can manipulate the fire
weaknesses: All abilities are temporary

name: Polyvision
description: People born with this ability are born with additional rods and cones in their eyes that can register more than just red, green and blue. This allows them to see all types of electromagnetic radiation, e.g. X-rays, gamma rays and radio waves.
summary: The ability to see other spectrums of light
strengths: You can "see" heat
You can "see" radiation
You can see through everything
weaknesses: Privacy issues
Not seeing what you want to see
May look a bit like a hallucination

name: Hydrogen Manipulation
description: With this ability, you can create water and other things that need hydrogen based molecules. Good in tandem with Hydrokinesis
summary: The ability to manipulate hydrogen-based molecules
strengths: You can merge hydrogen and oxygen to create water
Project high pressure water blasts and suffocate foes by drowning them
Generate the famous destructive Hydrogen bombs
weaknesses: A Hydrokinetic can take control of your water (unless you have that power too)

name: Hand Gun
description: Simply shape your hand into that of a pistol (index finger out and thumb up), drop your thumb like a hammer, and you will fire an invisible 9mm bullet from your index fingertip at 1000 feet per second. The bullet will disintegrate on impact, leaving no trace, but impacting ballistic damage equivalent to that of a hollow point. However, each hand only holds 120 bullets, and one will recharge every 30 seconds. Also, your finger still makes a gun flash and realistic sound, though it won't burn you.
summary: The ability to shoot bullets from your index finger.
strengths: Never need a 9mm pistol again
Effectively unlimited ammunition
The ultimate concealed gun
weaknesses: Must charge up your hands during extended gun fights
Might have a hard time attaching a sound/flash suppressor to your finger
There are no sights on your hand

name: Unstable Molecular Sythesizing
description: By focusing your entire force of Will into your body all at once, this Synthesis ablilty allows it's user to manipulate their entire molecular makeup. This would allow you to shift your body through solid materials, float through the air, breath underwater, purge yourself of poisons, and the like. While you can shift the molecules, you can't change what they are, only move them around, i. E. Forcing your molecules between the gaps in stone molecules to pass through a wall.
summary: The ability to manipulate your entire molecular structure, causing it to become unstable.
strengths: Able to heal instantaneously
Able to shift through any material
Able to survive in any atmosphere
weaknesses: Molecules cannot be changed, just rearranged
If you don't have an intimate knowledge of molecular structures, you could accidentaly kill yourself
Cannot exert any other powers that you may possess while using Unstable Molecular Sythesizing

name: Mind Pain
description: When you concentrate on someone, you can make them experience different types of pain by concentrating, from headaches to burning.
summary: The ability to make someone feel extreme pain by looking and concentrating
strengths: Easy to get back at people
Don't have to protect yourself through physical violence
weaknesses: May become an evil pain inducing villain
May become sadistic

name: Specialization
description: WIth this power you can turn a broad power into a more specialized one such as changing levitation to only levitate firetrucks and flame users only able to use blue flames. The specialized power has increased power equal to how narrow the range of what it can affect has become. It can be used on your own and others powers. The specialization can be changed or removed after which this power has time to recharge. Recharge time varies between users.
summary: The ability to place restrictions on what a power can affect or what a power is able to do.
strengths: Broad powers can be focused on specific things.
Specialized powers have increased power.
Can be used on opponents to make their powers only affect odd things.
weaknesses: Has a recharge time.
To increase your own power you have to narrow your own powers.
Your opponents can still use their powers if they follow the restrictions.

name: Attribute Reversal
description: With this power, you can reverse anything or anyone's characteristics. For example, if someone shot a fire blast at you, you could reverse the direction of the attack, sending it back to them, reverse its effect, making it a freezing blast or reverse the direction of the time flow of the blast, cancelling it. Any reversal is possible except reversing something to nothing or nothing to something, for example, movement/immobility, flowing time/stopped time, existing/not existing or living/dead.
summary: The ability to reverse any characteristic of anything into its opposite.
strengths: Reverse a strengthening power into a weakening one.
Reverse a damaging attack into a healing one.
Reverse your "opponent" into your "ally".
weaknesses: You can't attack by yourself, your opponent has to make the first move.
Reversals are local. You can't reverse the worldwide meaning of an F grade.
An exception is if your own power is reversed, you'll lose it.

name: Parting
description: This ability allows you to "part" anything. From mountains to oceans to your morning bagel, you can separate any conceptual mass into two. To perform this feat, you must raise your hands, place them together and move them outward. If there is resistance (i.e. a liquid trying to fill back in), the target will stay parted for roughly a day. Navigate through deadly swamplands with ease! Looking to shove some people around? Visit Times Square and have at it! Moses will be asking for pointers.
summary: The ability to part anything. You can separate any conceptual mass into two.
strengths: Create paths through mountains, oceans or busy shopping centers for travel
If there's resistance (such as water that tries to fill back in), it will stay parted for a day.
Easily win massive applause and rounds at the bars by parting mugs of beer.
weaknesses: Exhausting. The more mass involved, the more taxing.
Parting only lasts for a day if the parted target doesn't naturally stay parted (i.e. liquid).

name: Myth Power: Gaia's Gift
description: Gaia (Gaea, Ge), in Greek myth, was the goddess of earth (land; the ground). As such, channeling her allows one to perceive and manipulate all naturally-occurring earthly phenomena (earthquakes, quicksand, sinkholes, mudslides, avalanches, volcanic eruptions, geysers, oil spouts, etc), at will. In addition, one can perceive and manipulate plants and earth at will. One can even attune oneself to the earth/ground of one's current planet/location to become familiar with one's surrounding, and more.
summary: The ability to channel Gaia's command over the essence of earth, the ground and earthly phenomena
strengths: Perceive, induce, amplify, reduce and negate earthly phenomena at will
Perceive and manipulate plants and earth (dirt/soil, rock/stone, metal, sand, etc) at will
Attune oneself to earth from one's current planet/location (learn land's layout, be healed, etc)
weaknesses: At the lower levels, earth and plant manipulation are triggered by emotions (NCN)
Cannot take on a form composed of plant matter or earth until developed (NCN)
Cannot open the earth to reveal portals to the underworld, until developed (NCN)

name: Spheres Of Nothingness
description: You can create a 3cm solid marble that you can throw (or rather should throw). 3s after its creation, the marble immobilizes itself and expands into a 3m ethereal sphere, lasting for 3s before disappearing. Any matter that was inside or enters that sphere disappears forever. The sphere doesn't have a gravity of its own and therefore doesn't suck in matter like black holes do but air or water rushing in can provide mild or excellent suction. You can create up to 3 spheres within a 3min period.
summary: The ability to create spheres that obliterate everything inside them.
strengths: Anything can be totally or partially destroyed.
Waste regulation problems now have a solution.
Kill or incapacitate anyone you want. Even makes you intimidating or fearful.
weaknesses: You are not immune to your own spheres, so be VERY careful!
With 3 spheres max within a 3min period, you better be strategic.
If you use this power too much, fatally the planet's air supply will be depleted.

name: Aquaria Spinning
description: Aquaria is what keeps oceans, rivers, seas, etc healthy, vibrant and strong. By spinning Aquaria, you can draw raw life energy from the water. You don't actually need to be near water to spin Aquaria, but water does make it a whole lot more powerful. With this power, you can do a lot, from healing to destructive force blasts, just like how the ocean can be a great healer as well as a great killer.
summary: The ability to spin and manipulate Aquaria, the lifeforce of the waters
strengths: Can spin unlimited amounts of raw life force energy
Can do magic, heal, fly, shoot energy blasts and have psychic abilities
Raw power of the sea in it's purest form
weaknesses: All this power may go to your head
It reflects your emotions, if your not in a good mood, it becomes weak
Can't acutally control water, just it's lifeforce

name: Myth Power: Triton's Triumph
description: Triton, in Greek myth, was the god of the surging waves of the sea, as well as Messenger of the Seas. As such, channeling him naturally allows one to survive underwater and swim well. In addition, one can summon a conch (like Triton's) to churn any sufficient body of water into a tidal wave, and calm rough waves, at will. Furthermore, one can turn one's legs to/from a mermaid tail at will. One can even psychically perceive, communicate with and share senses with fish and other aquatic species.
summary: The ability to channel Triton's command over the essence of the surging waves of the sea
strengths: Swim well, survive underwater; summon a conch that, when blown, can stir up or calm rough waves
Turn one's legs to/from a mermaid tail at will (when developed, share by touch)
Psychically perceive, communicate with and share senses with fish and other aquatic species
weaknesses: Cannot use one's Triton Conch to teleport to any body of water until the higher level (NCN)
Cannot compel mermaids and tritons until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Poseidon's Prestige provides immunity and allows disruption/negation/compulsion (NCN)

name: Carbon Sequestration
description: With this ability, you can remove carbon from any source and use it. However, this is easiest to do with carbon dioxide. Once you have it, you can use it for many purposes, such as emulation of photosynthesis (requires water) and making various constructs with it, such as solar panels, diamonds and structures.
summary: The ability to remove carbon from any source, especially a gas such as carbon dioxide.
strengths: Helps to save the planet though simple use.
Has a variety of purposes, only limited to the user's imagination.
Plentiful source material.
weaknesses: To make full use of this power, you may need knowledge in areas such as chemistry.
Requires a fair bit of concentration for some tasks.
Heavily dependent on imagination.

name: Japanese Virtues
description: There are five ancient Japanese virtues and each has an element associated with them. Benevolence makes people willingly give you free gifts and control the element of wood. Courtesy makes people treat you as though you have higher rank and control fire. Sincerity makes people tell the truth and allows control of earth. Justice causes people to believe that you have the side of right and allows control of metal. Wisdom makes people listen to what you say and allows control of water.
summary: The ability to control the Japanese virtues and the elements associated with them
strengths: Can control five virtues and elements.
This power has many different uses.
weaknesses: Can only use one virtue at a time.
Each element is beaten by another element.
Con Negation has no effect on this power and alteration powers have no effect on the cons.

name: Object Shooter
description: You must first touch the objects you want to affect with your power. You can place them wherever you want, even leave them where you found them, and you can touch as many as you like. Then, just point at something with your hand shaped like a gun. Every time you do the finger-gun gesture, one of the objects you touched will be propelled towards your target, the first one you touched being the first one to be shot. Also, the smaller an object is, the faster it will be propelled.
summary: The ability to have objects you just touched shoot at anything you are pointing at.
strengths: You can shoot as many ammunitions as you can.
Projectiles are shot from where they are placed, so they can hit from any direction.
Since the target can be hit from any direction, there's a good surprise factor to your attacks.
weaknesses: You are limited by the number of objects you can touch. (I'd recommend Remote Contact to reuse them)
The ammos are shot in the order you touched them. So, anyone can dodge if they remember the order.
Only non-living objects can be used as projectiles, and the bigger they are, the slower they are.

name: Tactile Combustion
description: Your body is covered in a thin, invisible energy field which can spontaneously ignite any combustible material within it. If an object is touched, the field extends along it in a limited way, covering the object if possible, and linking to others to a degree. For example, if touching a person's hand, using the power on them would set their entire body alight, but using this on a table inside a house would only set the table alight. You are fireproof.
summary: The ability to set objects you touch alight
strengths: Easily win any close combat fight
You're invulnerable to all flames
You can ignite the air around your hands, creating flaming auras for them
weaknesses: Limited range
You're at a severe disadvantage against foes with guns, long range powers, etc.
Your tactile field cannot strech particularly far -- it can cover about two people

name: Thunder Ignitement
description: Because of it, Thunder Ignitement is considered the most undisputed super-ability for anyone to use. It does damage and has a 100.0% chance of electrocuting and burning the target. It's also a long-range attack that fires in a straight line of up to 90 miles, and may cause a burn and shock.
summary: The ability to unleash a long electrical flame in all directions.
strengths: It's totally effective against Pod People.
weaknesses: May cause maximum harm to someone you love most.

name: Empathic Weather Manipulation
description: An empathic weather manipulator can neither control or accurately predict the weather. All they can do is manipulate it through expression of their feelings & it has to be genuine feelings. If they are happy, it'll be bright & sunny, sad-cloudy & maybe rain, anger causes a storm & so on. They even manipulate clouds to reveal their expressions & feelings like make a cloud look like a boat or bunny or whatever they feel.
summary: The ability to manipulate the weather via emotions
strengths: Manipulate weather empathically
Make shapes of what they feel out of clouds
weaknesses: Its all controlled by emotion
Has to be genuine emotion, not fake

name: The Power Of The Moon
description: It allows you control water, air, ice and gravity. You can control the tides, the weather and you can become weightless
summary: The ability to the ability the control the elements it rules
strengths: You can refreeze the melting ice caps
You can fly
You can make water appear because of the tiny particles of water in the air
weaknesses: If your powers get out of control, it could destroy the earth
Messing with nature will create extreme consequences

name: Summon Excalibur
description: Excalibur is known as King Arthur's sword, but it is also one of the four swords of power. Excalibur is the sword of ice and its abilities include freezing anything it cuts and absorbing the purest memories of anyone it kills. It is also indestructible and can create Ley Gates when fused with its twin sword, Clarent. Ley Gates are portals to other Ley Gate locations around the world.
summary: The ability to summon Excalibur, the stone sword of Ice.
strengths: Freeze enemies
Absorb good memories
Create Ley Gates.
weaknesses: Must be combined with Clarent to create Ley Gates.

name: Purple Haze
description: With a wavy gestures of your hands, you can let out some hallucinogenic mist that makes people act real goofy, nullifying their senses, and make them see crazy illusions.
summary: The ability to cast waves on anyone that cause them to have crazy hallucinations.
strengths: Your enemies won't have a clue and doesn't know what hit them.
weaknesses: It can last for up to 45 hours.
Won't work against robots, or armored-type foes.

name: Induced Phobia
description: To use this power, you have to tell your victim "Does/do (object of fear) scare you?... Now, it does/they do." From now on, the victim will feel a visceral panic and anxiety whenever they think about or are exposed to anything related to the object of fear, and they will usually act irrationally. For instance, a phobic of constipation can constantly go to the bathroom; a phobic of water can stop drinking and go crazy when they are wet; a phobic of germs can wash themselves until bleeding.
summary: The ability to cause someone to be irrationally afraid of anything you want.
strengths: The fear is irrational, so the victim will stay afraid, even if one tries to reason with them.
A phobia can be very disabling. A phobic of doors can hardly have a normal social life.
Things related to their phobia can scare them. Popping sounds or blimps can scare a balloon phobic.
weaknesses: You can only give one phobia per person.
A person can become desensitized to a phobia you gave them.
If a person is already or became desensitized to a phobia, you can't give them that phobia again.

name: Friar Sand Channelling
description: You can have the granted power of being extremely strong, to breathe underwater, and have various magical abilities (transfom a small goard into a gigantic one, etc). You can also become a powerful alchemist.
summary: The ability to endlessly breathe underwater and possess unlimited magic.
strengths: Very strong fighter in the water
weaknesses: You look like a monster

name: Elemental Negate
description: A person with this power has the ability to negate any harmful effects of one element at any moment. The elements include but are not limited to: Heat, Frost, Earth, Metal, Air, Plant, Animal, Light, Dark, Liquid, Energy, Spirit, and Time. The user can switch between any negations at any moment but there is a small delay between switches. While active the user is completely immune to anything negatively related to the element no matter the strength of the element that is affecting the user.
summary: The ability to negate the harmful effects of one element on yourself at any time.
strengths: Many elements to choose from.
Complete immunity to the negative effects of one element.
Still affected by helpful things, such as still being able to breath while immune to Air.
weaknesses: Small delay between switches where you can be hurt.
Can only block one element at a time so you are still vulnerable to other elements.
Have to be able to predict ahead of time what you will need to be immune to.

name: Photosynthesis
description: With this ability, one can lay down roots and turn green to harvest energy from the sun. This gives them energy, heals them, eliminates disease and restores youth. The power can be turned off at will. The user cannot move while the power is in use, whether voluntarily or forcefully. They also need to be touching raw earth and water for the power to be activated, with sunlight powering the process.
summary: The ability to perform photosynthesis.
strengths: Heal yourself
Prevent someone from forcing you somewhere (example: Teleportation).
Re-energize yourself.
weaknesses: Can't move while in use.
Need to touch earth and water.
Needs sunlight.

name: Spinning Blizzard Fury
description: Create a blizzard-like tornado to freeze all in its path. You can create it by just using your mind. And it will not harm who you do not want it to. You can also control it and change its size and speed.
summary: The ability to create a blizzard-like tornado to freeze and destroy all in its path.
strengths: You have complete control.
You can create with your mind.
Doesn't hurt who you don't want it to.
weaknesses: Limited by the amount of concentration you have
Does not instantly freeze everthing

name: Golems
description: A golem is an animated being created entirely from inanimate matter. This power allows you to create golems out of materials around you. For example, if you have a lot of metal around you, make some metal golems. The golems would be completely under your control, have metallic reshaping powers,and have the properties of the metal you chose. This power can be used with anything so you can have an army of superpowered creatures at anytime. Metal golems, wax golems, water golems, its all yours.
summary: The ability to create golems out of anything around you
strengths: Creating super powered creatures
Creating super powered creatures that obey your every command
weaknesses: Some things are best left unanimated

name: Lateral Locomotion
description:
With this power you can move anything along a wall. You can move windows, doors, torches, murals, artworks, tapestries, murals, holes, and even people. Nothing attached to a wall is beyond this power. If you throw a spear and it is stuck to the wall you can move the spear too. Also you can rearrange the walls within a maze with this power by shifting the walls to other parts of the maze. 

Walls can be any size and through practice you can make this power work an any surface.
summary: The ability to move the position of objects along a surface
strengths: You can ride outside parts of the wall like an elevator or escalator
Move the location of a door to prevent people from following you
Find or make secret rooms by changing the door location
weaknesses: This power is only limited onto a wall or surface

name: Complete Lockdown
description: When this power is used, every door, window and closable passages within a defined area will shut themselves. They will even lock themselves if possible. Moreover, they, as well as every wall, floor and ceiling, become indestructible and can't be dismantled. On the other hand, only the user can open and unlock chosen passages. The chosen area will unlock itself if you stop concentrating on it for 5 minutes.
summary: The ability to close and lock every means of passage within a chosen area.
strengths: Your headquarters/home will become an impenetrable fortress
Hold your enemies prisoners in an inescapable area.
Lock the doors behind you when you escape from an enemy.
weaknesses: Don't forget to maintain the lockdown or it will disappear after 5 minutes.
You can't close a passage that doesn't have a means to be shut.

name: Adamantium Projectiles
description: With this power you can throw Adamantium projectiles from your hands. This projectiles have special properties that make them immune to air resistance, which allows them to get close to the Light Speed. One single projectile can cause massive destruction on anything, and they are made of the mythical metal called "Adamantium", which makes them nearly indestructible. The projectiles are really powerful, and you might kill yourself accidentally, so be careful!
summary: The ability to throw projectiles made of a powerful metal, which are immune to air resistance.
strengths: A powerful ability, can cause massive destruction and is nearly unstoppable.
Projectiles can get close to the Light Speed, since they are immune to air resistance.
Even if you attack someone invulnerable with this, this person will be thrown really far away.
weaknesses: People with Magnetic powers will be able to stop your attacks.
You might kill yourself while destroying everything with this.
Don't work really well in a close combat.

name: Bow Of Heracles
description: With the Bow of Heracles, you are holding a weapon capable of mass destruction. Considered a divine weapon, it can hurt beings on the god level. Otherwise, it can also be used to rain destruction on enemies when firing multiple arrows. When the user decides to actually channel magic power into the bow, you can fire a single charged arrow (full day charge and only if you have that much power) that has the destructive capacity of a nuclear weapon.
summary: The ability to wield Heracles' bow
strengths: Can hurt gods and decimate an entire city
Can use any type of arrow as long as it can be pulled on it
Can fire multiple arrows
weaknesses: Must have super super strength to use
Must have ammo

name: Job Training
description: You gain powers related to the job you work at. Such as if you are a doctor you would gain healing powers while a engineer would gain powers to construct things mentally. The level of powers that you receive depends on how good your job is. A manager would gain better powers than an assistant. You can gain more than one power depending on your type of job. If you are fired than you lose your powers until you regain a job. You also have access to changing into your jobs uniform at any time.
summary: The ability to gain powers related to your job.
strengths: Makes your job easier to perform.
Can use your powers outside of work as well.
Could use powers to get promotions and then get greater powers.
weaknesses: If you are fired you lose your acquired powers.
You still have to do the work for the job.
If you have a bad job then you will not gain great powers.

name: Path Maker
description: Just like Moses created a passage through the Red Sea, whenever you want to create a path, anything that obstructs the way will move out of it. Stones will roll away, branches will bend to free the path, people or vehicles will move aside,... Anything that can be moved away will move. With some experience and a lot of energy, you could smash through unmovable objects, such as walls, trees or giant rocks, to clear a way through them. Movable things could even be violently thrown out of the way.
summary: The ability to create a path by having nearly everything move out of the way.
strengths: Create a safe path through which you can venture.
Everything will be prevented from obstructing the way until whoever who had to cross crossed.
With enough energy, you could cause serious damage when you want things out of the way.
weaknesses: Things can only be moved away, so holes which are uncovered won't be covered.

name: Compressure
description: A person with this power can control air pressure. They can affect a whole vicinity with pressurized air and shoot cannons of pressurized air. The normal effects of increased pressure does not affect the user. Other people will get headaches by the changes in pressure.
summary: The ability to control air pressure
strengths: Give enemies headaches by quickly changing the air pressure
Can create pressurized air cannons
Immune to changes in pressure
weaknesses: Tricky to use

name: Celestial Flames
description: The flames will literally burn all evil from a person. All evil thoughts, habits, etc after being burned by these flames a person will have a clean mind and soul if not a clean body. You can only gain this power by mastering Golden Flames and by having a pure heart.
summary: The ability to create and control flames that burn evil
strengths: The flames won't hurt anyone physically.
You can make the world a better place.
weaknesses: Might feel a little mean to force people to become good.

name: Myth Power: Zeus' Zenith
description: Zeus, in Greek myth, was god of the sky, weather, fate and kings; he himself was King of the Gods. As such, channeling him allows one to alter the very sky itself to pour forth its blessings or its wrath. One can call forth any aerial phenomena, from lovely rainbows and gentle rain to drought, flash floods, blizzards and thunderstorms. The user can even call forth fiery meteors, and wield lightning like a weapon. In addition, one can mentally perceive, communicate with and compel sovereigns.
summary: The ability to channel Zeus' command over the essence of the sky, weather, fate and sovereignty
strengths: Call forth the phenomena of the sky (control the clouds, the air, the atmosphere, etc. )
Perceive, communicate with and compel anyone with an authoritative status
Immunity to probability manipulation or perception (Unpredictability)
weaknesses: People with MythPower: Kronos' Craft often dislike you
People with MythPower: Poseidon's Prestige and MythPower: Hades' Haunt often envy you
At the lower levels, may become afflicted with an overwhelming sex drive

name: Supersonic Soundwave
description: One rule to this power is, it can't be your soundwaves, it has to be the voice of someone else to be activated.
summary: The ability to ride soundwaves.
strengths: Travels fast
Even works for whispers
Can go through walls
weaknesses: Loud screech when riding
It can't be your voice you ride
It may get caught in tornadoes

name: Summoning: Elemental
description: You have the power to summon Elementals, beings of immense power. They serve you until you dismiss them back to their own plane. You are able to summon Elementals of Air, Earth, Fire, Water, Darkness, Light, and the minor Elementals such as Sand, Metal, and Lightning.
summary: The ability to summon elementals.
strengths: Beings that defend and attack for you.
weaknesses: Will attack you if you can't control them.

name: Pyrotechnics
description: Ability to generate plasmoids (fireworks)from fingertips
summary: The ability to generate bright bursts of multi-colored energy plasmoids from fingertips
strengths: You can control where the fireworks go
You can increase or decrease their size
You can create the shape of the fireworks nd explode them when u wished
weaknesses: They can blind someone

name: Power Resonance
description: The blast will resonate at the other being's resonation levels causing them to be energized to a point they can't contain. Thus they explode.
summary: The ability to fire a wave that resonates with another being and causes them to explode
strengths: Kills an enemy which means you don't have to worry about them.
weaknesses: They can still resurrect.
You can only kill with this power.

name: Unfriendly Fire
description: This power avoids all friendly fire. Some examples. You cast a huge meteor to drop in an area with both foes and friends and only the foes would get squashed. Your allies and friends would just stand unharmed in the crater. When you shoot randomly with automatic gun at a group of people, then only the foes get hit.
summary: The ability to never damage your friends or allies with your powers
strengths: No more risk hurting any your friends.
You could use some brutal methods to separate friends from foes.
You can go all out even when your friends haven't been brought to a safe place.
weaknesses: If you don't have any friends, this power would be rather pointless.

name: Lavakinesis
description: The user can create lava and magma as energy blasts, create lava hammers, lava tigers, lava tornadoes, or anything else the person can think of. Similar to a green lantern power ring, it's limited only the person's imagination.
summary: The ability to create and control lava and magma
strengths: You can use your imagination
You can absorb lava from volcanoes that gives you energy
weaknesses: If a character s can absorb energies or is immune to hot energies
Not immune to others with the same power, or that can use fire, heat, or any other hot energy

name: Universal Time Stop
description: A person with this power has the ability to freeze time for everyone. The clocks will not turn at all. There are no ill effects such as Earth's rotation stopping, etc. Time has just stopped until the user says it should go on. When this power is activated, no one will notice until they check their watches/clocks.
summary: The ability to prevent a day from ending
strengths: No one will age or die unless killed directly
People can still act during this time
Lots of free time
weaknesses: You will have to be on the job longer-Employers would give you more to do.
Someone will try to find out who stopped time
If you die, time will forever be stopped

name: Astrocyte Mimicry
description: As an Astrocyte Mimic, you have the ability to concentrate calcium ions in your hands and release them as huge ionic waves. You also have the crucial ability to greatly enhance the ability to receive special signals that some Neuron Mimics possess. Without you, their receiving ability is actually severely limited. Additionally, you also have the ability to feed Neuron Mimics with lactic acid through touch. Optionally, you also have the power to create clones of yourself.
summary: The ability to create calcium waves and enhance certain Neuron Mimics' ability to receive signals.
strengths: You are needed if a Neuron Mimic wants to receive signals from another Neuron Mimic.
An ionic calcium wave is a type of plasma. So, it's way cooler than it sounds.
You can also inject lactic acid into Neuron Mimics, which are nutrients for them.
weaknesses: The Neuron Mimics still require Oligodendrocyte or Schwann Cell Mimics to send signals.
To create calcium waves, you need calcium. Your primary source being your own body.
Shooting too many calcium waves using your body as a source is very dangerous.

name: Chroma
description: This power may sound silly but is most fearsome indeed. The user can harness the colors of the spectrum and absorb the colors, and then changing them into energy. For example the user may drain all the color in a an area, then convert it to energy and then use it. Another ability that comes with this is that the user may absorb the color of another person and that person will end up in a petrified or comatose state. The user can even make drawings that can attack another person.
summary: The ability to manipulate color and use it as energy or produce various effects depending on the color
strengths: Can absorb all the colors of the rainbow
Very versatile, can be used for defense and offense
If not converted to energy the colors can be washed away like paint
weaknesses: Must be in contact with an object or person in order to absorb the color(s)
Though very versatile the colors themselves don't have specific abilities, such as red being fire

name: Powerful Lungs
description: This ability allows you to take in large amounts of air at a time. Once you have filled your lungs, you can use it to either hold your breath for a long period of time, exhale it into a powerful gale of wind, or use it to scream in a high-pitched voice. Your massive lungs, however, also take in smoke or anything dangerous in the air more easily.
summary: The ability to take in large amounts of air at a time
strengths: Destroy basically anything and everything in your pathway if you exhale with maximum force
You can hold your breath for approximately 1 to 2 hours (depending on how expanded your lungs are)
Hold gallons of air at a time inside of your lungs
weaknesses: Take in smoke, pollution, and diseases more easily
Can be extremely dangerous to exhale at full-force
May trigger without noticing from taking deep-breaths

name: Freeze Vision
description: The opposite of heat vision. Your eyes shoot cold beams of ice that freezes anything in your sight. You can even freeze the air & rapid blinking can shoot icicles. Deep freezing can cause an object to eventually crack & break. Though prolong single use without blinking or resting your eyes causes your vision to become blurry & dry.
summary: The ability to project beams of ice from your eyes
strengths: Freeze everything in your sight
Shoot icicles from your eyes
weaknesses: Keeping eyes open for a long time can cause dry eyes & blurry vision

name: Celtic Invocation: Addanc
description: By using this ability, the invoker may call up waves on any body of water. The waves are primarily used offensively, for mass destruction, but may also be used as a form of transport. The invoker may also cause any water surrounding them to spoil and become poisonous if drunken. Also, the invoker may summon little versions of Addanc from brackish water. These versions may spread poison to other water sources and also be used to spy on those near water.
summary: The ability to call on the power of Addanc, the Welsh god of destructive water.
strengths: Having a fight near a body of water.
Living on the beach, or lake, etc.
You may be able to breathe uder water at higher levels of power.
weaknesses: The invoker cannot use their powers to purify the water-only pollute.
You may be persecuted and blamed for tsunamis, tidal waves, freak rips, etc.
You minions may break out of your control and posion your friends and family.

name: Witch Walk
description: Through the use of magical power, this ability allows you to walk on anything (water, air, walls, etc. ).
summary: The ability to use magic to walk on anything.
strengths: Get to places faster.
Escaping from enemies.
weaknesses: Doesn't apply to the hands.
Things (such as cracks in the wall or waves in the water) can make you lose balance and fall.

name: Blade Of The Elements
description: This ability allows you to summon an elemental blade that fuses with one's hand.  The user can summon a blade of fire, ice, wind, and diamond.
summary: The ability to summon an elemental blade that fuses with one's hand.
strengths: A strong weapon
It won't fall off
You can use it to fight anything
weaknesses: It is very dangerous
It's hard to use at first
People will fear you

name: The Strange:Sounds Like Reality
description: Some people can sound like anything. And some people can BE anything. Put them together, stir, bake at 350 for an hour and you get this. Anyone with this power can become whatever they sound like at that moment. So, if you can make yourself sound like a firework, then you will become a living firework. Thankfully, this is a voluntary abiliy, so you don't change when you don't want to. Also, you'll be able to change back to normal at will, even if you become something that cannot speak.
summary: The ability to shapeshift using your voice
strengths: Can become whatever you want
You might be really good at controlling your voice
weaknesses: Must sound like what you want to be
Might suck at controlling your voice

name: Seismic Scream
description: Also called a Seismic Voice, with this ability, no sound is produced, but the voice is instead converted back to raw, powerful vibration that cannot be resisted by Sonic Absorption or be canceled by the power Inaudibility (but can still produce the same, or worse, devastating effects).
summary: The ability to produce a "scream" composed of raw vibration
strengths: No loud sound is produced
All the power of a sonic scream (or more)
Can't be avoided by Induced Inaudibility, a soundproof barrier or Sonic Absorption
weaknesses: Still destroys property
May bounce off of echoing surfaces
Can instead be resisted by Kinetic Absorption, Vibration Channeling or the like

name: Halokinesis
description: Halokinesis, also called Salinokinesis or Salt Manipulation is the ability to manipulate salt crystals. This includes moving it, moving substances containing it, forming it into crystalline constructs, changing it into various physical states, altering its presence in bodies (including within animals and plants) and the like. One could even whip it at foes with force enough to flay flesh, if enough is gathered.
summary: The ability to manipulate salt
strengths: Salt, and anything salty can now be used as a weapon
Purify and flavor foods (and fling salt into enemies' wounds)
Extract salt from various sources (including from living organisms, and out of wounds)
weaknesses: Eating too much salt can be unhealthy
Crystallokinesis, when developed, can overpower this ability

name: Absolute Zero Temperature
description: Bring an object to absolute zero temperature, which is 0 degrees Kelvin. The object isn't damaged by the rapid loss or gain of heat. While at absolute zero, not even the smallest parts of the object will be able to move, such as its electrons. Since the object will have no heat energy while at absolute zero, it will have no energy to move, and will remain unmovable while you keep it at absolute zero. The object won't absorb heat from objects around it because you are keeping it at the same temp.
summary: The ability to bring objects to and from absolute zero without damaging them.
strengths: Freeze foes.
Objects become immovable.
Objects are unbreakable and unchangeable while at absolute zero.
weaknesses: Objects will become stuck in space as the Earth moves away from them.
Do not use on yourself or you will become a statue in space.
Frozen objects will dig straight through a planet if the planet moves across where the object is.

name: Circadian Control
description: The user is able to change the flow of the day. The movement of time is still the same, but the Earth is just rotated rapidly. The user can change night into day and day into night.
summary: The ability to change the flow of the day, changing night to day or vice versa
strengths: Good against opponents who rely on the sun
Good against opponents who rely on the moon
weaknesses: A very hard power to master

name: Dark Fire
description: In return for becoming a guardian of the legendary dark fire lord, your blood is infused with the poison of the black phoenix. Control the shadows and create flame. Coat yourself in shadows to create a twenty second unbreakable shield. Mix the flame with the shadow to summon forth the mighty dragon ras'khan.
summary: The ability to control the ancient forces of fiery passion and darkest sin.
strengths: Create things out of shadow.
Ride on a dragon.
Become invincible.
weaknesses: The poison will eventually take over your body and turn you into a monster.
A slave for the dark fire lord until the poison takes over you.
A long scar must be etched into your arm for the poison to be injected by the phoenix.

name: Unerring Aim
description: The person with this power has an unerring aim whenever they use a bow or arrow. People with this power do not make any mistakes when they fire an arrow from their bow. Not even a strong wind will veer it off its course
summary: The ability to have an unerring aim when the user has a bow and arrow
strengths: An arrow will always hit its target
You will never hurt a person you don't plan to hurt.
weaknesses: Only can be used on a bow and arrow

name: Money Multiplier
description: You can only use it 10 times a day on cold hard cash, if you want to double your money. Example: If you have 1 dollar, double it once to get $2, double again for $4 and again for $8.   It won't last more than 24 hours, so you need to spend immediately!
summary: The ability to double the amount of cash you have.
strengths: Double your money!
weaknesses: Only works on cash.
You can't save the money. You need to spend it within that day.

name: Geothermal Energy
description: Using this power you can attract geothermal energy within the Earth's core and use it. Whether it be to power your house or use it in battle such as attracting the actual magma.
summary: The ability to attract geothermal energy within the Earth's core and use it.
strengths: Multiple uses, it can power your house.
You can summon magma from the Earth's core in battle.
The Earth's core does not 'open' just because you are attracting energy.
weaknesses: If you use the magma for more than an hour at a time it will become dangerous.
You have to use magma only twice a day. (though the energy is unlimited)

name: Blessing Of Hekate
description: Hekate is the Greek god of magic. Her blessing gives you the ability to use Greek magic. You can control magical fire amd turn people into animals. Also, you'd be able to use words and symbols from Ancient Greek for various effects. For example, saying the Greek word for "lift" might allow you to levitate things or people. Or if you draw the Greek symbol for "serve" on a rock it might transform into a rock creature bound to your will.
summary: The ability to have the blessing Of Hekate
strengths: You can use Greek magic
You're very powerful
You know Ancient Greek.
weaknesses: Using symbols and words in Greek might be tricky unless you practice.

name: Atom Construction
description: Creates atoms using particals from the atmosphere and the earth. If used correctly, the caster can create items out of it. However, forming and combining atoms takes time unless the ability is mastered.
summary: The ability to create atoms from particals in the earth's soil and in the atmosphere.
strengths: Good for a sheild
Good for an explosive if used correctly
Can be used as a source for items or an offense.
weaknesses: Takes a long time to master.
Can be very unstable.
If used incorrectly, it can kill the caster

name: Blessing Of Helios
description: The user is blessed by the Greek Sun Titan, Helios. After the user is blessed, he or she will be able to shoot bolts or beams of fire and command fire.
summary: The ability to be blessed by the greek God of Sun, Helios
strengths: A good offensive power
Can put out fires with the control over fire
weaknesses: Vulnerable to water

name: Half Dragon (Eastern)
description: Someone with this power has higher strength, speed, and magical power than ordinary humans. They can cause the weather to become rain, shapeshift, and fly without wings. They will also have claws and fangs.
summary: The ability to be half-human, half-dragon
strengths: You have a more altrustic personality than western half-dragons.
You can always have rain when it is needed while growing food.
You are also far wiser than most beings most of the time.
weaknesses: Beware of using your rain power when the gods want a drought.
The 3rd pro also comes with the con of sometimes being more stupid than most beings.

name: Magic Snap
description: All you need to do to activate this power is snap your fingers. Suddenly, a random, silly event happens within your sight, from a random gong sounding, to jello raining from the sky. However, it is completely random, and if you don't know how to snap your fingers, you can't use this power.
summary: The ability to cause random events to happen by snapping your fingers.
strengths: Make comedic things happen by snapping your fingers.
Make people die laughing at the effects that will happen.
weaknesses: No REAL combat uses.
If you don't know how to snap your fingers.
It is completely random.

name: Umbral Waves
description: 20 foot high shadow waves that absorb all light temporarily and renders all people in area to be "hollow" or soulless. While soulless, they lose all ability to think, move or react (beyond autonomic responses)
summary: The ability to make huge black waves that absorb light and temporarily render people soulless
strengths: Render all in area vulnerable
Massive affection area
Those affected can't think or react beyond autonomic responses
weaknesses: Should be accompanied by Night Vision, but that's not always the case

name: Related Injury Power Mimicry
description: You gain some (3 max) powers related to how you are injured, so if you are hit with a flame, you probably will be able to create and control fire.
summary: The ability to get powers related to a way you are injured.
strengths: Get powers when hurt.
weaknesses: It is related to how you are injured.
If you have invulnerability powers.
Anti Power Mimicry

name: Cryo Webs
description: You have the granted ability to produce your own silk webbing from glands within your forearms, which will instantly freeze your opponents solid.
