It can be formed into any object of your choosing, but apparently you can simply direct the waves of coldness that you project in certain ways so as to create ice in the shape you may desire.
summary: The ability to fire webs that instantly freezes the opponent.
strengths: You could even protect yourself by being encased in a Organic-Ice web armor.
weaknesses: It can last for up to 102 hours.
The icewebs can be dissolved by acid, fire, or salt.

name: Oxygen Morphing
description: Oxygen can be turned into anything that is equal to or less than your own mass. The object will be taken from the oxygen in a ten-mile radius around you. Ex: superpowered gun, army of you. You can move objects through the air. Ex: you can create a platform that you can move to any location in the atmosphere where you can still breathe. Objects last one hundred days.
summary: The ability to turn oxygen into anything less than or equal to your own mass
strengths: Can create an army.
Make yourself unique objects
weaknesses: May use enough oxygen to damage the environment.
Limited object time.

name: Shadow Kinetic Slash
description: The user can absorb potiential energy around them in order to turn it into a grayish air slash that can cut almost anything especially anything that can't move.
summary: The ability to indirectly vampirize the potiential energy to redirect it as a air slash.
strengths: Powerful energy air slash
Immoblizes opponents or any object.
weaknesses: Works only when the solid isn't moving

name: Vibration Sense
description: Also called Vibration Perception, Vibration Energy Perception or the Vibrissa Effect, this power allows the perception of the force produced by the oscillation of waves (vibrations that range anywhere from force produced by echoing/reverberating sound, underground seismic activity, vibration in the water, through solid surfaces and in the air); the user can even perceive psychic vibrations (presence of life, ghosts, psychics, etc), and can analyze them to discern presences (and species), etc.
summary: The ability to psychically detect vibrations of any kind
strengths: Pick up on vibrational energy easily (discern when people are approaching, leaving, etc. )
Predict impending heart attacks, impending earthquakes, and oncoming attacks
Sense and analyze psychic vibrations to discern the species of approaching subjects
weaknesses: Not superhuman sense of touch (can't sense temperature/pressure changes, feel minute indents, etc. )
Detecting earthquakes and heart attacks and the like requires the user be in the immediate area
Psychic attacks do especial damage to the user's mind

name: Myth Power: Way Of The Winds
description: The Winds, in Greek myth, had numerous gods. As such, channeling Aeolus (Aiolos- Keeper of Winds), one can generate and manipulate wind, at will. Channeling the Anemoi (Winds), Boreas (North), Notos (Notus- South), Euros (Eurus- East), Zephyros (Zephyrus, Zephyr- West), Caicias (Kaikas- Northeast), Sciron (Skiron- Northwest), Apeliotes (Southeast) and Lips (Southwest), one can perceive wind's power, direction and flow. Channeling the Anemoi Thuellai (Storm Winds) one can become a living wind.
summary: The ability to channel Aeolus, the Anemoi and the Anemoi Thuellai and their command over the essence of the winds
strengths: Psychically generate and manipulate air/wind (including breathing in any gaseous medium), at will
Detect wind's direction/pressure/temperature; even heighten senses of smell/hearing
Become a spiraling, formless, shapeless, nearly-invisible breeze
weaknesses: Cannot psychically perceive, communicate with or command horses, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically raise one's home into the air as a floating island, until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Zeus' Zenith allows negation (NCN)

name: Razor Wind
description: With this ability you can summon a blast of wind which can cut, slice, slash or dice anything or anyone in your way. Can be used to create piercing blasts to puncture holes or large gusts that slice most things in half.
summary: The ability to summon up a piercing blast of wind that slices through anything
strengths: Cut throught swathes of enemies
Cut through nearly any matierial
weaknesses: Difficult to aim
A liability when fighting in populated areas or with teamates

name: Poison Flames
description: The fire is as hot as an ordinary fire. The smoke is as poisonous as a rattlesnake's poison. The user of this power is immune to the poisonous smoke.
summary: The ability to create and control flames that always give off a poisonous smoke
strengths: Allies with Poison Immunity and Fire Immunity.
weaknesses: Enemies with Poison Immunity and Fire Immunity.
Your allies can still be affected by the fire and smoke, you can still burn yourself with the fire.

name: Hand Blades
description: With this power you can turn your entire hand into a super sharp blade. You can use this power with both of your hands and the blades are so sharp they can even cut through rock and metal.
summary: The ability to turn your hands into blades
strengths: You can turn your hands into blades
You can use the power with both of your hands
You can even cut through rock and metal
weaknesses: You cannot make the blades less sharp

name: Aquatic Time Travel
description: If you are completely submerged in any body of water (lake, river, pool, bathtub) you can slow down, speed up, or go backwards in time. This ability also lets you be able to hold your breath underwater for longer periods of time. The area around you that you time travel in would also be protected from the effects of time.
summary: The ability to travel forward and backward in time while in any body of water.
strengths: Time travel
Area around you is protected
weaknesses: Risking paradox

name: Myth Power: Psamathe's Smarts
description: Psamathe (Psammathe, Psammatheia, Amatheia, Amathea, Amathyia, Amathia) is the goddess of sand, especially that of the beach and the sea. As such, channeling her allows one to swim well and survive underwater, which may be shared, by touch. In addition, one can psychically perceive and manipulate sand at will. Furthermore, one can take on the consistency of sand, at will, allowing one to assume the form of nearly any subject one desires. One can even teleport to anywhere with sand, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Psamathe's command over the essence of sand
strengths: Swim well and survive underwater (may be shared by touch)
Psychically perceive and manipulate sand at will; teleport to anywhere with sand, at will
Gain Arenaceous Shapeshifting (turn into sand, and reform as nearly any living subject at will)
weaknesses: Cannot gain normal Sand Mimicry, or turn subjects into sand, until developed (NCN)
Pro #3 is limited to subjects of similar size/weight/mass until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically perceive, mimic, manipulate or turn subjects into glass until developed (NCN)

name: Sun Blade
description: By utilizing the heat around you, you are able to form the Blade of the Sun. This blade is not as hot as the Sun but something very close. When hit with it, then your hit will burn anything to ashes at that very moment.
summary: The ability to utilize the heat around you to form the Sun Blade.
strengths: No one else can hold it.
If someone shot at you, the sword's heat will burn away every bullet they try to hit you with.
The Sun Blade can also create waves of fire.
weaknesses: No one else can hold it.
Your body has to be accustomed to that type of heat. If not, then you are dead.

name: Heat Eater
description: A person with this power does not need to eat normally instead their body takes in energy by absorbing heat. When next to another object you can also absorb their heat thus freezing them. Also you can absorb the heat from flames. When far away, you can activate this ability like a heat magnet attracting heat from objects remotely. People affected experience a pseudo burning effect(close to boiling water) from the heat escaping the person's skin and eventually frostbite before being frozen.
summary: The ability to absorb heat for food
strengths: You don't need to eat you just need to absorb heat from other things
Freeze things by touch
Remote absorption of heat
weaknesses: Extreme cold weakens you and makes you hungry
Can't absorb the environment past freezing point of water without equipment
Cannot absorb heat when you are full-you will throw up fire-fire can still burn your esophogus

name: Self Proclaimed Friction
description: With this ability, you can walk on any surface as if it has friction. That means you don't slip on ice rinks or wet floors or any surface you walk on. You can walk on the most slippery surface possible without slipping. This ability only works when you're wearing shoes, sneakers, boots, or some kind of footwear. Socks do not count.
summary: The ability to walk on any surface (no matter how slippery) as if it had friction.
strengths: Walk on any surface without slipping.
Walk on ice and wet floors without slipping.
Whatever you walk on seems to have friction.
weaknesses: Must wear shoes, sneakers, boots, or other footwear to work.
Socks don't count.

name: Chemical Warfare
description: Okay the name basically says it, you can create substances that are chemical weapons out of thin air or turn a different matter into the chemical you want. You could create different types of tear gasses or nerve agents,also a psychological agent which could cause hallucinations/delirium. And of course you could just kill them with sarin, cyanide, or botulism.
summary: The ability to use the toxic properties of substances to kill/injure/incapacitate people
strengths: Just stun them with tear gas or with hallucinations
Easily kill them if you want
weaknesses: Kill people TOO easily
If a villain gets a hold of this, there's gonna be trouble

name: Lavapit
description: With this power you can cause lavapits to appear on any flat surface and then make it disappear later. You can make the lavapit any size you want and keep it in existence for as long as you want.
summary: The ability to make a pit full of lava to appear on any flat surface
strengths: You can create lavapits
You can make them any size you want
You can keep them in existence for as long as you want
weaknesses: If you fall into the lavapit you will probably burn or die

name: Emotional Bomb
description: If someone is calm, the shock wave will be as if you are half way in the water at the ocean and the waves hit you. The strongest shock wave is like someone dropped an atomic bomb.
summary: The ability to create a shock wave with the strength of one's anger.
strengths: You can defend yourself
People will not mess with you
You have a lot of power
weaknesses: People will fear you
You will be alone all the time
People will never want to be around you

name: Sonar
description: Like bats or dolphins, you too can use the power of sonar to know your surroundings.  Never stuble in the dark again!  You only need to listen to the ambient noise around you and you will instantly have a 3D image in your mind of what your environment looks like.
summary: The ability to know your surroundings by hearing reflected sound waves.
strengths: Knowing what's behind you
See in the dark--save on energy bills
weaknesses: You might freak people out if you leave your house lights off all the time

name: Ultimate Pyrokinesis
description: A person with this power can create a flame of any size and the flame has the the property of being able to burn anything even abstract concepts like souls and time. The flame is unextinguishable and cannot be moved from the place where it was made. The flames can spread if it catches onto another burnable fuel(which can be anything). It does not require oxygen to burn but it can be spread through sparks catching on to other objects. Flames also burn any incoming controller force.
summary: The ability to create a flame down to the very concept that is also unextinguishable
strengths: Your flames are unstoppable
Once someone gets burned they will stay on fire until burned completely or until eternity
If you time it right you can stop your own flames by burning it with another flame-very hard to do
weaknesses: Your flames are permanent and stay stuck so you will have to prevent it from spreading
You cannot control your own flames except control where they start
Since it burns time anything around the flame will be distorted so you cannot even see your flames

name: Desert Control
description: Deserts are harsh environments that very few can survive in. This power allows you to control the sand and heat that make up deserts. Summon scorching sandstorms to blind and burn opponents, use blasts of sand to wear down and cut things, or create sand constructs. You can even create a small desert to fight in, ideal for you but horrible for opponents. You can also use heat for many things. Just be careful not to let your power get out of control and end up creating a new Sahara.
summary: The ability to create and control sand and heat
strengths: Create harsh desert conditions that only you can really fight it
Lots of uses for heat and sand
weaknesses: Creating deserts you can't get rid of

name: Combustion Projection
description: This is one of the most dangerous abilities. A Combustion Projector can generate a powerful ray that super-heats the air around the first object it contacts. The oxygen explodes, destroying the target. This ability is very powerful, but it has its drawbacks. The ray can only be projected by the forehead, and a direct blow to its middle will block the ability for a while. It is also hard to control at first; the beginner must be careful to not maim or kill himself.
summary: The ability to generate an explosive beam from the forehead
strengths: Extremely dangerous
Good for combat
Nigh-unstoppable
weaknesses: Can only be projected from the forehead
Direct blow to the forehead's middle temporarily paralyzes the ability
Hard to control at first

name: Torrental Darkness Rain
description: The user first presses his or her palms together which will collect all the darkness in the vincity of the user. It is compressed into the form of a sphere and, depending on how long the users palms remain together, the more darkness will be collected and, in effect, the more powerful the attack is. The user can then release the darkness by unlocking his or her palms in a forcefull motion. The darkness cannot be redirected back to the users palms once released.
summary: The ability to release a torent of destructive darkness at the target.
strengths: The darkness will pursue the target until it is either dead or destroyed.
The darkness cannot be dodged, blocked, redirected or stopped in any way.
The dark force can be adjusted according to the forcefullness of the movement needed to release it.
weaknesses: The darkness is extremely destructive and can branch out in all directions if not controlled.
The darkness will permanently destroy all life from organisms that it comes into contact with.
The darkness cannot be redirected once it has been released.

name: The Four Swords Of Power
description: The four swords of power are four stone swords that have been influential throughout history. They are Excalibur the sword of Ice, Clarent the sword of Fire, Durendal the sword of Air and Joyeuse the sword of Earth. With this power you can summon all four at the same time and fuse them into one weapon. Together they give you each of their individual powers along with the power to summon Coatlicue, The Mother of All Gods, who will devour your enemies.
summary: The ability to summon and wield all four ancient swords of power at the same time.
strengths: Use all four sword's power at once.
Summon Coatlicue
weaknesses: You get all the negative effects of weilding all four swords
Coatlicue will eat you if you summon her and there is no other food.

name: Heavy Rain Glasses
description: These glasses are wirelessly connected to the internet, satellites, and various other things that can be used to find out what you need to know. Here's how it works: A person leaves their wallet on the ground. Activate the scanner on the glasses and it can identify it's owner using any DNA and fingerprints left on it. It can then find their address, phone number, etc.
summary: The ability to use a pair of glasses that can gather enormous amounts of information.
strengths: Find all sorts of information about friends and enemies
Can be used for blackmail
weaknesses: They can break
No real combat purposes

name: Lucky Last Shot
description: Whenever you fire a gun, your accuracy is increased in proportion with the amount of bullets left. This way your last few shots will almost always hit where you want them to and be incredibly deadly.
summary: The ability to good for last ditch efforts
strengths: You will always succeed at something the first time you try it
Accuracy doesn't decrease proportionally, just increase
weaknesses: No accuracy increase with machine guns
Only works for firearms (no longbows or bazookas).

name: Nine Dragons
description: You could conjure up to nine blazing dragon spirits which fly towards, elevates & coils around your foes and then whips and damages them. Your foe is left burned in yellow-orange flames.
summary: The ability to fire 9 flaming dragons that'll swirl & engulf your opponent.
strengths: It is super effective against plant type foes.
Melts off Ice type objects and opponents.
weaknesses: None

name: King's Cross
description: You can send a glowing turquoise cross from your chest in front of you directly towards the opponent or float in mid-air having several crosses kinetically imbued within spinning, swirling & surrounding around you, these follow as you fly damaging or killing every villain on sight. As it hits the enemy he/she will be quickly disintegrated.
summary: The ability to fire a huge light blue cross from your chest.
strengths: It protects you from the Dark Arts.
weaknesses: They will fade as it lasts for eight turns.

name: Library Of Dreams
description: A person can access this library when they fall asleep. This will be akin to a lucid dream where they enter a library. In the library are all the books erased from history ie burned destroyed etc and books that were thought up but never published. Unfortunately you can only access these books for the duration of your sleeping time. You get kicked out when you wake up in real life. Also you cannot recall enough to write the books down when you wake up, although you remember the details perfectly.
summary: The ability to have access to all books that were erased from history or never published when dreaming
strengths: Can have access to all the books that you wanted to read
Can dream up furniture in the library to sit on while reading
These books cannot be accessed by anyone else
weaknesses: Some books should never be opened or read
No access to books when awake and you are able to recall details but cannot write it out
Will be tired when you wake up unless you sleep inside the library

name: Electrifying Fire
description: You can create a yellow flame that electrifies what it touches instead of burning things.
summary: The ability to create and control a flame that shocks instead of burns
strengths: The fire makes it easier to stun an enemy with all their limbs instead of incinerate them.
weaknesses: The flame is a bright yellow which makes it easier to see.

name: Miniature Army
description: If you've seen the movie Small Soldiers, then you will immediately recognize this power. However, the user materializes soldiers instead of making them. You are the general and you give them missions. Your army is made up of soldiers, navy, air force, and special ops. The army has tanks, copters and other military vehicles. Soldiers are armed with all modern weapons the user can think of and each have radios to communicate their findings to you. The army's numbers regenerate over time.
summary: The ability to materialize a miniature army that can fire modern weapons and obeys your orders
strengths: You can command an entire army of soldiers/marines/air force whose numbers also regenerate over time
Find where your missing socks are
You can have your army surround your enemies and fire at will
weaknesses: You only have a finite number of soldiers (but the numbers always regenerate) also unlimited ammo
Your army can be stepped on by anyone
The size of weapons does make a difference. However, the sheer number of attacks more than makes up

name: Anomaly Core
description: You can create rocks that each grant one wish by creating an anomaly in existence around themselves. The rock needs to be around the target of the wish. The rocks can only be created by Jesters and any Jester can destroy the rock
summary: The ability to create a rock that grants wishes
strengths: Grant any person any wish.
You can give yourself or another person any ability as long as they are near the rock.
Alter reality in a set area.
weaknesses: Wishes often go awry, creating unimaginable chaos.
Rocks can only be created by Jesters
Rocks can easily be destroyed by other Jesters, thus disabling the wish.

name: Word Defuser
description: A person with this power can split an object into its composite words and create objects from those words. For example, you can split a firefly into fire and a fly. You can also create more people by splitting apart people's name. Ricky Bobby becomes Ricky and Bobby and Catwoman becomes a cat and a woman.
summary: The ability to an object's words in order to create multiple objects
strengths: Fake diamonds become diamonds and fake, just throw away the fake
Create more people
You can use synonyms--firefly is the same as lightning bug
weaknesses: If an object only has one word in its name
Spilt people are unpredictable--you don't know what they are like

name: Tidal Beam
description: You have the granted ability to fire a glowing beam of high-powered water blasts which can easily knock over a person, but only if you are in your water form.
summary: The ability to fire a geyserous beam of water-like substance.
strengths: You can use this power to put out the flames.
weaknesses: Never use this while you're around electrical currents.

name: Chemical Redirect
description: A person with this power has the ability to redirect effects placed on one object to another object. For example, they can boil water then switch the effect to a nearby iron door to boil the iron. If the other object is destroyed, the original receives the same effects again. However, if an effect was cancelled through other means, then the effect will stay cancelled. It cannot remove physical change so no switching wounds.
summary: The ability to redirect chemical reactions of one object to another
strengths: Can switch any reaction to another object
Can steal regeneration (if it is caused by chemical processes)
Reverse poison effects then reverse the antidote effects
weaknesses: Can't reverse physical changes
Must know chemistry

name: Technomorph
description: A person with this power can turn into any type of appliance in existence as well as some fictional appliances. For example you can turn into a refrigerator that can shoot freeze rays when the door is opened or if you wanted to surprise people it can shoot out fire instead. However there is a price for having such a great power you must always charge yourself for 4 hours everyday or else you will be stuck in your current form.
summary: The ability to turn into any type of technology
strengths: Able to turn into appliances or toys or even a phone to hide.
Can move in any technological form-though speed may be an issue
Can morph to access various superpowers by creating the necessary parts to simulate them
weaknesses: You can only turn into pieces of technology that you somewhat understand so no black hole generators
You need to charge yourself for 4 hours per day

name: Jinx
description: You shoot a psionic energy wave to a certain person or object. This causes a minute alternate reality to happen in which you manipulated a probability field, meaning you caused "bad luck" to someone.
summary: The ability to manipulate probability & cause misfortune
strengths: Cause bad luck
weaknesses: Still can have bad luck yourself

name: Elemental Army
description: You will be able to create minions to fight for you. 10 will be made out of water, 10 will be made out of earth, 10 will be made out of fire, 10 will be made of air.
summary: The ability to create an army made of elements
strengths: Despite their elemants, each of them fight with equal stregth.
Each of them have special moves incorperated with their elemant
weaknesses: Not Really.

name: Arceusforce: Splash
description: The user of this ability can channel the control over the seas of the Pokegod, Arceus, taking the form of its Water-type. The user's skin turns blue and their irises turn light blue. Under their aquatic guise, the user has the resistances, weaknesses and immunities of a Water-type Pokemon, translated to real world equivalents. They are also able to channel and manipulate many Water attacks such as Water Gun, Bubblebeam, Hydro Pump, Water Spout and more.
summary: The ability to channel the power of Arceus's Water form.
strengths: The user is resistant to fire, ice, metal and other water-based attacks.
Generation and manipulation of water for water attacks.
The user can breathe underwater and swim fast.
weaknesses: The user is weak to electrical and plant-based attacks.
This power may be too powerful for the user and may even require to be unlocked from default form.

name: Fire Eyes
description: With this power you can set people's eyes on fire meaning they will have flames coming from their eyes and unless they have some sort of flame resistant power will be in immense pain
summary: The ability to set people's eyes on fire
strengths: You can set your enemies eyes on fire
weaknesses: This may kill the person you use the power on

name: Johnny Storm
description: You can do just what Johnny Storm from Fantastic 4 can do! You light on fire, fly around, chuck fire balls at bad guys...unless, you want to BE the bad guy.
summary: The ability to light on fire and fly.
strengths: fly while on fire
chuck fire balls
go to supernova heat
weaknesses: your clothes burn off
noticeable
stealth is not an option

name: Elemental Weapon: Wind Spear
description: This ability you can call forth a spear to control and manipulate the wind element, you can create tornadoes, hurricanes, and wind blasts strong enough to rip off human flesh, and blow cars, trucks, even houses away. Or you can simply strike or thrust your spear piercing the flesh of your foes.  While wielding this weapon you are immune to the effects of the wind.
summary: The ability to wield a spear that manipulates the wind element.
strengths: Control and manipulate the wind (this includes any atmosphere you are present at)
Can lunge and pierce enemies with the spear
Create devasting natural disasters
weaknesses: The spear controls the wind, not you
Only immune to the effects of wind when wielding the spear
Your elemental weakness is earth

name: Tattoo Power
description: If you have a Superman logo tattoo, you're Superman. A flame tattoo? You get flame powers. Any tattoo is possible, but you can only have up to three Tattoo Powers. Any extra and a random tattoo is burned off. And it hurts when it gets burned off!
summary: The ability to get a power based on your tattoos
strengths: Three Tattoo Powers.
A cross tattoo could equal Jesus.
Mario or Bowser tattoo... Well, figure it out.
weaknesses: Only three powers.
More than three makes a random tattoo burn off.
And it burns!

name: Fire Whirl
description: It's been said in Wikipedia that a fire whirl, is a rare phenomenon in which a fire, under certain conditions (depending on air temperature and currents), acquires a vertical vorticity and forms a whirl, or a tornado-like effect of a vertically oriented rotating column of air. Fire whirls may be whirlwinds separated from the flames, either within the burn area or outside it, or a vortex of flame, itself. Fire Whirl does double duty--it sucks, spins and burns enemies inside of it.
summary: The ability to send out a firey tornado that creeps above the ground.
strengths: Evildoers are even sent flying up and burning into the air if caught in it.
You could summon a firenado or spin yourself in anger to become one.
weaknesses: This power might be uncontrolled when it sucks and burns everything in sight period!

name: Tornado Of The Elements
description: This ability allows one to create tornadoes. However, the tornadoes created are not limited to tornadoes of gale-force WINDS; you could use this power to create a fire tornado, a water tornado, a rock tornado, a sand tornado, as well as many other kinds; the limit is really just your imagination. This ability even allows you to combine tornado effects...like maybe water plus fire equals a steam tornado, and fire plus rock equals a lava tornado.
summary: The ability to create tornadoes (and tornado-like forms)
strengths: Create tornadoes at will (for both defense and offense) and guide their movement
Select the element that is converted into tornado form (fire, water, ice, earth tornado, etc.)
Mixing elements to create numerous creative effects
weaknesses: Can't STOP tornadoes (created or natural) and cannot otherwise manipulate weather
If not guided well it could be deadly
Limited by your imagination

name: Cyperiokinesis
description: Through the hand of the caster, a sensation of intense burning and zero-degree freezing is felt within the target, giving both a mental and physical disability.
summary: The ability to give the sensation of being burned and frozen simultaneously.
strengths: Heavy wounding if inflicted properly
Can leave the enemy mentally defeated if nothing else
weaknesses: Depending on the strength of the opponent, it may not be as effective as on a weaker one
Through total mental control, it can be overcome

name: Haha! Burn, Baby, Burn!
description: You can actually control the elements. Good thing is you can create your own minions from your element, such as, let's say, you can control fire, you can create minions who are your element (fire) and they follow your commands. Bad thing is, you CAN be defeated by your opposite element, such as water beats fire, earth beats wind, energy beats ice and so on. The examples below are the characters created from my own imagination.
summary: The ability to control and create minions out of fire, water, air, etc.
strengths: Kyanos (ice)
Tremblor (earth)
Groglurk (fire)
weaknesses: Drakonnan (fire)
Haeos (energy)
Heatblast (fire)

name: Polymerkinesis
description: You can be capable of manipulating and channelling various kinds of plastic. You can even manipulate polyesters and silicone-based nylons to your whim. This newly developed technique allows you to form organic bioplastics with the earth, water, and air.
summary: The ability to control and reshape plastic objects
strengths: You can be a Plastic Magnet
Plastic is a relatively common substance
weaknesses: Fire will melt anything you can control
Rural areas typically do not have many plastics

name: Point Defense
description: Basically, point defense is the practice of defending a single object or small area using things that are normally offensive. Ex: Using Surface-to-Air missiles to destroy Intercontinental Ballistic missiles, however realistic that may seem. This power just applies the practice of point defense to offensive superpowers. For example, this power will use Pyrokinesis, but not PB: Ignition. You could do point defense without this power, but it is harder to do without this power.
summary: The ability to defend oneself with offensive powers
strengths: If all your other powers are offensive, then this power will really help.
You can still use your powers normally even if they're being used by Point Defense.
This power calcutes out all the mathematics involved for the user.
weaknesses: Has no effect on normally defensive powers.
Will not affect friends' powers.
Con Negation and similar alteration powers do not affect this power.

name: Golden Flames
description: These flames have the color of gold and can hurt beings like ordinary fire but deal more damage to anything that is evil and less to anything that is on the side of good. Those who are extremely virtuous will most likely not be harmed by these flames.
summary: The ability to create and control flames that are anti-evil
strengths: Cool golden flames that have the purpose of taking down demons.
weaknesses: Not meant to be used against the virtuous.

name: Aura Attune: Air
description: With this power, you may attune your aura with Air. While active, all mystical and spiritual abilities related to air or wind are greatly empowered, but all earth related ones are weakened. You also become more resistant to air powers, but weaker to earth related powers. This power also makes your aura like that of a powerful Air Elemental, causing Air-aligned beings to treat you with respect. Earth-aligned beings, however, fear or hate you. Luckily, this power can be turned on and off.
summary: The ability to attune your aura with the element of Air.
strengths: Empower your spiritual or magical air powers.
Have air-aligned creatures treat you with respect or friendliness.
Become more resistant to harmful air powers.
weaknesses: Weakens magical and spiritual earth powers.
Earth-aligned creatures hate or fear you.
Weaker to harmful earth powers.

name: Meteoric Metamorphosis
description: This power allows you to turn yourself into a stone-like material and launch you in the air like a real meteor. You can fly in that form and, in addition, your body will be unbreakable, destroying every terrestrial stuff in your way.
summary: The ability to convert your body into stone and propel yourself like a meteor
strengths: You can fly really fast both on earth and in the space
If you land in somewhere with enough force, you'll make a real disaster
In your Meteoric form, you're completely invincible, even if you don't have oxygen
weaknesses: It's really hard to control the flight distances
Your force will be very difficult to tame if you aren't very careful
Your power can be a danger to others in a very enclosed places

name: Weight Mimicry
description: With this power, you just touch an object, concentrate on it, and Boom. You now weigh as much as that object. This process does not change your mass or density, and you do not require extra muscle to support extra weight. You can imitate the weight of anything, from the air around you to the whole earth, though doing the latter will likely cause you to fall to the center of said earth and die. There are really only two applications for this power: flight and demolition.
summary: The ability to become the same weight as anything you touch
strengths: Float and/or Fly if you have some helium with you
Tackle with the weight of a house
No need for extra muscle
weaknesses: If you can think of more than two effin' uses then you're effin' brilliant
Falling through the earth might hurt a bit
Must touch another human to return to a reasonable weight

name: Water Absorption
description: Absorb water and ice with out harm. You can either release the water when you absorb it or save it in your body. Can only hold the water in for an hour.
summary: The ability to absorb any water or ice without being harmed
strengths: Water or ice will never hurt you
If your a firefighter you will never need a hose again
Good for in the summer and the pool is crowded
weaknesses: If held in for to long you will blow up
Does not work at all in dry areas
If you go into a desert all the water will immediatly evaporate

name: Office Assassin
description: You know a multitude of ways to use any everyday objects to kill someone. Anything you can hold in your hand you know over 50 ways to kill someone with it. You know just where to staple someone in the neck to paralyze them; you can make a bomb out of a microwave, a radio clock, a water jug, and rubbing alcohol; you can make poison out of coffee, hand sanitizer, and a bag of jellybeans; you can crawl through air ducks, jump from roof to roof, and climb from window to window with ease; etc.
summary: The ability to kill someone with everyday objects
strengths: You know over 100 ways to kill someone instantly with just a paper clip
You can hide any evidence and never get caught, they'll never know it was you or how you did it
You know every form of self defence and martial arts there is.
weaknesses: You may have random impulses to kill the nearest person.
Does not affect your skills at normal weapons, e.g. guns, knifes, etc.
If someone taps your shoulder, or does anything to startle you, you go into killing mode.

name: Jadeite
description: Jadeite is a form of jade and is currently the most expensive gemstone in the world. With this power, you have full control over jadeite having the power to create it, shape it, alter it's weight and density, perceive it and turn into a form composed of it. Even large amounts of Jadeite can be levitated and reshaped with little effort. However, you can only control the solid form of jadeite.
summary: The ability to generate, manipulate and mimic the mineral jadeite
strengths: Jadeite is the most expensive gemstone in the world.
Can turn yourself into a jadeite golem.
Can have full control over jadeite, creating and reshaping it.
weaknesses: If you create to much jadeite the price will go down.
If jadeite is changed chemically you lose control over it.
Geokinetic powers may override this power (and can manipulate YOU in Jadeite form)

name: Biohazard Immunity
description: With this superpower, you are immune to all illness based attacks. If you have this power, you can also duplicate it and give the power to as many living organisms as you like. Any living organism with this superpower are immune to illness based attacks.
summary: The ability to any and all illness based attacks.
strengths: Be completely immune to illness based attacks.
Can duplicate and grant the superpower to others.
weaknesses: You can still catch the common cold.
If someone attacks you with the common cold, you might catch it.
Everyone gets the common cold sometimes.

name: Living Rock
description: With this power, you can make rocks into stone warriors to defend/serve you. Basically, you find some rocks and fire the life wave at them, and they form themselves into a human shape. This power will only work if there are enough rocks to make a person out of.
summary: The ability to bring rocks to life.
strengths: Rock armies
Rock slaves
Crowd surfing with enough rockmen
weaknesses: High 5s really hurt
Not exactly the brightest pets
Heavy

name: Disasters
description: Nuclear Explosions, Tornadoes, Hail, Plane Crashes, Earthquakes, and everything in between. Cause any form of disaster or calamity to occur.
summary: The ability to make any form of disaster happen
strengths: Can be as harmless as rain or deadly as a comet strike
weaknesses: Cannot stop disasters from happening

name: Flames Of Possession
description: A person with this power has a very selfish power indeed. They gain the ability to create a fiery construct of anything that they have ever burned as long as that object had been burned to ashes. Once an object has been burned, they can immediately summon a fiery construct of that object with the same properties. In addition, even burned people can be summoned by the user, so the user can easily assemble an army of flamies. Fiery constructs can become solid or pure flame.
summary: The ability to summon fiery constructs of anything you have ever burned to ashes that will obey you
strengths: Can easily get lots of fiery objects
Can have a flame army
Constructs can become solid or flame at will and you can touch the fire without damage
weaknesses: Some things are hard to burn to ashes-such as metal
The durability of the solid construct remains the same
Need to have a lighter or some other object to start your fire collection

name: Kirby's Inhale
description: With this ability, you can inhale things and other people's attacks and gain powers from them like the famous pink puff, Kirby. Ex. Inhale ice and you can have ice breath. Ex. Inhale gunpowder and you can produce bombs out of thin air. Etc. People might think you're a cannibal though.
summary: The ability to inhale people and items and gain powers from them
strengths: You can inhale anything and gain a power from it.
It's easy to eat cause you could eat anything.
weaknesses: Eating at a restaurant is not a good idea.
Be careful when kissing.

name: Shadow To Clay Figures
description: The user is able to summon up clay figures from their own shadow or shadows from non-sentient life. These clay figures are under the direct control of the person who summoned them. The number of clay figures that the user can can summons is highly dependent on the user's control over this power. If the clay gets burned by pyrokinetic users and turns into stone, the user can still control the new stone figures.
summary: The ability to summon up clay figures from the user's shadow
strengths: Shadows are ever present
Clay is strong against electricity
weaknesses: Weak against water
Shadows are scarce during the night

name: Ten Incarnations
description: The user of this power has the ability to wield the power of the god of Victory which is "Ten Incarnations" and they are Gale(Wind), Bull, White Stallion, Camel, Boar, Youth, Bird (Raptor), Ram, Goat,and Warrior.  However, some Incarnations work only under certain conditions, and all of them can only be used once a day.  Conditions are like the white stallion can only be used against those who have committed great sins against the people and likewise.
summary: The ability to posses the abilities of "Verethragna", the god of Victory
strengths: Ability of Verethragna(God of Victory)
With proper training Incarnations could be activated and used at the same time
weaknesses: Some incarnations only works under certain conditions
All of the incarnations can be used only once a day

name: Neural Pyrokinesis
description: This superpower allows people to trick the body into thinking it's burning while causing no actual harm. This makes it perfect for torturing people.
summary: The ability to make a person think they're burning to death.
strengths: This is great for torture.
This doesn't take any focus--just eye contact.
This power is non-lethal.
weaknesses: This cannot kill someone.
Must make eye contact.
Strong-willed people can break the effects.

name: Anti Matter
description: The ability to create anti-matter, or dark matter, at will. Anti-matter is the opposite of matter - yes, it exist in real life - and creates massive explosions if it comes in contact with ordinary matter, such as rocks, water, even air. Simply put, the power enables you to create massive explosions, and in the worse-case scenario, black holes.
summary: The ability to create anti-matter at will.
strengths: Nobody will have the guts to come near you, risking to explode.
Blast the crap out of things.
Create a black hole, and let it suck up everything in nearby places.
weaknesses: Watch out so that you won't blow yourself to smithereens!
Don't get sucked up by one of your own black holes!

name: Myth Power: Nod To Nereus
description: Nereus (Nereos), in Greek myth, was the god of the quiet sea and the sea's bounty of fish, as well as the Old Man of the Sea. As such, channeling him allows one to swim well and survive underwater. In addition, one can psychically teleport to any calm, quiet body of water at will. Furthermore, one can psychically perceive, communicate with, and command fish and other aquatic species at will. One may even communicate with the sea itself, to receive psychic insight about past, present and future.
summary: The ability to channel Nereus' command over the essence of the quiet sea and the sea's bounty of fish
strengths: Swim well and survive underwater (may be shared by touch); teleport to any quiet body of water
Psychically perceive, communicate with, share senses with and command fish and other aquatic species
Speak with the sea to receive insight on past/present/future; automatic favor with sea creatures
weaknesses: No Aquatic Shapeshifting until the higher levels (NCN)
Only summon fish, turn one species into another, or turn foes into fish at higher levels (NCN)
Aquatic/water/sea/ocean-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Limited Summon
description: With this ability you will be able to instantly summon anything or anyone that currently exsists on earth to you. There is a catch however, you can only summon each object once. Once you have summoned a particular item, you can never summon it again.
summary: The ability to summon anything that already exsists on earth one time for each item.
strengths: Summon anything or anyone
Have access to any item that could help you
weaknesses: Can only summon an item once
The more items you summon the less you will be able to summon later

name: Holy Water
description: The subject's body reacts with the molecular composition of water that they drink, and depending on the source and origin of the water, they acquire a specific superpower. An example: drinking water from a spring situated in Germany, he/she will be able to control plants and vegetation; drinking water that comes from the Antarctic, he/she could manipulate ice, and so on. The effect of the power lasts until the water flows in the organism.
summary: The ability to gain a superpower by drinking water that comes from a specific place.
strengths: This method of gaining powers is not invasive, no collateral effects are expected;
A single drop of water is sufficient to give a power.
weaknesses: Water is not so different in the world, so the range of obtainable powers is limited;
The duration of every power is limited;
Providing fresh water from some places in the world is not so easy.

name: Trick Magic
description: This ability is very similar to the power Magic Tricks, but the difference is that the user never does any real magic. Here's the process. First, you must imagine what you want to do. Then, you will have a vision of how to do it using stage magic. Let's say you want to shoot endless fireworks from your fingers. Then, you will have a vision of how to build a small, concealable firework-shooting device that goes around your wrist or something like that.
summary: The ability to do anything through sleight of hand.
strengths: One of the BEST performers of all time
Can be very useful
weaknesses: May be harder to do some tricks than others.

name: Future Vision
description: You can fire electric bolts from your eyes whether is far or close and put it into theirs and see what their future is like, but you may able to stop their new crimes from happening and save the innocent.
summary: The ability to stare far away or up close and fire bolts into your opponent's eyes to see what events may occur.
strengths: You can stop new crimes from happening.
Villains will be afraid of you.
weaknesses: Must stare at an enemy to work.

name: Ice Shard
description: Like the explanation says, you can shoot ice shards out of your hands.
summary: The ability to shoot ice shards from your hands.
strengths: Shoot ice shards.
Could kill because they are sharp.
weaknesses: If your opponent has a fire power, he/she could melt it.

name: Wind Breeze
description: Wind breeze can be used to travel quickly or to not be seen or to fit through tight spaces. It can even be used to create certain natural disasters (large and small). Also, the user won't get mixed with other winds/breezes. Plus, if you want, the user could scare someone by pretending to be a ghost.
summary: The ability to become a wind breeze.
strengths: Eco-friendly and efficient transportation
Become an invisible breeze
Be a "ghost"
weaknesses: Natural disasters may get out of hand
"ghost prank" might go too far

name: Rain Of Terror
description: Now you'll even lethally rain on someone else's parade by dropping a billion nails from above and/or sending many long spikes all around flying across the area onto the enemies. Shoot up a bunch of endless shards in several different directions.
summary: The ability to summon a million spikes from the sky
strengths: Bust up a thousand of ballons.
You can take out an entire army.
Take this power in a different direction.
weaknesses: Not a good idea to use indoors.

name: Cloud Mimicry
description: You can 'rain' your form up into the shape and substance of a cloud (same mass as yourself, but less density, which is that of a cloud), and can do anything that a cloud would be able to do, including raining on people, shooting lightning, making tornadoes, hail, etc. This power turns you into a cloud, so anything that affects a cloud affects you, and everything that doesn't affect a cloud doesn't affect you. After 'raining' yourself back down, the cloud disappears and you become human again.
summary: The ability to turn into a cloud at will
strengths: Float around at any height at will without fear of falling (you fall as rain)
Shoot lightning!!!!!
Spy on people
weaknesses: A cloud floating around will be suspicious
Pollution
You can be caught with a vacuum cleaner...

name: Induced Digression
description: The flow of ideas being expressed is like a flow of water. And just as you can divert water to make it go wherever you want, you can divert a speech/conversation to make it go to whatever subject you want. Since the direction is taken naturally, it can be difficult for the speaker(s) to notice they are digressing, but, if they do, they can change the subject or come back to the original one.
summary: The ability to control the direction of a speech/conversation.
strengths: You do not have to be one of the speakers to use this power.
You can bring anyone into a delicate, embarrassing or confidential topic.
You can get information out of anyone.
weaknesses: If they realize they are digressing, they can break your control.
The further the distance toward the topic you want, the longer it may take to get there.

name: Quartz Graveyard
description: This abilty give you the ability to preform The Quartz Graveyard move. By slamming your hand on the ground you can cause hundreds of Quartz spikes to erupt from the ground around you. The spikes rise in a wave eminating from you and devastate the area around you.
summary: The ability to cause large spikes of quartz to erupt from the ground in a large area
strengths: Cause lots of damage
Large area of effect
weaknesses: Does not discriminate victims (You can harm allies by accident)
Requires nearly all your energy to use.

name: Myth Power: Phorcys' Ferocity
description: Phorcys (or Phorkys), in Greek myth, was the god of the dangers of the sea. As such, channeling him allows one to manipulate water at will, as well as surviving underwater and swimming well. In addition, one can perceive dangerous waterways (rocky waters, rough or stormy waters, toxic waters, flooding rivers, waters infested with sea monsters, rapids, whirlpools or water spouts, at a waterfall's edge, etc) at will. One may even teleport subjects to locations laden with said dangerous by touch.
summary: The ability to channel Phorcys command over the essence of the dangers of the sea
strengths: Gain the ability to manipulate water, bending it to one's will (regardless of its physical state)
Perceive dangerous waterways at will (rocky/stormy/toxic/monster-infested, waterfall's edge, etc)
Teleport subjects to dangerous waterways by touch; sea monsters will NEVER attack you
weaknesses: People with Teleportation Immunity or the like are immune to Pro #3
People with aquatic/water/sea/ocean-based MythPowers are immune to this ability
At higher levels, people with MythPower: Poseidon's Prestige can disrupt/negate this ability (NCN)

name: Elemental Weapon:Water Trident
description: You can call forth a trident that can control and manipulate the properties of water. Not only water, but steam and ice, and everything that is primarily H2O. You can thrust the trident at foes and strike them down, or you can flush them away with a tsunam or tidal wave.  You are immune to the effects of water, while wielding the trident, and can breathe underwater.
summary: The ability to wield a trident that can control and manipulate water
strengths: Control and manipulate all forms of water (steam, ice, and water)
Can strike enemies down, by thrust a powerful trident at them
Not only control water, but can generate it too
weaknesses: Can only control water when wielding the trident.
Are only immune to the effects of water, when wielding the trident
Your elemental weakness is fire

name: Empathic Storm Cloud
description: An Empathic Storm Cloud has many uses, in both combat and defense. It hovers over head at all times, only dissipating when the user consciously wills it to; its effect varies based on the user's emotions (thunder and/or lightning when angry, furiously blowing winds when afraid/nervous, rain when sad or a combination of these and orher effects at will). The user can often also make the cloud FOLLOW the foe with its effects, or even coalesce the cloud's molecules so one can stand on and ride it.
summary: The ability to produce a storm cloud above your head that interacts with your surroundings based on your emotion
strengths: Cloud produces effects based on one's emotions
Make the cloud follow the foe around, raining/hailing on him, striking him with lightning, etc.
Can even be used to ride/fly on
weaknesses: Cloud produces effects based on one's emotions (emotional stress may even harm loved ones)
If you have no control over this power, it may even hurt you
Cloud is almost ALWAYS overhead, even if you develop this power

name: Drizzle
description: You can now make it rain from the sky anywhere at any time, indoors and out. You control how long and how hard it rains as well as the temperature of the rain that falls, from boiling heat to as cold as the arctic sea. Since the rain is supernatural it vanishes at the point when it would normally evaporate and contains none of the nutrients needed from water to survive.
summary: The ability to make it rain.
strengths: Make it rain anytime. By extention you can also make it cloudy.
Rain out your opponent with a boiling or icy shower.
Flood whole areas.
weaknesses: Nothing can make use of the rain water.

name: Bullets Of Un Adaptability
description: The power of defensive adaptation is an effective way of protecting oneself from defeat. For some, it is a cheap and annoying ability that doesn't require mastery, skill, or any tactical method to overcome a difficult situation. With this ability however, a person can now materialize a bullet (wired to defeat the target) that can counter-adapt any immunity or protection gained from adaptation. It will continously evolve and transform itself whenever the target has adapted from a previous attack.
summary: The ability to materialize meta-existential bullets that counter-adapt to anything the target is adapted to.
strengths: Infinitely creates new ways to harm, torture, counter abilities to defeat your target.
All Meta-bullets fired transcend all existential limitations and stay within the target.
The Meta-bullet will continously adapt to cause harm, even if it is inside the target.
weaknesses: The bullet is perfectly unique and no two bullets are the same so you don't know what they do.
Can 'only' I repeat ONLY be used against annoying super beings capable of adaptation.
Has no effect whatsoever on non-adaptative targets.

name: Hydro Breath
description: You can easily breathe out burst streams of water from your mouth to extinguish fire and reduce your opponents to wetness (especially fire-based enemies).
summary: The ability to spew a jet stream of water from your mouth.
strengths: You'll become a human firehose.
weaknesses: Never use it on electrical objects.
If you use it on electric based opponents, you can get shocked.

name: Molecular Repulsion
description: This ability will allow you to make stuff, including you, unable to be touched or combined by any molecule or what they form into like earth or water. This was made for defense, but with the right amount of imagination, it can be used for offense.
summary: The ability to make anything unable to be touched by any molecule, the effects only last for 10 min, if left alone.
strengths: Can be protected by any form of molecule.
Make anything else protected by any form of molecule.
weaknesses: The effects, if left alone, can last for 10 min.
Can't be protected from light, sound, or heat energy.

name: Master Evolver
description: You can use your ability to accelerate the genetic evolution of living organisms, could foribly evolve or devolve life froms at an aceelerated rate. For my example - you could fire mental waves to evolve any ape species into a human, any kind of fish into a reptile/amphibian and/or you can use it on a human to make their craniums grow in size.
summary: The ability to turn any ape/primate into a human & turn any fish species into a reptile/amphibian.
strengths: You could even turn a Shark into a T-Rex.
Can enhance other hero or villain's powers & abilities.
weaknesses: It can cause them to die.

name: Fractal Matter Conversion
description: Use this power on anything solid-say a vase, smash it into a 100 pieces, and you get the original back plus 99 duplicates. Smash those hundred vases and you a get 10,000 vases. Now imagine any weapon or armor self-replicating/regenerating. This power will work on the simplest thing(a rock) to the most complex-a super computer. This power will work on a painting or a book. It will work on objects made of frozen liquids. It will work with batteries. Scale is no object-the Earth could be affected.
summary: The ability to make any non-fractal non-living object into a fractal one.
strengths: Make anything you own self-replicating and self-regenerating.
Your clothes will always be like new.
Think of what objects you like to make indestructible.
weaknesses: Powers that totally destroy an object.
Matter control powers.
Powers that stop or freeze an object without damaging it.

name: Isolation
description: With this power, you can isolate a single element when it is combined with others. For example, you could make water disappear and float upwards by isolating the oxygen and hydrogen. It requires little focus and can only be used when in physical contact with the object you want to break up. You could basically kill anyone by isolating all of the elements they are made of. You do not need to isolate them completely though. You could breathe underwater by just isolating some O2, not just oxygen.
summary: The ability to isolate elements in compounds, minerals, ect.
strengths: Isolate precious metals from ordinary rock.
Breathe underwater.
Instant kill.
weaknesses: Needs physical contact.
Might become power-mad.
Might need to research your periodic table to use this effectively.

name: Spark
description: An electrical spark is created by snapping one's fingers
summary: The ability to create a spark by snapping your fingers
strengths: Can light certain objects on fire
Waterproof
Can come in handy in survival situation or recreation
weaknesses: Not good for offensive
Nor defensive

name: Sun Palms
description: You are able to create stars in your hands. You are also able to mentally be able to explode it.  These suns are loaded with an insane amount of thermal energy, so if they touch you, you will be burned.  BADLY.
summary: The ability to create sun in the palm of your hands.
strengths: Create Stars.
weaknesses: You will be burned badly.

name: Elemental Weapon: Earth Hammer
description: You can call forth a hammer/mallet, that when pounded on the ground can cause massive quakes, tremors, avalanches, and terraform the land.  You can pound away at foes or manipulate and control the earth to do damage.  This power you can manipulate the majority of minerals found on the earth, including trees and plants. While wielding the hammer, you are immune to the effects of the earth element.
summary: The ability to wield a giant hammer/mallet that can manipulate the earth
strengths: Control and manipulate the earth (this incorporates the basic natural minerals too)
Can pound away at enemies, with your giant hammer/mallet
A giant hammer that you can wield with ease and minimal effort
weaknesses: Can only control the earth element when wielding the hammer/mallet
You are only immune to the effects of the earth element when wielding the hammer
Your elemental weakness is wind

name: Zero Tact
description: Remove all heat from anything with a touch. The side effect being you will also cause someone or something of equal size and weight to be consumed by flame. Shatter walls, people, buildings etc.
summary: The ability to reduce any object to absolute zero with a touch
strengths: You can activate this power at will
Irreversible. Works on any size, shape or person as long as you make skin contact
Side effect could eliminate two problems
weaknesses: No choice. Absolute zero, you get three seconds to break contact or you freeze too
Side effect is someone or something will be instantly be consumed by intense heat
Losing precious items while learning how to use your ability

name: Rock Cycle
description: With this power in one hand you have the power to control heat and in the other hand you have the power to control pressure. You can only control the heat and pressure on rocks and minerals though. Pressure can be used to compact or expand the minerals or be applied in a certain direction to levitate minerals. Heat can create magma or freeze the minerals so that they become harder. By using heat and pressure you can turn one type of rock into another metamorphic rock.
summary: The ability to use heat and pressure to change rocks and minerals.
strengths: Can heat up or cool down rocks and minerals by extreme temperatures.
Can apply pressure on rocks in a single direction to move the rocks.
If you understand Earth science you could change rocks into new rocks.
weaknesses: Only works on rocks and minerals.
Might be annoying for some for the power to be seperated into each hand.
If you have less than two hands then you lose parts of this power.

name: 1st Key Of Life
description: With this power the first key of life is yours to summon. Mankind has two kinds of Death resulting in two keys. This one is for the Underworld. By dropping/throwing this key on the ground, an earthquake occurs, and within the cracks, the people you wanted to release come up within the cracks, releasing them from the underworld.
summary: The ability to summon the first key of life.
strengths: Release loved ones from the Underworld.
weaknesses: You may have a loved one that went to Heaven.
If they ate down there, they can't come back.
It is a small key you may lose.

name: Defenders Call
description: Reinforcements appears as soon as you say: Calling all defenders, Cover me! A lightning bolt will crash from the skies and reveal a hero that is perfectly suited to take down whatever danger is about to harm you.  An evil scientist trying to kill you with a freeze ray? The reinforcements power will summon a fire manipulating hero.  A hero for every situation.
summary: The ability to summon a random being that will defend you.
strengths: Nothing will ever get close enough to kill you if you summon a defender.
You are prepared for every situation.
You get to order beings around that are possibly more powerful then you.
weaknesses: Each defender can only be summoned once, someone else that could save you is summoned instead.
This power only works if you get attacked, NOT if you attack.
Power not available on a holiday, everyone deserves to be with their family on a holiday.

name: Speed Drawing
description: You might need several sheets of paper, because if you draw too fast you'll cause the paper to spontaneously combust from friction burn.
summary: The ability to draw anything you want at the speed of light.
strengths: Draw anything fast
Easy way to make a quick buck as an artist.
weaknesses: Only works with drawing, not writing nor reading.

name: Disaster
description: Natural disasters have always played a major role in the world's history. A person with Disaster can bring forth various natural disasters: floods, fires, hail, tornadoes, earthquakes, meteor showers, etc. However, the ability is extremely volatile: strong negative emotion usually makes it very uncontrollable. The user has little directive control over the disaster. With training, though, they can send disasters 6 miles away and create very minor disasters.
summary: The ability to summon various natural disasters
strengths: Great destructive power
Very versatile: tornadoes, earthquakes, meteor showers
Becomes very powerful with training
weaknesses: Very volatile w/ emotion
Have very little directive control over the disaster
Only natural, not smog or acid rain

name: Zodiac: Sagittarius
description: You can call upon the power of Sagittarius by drawing his symbol in the air. This allows you to fire off psionic projectiles at a rate of 100 per second for two seconds before you have to draw the symbol again. The projectiles can be fire, water, earth, sand, mud, wood, etc.
summary: The ability to call upon the power of Sagittarius the Archer
strengths: Can fire projectiles rapidly.
Projectiles can be made from virtually anything.
Projectiles are tough to destroy.
weaknesses: Can only fire for 2 sec before drawing symbol again.
Have to draw symbol to use.

name: Razorphoon
description: With this ability, you can create a giant whirlpool in mid air filled with razor blades, swords, knives, mirror shards, glass shards, and much more. You can use it to douse fire enemies and slice your foes deep at the same time. If you are electrocuted while using the power, an army of razor blades made of water will fly out of the whirlpool and attack the enemy.
summary: The ability to create a whirlpool in the air filled with sharp objects.
strengths: Puts out fire enemies
Cuts your enemies, so they lose large amounts of blood
Send an army of razor blades to do your bidding
weaknesses: Betray the razor blades, and they will destroy you

name: Powers Of The Hydroquan Hero
description: You will be able to control liquid, but you cannot control frozen liquid. You can also turn into water and become very flexible. But beware! You may be frozen by your enemy when you are in liquid-form!
summary: The ability to control liquids and liquefied substances, and turn into liquid.
strengths: Aqualad
Aquaman
Hydrolad
weaknesses: H2Ogla
Bin Fei
Mercurus

name: Mini Capsule Grenade
description: The person with this power is able to summon mini capsule grenades for him or her to use. The grenades range from smoke grenades, electrical grenades, a normal sized grenade that is used to capture a person or even a freeze grenade.
summary: The ability to summon mini capsule grenade, each with its own use and specialty
strengths: Never run out of grenades
Different grenades have different uses
No cooldown time between summons
weaknesses: Only can summon one type of grenade at a time
Maximum of five mini capsules per summon of one type

name: 100x Big Bang Kamehameha!
description: Literally meaning "Hundredfold Big Bang Turtle Destructive Wave;" it is an energy wave technique used by Super Saiyan 4 Gogeta against Omega Shenron. It is a fully-powered, synchronized combination of two ultimate attacks simultaneously harnessed by a separated Goku and Vegeta. The user does not genuinely provide the attack with their own energy, in fact, they gather it from their environment - broadening its force to any extent. Hence, nothing can survive it.
summary: The ability to expel the most powerful attack in the Dragonball Franchise.
strengths: Destroy anyone and anything.
weaknesses: None known.

name: Central Air Conditioning/Heat
description: With this power you will always be cool or warm; you will never become too hot or too cold, but you'll always be somewhere in the middle. If it is very cold in your location you automatically become warm, if it is very hot in your location you will automatically become cool. This power basically makes you comfortable, temperature-wise. It is automatic and it cannot be turned off.
summary: The ability to be constantly cool/warm
strengths: You will never be too hot or too cold
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat
It cannot be turned off

name: Vitrification
description: Similar to the superhuman power Glaciation, this is the power to psychically transmute matter into glass. One with this ability may do it by touch, look or just mental power (depending on the user's genetics). It affects the subject in the same way one is affected by the power Petrifaction, but, instead of stone, the subject turns into glass. In addition, if a subject is turned into glass, they can *sometimes* be returned to normal at will, as long as the glass isn't shattered.
summary: The ability to turn matter into glass
strengths: Glass is very fragile
May be accompanied by the ability to assume a form composed of glass (or to control glass)
User is often able to affect living and inanimate matter
weaknesses: You can't return a person to normal if they get shattered
Sometimes only affects living matter (or only non-living matter)
It can also be triggered subconsciously (accidental vitrification)

name: Moisture To Ice
description: The user of this power is able to turn the moisture in the air into ice. The ability to turn the moisture in the air into ice, is dependent on how humid the air is. If the air has a high humidity then this power is very effective, in a low humidity environment, this power is almost useless
summary: The ability to turn the moisture in the air into ice
strengths: Air is pretty much humid in most parts of the world
Good at stopping bad guys
weaknesses: Low humidity or no humid air will render this power useless

name: Green Arrow's Quiver
description: With this power you can summon Green Arrow's quiver. You have every trick arrow he's ever used and once you fire them they automatically teleport back into the quiver after an hour. You're also an expert archer but only when you're using Green Arrow's quiver.
summary: The ability to have Green Arrow's quiver
strengths: You have all of Green Arrow's trick arrows
The arrows automatically teleport back to you after an hour
weaknesses: You're only an expert archer when you have the quiver
If you use all of your arrows in under an hour you're screwed for a bit

name: Dense Air
description: This power allows you to make air thinner or denser. You can make it so thin that people find it freakishly hard to breathe, or so dense and heavy that people can barely walk through it.
summary: The ability to mess with air molecule concentration in an area
strengths: Lower your enemies' oxygen supply, thus reducing their brains' capabilities.
You are immune to the effects, so you'll be running around while others are gasping for air.
weaknesses: I'm pretty sure there is none. I could be wrong, but I don't think so.

name: Greatest American Hero
description: "Believe it or not, I'm walking on air. I never thought I would feel so free eee eee. Flying away on a wing and a prayer. Who could it be? Believe it or not, it's just me. " Yes, with this power, you will have the red alien suit of Ralph Hinkley. The suit comes with an instruction manual to show you how to use it, so hero up!
summary: The ability to possess a red alien suit with various powers.
strengths: Invulnerability, super strength, psychometry, invisibility
Walk on air
Cool 80's theme song
weaknesses: Losing the instruction manual
Learning how to use the suit (and sucking at it) if you lose the manual
Flying and falling (make sure you fly low)

name: Camera Power: Freeze Frame
description: A person with this power can turn anything they see immobile at will. There are two limits on this power. The first limit is that you have to close one of your eyes every time you use this power. Opening it will release the immobility effect. The second limit is that it can only immobilize what you see. If someone is hiding behind a rock or is invisible, they won't be immobilized. Otherwise, this is a very versatile power, even allowing you to make water solid or even freeze fire or explosions.
summary: The ability to render anything you see that would be visible in a standard camera immobile
strengths: Can immobilize enemies
Non-lethal in normal situations -- air still moves and people's internal organs are hidden from view
Can even freeze explosions so you can pose in front of it
weaknesses: People can hide behind objects or within objects to avoid power
Must close an eye to keep things immobilized
Con 2 ruins the picture of yourself in front of the explosion

name: Fire Walk
description: The flames created by this power will only last for 10 minutes before they disappear. Your speed is also boosted while using this power.
summary: The ability to cause the areas one's feet touch to burst into flames
strengths: Surround enemies with a ring of flames.
You can choose when to use this power so that there are as few accidents as possible.
weaknesses: Can accidentally hurt friends if you're not careful.

name: Angry Earth
description: Pick anyone of your choosing. Then by your command, the earth will open under the person, swallow them, then close back up.
summary: The ability to have the earth swallow anybody
strengths: Powerful
Little concentration
weaknesses: Dangerous
Creepy

name: Sand Mimicry
description: Sand is defined as 'a naturally occurring granular material composed of finely divided rock and mineral particles'. A Sand Mimic can become this at will. This means they can create blasting jets of sand from their own body mass, fly by directing their sandy form, allow objects to go through them, and even take on extra sand to become larger. However, they are subject to parts of themselves being seperated (like in a jar), being transformed into glass, or even being washed away.
summary: The ability to turn your body into sand
strengths: Can allow objects to pass through your sand
Can drift on wind currents as sand
Can take on extra sand to become larger
weaknesses: Parts of you can be seperated from the whole
Can be turned into glass or washed away
Never totally flesh-and-blood

name: Earth Siphon
description: When you use this power. You can pull out the earths life energy, And use it as you wish. But be careful use it too much, and it could cause unnatural disasters.
summary: The ability to suck energy out of the earth
strengths: Suck out the earth's energy
Use it as you wish
weaknesses: Cant overuse it (see description)

name: Coreation
description: The power to drain heat from the center of the Earth and use it for superstrength. The power also makes you immune to fire.
summary: The ability to suck the heat from the center of  the Earth and use it for superstrength.
strengths: You get unbelievable superstrength.
You get superhuman durability.
weaknesses: You can get too much heat in your body and die.

name: Leidenfrost Effect
description: With this superpower, you are protected from hot liquids and solids that are 122 degrees fahrenheit or hotter for a short time. There's an invisible layer of insulation. The layer works for five minutes at 122 F. The hotter it gets, the longer the insulation last. Every degree hotter it gets, that is the number of additional minutes it last. Can only work against heat 122 F of hotter. 222 F will have this power work for 105 minutes. Anything colder than 122F can still burn you.
summary: The ability to temporarily be protected from extreme heat
strengths: Be insulated from temperatures 122 degrees fahrenheit and above.
The hotter it is, the longer this power stays activated.
No more third degree burns.
weaknesses: Doesn't protect you from heat colder than 122 degrees fahrenheit.
Can still get a mild first degree burn sometimes.
Insulating layer is visible underwater.

name: Space Hero
description: When you are in space, you can survive the cold (even the absolute zero), the radiation, you don't need to breathe and you are able to float or fly in space. But you need to be in a vacuum: in the atmosphere, you are just a normal human being.
summary: The ability to have various superpowers while being in space.
strengths: You survive extreme cold and radiation in space.
You don't need to breathe in space.
You're able to float and fly in space.
weaknesses: In the atmosphere, you are just a normal human being.

name: Haberdashery Mimicry
description: With this power, you gain all the typical abilities associated with any hat you wear. A hard hat will turn you into an peerless construction worker, a coonskin hat purveys the firearm skills of Davey Crockett, and a Deerstalker will give you unparallelled powers of deduction.
summary: The ability to gain powers from hats.
strengths: Hats give you the abilities of the most famous person to wear them (Such as Mario's cap)
In cases where the hat isn't associated with someone, they give the most appropriate skills for it.
weaknesses: If the hat is knocked off your head, you lose all your power.

name: Moon Fire
description: Gives the wielder control of moon fire. Moon fire is the essence of the night, so it lets you control darkness, shadows, moonshine, the evil inside people, the public conciousness and protection at night. Each use of the moon fire will make the wielder more attune to the darkness. If the moon fire is left uncontrolled, the wielder will eventuall turn into a mooncalf, a creature of the moon.
summary: The ability to wield the moon fire
strengths: Gives you control over the evil in others
Shadows can be used to hide from enemies
Gives you protection when it's night
weaknesses: If left unattended, it will take over the wielder
It will make the wielder a magnet for creatures of the night
It is very addictive

name: Exemptedness
description: This power causes you to be exempted from a plethora of things. You could be exempted from laws and be a villain or be exempted from movement and literaly be unmovable. You can also make yourself exempted from fire or other elements. A bad feature is that you can make yourself exempted from types of damage, but not from damage itself, and powers like regeneration block can still get to you if you are not careful. You can declare yourself exempted from the laws of physics.
summary: The ability to be exempted from many things.
strengths: Be exempted from space to travel quickly.
If you turn evil and become exempted from perception, specific powers can still find you.
Youre levelheaded friends with anti telepathy or such still know when you do bad.
weaknesses: Not exempted from most superpowers, mostly just from what they can do.
Not exempted from natural stupidity, also takes practice to master.
These three cons can't be fixed by con negator or flaw removal.

name: Icicle Control
description: You can create and control icicles out of the water floating in the air(humidity). The icicles will last as long as you want them too and will melt when you don't care about whether they are there or not. The icicles will be as hard as normal icicles are.
summary: The ability to create and control icicles
strengths: Untraceable kills because the icicle melts.
Last as long as you need them.
weaknesses: Only icicles.

name: Elemental Weapon: Fire Sword
