description: With this ability, you can call to you a sword engulfed in flame. With it you can slash away foes and increase heat. It can also manipulate and control fire; you can shoot fire blasts and beams with the sword. Also you are immune to the effects of fire while wielding the sword.
summary: The ability to wield a sword that controls the fire element
strengths: Control and manipulate all fire (ones you generate, and already lit fires)
Can slash away at enemies with an awesome sword engulfed in flames
weaknesses: The sword controls fire, not you
Only immune to effects of fire, while wielding the sword
Your elemental weakness is water

name: Abacomancy
description: Abacomancy is a method of divination using small particles (Sand, Dust, Ash, Etc.) An Abacomancer merely waves a hand over some dust/sand and it rearranges itself into a pattern that tells the future. More sand/dust means "seeing" further into the future. This power is very unspecific in what information it gives you; you may get anything from useless to bizarre. The better you are at Abacomancy, the more useful the information you get. For obvious reasons, this power works well in deserts.
summary: The ability to divine the future through sand, dust, and ash.
strengths: Can get information about the future.
Can work on dusty things, sand, or even the remains of campfires.
The patterns are unique to each person, like a fingerprint.
weaknesses: May give you really weird things like, "There are 3 millon grasshoppers on the continent".
Can't be used without small particles.
Takes time and effort to decipher the patterns.

name: Myth Power: Oreithyia's Order
description: Oreithyia (Orithyia), in Greek myth, was the goddess of sharp, cold mountain winds. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically generate and manipulate cold winds at will. In addition, one may induce the feeling of frostbite in living things by a touch. Furthermore, one gains adaptation to survive on any mountain (enhanced toughness, cold immunity, adapted respiration, etc), which may be shared by touch. One can even teleport self and others to or from any mountain in the Cosmos at will.
summary: The ability to channel Oreithyia's command over the essence of mountain winds
strengths: Generate and manipulate cold winds at will; induce frostbite in living creatures by a touch
Teleport to/survive on mountains (enhanced toughness and respiration, cold/wind immunity, etc)
Share Montane Adaptation (adaptation to survive mountain conditions) by a touch
weaknesses: Cannot teleport foes to mountaintops and immobilize them there until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Way of the Winds and MythPower: Horae (Seasons) provide immunity
Cold Immunity provides immunity

name: Myth Power: Galene's Grace
description: Galene, in Greek myth, was the goddess of calm seas, and calm weather at sea. As such, channeling her allows one to swim well and survive underwater, which may be shared, by touch. In addition, one can psychically still any body of water (keep water from being manipulated by hydrokinesis, etc) at will. Furthermore, one can psychically calm storms at sea (and on other bodies of water), at will. One can even psychically perceive and teleport self/others to anywhere where the sea is calm, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Galene's command over the essence of calm seas
strengths: Swim well and survive underwater (may be shared by touch)
Psychically still any body of water at will; psychically calm storms on any body of water, at will
Psychically perceive and teleport self/others to anywhere the water is calm
weaknesses: Cannot psychically perceive, communicate with and command sea creatures, until developed (NCN)
Cannot calm the 'sea' of 'stormy' emotions, by touch, until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Poseidon's Prestige provides immunity and allows disruption/negation (NCN)

name: Gorgon's Touch
description: This power allows you to turn anything you touch into a brittle stone that can break if hit. It is possible to turn something you turned to stone back to its previous form, but it causes immense drain on your own energy.   You can also control how fast the thing transforms, allowing for instant transformation or incredibly slow.
summary: The ability to turn anything into stone that you physically touch.
strengths: Can break through anything.
Can turn even living things to stone
Can control what is turned to stone (so you don't accidentally turn your friend to a statue)
weaknesses: Can't undo power if the item that was transformed was broken.

name: Zodiac: Scorpio
description: By drawing the sign of Scorpio in the air, you can fire off telepathic blasts that poison your enemy's mind with doubts as to why they are fighting. They will question what it is they fight for and whether or not your side would be better. This can lead to a massive loss in morale for ordinary troops. This effect lasts for two minutes and blasts are fired in sets of one per second.
summary: The ability to poison your enemy's mind(s) with doubts
strengths: Get rid of enemies fast.
Can gain alies from enemy side.
weaknesses: Can accidentally reinforce an enemy's resolve.
Are required to draw the sign of Scorpio.
Con Negation and similar powers don't work on this power.

name: Wind Perception
description: Wind Energy Perception or Wind Perception is the ability to perceive the flow and flux of the wind, and its direction; it also allows one to perceive things being carried by the wind, or that affect the flow of wind; it may even allow one to eavesdrop on conversations by listening to voices being carried by the wind (and otherwise mimic Superhuman Hearing), or allow one to mimic Superhuman Smell by honing in on scents carried by wind
summary: The ability to perceive the flow and intensity of the wind
strengths: Sense the flow, direction and intensity of the wind
Sense things being carried by the wind (including the approach of storm clouds)
Mimic Superhuman Smell and Superhuman Hearing by honing in on the wind
weaknesses: Sometimes you see only see the wind as color (and can't hone in on scents or sounds)
Sometimes your power to smell the wind is really strong (honing in on scents is disorienting)
Sometimes your power to hear the wind is really strong (honing in on sounds is disorienting)

name: Rise Of The Two Headed Dragon
description: With this power you can turn into a dragon with two heads. One of your dragon heads breathes fire while the other one breathes ice. In addition to that you are super strong, can fly and have sharp teeth in both of your mouths. You cannot speak English in this form only the language of the dragons.
summary: The ability to turn into a two headed dragon
strengths: You can turn into a two headed dragon.
You can fly.
You can breathe fire and ice.
weaknesses: You can only speak the language of the dragons in this form.

name: Aqua Cage
description: This ability allows you to create a water sphere to entrap your enemy. Once the opponent is trapped, the water sphere will solidify and shatter into millions of shards along with the trapped opponent. The Water Sphere originates from your hands as a small sphere at first. You have to throw the sphere at your opponent and it will turn big.
summary: The ability to create a sphere of water to trap your opponent
strengths: Can trap multiple opponents at once
weaknesses: Can be dodged
Requires your hands in order to form

name: Human Hurricane
description: This power requires a great deal of focus and energy to be used. When activated, a gravitation field surrounds the user, the radius of which is adjustable. Any objects pulled into the field will begin to spin around the user while remaining a set distance away. It takes more focus to rotate the objects faster, and even the best of users would only be able to maintain the field for about a minute before collapsing. Once the field is down, all objects will keep their speed, and are sent flying.
summary: The ability to create a potent orbital field of varying size and rotational speed around the user
strengths: Can easily destroy just about any interior locations.
With very precise focus, different objects can be rotated at different speeds within the field.
While in use, the user is protected by a kinetic barrier a few inches from their body.
weaknesses: Takes a lot of energy to use.
User becomes very drained for a time after use (about ten times the total time the power is active).
Limited functionality.

name: Double Helix
description: The elements can be from the periodic table (oxygen, helium, hydrogen, plutonium, etc) and/or the traditional elements (fire, water, wind, ice, etc). The elements can be changed as needed. Either way, they will rotate around like a double helix. Radius for the helix is half a metre.
summary: The ability to take one or two elements and create a a rotating double helix with them
strengths: The two elements can also be used to augment other powers.
Ex: Oxygen can make fires larger.
weaknesses: Some might think it looks weird.

name: Emotional Ego Trip
description: With the power of each personality, you could control different powers with vast emotions. However, due to your multiple personalities and potential, you can possess different powers and some of your abilites and personalities are as follows: fiery rage - zorn, cold cruelty - gene fezirk, waterly joy - acre, electric awe - tonnerre, god mode - victory, psychic lust - adan, optimismistic terrakinesis - manearth, envious toxics - eve, and enthrallment of light and dark - libra.
summary: The ability to possess different powers and personalities inspired by your emotions.
strengths: Your enemies will get confused.
weaknesses: It can only last up to 144 hours.
Your condition will grow bad to worse when you grow older.

name: Measure Control
description: If you were to hold a clock then you can control time. Holding a thermometer gives you control of hot and cold and a ruler the ability to control size.
summary: The ability to when you hold a measuring tool, control what it measures
strengths: You can control many types of measurements
weaknesses: You must hold measuring tools

name: Lateral Line System
description: Similar to the lateral organs possessed by most fish and some amphibians, this adaptation is a must for all aquatic beings.  Being able to detect the movement and vibrations of the water around you allows you to orientate yourself in relation to water currents, avoid collisions, detect predators and prey (or the positions of friend or foes), and, if applicable, assist in schooling behavior.
summary: The ability to detect movement and vibrations in the water
strengths: Detect approaching foes (or prankish friends) trying to surprise you in the water
Avoid bumping into things while swimming. Especially helpful in the dark.
Orient and position yourself in a group in the water
weaknesses: Only effective in the water (or other liquid environments). Useless in the air.

name: Life Unmaking
description: This power lets turn a man into a puddle of mostly water. Victims can be solid,liquid,gas or energy. Turn a man of living rock into a lifeless statue. Use this power on someone made of fire and he'll become a blazing camp fire. An air elemental will disperse into the atmosphere. Any solid (un)dead will crumble to dust. Ghosts will break apart into ectoplasm. The only ways to undo this power are through time reversal or reality alteration. You only need to think to use this power.
summary: The ability to turn the living or once living into inert matter.
strengths: Deal with living,dead or undead foes.
All you do is think to this power.
Only reversed with time or reality powers.
weaknesses: This power won't on anything that was never fully alive.
Someone with immutability or fixed form.

name: Calorie Burn
description: This ability allows the hero to convert his fat and immediate energy into energy. This can be used to warm object, it can be fired, it can be thrown, it can form a force field, or it can explode from ones body. The power makes you body convert energy and nutrients more efficient so you can go without food for days if you don't fire the energy to much.
summary: The ability to turn fat and calories into manipulatable energy.
strengths: Maintain excellent body shape.
Improved overall body function.
Energy attacks.
weaknesses: You have to eat pretty constantly if you plan on a lot of energy discharge.
Keep candy with you on missions.
If you use too much energy you risk losing conciousness.

name: Gasoline Alchemy
description: Change water, beverages and any other liquid into gasoline.
summary: The ability to change a liquid into gasoline.
strengths: Never go to the gas station.
weaknesses: You need to put some kind of liquid in your car and change that into gas.

name: Amber Breath
description: With this ability you will be able to exhale a cloud of gas that activates with the air to form an amber like substance to trap your enemies in. Anyone trapped in the amber remain in a state of suspended animation until they are freed. The gas has a delayed activation so you don't have amber form in your esophagus.
summary: The ability to breath out a gas that quickly coalesces into amber
strengths: Trap enemies
Victims remain alive (good if you're a hero)
Gas has delayed activation to prevent suffacation
weaknesses: Gas does not travel very far
Victims remain alive (bad if you're evil)
Hard to control

name: Pyrokenesis Limited
description: Instantly lighting candles can be done with the snap of your fingers, but you cannot control fires larger than a radius of 26 feet.
summary: The ability to create small amounts of fire
strengths: Ability to start fires instantly
Control small fire sources
weaknesses: Cannot control large amounts of fire such as a forest fire

name: Biome
description: With this power you can create a sphere of any size that changes the ecosystem within to match a Biome of your choosing. You can change the area to that of a tundra, desert, rain forest, etc. The change is instant and all Earth plants and animals except humans get changed to match the Biome you create. Masters of this power could create a sphere in space that creates a planet with Earth plants and animals inside of it based on a Biome.
summary: The ability to create a Biome sphere that changes the ecosystem within.
strengths: Change your area to the Biome of your choosing.
Make your enemies live in artic or desert areas.
Create planets at master level.
weaknesses: Permanent unless you create a different Biome to replace to existing Biome.
Limited to the size of sphere you are able to create.
Does not give any sort of weather control after sphere is made.

name: Zone Zero
description:
Do you have enemies who are just a pain in the behind? 
Immortal, overpowered or just really annoying? 
Well we, the employees of Diviousness. Inc have developed the Zone Zero Power. 
As soon as the threat is in your sight just clap your hands and wamm bamm they have been relocated into Zone Zero, a soothing place filled with nothing but air.
summary: The ability to send someone to another dimension.
strengths: Nobody is safe from your almighty hands.
You don't kill someone so your karma isn't harmed.
It never fails, as long as you clap your hands.
weaknesses: Useless for people who lack hands.
Enemies who are able to teleport are still able to return.
If someone glues your hands to a rock or something else you are left defenceless.

name: Crown Of Ice
description: With this power you can summon a crown made out of ice and it will apear on your head. Though it is made out of ice your head will not become cold from it. Embedded in the crown is a large blue jewel that can either shoot beams of ice that can freeze people or objects or shoot super sharp icicles that can impale people. The crown also allows you to control snow animals such as yetis, polar bears, snow owls etc. When you're done with it you can just unsummon by taking it off your head.
summary: The ability to have an ice crown that allows you to shoot ice beams out of your head and control snow animals
strengths: You have an ice crown that shoot ice beams/icicles and controls snow animals
If anybody ever tries to steal it by removing it from your head it disappears
It doesn't cause your head to become cold
weaknesses: It's not very fashionable

name: Stimuli Inducement
description: Heat, Gravity, smells, etc. The user can induce the feelings of any stimulus towards anyone or anything. If a stimulus that is external like a reaction to fire is induced to a victim, the victim will be engulf by that stimulus spontaneously.
summary: The ability to inflict different stimuli towards anything.
strengths: Make feel any kind of stimulus: external or internal.
External stimuli will result in exposure to actual stimuli.
weaknesses: Can be very dangerous.

name: Eternal Nourishment
description: With this ability you will never be hungry or thirsty again.  You will always feel satisfied (not full).  If you want to feel full, you still have the option of eating something. Also, you will always have the perfect level of nutrients, fats, carbs, etc. in your diet.  So, if you start working out, your protein levels will automatically increase. As a result, your health will probably be top notch. Eating foods that are unhealthy, like the glorious twinkie, is still bad.
summary: The ability to never go hungry or thirsty.
strengths: Never have to pay for food again
Have a perfect food intake as long as you don't eat junk food
Never feel hungry
weaknesses: Never have the satisfaction of quenching thirst of relieving hunger
You might not enjoy food as much
You might start eating more junk food

name: Magma Current
description: With this power you are capable of sending waves of magma across the ground at your opponents. Regardless of how strong you are the waves only go as far as you raise them.
summary: The ability to send a wave of lava along the ground.
strengths: Very easy to clear away your opponents.
weaknesses: Doesn't mix well with water because lava and water mix into stone.

name: Blessing Of Pan
description: Pan is the God of Wild Places. His blessing allows you to be one with the Wild, meaning you can control everything natural in nature. Rivers, trees, rocks, wind, if it's naturally there, you can control it. You cannot control animals; however, you can speak to them and they always love you. You can also use nature magic. It involves playing a certain tune on a wooden instrument for a certain effect. It could be almost anything, from finding a path to putting someone to sleep.
summary: The ability to have the Blessing of Pan
strengths: Controlling nature
Speaking to animals, who always love you
Nature magic
weaknesses: Losing your instrument
If you hurt nature, nature will hurt you back
Nature magic has its limits

name: Myth Power: Siren's Song
description: The Sirens were known in Greek Myth as beautiful sea nymphs whose song lured many sailors to their death, crashing on the rocks of their island home. Channeling them gifts you with the same seductive power. You can entrance others of the opposite sex with your voice, and it has more than one effect. If you are up close, the subject will follow any command given. If you are far away, the subject will try to reach you at all costs to follow your orders. You can also communicate with/command birds.
summary: The ability to channel the deadly seductive powers of the Sirens
strengths: Entrance subjects of the opposite sex with an otherworldly singing voice
If they hear your voice close-up, they follow any command issued (whether you sing it or not)
If far away, your voice lures them to you (by safest or most dangerous route possible; you choose)
weaknesses: People with MythPower: Aphrodisia or MythPower: Arrows of Eros are immune to this ability
People with MythPower: Muse Influence are immune to this ability
You can also communicate with, control and share the senses of birds (may make you seem wimpy)

name: Ability Skill: Mimicry Wisdom
description: Let's say the user, a Fire Mimic, has this Ability Skill. Once they mimic the fire, they will gain the wisdom of this element. They will know how to use it, to actually think like it. That goes to all different types of mimicry-based powers--electricity, sound, etc.
summary: The ability to gain innate intelligence, to those with mimicry powers, of the thing being mimicked.
strengths: Know how to use the thing you mimicked.
No need to practice.
weaknesses: Must be a mimicry-based powers.

name: Napalm Dominance
description: This power allows the user to create and freely control high-grade napalm, a gelatin substance that not only persistently adheres to surfaces it comes in contact with, but that burns with such an intense heat that being anywhere within several hundred feet of a source of napalm can cause third degree burns. Larger quantities of napalm can cause the air temperature to dramatically spike, causing water to boil rapidly and burning skin and muscle with 2,200 degree Fahrenheit winds and flames.
summary: The ability to create and manipulate military-grade napalm.
strengths: It's great for mass combat; the intense heat drives away most low to mid level baddies.
It's absolutely wonderful to be paired up with any wind-oriented powers (except for vacuum control).
The intensity of heat makes it useful even in small quantities and vs. Water/ice powers.
weaknesses: You're human, too, so you better be wearing some anti-thermal gear or something.
It's an indiscriminate power; watch out for civilians and allies.
Be careful of potential collateral damage, like buildings catching fire.

name: Frost Shell
description: A frozen shell is created two inches above and around any object of your choosing. The shell is light blue and can allow a small amount of light to pass through or none at all as well as air to breathe. The shell keeps strong amounts of energy from passing through so that it keeps power out or power trapped inside. It is near impossible to break the shell through non-physical means but can be shattered from a strong physical hit. Only lasts while caster is around. Shell is not fixed to one spot.
summary: The ability to create a frozen area around a object that prevents energy exchange.
strengths: Can be used as a defensive barrier.
Or as a prison for energy.
Takes little effort to make.
weaknesses: Can be broken physically.
Manipulated by cold-related powers.
May not put shell up until after the energy hits you and then you trap the energy inside with you.

name: Ultimate Comeback
description: This power is perfect when you're getting burned constantly and can't figure out a good comeback in time. Now you can! Someone hurting your feelings, then absolutely destroy them mentally with the ultimate comeback when they feebly try to tell you off. However, this only works on after burns, it doesn't help with physical bulllying. And the ultimate comeback works automatically.
summary: The ability to create the ultimate comeback to any burn instantly
strengths: Ultimate comeback to any burn
Possibly blow someone's mind out of their head
weaknesses: Only works on burns
Happens automatically

name: Magma Mimicry
description: This power combines rock & fire mimicry. The Thing & Human Torch fused together. Your body will convert itself into burning lava creating obsidian body armor. You'll have increased strength & durability. You can secrete & spew lava & make volcanic blasts. The negative side to this power is your speed is slow & water can harden you till your frozen solid.
summary: The ability to become living molten rock
strengths: Increased Strength
Molten lava powers
weaknesses: Hindered speed
Water equals enemy
Burn everything you touch

name: Twisted Liquid Reflection
description: This power gives you full control over what is reflected on the surface of any liquid. You can even make moving objects, or as if there was not even any liquid at all. To use it, you must touch the liquid while imagining an image or a scene and it will appear on the surface as if it was a movie or a picture.
summary: The ability to change what someone sees on the surface of a liquid to whatever you imagine.
strengths: You can hide people/items beneath the surface of lakes or pools.
Or you can make sure no one takes water from your secret oasis.
This ability works on any liquid. Just to be clear, pudding is not a liquid.
weaknesses: You can only change the parts of the liquid you can see.

name: Myth Power: Ocean/Tethys Power
description: Ocean (Oceanos, Oceanus, Ogenos) in Greek myth, was the Titan god of ocean's expanses; his wife Tethys was the Titan goddess of freshwater, as a source of nourishment. As such, channeling Ocean, one can perceive and manipulate water, turn into a form composed of water, and project one's sight to anywhere submerged in water. Channeling Tethys, one can perceive, communicate with and share the senses of any being submerged in water (not just aquatic species), and generate drinkable water at will.
summary: The ability to channel Ocean and Tethys' command over the essence of freshwater and the ocean
strengths: Perceive, manipulate, and mimic water at will (in water form, breathe underwater
Project your sight to anywhere submerged in water; generate potable water at will
Perceive, communicate with and share senses with any creature submerged in water (even non-aquatics)
weaknesses: Cannot become physically stronger underwater until the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot become invisible underwater until the higher levels (NCN)
Aquatic/water/sea/ocean-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Transforming Dragon Master #2
description: As Master of Martial Arts, styles & ways you are gifted with the ability to transform into forms of base elements through fighting styles. Earth, wind, fire & water. Continuous movement in a style grants more bodily changes. Fight long enough & you morph into a full form of an element, able to use incredible durability, endurance & strength. You could even lend your powers to others if you are fighting in tandem. You innately know each fight style when you begin practice or battle.
summary: The ability to transform yourself into many forms of elements through martial arts
strengths: Transform into any form of fire for burning offense
Transform into any form of earth or water for defense
Mix elements to form fighting clay, lava, dust storm, geysers, hail etc.
weaknesses: Complete devotion to movements & absolute focus is needed to maintain element fighting forms
You cannot force your element form, each style dictates what form you must take
You can lend your powers only to people who can mimic the fighting style (preferably another master)

name: Weather Fusion
description: This ability allows the user to fuse with any weather condition. When the person is fused, they are the weather and can control it. For example, being rainy lets them control all the rain drops like bullets and attacking the rain does nothing, being sunny lets them control the heat, etc. However, the limit is the time the weather condition is active. If the user does not unfuse before the weather condition ends, they will forever be stuck as that weather condition.
summary: The ability to fuse with the weather
strengths: You are invincible as long as it is the same type of weather
You can control the weather to attack
You can create a pattern that looks like you, similar to a mirage to speak
weaknesses: You must unfuse before the weather ends every time you use this or you will be stuck as the weather
If you are stuck, you will be "immortal" but you can only appear if the same weather occurs again
You cannot activate any other powers when you are the weather

name: Walls Of Jericho
description: It is designed to block and trap foes that are in contact with the barriers. They can be stunned, or even zapped if they run into it. It is also intended to stop the spread of zombies, werewolves and vampires, and instantly absorb projectiles.
summary: The ability to create barriers that can absorb projectiles and can hurt and trap opponents that run into it.
strengths: Nothing can stop it, except magic.
weaknesses: Only those with light or dark magic can destroy the walls.

name: Brush Of Truepaint
description: The Brush Of Truepaint is a brush that allows you to create a portal on a canvas that lets you go inside. Once inside, you can imagine something and the brush will auto-paint it for you. This also works on creatures. Everything in the painting is real and real time...The trees will move, wind will blow, creatures will move... When you paint the portal back out, the canvas will contain the things you painted.
summary: The ability to make portals into paintings and paint
strengths: A safe haven for easy hidden escape that no one would think to look
Painting appears normal from the outside, nobody can see the brush
Can create things in the canvas world, like toys and animals to play with
weaknesses: If someone destroys the painting, then you are stuck till you paint the scene on another canvas
Could get cluttered if you don't realize how much your painting
Painted items could turn against you.

name: Dead Eye
description: With this power your irises become gun-barrels and you eye-lids become a trigger. All you must do is look at someone and blink and they will appear to be shot. Your eyes fire no bullet and makes no sound, but the victims wound will be that of a high caliber handgun such as a magnum.
summary: The ability to shoot people by blinking at them.
strengths: Carry a weapon with you everywhere.
Shoot anyone stealthyly.
weaknesses: May cause the act of blinking to become very uncomfortabe.
Looking at things doubly so.

name: Fire Sight
description: The user of this power can use fires as their 'eyes'. They can see what is happening around the fire as if they were in the spot they are looking from. The limit is that the fire must be less than 1 kilometre from their body in order to see out of the fire.
summary: The ability to see out of fires
strengths: Hunting a fireuser? This power is perfect!
weaknesses: 1 kilometre isn't that large of an area. 3 to 10 minutes to run that distance.

name: Rainbow Slide
description: With this ability, you generate a rainbow-like projection that you can travel on, much like the Marvel Comics character Iceman's ice slides. You slide along it as you generate it. It is fast travel. Some particularly powerful individuals use this ability to transverse intergalactic distances (Up to hyperspatial speeds), although most users just move around the city or country side (100+ mph).
summary: The ability to generate a rainbow that you can travel on
strengths: Fast travel
weaknesses: Brightly colored, it is not a stealthy means of tranportation

name: Dwarf Planet Empowerment
description: The person with this power is able to gain powers by shouting the name of the dwarf planets in our solar system. For example, if you shout out Ceres you get to control plants and communicate with them, Pluto (control over ice), Orcus( phasing), Haumea (geokinesis), Quaoar ( energy construct), Makemake (lava-kinesis), Eris ( illusion), Sedna (hydrokinesis).
summary: The ability to be empowered by the dwarf planets in our solar system
strengths: Different powers to counter different situations
Good arsenal to take down enemies
weaknesses: Powers are not that strong compared to planet empowerment

name: Cyrolance
description: With this lance you have the power to freeze all most anything apon striking contact,split it into small forms of ice spears and reform it back,and with enough training create snow storms.
summary: The ability to use it to manipulate ice
strengths: Freeze your enemies with a single strike
Control small ice spears
Create snow storms
weaknesses: Poeple with fire manipulation
Takes a lot of training to make snow storms

name: Avatar Summon
description: (If you like the avatar the last air bender series than this power is for you) with this power you can  Summon forty-six characters from the series. You can only summon one character at a time saw choose wisely. Know your history
summary: The ability to summon any character that is in the avatar the last air bender series
strengths: You have forty sixe characters to choose from
Some of the girls might like you
They will help you and protect you
weaknesses: Some of the characters will try to kill you
Teams and armies are very hard to summon
Can only summon one character at a time saw choose wisely
tags: avatar the last air bender series

name: Rock Portation
description: A person with this power does not have control over rocks but they do have the ability to control the position of any rock within a certain range. This includes being able to teleport concrete. The user can even create constructs by displacing rocks in a certain shape. In addition if skilled you can even teleport rocks into the same position repeatedly at fast speeds to suspend it in air.
summary: The ability to apport or teleport any type of rock or concrete within your vicinity
strengths: Obvious uses include raining rocks or creating instant holes or breaking building supports
Can displace rocks in a specific shape thus creating rock constructs
Can teleport rocks repeatedly to the same location to create staircases
weaknesses: If you are not careful you might hit yourself--dangerous for first time users
Unless you have other powers or equipment you are still limited by human reflexes etc.

name: Wind Up Key
description: This power allows you to place a wind up key, like those used on clockwork toys, onto anything and anyone. You can then turn the key to "wind up" whatever you placed it on. Anything wound up by the key takes some action of springs into motion. For example, a person will continue the same sequence of actions they were when you first started turning the key, a car would roll forward, a door would swing open and shut. You can even keep someones heart beating by sticking the key in their chest.
summary: The ability to place a clockwork wind up key on anything.
strengths: You can mke anything move, but only in the way it is suposed to.
Any living thing become paralyzed from the moment you start turning the key.
In addition, they will keep performing their "sequence" until they run out of "power"
weaknesses: How long the effects of the key last depends on how long you "wound" what you put the key in.
Once a living thing runs out of "power" (genrated by you winding the key) they are free.
You will have to wind the key again once it runs out of "power. "

name: Arceusforce: Flame
description: The user of this ability can channel the burning anger of the Pokegod, Arceus, taking the form of its Fire-type. The user's skin turns orange and their irises turn yellow. Under their fiery guise, the user has the resistances, weaknesses and immunities of a Fire-type Pokemon, translated to real world equivalents. They are also able to channel and manipulate many Fire attacks such as Flamethrower, Fire Spin, Fire Blast, Overheat and more.
summary: The ability to channel the power of Arceus's Fire form.
strengths: The user is resistant to insect, plant, ice, metal, fairy magic and other fire-based attacks.
Generation and manipulation of fire to perform different attacks.
weaknesses: The user is weak to water and earth-based attacks in fire form.
This power may be too powerful for the user. This form may have to be unlocked from default form.

name: Gun Of Stonehenge
description: This gun looks like the Thompson submachine gun nineteen twenty eight. This gun is made from chromoly steel. The bullets are made from stellite. This gun can turn your victims into stone.
summary: The ability to possess a gun that can torn living things into stone
strengths: Turn your victims into stone
You are Al Capone with a stronger gun
weaknesses: Turning people into stone is a bad idea
The mafia will kill you for this gun
People will steal this gun

name: Guardian Force
description: You can transform into any of the Guardian Forces from Final Fantasy VIII and use their individual powers when in their form. For example, as Ifrit you can command flame and fire, but you are also weak to Ice powers.  As Bahamut you can fly at high speeds, or as Cactuar you can sink into the sands. Eden means you can only exist outside the Earth in her form. You can only remain in the Guardian Force form for a certain period of time , then you must regain your energy.
summary: The ability to morph into any of the guardian forces from Final Fantasy VIII and use their individual powers at will.
strengths: Become a powerful guardian force, and use their powers.
As one of the Brothers you can regenerate as long as your feet are connected to the Earth.
Can also be the "non-junctionable" GFs like Odin, Phoenix, and Chubby Chocobo
weaknesses: When in guardian force form you also take on their weaknesses or limitations.
As the most powerful guardian force Eden it forces you to be placed into outer space.
Time as Guardian Forces is limited, and time before you can transform again takes a while.

name: Sand Conversion
description: Similar to the superhuman power Glaciation, this is the power to psychically transmute matter into sand. One with this ability may do it by touch, look or just mental power (depending on the user's genetics). It affects the subject in the same way one is affected by the power Petrifaction, but, instead of stone, the subject turns into sand. In addition, if a subject is turned into sand, they can *sometimes* be returned to normal at will, as long as the sand doesn't get blown away.
summary: The ability to turn matter into sand
strengths: If you feel threatened, then any incoming impact automatically turn into sand (bullets, knives, etc)
May be accompanied by the ability to assume a form composed of sand (or the power to control sand)
User is often able to affect living and inanimate matter
weaknesses: You can't return a person to normal if they got blown away
Sometimes only affects living matter (or only non-living matter)
It can also be triggered subconsciously (accidental sand conversion)

name: Quickfloor
description: With this power, you can turn the floor into a deadly trap. An affected area remains somewhat solid and looks normal until something with a mass stands on it, at which point the ground suddenly liquefies. Even the user can't tell the difference, so be careful. As real quicksands, it takes a lot of effort to extract oneself out of it, and the more someone struggles, the more they will sink. The worst thing is the quickfloor is bottomless, though it's limited by the depth of the floor.
summary: The ability to give an area of ground the properties of quicksand.
strengths: A very effective booby-trap as noone should be able to see the difference with normal ground.
Even if someone doesn't sink entirely, they are completely exposed.
If the floor is not deep, someone who is trapped can fall all the way through the floor.
weaknesses: You could fall into your own trap. So be careful.
If you're dealing with flying enemies or someone who knows how to react in this kind of situation.

name: Touch Of Death
description: With this ability, you can cause any organism to suddenly die by touching it. This includes all carbon-based organisms, such as the organisms here on Earth, and even viruses. Of course, you have full control over this ability, meaning you can't accidentally kill something or someone. No pain is inflicted, nor is there any symptom before death--the organism just ceases to live. Just in case, you have a 10 second window in which you can reverse the death, but touch is still required.
summary: The ability to cause the sudden death of any living organism at will.
strengths: Self defense in extreme situations
Killing off harmful viruses in your body (or others')
I suppose this would be useful if you were a butcher
weaknesses: If your powers were known, people would fear you
Touch is required to use the ability

name: Power Bypass
description: With this ability, one can bypass any protective measures of a foe, but only one power at a time. For instance, you can use it to burn someone with Fireproof Body. There is no defense against this power, except for getting multiple lines of defense. Unfortunately, you are still doomed if your enemy has a lot of offensive powers.
summary: The ability to bypass the protective measures of one power.
strengths: Block a power -protection power.
Sick of a nearly impenetrable defense? Bypass it!
No direct defense against it.
weaknesses: Can only bypass one power at a time.
Your foe may have multiple lines of defense.
This does not help if your enemy has lots of offensive powers.

name: Air Liquefaction Manipulation
description: When you have this ability, you can swim in the sky. To make it faster, make a current, and you will be able to control it to take you anywhere you want to go. Even better, you can make the air so thick, that you can drown people with it.
summary: The ability to give air some traits of liquid and control it.
strengths: You can be in the air.
Good for air fights.
The air can still be breathable.
weaknesses: You'll have to be a fast swimmer, if you are not using the currents.
Anything within the ability's range will slow down like in water.

name: Ice Fyre
description: You are able to create fire, block fire, and manipulate fire that is the color of silver, freezing anything until it is a pile of dust. Only very experienced Fyre Wizards can do this.
summary: The ability to manipulate and create fire that burns like ice.
strengths: Sater Stiger. The famous alchemist
Tellito Anth, Successful pyromancer
Kayan Garsstant, Princess of Icefyre
weaknesses: Nill
Nill
Nill

name: Asphyxiation
description: Also called Suffocation, this is the ability to choke foes, by keeping them from getting air. With this ability, the user inhales deeply, which takes breath out of the OPEN air, but also out of a foe's LUNGS. Not only is the user depriving this foe of breath, but after he inhales, his mind subconsciously connects with the foe's mind, compelling him to not INHALE again. The foe then suffocates unless the user relinquishes the compulsion.
summary: The ability to literally take foes' breath away
strengths: Suck the breath out of others (if you need air, or you're fighting an opponent, etc. )
Compels subject not to inhale again after his air is stolen (user can relinquish this at will)
Works on ANY breatheable air (within plants, animals, taken from water--don't drown--, etc. )
weaknesses: Doesn't affect foes with Lung Adaptation
Doesn't affect foes who don't breathe the same as you (alien species that breathe carbon)
If you can't control it (it activates all the time, or you can't undo the compulsion)

name: World Record Reproduction
description: With this power, you can do anything that has been recorded as a world record. You can run as fast as the world record states and lift as much as the world record. All world records must be either published or well known and the user must know them to activate them. You can grow taller or shorter. The user can also recreate any world record outside physical feats such as weather conditions and temperature.   You can only use one record at a time and must finish it before accessing another.
summary: The ability to reproduce any world record at will
strengths: You are as good as people are recorded
You can access a lot of limited versions of abilities.
This power does not put a toll on your body until after the world record-running will tire you
weaknesses: You can only be as good as the published world record
You must follow the record-you cannot do more or less than the record-you have to only go super fast
You cannot stop until the copied record is finished-you must run 40 meters

name: Flaming Bow And Arrows
description: The bow and arrow are made of pure fire. You are immune to the fire and you never run out of arrows. Now, some of you may ask, "How does an arrow of pure fire hit something?" or "How do you hold an object of pure fire?" My response to that is that it just does and you just can.
summary: The ability to shoot arrows of pure fire
strengths: Awesome
Easy
Long-range and flashy
weaknesses: Dangerous
Must be careful waving around flaming bow

name: Sonic Howl
description: This is the remarkable, but strange power to possess a metagene that gives out a prolonged potent howling sonic attack, it can last from 0. 50 to 60 minutes, absorbing the sound waves around you and sending them back with concussive force by howling, and can cause an incredible amount of damage to non-living targets, and a remarkable amount of damage to living targets, stuns people in an entire area.
summary: The ability to utter a loud, protracted, concussive sound or cry to damage and stun foes or objects.
strengths: Can even induce sleep.
weaknesses: Only if you are a werewolf or a hybrid you can use it.

name: Solar Arm Cannon
description: Your right arm turns into a cannon that fire solar energy. Anything caught in the blast is burned or turned to ashes.
summary: The ability to have a cannon arm that runs on solar energy
strengths: Arm cannon is indestructible
Fires solar energy like a beam
burns things
weaknesses: Runs on solar energy

name: End Of The Line
description: Everything that exists today, living and non-living, will one day cease to be. This power allows you to know when and how an object will end its life just by touching it. Some examples: for a table, this would be when it ceases to be a table (eg. it is irreparably broken or burned), for a car, this could be a crash, but for a living creature this would be it's death. When an object ceases to be what it is at the moment (a shoe, a couch, a living being) - that's what you'll see.
summary: The ability to foreknow how any object will end its life just by touching it.
strengths: Know in advance when catastrophes are going to occur.
Have some knowledge of future events, allowing you to plan accordingly.
weaknesses: Cannot be switched off; every human touch will become horrific.
The event is inevitable, but you may be able to save people involved (eg. a bridge collapse).
Buying a new car would be quite a scary experience...

name: Water Nymph
description: You just become a water nymph which is similar to a mermaid but not quite. A water nymph doe not have a tail like a mermaid does; therefore this is more common.
summary: The ability to be a water nymph and control water
strengths: You only have webbed toes (less conspicuous)
You can control water
You can breathe and talk underwater
weaknesses: You can't control it for the first few weeks

name: Gift: Weather.
description: Basically, someone with this power is better at controlling the weather than other beings. Thus their weather-based powers are stronger than most other being's powers and it is harder to take control of the weather from them. However, someone with this power can only receive weather-based powers, nothing else.
summary: The ability to be gifted at the control of the weather
strengths: Almost no one has as good control over the weather as someone with this power.
Weather-based powers are boosted slightly.
weaknesses: Can only have one gift.
Two beings with the same gift will cancel out the control aspect.
Pretty much restricted to only weather-based powers now.

name: Celtic Invocation: Brigid
description: An invoker of this power has power of the three types of flame: the flame of inspiration, the flame of health, and the flame of crafting. By channelling the flame of inspiration, the invoker may inspire artists around them, to create fantastic arts. By channelling the flame of health, the invoker may burn out disease and infection from people's bodies, as well as increase the targets healing factor. By channelling the flame of crafting, the invoker may increase and control normal fire and heat.
summary: The ability to invoke to power of Brigid, the Irish goddess of the three flames.
strengths: The flame of inspiration makes you many friends among the artistic types.
The flame of health ensures that you will never fall sick, cold, or become injured for too long.
The flame of crafting makes sure that all flames will do as what you want.
weaknesses: Too much use of the flame of inspiration will drive the targets insane.
The flame of health does not instantly heal flesh wounds -- it only increases the healing rate.
The flame of crafting can not create flame from nothing. It can only control already existing fire.

name: Miracle: Water Walk
description: With this abiliy you can "walk" on water like a water strider by increasing the surface tension of the water. You can apply this to other fluids besides water as well.
summary: The ability to increase the power of surface tension
strengths: Walk on water
Prevent spills by making the water stick together in one glob which you can then pick up
Water bed
weaknesses: You must have great control in order to do this
You can't control the water only increase its tension

name: Universal Solvent
description: The first thing most people think about when hearing the term alchemy is the so called "Philosopher's Stone", but a lesser known substance sought by alchemists was something called alkahest-a substance that can dissolve anything. A person with this power can create alkahest and use it to dissolve anything they want. Also they control the alkahest so they don't need a container. Once made alkahest will absorb anything and everything that it comes in contact. Alkahest cannot become saturated.
summary: The ability to create and control alkahest
strengths: Alkahest dissolves anything-- even photons or energy
You can undissolve elements from the alkahest--great for stealing gold, silver, etc.
You can control it so you don't need a container
weaknesses: If it gets on you and you don't know how to control it
Once you make some you can't contain it unless you have a vacuum
You need to have control in order selectively dissolve things such as poison from your blood

name: Lava Secretion
description: Lava secretion lets you spew lava from your hands as a projectile. Not much else to say about that.
summary: The ability to fire volcanic lava from your hands
strengths: Doesn't harm you when power is used
Causes a painful melting death for your enemies
weaknesses: You might surround yourself with lava accidently
Once the lava is there, it stays there
Causes massive fires.

name: Kolasi Generation
description: This power allows you generate the flames of kolasi, the flames of hell, damnation, and inferno. By using this ability, these flames are not ordinary; they do not extinguish easily. They are also way more intense than normal flames. If something is even capable of extinguishing these flames, it leaves behind nothing, not even ashes.
summary: The ability to generate the flames of hell.
strengths: Powerful fire.
weaknesses: If it gets out of control...

name: Siri Mind Link
description: Once a person gains this power a "helper voice" similar to the Iphone's Siri will activate inside your brain. The voice can help you with all sorts of things it can give you directions, record things, predict the weather for you and it is hooked up to the internet so you can ask it to search something for you and it will tell you what it finds. You can name the voice whatever you want and make it sound like whatever you want. To activate the voice you simply say it's name then ask it something.
summary: The ability to have a helper voice similar to Siri in your brain
strengths: You have a helper mind voice
weaknesses: If you forget what you named it you're screwed

name: Disk Generating
description: With this superpower you can create anything out of thin air. But it has to be flat and circular; approximately disk shaped.
summary: The ability to create anything as long as it's round and flat
strengths: Cookies! Pizza! Frisbees! You could throw the perfect picnic
Circular saw blades could be used as weapons
Psh, COOKIES!
weaknesses: Must be round and flat

name: Water Purification
description: Oceans, seas, lakes, rivers, swamps, and ponds: the user can purify all of these waters. Approximately 75% of earth is water, but only 2% of that water is clean. With this power, all of the planet's water can be cleaner than clean.
summary: The ability to purify bodies of water
strengths: Clean water
weaknesses: Kinda sucks

name: Ability Skill: Ripple Sense
description: This provides support for water user. It adds a kind of sensor to your water abilities that allow you to sense vibrations, sounds or movements in water and, to some extent, air.
summary: The ability to sense vibrations, sounds or movements if one has water-based abilities.
strengths: Helpful in hunting and tracking.
Good detection system.
weaknesses: Must have a water- or liquid-based ability.

name: Frost Breath
description: You can breathe out frost at will.  Using this ability allows you to breathe frosty air on enemies, freeze stuff or you can just have fun!!
summary: The ability to breathe out frost
strengths: No need for a freezer
weaknesses: May accidentily freeze friends

name: Think Cold
description: With this power you can cause frost bite just by thinking of the desired person having frost bite
summary: The ability to cause frost bite with your mind
strengths: Can give enemies who are holding weapons frost bite so that they'll drop their weapons
weaknesses: The frost bite wears off after a couple of hours

name: Maelstrom
description: A maelstrom is a large and powerful whirlpool of tremendous destruction. It's basically a tornado but in the water that is in swift, circular motion creating a downward spiral. This ability you just focus your mind on the sea and maelstrom's occur.
summary: The ability to create violent whirlpool's of mass destruction
strengths: Power has very high destructive capabilities.
weaknesses: Rely on vast amounts of water (sea) for power to work.

name: Cold Point
description: Unlikely you can create a spear of ice out of thin air, but only when it's below zero or in cold areas you might be able to throw an an ice spear to damage and freeze your enemies even if it kills them.
summary: The ability to shoot out a icy harpoon to damage, impale and freeze your opponent.
strengths: You might be able to break through concrete blocks with this power.
weaknesses: You can only use this ability when it's zero below.

name: Weakness Pool Manifestation
description: When activated, every being or object will appear to you with a swirling pool of energy near them. This pool is a representation of all their weaknesses, even the unsuspected and less obvious ones, like a need for food or air, an attachment to a loved one, or a past trauma. Only you can see it and only your attacks can affect it. Any damage dealt to the pool will be reflected on their owner and any type of attack will work. Basically, that pool now becomes their most obvious weakness to target.
summary: The ability to create a manifestation of all your enemy's weaknesses which you can attack to deal damage.
strengths: Even attacks which shouldn't affect them will work. You can strike the pool of an intangible being.
Even those who claim to be invincible can have a weakness, not just a magical or a physical one.
Only you can see the pool. So, it will be difficult for your enemy to defend it without seeing it.
weaknesses: The weakness pool can be difficult to target.
One with very few weaknesses will have a very small pool. One without weakness won't even have one.
One who is changing or shifting their weakness will either have a fast moving pool or a fading one.

name: Piece Of Eden: The Sword
description: The sword can cut just about anything as long as it's solid (so it can't cut air or water or anything like that). It also gives the user knowledge of battle skills and strategies.
summary: The ability to use a sword that can cut anything solid.
strengths: Can cut anything (bullets, rock, metal).
Knowledge of battle.
weaknesses: Can be destroyed and causes a HUGE explosion if it is.
Enemies can use it.

name: Crimson Tornado
description: The person with this power use to be a person but due to a freak accident , he or she is now disembodied crimson tornado that floats around. However, a robot body was created to house the now disembodied tornado. Through this robot body , they are able to generate tornado using their new forms. The power of the tornados can be boosted by using certain equipments attached on the robot's body. The person with this power, cannot control any other winds but his or her own tornado
summary: The ability to create crimson colored tornados
strengths: Tornado can be used for transport
Tornado can be used to attack enemies
Good against other aerokinesis user
weaknesses: Robot body can destroyed if it has taken a lot of damage
Can only control your own tornados
Can be deactivated if hit with a strong enough electrokinesis user

name: Wood Control
description: you can control different sizes of wood - trees, paper etc to use as shields, battering rams, whatever you can think to use wood for. the wood your controling can be shattered with enough blunt force, frozen, set on fire
summary: The ability to control wood with your mind
strengths: theres a lot of wood around
can use it to help the rainforest
paper airplane army
weaknesses: control can be broken
possible to get cut off from wood

name: Spell Singer
description: The SpellSinger ability is an odd one. All you have to do is sing. However things might not always be like you want them to be: if you sing about about a boat to take you across the ocean, you can risk to summon a water dragon, or a whale. You will always get help, just dont expect that if you sing about knives that its a knife you are gonna get, it might as well be flint that is as sharp as a knife.
summary: The ability to summon any kind of help by singing.
strengths: You can use the power everywhere.
You don't need to prepare to use the power.
You will always be amazed or amused with what the power brings you.
weaknesses: Hard to use power if one has a soar througt,
Crappy power if you are a mute.
As you never know what you might get, there is really no way of preparing yourself.

name: Cloud Generation
description: A person with this power has the ability to convert water in the atmosphere into clouds. They can even create clouds at street level as long as there is water in the air. The clouds are controllable through practice and it is possible to create air gaps within the clouds. A master would know how to create any type of cloud, be it a peaceful white cloud to a dark stormy raincloud. However, the user is limited by the fact that they don't have full control of the clouds once released.
summary: The ability to create clouds out of water from the atmosphere
strengths: Clouds can become an excellent smokescreen at street level
Can learn how to make different types of clouds
Can make structures using clouds
weaknesses: If you are evil you can block out the sun by creating endless supplies of clouds
Can't control clouds after creating them
White puffy clouds don't look threatening

name: Legendary Tailoring
description: With this power you are the greatest tailor to have ever lived, able to create the most stylish and well made clothing of all time. This power also allows you to weave impossibilities into the cloths you make. Pockets that are bigger on the inside, a living scarf that obeys your every command,and a jacket that shrug of a LAW rocket are just a few of the fantastic items you can sew yourself.
summary: The ability to create impossible and fashionable clothing.
strengths: Weave superpowers into the very fabrics of your creations.
Make money selling your clothes.
Always look good.
weaknesses: You have no power without your super clothing.
You must make each piece personally for the power to work. No mass production.
Likely be sought after by people of ill repute, who wish to put your power to work for themselvs.

name: Inferno Hurricane
description: A huge hurricane of fire 1 mile in diameter. The rain is lava. The wind is 1,140 degrees farenheit.
summary: The ability to create a huge hurricane made of fire
strengths: You are totally invulnerable during hurricane.
With this superpower, you are imunne to fire and heat.
weaknesses: Hurricane lasts five minutes.
You become physically drained and exhausted afterwards

name: Human Lightning Rod
description: Your body provides the electricity with a path of least resistance to the ground. So, if electricity is travelling through the air in your vicinity, your body will 'attract' it and disperse it into the ground. If you touch a conductor with electricity flowing through it, it will discharge into your body and into the ground. It works as long as you are in contact with the ground or a body of water.
summary: The ability to harmlessly channel electricity to the ground through your body.
strengths: You can divert the flow of electricity and neutralize it.
You can protect yourself and others from electrocution, lightning and electricity-based abilities.
You can safely stick your fingers or a fork inside an electrical outlet.
weaknesses: Lightning will take the most direct path to strike you, possibly damaging things along the way.
You will be hit by lightning a lot! There goes your hairdo.
You need to be touching the ground or a body of water to use this power.

name: Day/Night Control
description: You decide when day comes! You decide when night plagues the city! Its all in your control! You can also control sunsets and sunrises and what colours they will contain and you'll be able to control how much of the moon everyone in your city see's. this is basically controlling the rotation of the earth.
summary: The ability to control both day and night
strengths: Create amazing sunsets to stun your friends!
Dont want to go to bed yet? Just extend day time!
Drag the morning on if you want to sleep in!
weaknesses: If you make it night time all the time, vampires will love you but all the plants will die.

name: Enhancement: Double
description: This power is a support and useless on its own. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached it doubles the effects of the power. E.g. double fireball - fire two fireballs simultaneously or fire a fireball twice the size or intensity as normal. If someone tries to steal this power it doubles the effect to the attached power and gives this power to the ability thief.
summary: The ability to double the effects of a power by attaching this power to it
strengths: Double the effect of a power!!
Could if used enough double the number of uses or triple instead.
You still have this power if it is 'stolen'.
weaknesses: Useful only if you have another power.
Can only be used for one power at a time - takes time to switch
The power might be useless doubled or more trouble.

name: Angered Spontaneous Combustion
description: This is not exactly the best power to have when in a small room full of people. This ability is completely painless to its user; he/she will survive the full blast of the combustion because the user regenerates after the blast. The angrier the user is, the bigger the explosion and flare.
summary: The ability to suddenly catch on fire and explode if the user's angry enough.
strengths: Awesome party trick.
If it's cold, just get mad.
weaknesses: Live alone so you don't get angry around people.
Cannot be held back or controlled.

name: Air Car
description: With this power, you can drive a car like you normally would, except the car isn't there. You can "drive" (float/hover/levitate) anywhere a car could fit. This is done by a combination of Mimesis and Telekinesis. It'll make the same sounds, but doesn't require fuel.
summary: The ability to drive an imperceptible car.
strengths: Free car
No expenses
weaknesses: Safety is an issue, as nothing protects you
Can't go too fast without protection

name: Myth Power: Anchiale's Anchor
description: Anchiale (Ankhiale), in Greek myth, was the goddess of the warming heat of fire. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically generate and manipulate heat, at will. In addition, one can psychically absorb ambient heat, to gain physical power (and sustenance), at will. Furthermore, one can psychically teleport through any body of fire, or fire-starting heat, at will. One can also withstand intense heat/cold. One can withstand even psychically turn into an entity of thermal energy, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Anchiale's command over the essence of the warming heat of fire
strengths: Psychically generate and manipulate heat; gain physical power, sustenance from external heat
Psychically teleport through fire (or fire-starting heat), at will; withstand temperature extremes
Psychically turn into an entity of thermal energy (heat), at will
weaknesses: Cannot psychically absorb 'heat' from passionate emotions (anger, love, etc) until developed (NCN)
Heat Immunity, Heat Absorption, Fireproof Body, Empathic Immunity, etc, provide immunity (NCN)
MythPower: Iapetos' Impetus provides negation (NCN)

name: Elemental Move: Futo
description: The literal translation is wind knife. This is a wind element manpiulation techique which can create any kind of kinfe out air within the palms of your hands witch can be used for hand combat or a throwing object and is strong enugh to cut through rock.
summary: The ability to create any kind of knife out of air
strengths: Very useful in battle
Make any kind of knife with any kind of gas
weaknesses: Need the wind element
Hard to use under water and space

name: Arcana: 5 The Hierophant
description: This ability deals with information and knowledge. It allows you to move knowledge from anywhere and anything into your mind and then into a medium of your choice. You can take information from anything, books, computers, radio waves, even people's memories. 'Take' means you completely remove it from the source. The same rules apply for putting the information in new places. This power has a very large range, it covers several miles.
summary: The ability to transfer any kind of information from and to any medium.
strengths: You can have vast libraries (both literal and otherwise) of information.
You can make people forget things, teach them things they never knew..
You can take songs straight from the Internet into your mind.
weaknesses: You can't decide what information to take, unless you know exactly where it is.
Your mind is not infinite, so you can't hold all the information in your head at once.

name: Sacred Water
description: The power to find safe havens in pools of water. You can stand in water or just have water between you and a foe, and be safe. No one can cross the water you use to stay safe.
summary: The ability to stand in water and keep anyone away from you.
strengths: Awesome way of staying safe
Easy to activate
Easy to hide
weaknesses: Won't work without water
Won't work on water spirits
Won't keep you dry

name: Spontaneous Human Combustion
description: Bored? No problem. Set your neighbours on fire telepathically! With this power, just by thinking about it, you can make anyone suddenly burst into flames. They will continue burning-unless you choose to release them from your power- until there is no longer anything to burn. Because the victim becomes self-oxidizing, water cannot stop the fire. Planning a suicide? Make it one to remember! (My humour has turned quite macabre... )
summary: The ability to cause any human to burst into flames.
strengths: Awesome assassin.
Never go bored again.
Win any fight with non-superpowered people.
weaknesses: May end up killing a lot of people.

name: Third Eye: Control
description: This power is gained by using the long-distance and slow-motion aspects of the Third Eye power equally. The Third Eye power slowly changes into this power. You can fire rainbow blasts from your third eye that you to control every aspect of a person it hits for an hour. This means mental, physical, and superpower aspects. Control can be shaken off by those with strong will. After the hour they are released from your control but changes stay. You can still use the Third Eye powers.
summary: The ability to fire a blast from one's third eye that allows control of a person
strengths: An evolved form of Third Eye.
Can control other beings.
Can still use Third Eye powers
weaknesses: Must have Third Eye power and look at far-off objects and fast-moving ones equally.
Must hit the target and blast is really visible.
Cannot get the other formerly possible powers.

name: Flower Petal Wind
description: The wind will only last for 2 seconds and brings along several flower petals. You can choose what type of flower the petals come from and can control the movement of the petals as much as you want. However, it is exponentially easier to control all the flowers as a group than individually and this power can be used only once every 24 hours. The petals disappear after 1 hour by the way.
summary: The ability to create a gust of wind that brings along razor-sharp flower petals
strengths: Can use for dramatic effect and as an effective attack.
weaknesses: It's much harder to control an individual petal than 1000 petals in a single group.
The number of petals is random each time you use this power.

name: Dictukinesis
description: The ability to manipulate and control alcohol. Some can only turn things into alcohol. Some users are able to increase the amount of alcohol inside a person when they've only inhaled literally a drop of it, making them drunk. And can lower to alchol limit in a certain beverage meaning that you drink more without getting drunk or liver poisoned. If mixed with Pyrokinesis it could be very dangerous against an opponent(s)
summary: The ability to manipulate alcohol with your mind.
strengths: Fun at parties!
Always win drinking contests.
Along with Pyrokinesis, it could be very powerful.
weaknesses: Along with Pyrokinesis, it could be very destructive.
You might be sent to rehabilitation for all that alcohol.
Alcohol doesn't nourish you at all.

name: 1000 Exploding Fireballs
description: You can create fireballs that explode upon impact in groups of 1000. You can adjust the power of the explosion by changing the density of the fireball. The denser the fireball is the more powerful the explosion, thus a fireball that has its molecules spread out is a lot weaker than a normal one. The heat of the flames cannot be changed.
summary: The ability to create 1000 exploding fireballs
strengths: Can create more even if previous groups aren't fully used.
No concentration required for fireballs to stay after creation.
Can set extremely dangerous traps for intruders or enemies.
weaknesses: Must create them in sets of 1000.
Harder to create denser fireballs for more damaging explosions.
No immunity to fire or explosions without another power.

name: Jumping Jack
description: With this ability, you can jump into the air as high as you want without getting hurt on the way down.
summary: The ability to jump as high as you want.
strengths: No apple is too high for you.
Show off your trampoline skills.
weaknesses: There's less oxygen at high altitude.
Ceilings.

name: Negative Transformation
description: Negative Tranformation is the ability to get rid of parts of yourself. With it, you can get rid of your physical form and phase to pass through objects, or get rid of your visible form to be invisible. You can also get rid of your need for something like air, food, or water. It can also get rid of sicknesses in yourself.
summary: The ability to negate parts of yourself.
strengths: It isn't really a specific power, so you can do a whole bunch of things with it
It isn't permanent. I guess that is a good thing
It is pretty much only limited by your imagination
weaknesses: You can only use it on yourself
It isn't permanent. In case you wanted it to be
You cannot add anything to yourself

name: Rainbow Manipulation
description: This power can be used to generate rainbows and manipulate existing rainbows for your own use. This means you can change light different colors, and control colored light to form it into blasts, bolts, barriers, rays and lasers, and even constructs. You can also solidify rainbows and lower them down like a staircase so you can walk on them, form them into colorful fireworks, etc.
summary: The ability to create and manipulate colored light for various purposes
strengths: Generate little rainbows to cross over puddles, rivers, and other things that hinder your movement
Hit foes with colored light, or use it to defend yourself
Stand on rainbows if you want (but only if you can fly)
weaknesses: Less powerful in dimly lit areas; useless in complete darkness; powerless against Light Absorption
Cannot be used to change the color of things
Cannot be used to manipulate white light (only colored light)

name: Myth Power: Underworld Assault2
description: The Underworld, in Greek myth, was composed of three levels. The second was Hades. As such, channeling the realm of Hades, one may summon the large three-headed dog Cerberus at will; he is super-strong, with a flaming bite that can harm even spirits. In addition, one can banish foes to any of the infernal rivers: Lethe (Oblivion) erases memory; Cocytus (Lamentation) dredges up painful memories; Acheron induces sourceless pain; Phlegethon (Flame) burns like fire; Styx is home to hateful harpies.
summary: The ability to channel the hellacious power of the Greek Myth Underworld's second level, Hades
strengths: Summon/command huge three-headed dog Cerberus (superhuman stats; flaming bite harms even spirits)
Banish foes to any of the five underworld rivers to be tortured
Immune to death-based, underworld-based or infernal MythPowers
weaknesses: Cannot free spirits of the dead from Hades (no Con Negation)
People with death/underworld/necromantic based MythPowers are immune to this ability
People with law, order and justice based MythPowers are immune to this ability

name: Weather Empathy
description: We devote most of our morning time to the news, and they devote their time to the weather. A person with Weather Empathy is a extremely accurate weather forecaster. The ability lets them detect major weather systems from miles away, lets them accurately tell and predict temperature, and lets them know how much time there is before the system reaches their location. However, they cannot control the weather. In addition, their predictions get less accurate the farther away in time the event is.
summary: The ability to detect and accurately predict weather phenomena
strengths: Extremely accurate weather forecaster
Able to know how long a system will take to reach them
Able to detect major systems from miles away
weaknesses: Cannot control weather
Accuracy of predictions decrease the farther away in time they are
People bugging you about what the weather will be

name: Doppler Effect
description: One with this ability uses himself as a reference point for the fluctuation of light. He concentrates on a subject he wants to effect, and then a psionic link is established. This link allows the user's proximity to determine a foe's perception of light. As he moves closer to the user, RED light becomes more and more visible, so he is blinded by red light. The FURTHER he moves away from the user, BLUE becomes more and more visible, so he is blinded by blue light.
summary: The ability to cause foes to see fluxes in light based on one's proximity to them
strengths: Overwhelm a foe without even touching them
Your body is a reference point (very close makes blinding red, very distant makes blinding blue)
Blinded by a particular color, they can't see (you can get away, attack them, etc)
weaknesses: Only affects foes that require light to see (no Lightless Vision, blind people, etc. )
If the subject has Protected Sight, he wont be blinded
If the subject can manipulate light, he can stabilize his vision

name: Starships V2
description: With this power you can turn any air vehicle into a starship. The starship is tricked out with tons of alien technology such as teleporters, lasers, turbo thrusters etc. You can turn the starship back when you're done.
summary: The ability to turn air based vehicles into starships
strengths: You can turn any air vehicle into a starship
You know how to operate the starship
weaknesses: You do not know how to operate the air vehicle unless it is a starship

name: Ultimated Dragon Bringer
description: You let out a yell so loud that it is heard all over earth (only by dragons)then every dragon comes to help you. Also there are many types of dragons poison, lightning, fire to help you out in any situtation of dire need. The thing is though you can only let out the yell when it's truly needed.
summary: The ability to summon all dragons on earth
strengths: Many types to help
Can take out large armies
Can deffinetly scare the crud out of enemy
weaknesses: You can't control the dragons
Some dragons still want to fight after battle
Makes your very tired

name: Hydro Bomb
description: This is the most explosive and wettest ability to master. It allows you create and utilize an endless supply of bubbled water balloons for massive damage. Because of the rapid throwing rate, it can overwhelm fire based enemies. You can make a hydro bomb. You can do a lot with the bomb--though note that if you hold a bomb in your hands for too long, it will blow up and splash on you, along with anything else that gets in the way (including your allies).
summary: The ability to throw a ball of water that explodes and splashes the enemy on contact.
strengths: It's extremely effective against fire based enemies.
weaknesses: Never use it on electronics.

name: Stonecutter
description: Also called the sword of siege, Stonecutter is a specialized sword made for one purpose, to be able to cut through stone like a hot knife through butter. It was made to be able to dismantle castle walls with ease. Stonecutter can cut through bricks, earth and stone, but is like any other sword against metal. It is one of the few swords that lacks a severe weakness.
summary: The ability to wield the sword of siege.
strengths: Able to cut through stone, earth , and brick with ease
Well balanced, super sharp sword resistant to most damage
weaknesses: No other special powers
Can't cut through other things with the same ease.

name: Fire At Will
description: Taking heavy fire? Alone on the battle field with tons of enemies surrounding your every move? Forget finding cover, just fire at will. Will will pop up on the battle field and take any and all damage that would be done to you. The enemies can't resist wasting their bullets on him for some reason. Will will re-spawn when ever he dies. It takes about three second with each re-spawn time. He dies about as easy as a charging rhino, so he's got you covered.
summary: The ability to summon a guy named Will and have him be the target of your enemies
strengths: Never get hit by another stray bullet again.
Cannon fodder no more
Take down armies without even getting touched.
weaknesses: Will will start to hate you when you get him killed
Will has no free will; will dive in front of any thing he sees as a bullet (empty shells, etc.)
Three-second respawn time

name: Blade Ankle Wings
description: With this power you can sprout wings from your ankles. These wings enable you to fly like normal wings and you can shoot sharp blades out of them. These blades can cut through almost anything (stone, wood, metal flesh etc. ) and you have an unlimited amount of them.
summary: The ability to sprout wings that shoot sharp blades from your ankles
