strengths: You can sprout wings from your feet
You can fly
You have an unlimited amount of sharp blades that you can shoot from the wings
weaknesses: The blades can;t cut through everything just most things

name: Aerosol Generation
description: With this power, you can generate any substance you want, provided they are in aerosol form. At first it must be from your body, but later can be at range. By default, the aerosols are at the temperature they come from; if emitted from your body they would be body temperature, while they'd be room temperature if emitted from the environment. However, the user may alter the temperature with experience and solids will always be heated to the point of becoming an aerosol.
summary: The ability to generate aerosols in your vicinity.
strengths: Infinite aerosol products.
Add a match and you can make a flamethrower.
Can even make aerosols of supernatural substances such as Normalization Fluid.
weaknesses: Aerosols of, say, titanium may be slightly warmer than they normally are.
Chemically complex substances may change into other substances as an aerosol.
Aerosols cannot be controlled easily; they spread to fill a larger volume.

name: Friendly Power Gifting
description: Have you wanted to make a super team with your friends but don't have a giving ability? Or maybe you have one but are afraid of losing the power yourself. Well look no further. We, here at Sahow Inc. have the Power that will solve your problem.
summary: The ability to give powers you have without losing them.
strengths: You can happily give your friends powers.
You dont have to worry about losing powers when giving them away.
weaknesses: You might not have any GOOD powers.
You might be a selfish jerkface

name: Myth Power: Amphitrite's Amity
description: Amphitrite, in Greek myth, was the goddess of the sighing, moaning sound of the ocean's wind and waves, as well as Queen of the Oceans and Seas. As such, channeling her allows one to swim well, survive underwater and glide on sea winds, which may be shared, by touch. In addition, one can psychically manipulate water at will. Furthermore, one can psychically teleport to any shore or body of water, at will. One can even listen to the sea's rushing winds and waves to gain psychic insight, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Amphitrite's command over the essence of the sighing, moaning wind and waves of the sea
strengths: Swim well, survive underwater and glide on sea winds (may be shared by touch)
Psychically manipulate water at will; psychically teleport to any shore or body of water, at will
Listen to the sea's rushing wind/waves to gain psychic insight on past, present and future, at will
weaknesses: Cannot cast an illusion of rushing sea wind/waves to psychically calm subjects until developed (NCN)
Cannot gain physical power from listening to rushing sea winds/waves until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Poseidon's Prestige provides immunity and allows disruption/negation (NCN)

name: Ability Amplify
description: Powers have limits. Pyrokinetics can only make so much fire, Speedsters can only move so fast. Ability Amplifiers can remove their, and other power's, limits for a short while.
summary: The ability to enhance another person's abilities
strengths: Become a VIP sidekick
Become an important team player
Get to watch some amazing things
weaknesses: Only temporary
May never become real hero
Cannot enhance regular attributes

name: Kunai Thunder
description: You can send out a rope with a tipped kunai at the end. It impales itself into the victim's chest and it shocks them, allowing you to pull them through the air towards you for a free hit while electrocuting them, as well as causing a lot of damage. The move could be upgraded so as to be used as a whip-like weapon to torture your opponents with it.
summary: The ability to fire a steel-tip spear filled with deadly electricity.
strengths: You can toss a spear at the opponent, causing them to explode or reducing them to a pile of ashes.
weaknesses: None.

name: Punctuality
description: The ability to set timers on things and beings with specific conditions. The conditions must be plausible, meaning that it has to be realistic. The length of time for the timer must be realistic as well, and not overly exaggerated. The condition could be that something will or wont happen in a specific amount of time. If the condition isn't met, the thing the timer is attached to will perish in the flames of time. You can't remove your timer once it has been set.
summary: The ability to create timers.
strengths: Create a timer to constrict people's options.
If foes don't follow the conditions they would perish in the flames of time.
Helps you stay in control of a confrontation.
weaknesses: The conditions and time periods must be realistic and unexagerated.
A foe could simply follow the conditions and be perfectly safe.
Unable to remove a timer once its been set, even to save yourself from not meeting the conditions.

name: Ball Listic
description: You could have the ability to tuck into a cannonball, then bundle it into a fireball, an avalanching snowball, surrond yourself in electricity, change into a boulder, or turn into a spiked-metal ball and propel yourself at your opponents. The speed depends on the strength on how you use the move, you would aim your cannonball upwards to an aerial opponent, can hop back, then roll forward in a rainbow arc, and/or can use it to fly all over everywhere.
summary: The ability to bundle your body in any kind of element and launch forward into a ball.
strengths: Can do it Pinball-style with full force.
When you are with a muscle-bound ally, you can perform a Fastball Special.
weaknesses: The ability's one external weakness is a well-timed jab or a projectile.

name: Hellrazor
description: You can sprout out long retractable metallic blades from your arms that are covered in flames and span (at most) to seven feet, can raises the blades up which can slice and destroy most substance, shoot the blades straight forward flying through anything in its path, can attack with a lightning fast slash that are nearly impossible to see.
summary: The ability to let out fire covered blades from your arms.
strengths: Extremely effective against wood/plant and bug-type foes.
weaknesses: Will not work underwater because the flames are put out.
Invulnerability
Metal/Fire Manipulators

name: Myth Power: Proteus' Profession
description: Proteus (Proteos), in Greek myth, was the god of elusive sea-change; the sea's constantly changing nature. As such, channeling him allows one to swim well and survive underwater, which may be shared, by touch. In addition, one can psychically perceive any location in the depths of the sea, at will. Furthermore, one can attune to the sea for psychic insight, at will. One can even take on the consistency of water, at will, allowing one to assume the form of nearly any subject one desires.
summary: The ability to channel Proteus' command over the essence of elusive sea-change
strengths: Swim well and survive underwater (may be shared by touch)
Psychically perceive any location in the sea, at will; attune to the sea for psychic insight
Gain Aqueous Shapeshifting (turn into water, and reform as nearly any living subject at will)
weaknesses: Part 2 of Pro #2, and Pro #3 cannot be shared by touch until developed (NCN)
Pro #3 is limited to subjects of similar size/weight/mass until developed (NCN)
If grappled for thirty seconds, one can be compelled to tell psychic insights, until developed (NCN)

name: Saprokinesis
description: One with this ability can psychically control putrefied matter and any other organic matter that festers with bacteria. This means one can control earwax, mucus, saliva, feces, urine, dead matter, moldy matter, fetid water, stale/polluted air and the like. At the higher levels, the user can even induce such foul conditions, making water bacterial and unsafe, making air (including breath) stifling and smelly, inducing rot and putrefaction in organic matter or even inducing bacterial infections.
summary: The ability to manipulate rot and putrefaction
strengths: Anything foul, rotten or fungal can now be used as a weapon
Controlling it means you can also keep it from touching you
At the higher levels, induce or reverse rot, stagnation, pollution and bacterial infection
weaknesses: Doesn't make the rot, sewage or disgusting/unsanitary/unclean matter smell any better
Can't REVERSE the rot unless the matter is still intact
Can't control dust or normal mud (only nasty, swampy mud)

name: Hyperpower Switch
description: With this ability, you can turn superpowers on or off. You can activate them, deactivate them, then reactivate your superpowers again. Useful for conserving the superpower's energy so it doesn't leak energy while not in use. It also comes with a scroll that you can summon at any time to see which powers are on and which ones are off. It doesn't work on this power because this superpower is always on and runs on the energy from the center of the earth.
summary: The ability to turn your own superpowers on or off.
strengths: Turn your superpowers on or off and conserve their energy.
Comes with a scroll that tells you which powers are activated and deactivated.
This superpower runs on the power of the earth's core.
weaknesses: This superpower is always active.

name: Sparks
description: Some of us have been camping and forgotten matches. I don't know how many of us are able to start fires by rubbing sticks together, but if you have this power, you can turn an ordinary stick into a highly flammable matchlike object - now you just have to find a ragged rock to strike it on.
summary: The ability to make things highly flammable
strengths: Make sticks, rocks, clothes, even people highly flammable!
Since you don't make fire, nobody will know it was you.
weaknesses: You can't make fire, only make things inflammable.
Don't make yourself inflammable, because you'll catch on fire as soon as you scrape something fast.
High speed crashes.

name: Blinding Acid Stare
description: This power is most active when angry. When you're angry but don't want to blind anyone, don't stare in their eyes. Wearing sunglasses makes this power have no effect. People wearing sunglasses are not affected by this power.
summary: The ability to painfuly blind people by staring into their eyes and turning their eye fluids into acid.
strengths: Blind people.
Turn their eye fluids into acid.
Power is most active when you're angry.
weaknesses: This power is not effective when wearing sunglasses.
People wearing sunglasses are not affacted by this power.
Have to stare at their eyes to work.

name: Psychic Tattoos
description: By focusing on a person and picturing the tattoo, you can psychically create a tattoo on someone's skin, which affects their mind in different ways depending on the tattoo design. For example,a tattoo of fire would make them think they were bursting into flames, while tattoos of chains would make them think their arms are bound.
summary: The ability to grant people psychic tattoos which affect their minds
strengths: Can control people's minds with the right tattoo
Can beat people in fights without the chance of accidentally killing them, as all damage is psychic
It is very difficult to block this attack without psychic powers
weaknesses: It is easy for others to tell if you are using your powers, as tattoos are an obvious sign
It takes a few seconds to focus to use this power

name: Fire Seeker
description: You can look into fire and see a hidden message describing what will happen in the future. But it must be a real fire. Not like a fire on T. V., or pictures.
summary: The ability to see hidden messages of the future in fire.
strengths: You can tell what will happen to your best friend in 5 minutes.
You only see the message if you want to (so it's optional).
If you master this power, you might earn the ability to control fire.
weaknesses: If you tell anyone what you've learned about the future, you lose the power.
Make sure you have self-control, because you don't want the fire to spread around.
You must never try to change the future to hurt someone (unless they're a villain).

name: Universal Softener
description: With this power you can make even the hardest diamond as soft as a marshmallow. In practice this can be use to make bullets fired at you no more effective as being hit by very cheap water guns. Softened objects will be able to easily bend and can be shoved into tight containers. They can be effectively rendered as soft pillows. Objects turned soft are more durable than before since they can absorb impacts.
summary: The ability to make anything super soft
strengths: Make your belongings soft so you can pack things faster. Also makes armor a lot more comfortable
Cushion an impact
Sleep on anything
weaknesses: Not very powerful
You would want to hug everything

name: Trap Door
description: The trap door ability enables it's user to summon a rope wherever they may be. Once said rope is pulled, a trap door opens up underneath the target (or targets) of choice. Door drops target at a totally random location. This could be anywhere from the moon, to five feet away.
summary: The ability to summon a rope out of the air which opens a trap door underneath your enemy
strengths: Gets rid target almost instantaneously
Works both indoors and outdoors
Can be used on yourself as a method of escape, albeit a risky one.
weaknesses: Could potentially deposit target on top of you
If used on yourself, could potentially deposit you in the middle of space.

name: Lifespan Of A Black Hole
description: You have a natural lifespan of roughly 66 quindecillion years. That's 66 followed by 49 zeros. This power only extends your lifespan. Other powers are needed to make yourself invulnerable or go without food,air or water. If you actually possess a power to absorb matter like a black hole then the lifespan of 66 quindecillion can be made longer by absorbing matter.
summary: The ability to extremely long natural lifespan.
strengths: Pass as a immortal.
Live a extremely long time.
Absorbing matter as if you were a black hole will give a even longer lifespan.
weaknesses: You're not immortal. You're still aging.
Beyond 100 billion years you'll need a power to survive proton decay.

name: Brain Waves
description: You can shoot sonic waves by using your brain.
summary: The ability to create brain waves that act as propulsion beams.
strengths: Handy in some cases...
weaknesses: Can cause recoil.

name: Invincible War
description: Have you read Invincible #60? I have. With this ability, you can summon an army of Invincibles (good or bad) and make them do your bidding. Invincible is a teenaged Image Comics superhero. He can fly and has sworn to protect the Earth.
summary: The ability to summon copies of the superhero Invincible.
strengths: Police the world
Make them do whatever you want
weaknesses: Some of them might turn on you
An army of godlike teens could destroy the world if you're not careful

name: Color Hair Power
description: With this power you can gain different powers based on the color of your hair. If you're blonde you will be able to glow in the dark. Red heads will be able to shoot flames from their hands. Brunettes will be able to control the weather.
summary: The ability to have certain powers based on the color of your hair
strengths: You can gain different powers based on the color of your hair
weaknesses: If you have hair a different color then the ones mentioned here you get no powers

name: Ability Skill:Cursing/Blessing
description: This new ability skill can give one the ability to use their other powers to curse or bless people. An example, would be if a pyrokinetic use this skill to curse someone to forever burn in flames or blesses someone to have a fire shield to appear everytime their are threatened.
summary: The ability to utlize abilities in the form of curse or blessing on someone else.
strengths: Bless/Curse people
weaknesses: May require magical skills or decent training

name: Fangs
description: With this power you can turn your teeth into super sharp fangs that can bite through almost anything including stone and metal. The you can turn as many of your teeth as you want into fangs and when you're done you can simply turn them back into normal teeth.
summary: The ability to grow fangs
strengths: You can turn your teeth into fangs that can cut through almost anything even metal and stone
weaknesses: You might not like the taste of metal or stone

name: Elemental Move: Guraten
description: The literal translations is quake. This an earth manipulating technique which create fissures in any direction you point to ground with a finger. With this move you can trap enemies in the cracks and set off land mine and its power can be increased by adding more fingers to the ground. With enough practice this move can hit ground under sea levels.
summary: The ability to create fissures in the ground with a finger
strengths: Good for long range battle.
Crush the beneath your enemies with a finger tip.
weaknesses: Need the earth element.
Useless against enemies who fly.

name: Pain Delay
description: Allows you to delay harmful effects up to 5 minutes. Stabbed, cut, burned, explosions, and ect. Can all be delayed no matter what. Even a head stot wont bring you down. This ability will also slow down everything except yourself.
summary: The ability to delay pain damage or death
strengths: Be able to have the last laugh.
Say those final words you want to get out.
Find medical attention BEFORE the effects kick in.
weaknesses: Only lasts 5 minutes
Death is death it will happen now or later

name: Wind Up Punch (Flame)
description: A person with this power can generate flames on their arm via the use of friction whilst spinning their arm rapidly. In addition, the user is immune to their own flames. If skilled, the user can use the spinning arms to grab things to fling as fiery projectiles. Also, the user can use the arms as flails-like the other Wind-up powers. There is no recoil after it hits something and Newton's Third Law does not apply to it. However, targets will get blasted backward on fire if hit hard enough.
summary: The ability to generate a flaming arm by spinning rapidly using the force of friction
strengths: You are immune to your own flames
You can grab stuff while spinning and throw as flaming projectiles if you are skilled
Fire punch enough said, also like the other wind-up punches it has no recoil and protects from NTL
weaknesses: Fire is dangerous to other people
Cannot use if there is no oxygen

name: Blessing Of Xuan Wu
description: Xuan-Wu is one of the four Chinese celestial beasts and is alternatively known as the Black Tortoise or the Black Warrior of the North. He is often depicted with a snake for a tail. Thus, his blessing confers all the defense of a turtle as well as the speed, flexibility,and striking power of a snake for as long as you are facing the direction of north. In addition, you gain control over the element of water.
summary: The ability to gain all the power of a turtle and a snake, so long as you face north.
strengths: The defense of a turtle.
The speed and deadliness of a snake.
Control over water in all of its states.
weaknesses: You must be facing north for your powers to activate.

name: Death Elements
description: With this ability, you are able to control the four elements but only the ones that are tinged with death. The user can summon and control grave-dirt/gravestones, cold air/wind, pyre flames and tears. You can rip the tears straight from people's eyes, make the surrounding air fearfully cold, ignite the undying flames and summon the dirt/stone that buries the dead.
summary: The ability to summon and manipulate the elements in the form of Death.
strengths: You can control the four elements in a creepy way.
Induce fear to most lifeforms.
Forcibly make people cry.
weaknesses: You cannot just summon tears and cold air. You must have people (that have tears) and air to change.
Some people don't fear death and won't be intimidated by you.
Elemental manipulators have more variety over the elements thn you do (unless your in a cemetery. )

name: No Heat
description: This fire is shot out from the user's hands. It is a fire that is very cold. If touched by it, the flames will infect the target if the target is a living one. The infection must be cured by burning the flesh off of the infected or the infected will become a dumb witted super strong zombie and the zombie can make others very cold.
summary: The ability to shoot out cold fire
strengths: The fire only has whatever weakness water has.
Can't infect the user what so ever.
If others touch the fire, they become a zombie.
weaknesses: The user can get a little chilly.
Can infect family, friends, ect.
Can't burn anybody or anything.

name: Communication Spy
description: You can easedrop on phone conversations via mentally tuning into the phone lines or wave frequency. You'll be able to hear both ends of converation, even 3 way call. You can't see text messages or pictures though & you have to focus on the conversation you are hearing or you end up listening to someone else or to many conversations all at once.
summary: The ability to listen in on conversations via phone lines or waves
strengths: Listen in on phone conversations
Make a good communication spy
weaknesses: Cannot see text, IM or picture messages
Have to focus on the conversation you are listening in on or end up listening to the wrong one
Could hear to many conversations all at once if you don't focus hard enough

name: The Paths Of Magic:The Magician
description: The Path of the Magician, or the Path of the Word, is the third path of magic. Magicians use words to control their power. You see, space bends around everything, including vibrations in the air. Certain things happen when these distortions are energized with mana. Ancient mages developed a language that worked best with magic. This was the base for many ancient languages, such as Egyptian and Greek, which can also be used for magic. Latin is nearly identical to this language, so it works best.
summary: The ability to have special talent as a magician.
strengths: You have special talent as a magicain.
weaknesses: You must learn another language.

name: Tao Dial
description: You could temporarily gain the ability to transform into eight humanoid warriors with elemental patterns of the ba gua. It is a unique power to morph into any of the eight half-human, half-animalistic warriors, so here are the examples: heavenly dragon, firey tiger, tidal shark, moon unicorn, earthly millipede, mountain elephant, thunder eel, and windy hawk.
summary: The ability to use it to transform into any of the eight humanoid warriors.
strengths: Can be of use for extreme heroism.
weaknesses: Could be of use for dark villainy.

name: 1 For The Money
description: With this power you can make as much money as you want rain from the sky. You can only use this power once a day and as soon as you stop making it rain money you have to wait a whole 24 hours before using this power again.
summary: The ability to make money rain from the sky
strengths: You can make money rain from the sky
weaknesses: You can only use this power once a day

name: Boom Bag
description: The Boom Bag is a portable bag that works like a Hammer Space for grenades. Any type of grenade can be taken out from it's endless supply. The condition for the explosion can be chosen from a list.  E.g. timed, on hit, proximity, temperature, voice recognition, remote control etc. The type of explosion can also be chosen.  examples : fire, ice, local time freeze, stench, sleeping gas, power canceling field etc. They can only be activated/deactivated by who pulled the grenade out of the bag.
summary: The ability to wield the Boom Bag
strengths: Very versatile weapon if used wisely
The grenades you pulled out can be used even if you don't have the bag with you
Bada Bing Bada BOOOOOM!!!
weaknesses: Your Boom Bag could be stolen
If your arms are weak, you can't throw the grenades very far

name: Bubble Shield
description: This power creates an ordinary water/air bubble around the user. The bubble has a radius of one metre from the center of the user. If the user won't fit, then add one half of a metre to that and repeat until the user fits. The bubble can withstand up to ten pounds of force being used on it, but reforms after ten seconds.
summary: The ability to create a shield that is a bubble
strengths: Bubble automatically reforms after ten seconds of being hit unless first con occurs.
Bubble can withstand most non-slashing and non-electrical attacks/powers.
weaknesses: If the bubble is hit with an electrical attack or power, you can't form it for the next 24 hours.
Bubble is automatically destroyed if hit with an electrical attack/power.

name: Cold Night
description: The ability to freeze the night when you are sleeping. The night will last as long as you're still sleeping. It will only end the moment you wake up. This ability is not permanent. You can activate this skill when you want to.
summary: The ability to freeze the night by sleeping and decide when the sun will rise by waking up.
strengths: You don't have to follow an alarm clock anymore
weaknesses: Lots of things can happen by messing up with the time

name: Koldoken
description: Meaning freezing surge fist, a hadoken is the ice equivalent of a fireball, a frost/cold ball if you will. You can fire up to three of those (at the same time) towards the enemy and if it touches your enemy, he/she will be frozen for a while.
summary: The ability to launch a projectile that would temporarily freeze the opponent.
strengths: Can be like Sub-Zero from MK.
weaknesses: Fire type opponents would be immune to this.
Only lasts a small period of time.

name: The Pathsof Magic:The Enchanter
description: The Path of the Enchanter, or the Path of the Hand, is the last Path of Magic. Enchanters use magic to create objects with magical powers. One of the many properties of mana is that it can change the atomic properties of matter it flows through. If this is done in a controlled fashion, objects can be given new properties. One example is a sword that can absorb heat from something it stabs, causing it to freeze. This ability gives you special talent for enchantment.
summary: The ability to have special talent as an enchanter.
strengths: You can create objects of great magical power.
You have special talent for enchantment.
Objects can be given multiple abilities, but this is dangerous, as the properties can conflict.
weaknesses: Items can be lost or stolen.
If an enchanted item is transmutated, it loses all magical abilities.
If the enchanted object is broken, it will release a destructive explosion of magical energy

name: Paint Manipulation
description: A person with this power can manipulate paint. Not only can they use this for artistic purposes they can also use this to attack. For example they can control paintballs as a concussive attack as well as use paint similar to hydrokinesis. They can also literally rip the paint off walls to use. The paint can also be turned from solid to liquid state at the user's preference. In addition objects covered in paint are also able to be manipulated by moving the paint with the object.
summary: The ability to manipulate any paint or pigment (except chlorophyll or melanin)
strengths: Can cheat at paintball deflecting all shot and making all shots "home in" on opponents
Paint the fence faster
Since most houses are painted you can literally rip off that paint to use it as a weapon
weaknesses: Needs imagination to use
Needs paint to work

name: Cryonic Function
description: When the body temeperature drop, you usually shiver, get hypothermia, nerve signals slow down, blood flow stops in some areas, skin contricts, and many more problems. With this ability, you can move and function normally even when body temperature drops too low. You don't even shiver when the temperature drops. Your body will still produce body heat to stay at 98. 6 F. The risks are that body temperature can lower quicker, frostbite can occur, feeling cold, and freezing solid kills you.
summary: The ability to function and move normally even at really cold temperatures.
strengths: No more numb extremities in the cold.
No more hypothermia.
No more shivering.
weaknesses: Body tends to cool down faster.
Frostbite can occur and kill the frozen area.
Freezing solid will kill you.

name: Inescapable Judgment
description: Usable by the Demon Transformation #3 Black Demon. Lasers shoot out of your wings (must have some), go around an enemy and close behind him (Explanation: take both your hands, hold the wrists together. Now, touch each finger of one hand with the opposite finger of the other hand (ring finger with ring finger, etc.) You are standing where the wrists meet, your palms are your wings, your fingers are the lasers and your enemy is in between) First, you fire an orb that will sap out all the power...
summary: The ability to trap an enemy and kill him.
strengths: ..of your enemy, then you follow up with a sword attack that finishes off your helpless opponent.
If the orb hits, your enemy is finished.
weaknesses: Can be evaded by: teleporting out of the lasers, burrowing in the ground, turning into mist etc.
PS. 500 letters is SOO not enough for my descriptions.

name: Frozen Reaver
description: The Frozen Reaver it a move that allows the user to steal any number of souls and create a sword out of them. The sword can freeze enemies on contact and is very hard to destroy. The sword is grayish black and can have any style the user wishes to have (Japaneses, European etc). The size of the sword depends on the number of souls used: 1 soul makes a dagger, 10 and up make a sword that grows with the number of souls. In order to add more souls, the user must kill anything and trap the soul
summary: The ability to create a sword made of frozen souls
strengths: Very strong weapon
Freeze anything on contact
Hard to destroy
weaknesses: Needs souls to make
Size and power depend on the number of souls used

name: Myth Power: Eurybia's Rule
description: Eurybia, in Greek myth, was the goddess of the sea's forces, which influence sailing and other marine pursuits. As such, channeling her allows one to breathe underwater, swim well and withstand pressure and friction from wind and water. In addition, one can pressurize ambient moisture at will, to blast at foes. One can even mimic water pressure; this allows a tactile form of Hydrokinesis, enhances attack impact with moisture from the air, or even allows one to crush things in one's bare hands.
summary: The ability to channel Eurybia's command over the essence of the sea's forces and naval/maritime supremacy
strengths: Breathe underwater, swim well, withstand pressure/friction/resistance from wind and water, etc
Pressurize water or ambient moisture in the air to produce powerful water jets at will
Water Pressure Mimicry (control water by touch, stand underwater as if on land, crush things, etc)
weaknesses: Skill in sailing/boating, fishing/whaling/shrimping, navigation, etc sometimes come later (NCN)
Pro #3 requires touch (NCN)
Aquatic/water/sea/ocean-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Lonely Island
description: With this power you can teleport people to an island where they are all alone and they can't escape from it and nobody can get to it unless you send them there. The island is a standard desert island its got palm tress, coconuts, crabs and one fresh water river surrounded by thorn bushes.
summary: The ability to teleport people to an island in the middle of nowhere
strengths: You can teleport somebody to a lonely island
They can't get off the island and nobody can get to the island
weaknesses: You can't bring them back even if you wanted to

name: Taste The Rainbow!
description: With this power, anything that you touch turns into Skittles. Want some Skittles? Touch a table or chair. The best thing is it's silent, and you can control it. So no accidental Skittle-fication!
summary: The ability to touch an object or living thing and turn it into Skittles!
strengths: All the Skittles you want
Makes no noise
Can control it
weaknesses: If you hate Skittles
You can't control what kind you just get a random assortment
Only works on items, not on persons

name: Flaming Tennis Ball Hands
description: With this power you can shoot flaming tennis balls out of your hands. The tennis balls can not be put out by water of fire retardant foam or anything else. The tennis balls are also bouncy so if they miss the target they might bounce off of something and hit them anyways. You have an unlimited amount of flaming tennis balls as well and after two minutes the flaming tennis ball disappears.
summary: The ability to shoot flaming tennis balls out of your hands
strengths: You can shoot flaming tennis balls out of your hands
The fire can not be put out
They are bouncy
weaknesses: They are not effective against fire proof enemies
The tennis balls disappear after two minutes

name: Job Market
description: This power allows you to be hired to any job that you wish. Simply think of the job that you wish to be hired to and will the power to activate. When you will the power to activate a string of events will occur that will cause you to be offered the job as soon as possible. You do not need any training to be hired to the job, only to keep it. When hired you will always receive the best possible pay. If you use this to get a second job the power will cause you to be fired from the first.
summary: The ability to be hired to any realistic job that you can imagine.
strengths: Can have your dream job.
Can switch to being hired for another job if you get tired with the first.
You get the best pay possible.
weaknesses: Can still be fired.
Only Works on one job at a time.
You still have to work.

name: Chains Of Dragonoid
description: Ages ago in a galaxy not so far away, a dragonoid roamed our stars. Searching for someone who could be a match for it's powers. And it found someone. The chain master Slybound forged two unique chains that could control this monster. But eventually the dragonoid died and so the chains were enchanted to set everything on fire. Only the handles are fireproof the rest will ignite all. Beware the actual chains don't burn but whatever hits them will ignite.
summary: The ability to summon two huge chains that set everything on fire.
strengths: When mastered you could hit almost anyone from any angle.
Cold during the winter or on hoth? Just touch a nearby object to set it on fire.
Just give an enemy a smack of the ol' chain and he'll run for the nearest source of water.
weaknesses: You have to master this weapon so beware of ricochet.
Two huge chains that only work when together, and they are heavy as hell.
It's not like you can put em on the ground. Or the ground will be set on fire. (If it wasn't clear)

name: Crown Of Sand
description: With this power you have a brown crown with a sand colored gem. You can shoot sand out of the gem in powerful bursts that send your opponent flying. The crown also gives you control over animals who live in the desert such as camels and lizards and such.
summary: The ability to have a sand crown that allows you to shoot sand and control desert animals
strengths: You can shoot sand
You can control desert animals
weaknesses: The sand might get in your eyes

name: Femtosecond Laser Burst
description: A femtosecond is 0. 000000000000001 of an second. You will put a hole in anything that is not is somehow invulerable to lasers or that doesn't reflect or absorb lasers. The burst has a range of 20 feet and needs a 5 minute recharge time between uses. If you use this power more than 10 times a day your 'laser' hand will suffer burn injury and be crippled for a day. Your laser burst can only be dodged by someone who can perceive time slowed down or is moving light speed or faster than light.
summary: The ability to shoot one laser from your hand for every femtosecond in a second.
strengths: A million times a billion lasers in one second.
An attack so fast almost no one can perceive it.
weaknesses: It's short range.
Lasers can't hurt everyone and some people could actually dodge your attack.
Limited use.

name: Similtude Combiner
description: Combine things into one, like making a drop of water from every lake in the world go into a giant water bottle made from plastic from around the world. You can't combine things that are different, like water with steel: Ground combines with ground, air with air, metal with metal, fire with fire, etc.
summary: The ability to combine all or some things into one thing.
strengths: You can be a big time inventor.
Takes only a second.
Handy for a quick get away
weaknesses: Can't be used on enemies, as in you can't use them, but you can hurt them with something you made.
Can only be made from the same type of thing that is connected in some way.

name: Summon Durendal
description: Durendal is known as Charlemagne's personal sword, but it is also one of the four ancient stone blades of power. Durendal is the sword of air. Its powers include controlling air and purifying anything it touches. It is indestructible and can combine with its twin Durendal to create new Ley Gates which act as portals to other Ley Gate locations around the world.
summary: The ability to summon Durendal, the ancient stone blade of Air.
strengths: Control air
Create Ley Gates
Purify anything
weaknesses: Must be combined with Joyeuse to create Ley Gates.

name: Crack Creation
description: A person with this power can create cracks on anything the touch. In addition they can control this crack(s) as long as they have not lost physical contact with that object. The crack can travel from one solid to another so you can make the crack follow people at will. By controlling the crack they can use it in creative ways. A skilled user can control how deep the crack is and how wide it is so they can used it to carve up solid blocks into any structure into art or weapons.
summary: The ability to create cracks on contact and control them for various functions
strengths: Powerful and versatile
Can use to carve up anything into a desired structure
The crack can travel from one object to another--ie "The Crack from the Donald Duck Cartoon"
weaknesses: Inevitable bad puns based on this power's name
Requires constant touch with the origin of the crack--ie easy to find you
Does not work on incorporeal things

name: Reversal
description: Basically you use this power on another power and the positions of the one who is using the power and the one who is targeted by the user are switched. Ex. You're being chased by a pyrokinetic. You use this power on their pyrokinesis and voila! You are now the one controlling the fire and they're the one on the run. They still have pyrokinesis but you're the one controlling it.
summary: The ability to reverse the user and the target in a power
strengths: You can get a lot of laughs out of this one.
Getting someone to attack you with a power then hijacking that power with this power.
weaknesses: The other person has to use their power on someone else in order for you to use this power.

name: Sociopathic Ability Mimicry
description: This ability always stirs up on people who are naturally sociopaths. It allows them to feel the extreme ends of emotions and allow them to use abilities they have copied off of people. In their non ability state, they are cold and emotionless. With the limited number of emotions, there are only so many abilities that can be copied, and only one emotion can be felt at a time. Every person uses an ability tied to an emotion, so when a new ability is tied to the same emotion, the last one is lost.
summary: The ability to copy abilities but have no emotions when not using powers
strengths: Various super powers at your disposal.
Allows sociopaths to feel emotions
High control over copied abilities.
weaknesses: Feel the extreme ends of emotions which can lead to uncontrollable actions.
Lose old powers when exposed to new ones that are connected to the same emotion
You need to be a sociopath

name: Spit Fire Stardust
description: You can spew a stream of star-filled blue flames from your mouth, which will burn foes.
summary: The ability to blow blue sparkling flames from your mouth.
strengths: Blue flames are cool and hot.
Other fire-breathers might be amused and astounded.
weaknesses: They only burn in cosmic or magical realms.

name: Delete This Planetary Wheel
description: You spin the wheel and the needle points at a power, which is named after a planet. Mercury: fire freezing bubbles & absorb your foe if, Venus: fire exploding ribbons, Mars: throw burning spears, Neptune: summon a tidal waterfall, Jupiter: summon an electric whirlwind, Saturn: time & death manipulation, Uranus: cause landslides or avalanches, Pluto: uper speed through t
summary: The ability to use the powers named after nine planets
strengths: Could use it to devastate your foes.
Never wears off.
Surprise which one you get
weaknesses: Evildoers would use it too.
Surprise which one you get
Can only use once per hour

name: Fire Touch
description: When you're touching someone, they combust and turns into ashes!
summary: The ability to turn a person into fire
strengths: You are immune to THIS fire
And you can control the fire
Ggetting rid of people
weaknesses: When you approach the water you becomes steam

name: Moon Blade 2nd Form: Sky Blue
description: A blade with a white hilt, and a blue blade and wings sprouting from the hilt. Allows for wind manipulation, flight.
summary: The ability to create a blade allowing for advanced wind manipulation
strengths: Ability to fly.
Ability to produce blades of compressed wind that are wired off as the sword is swung.
weaknesses: Almoust no power underwater, and no power in places with no air (space)
Medium range weapon which has limited effectiveness in close quarters combat.

name: Holy Power: Terra Burst
description: Using the destructive energy of the Reaper, you can crush part of the tectonic plaques underneath you and your target, creating an enormous explosion of fire and magma, destroying everything at great distance. This ability is really powerful, but dangerous and hard to control. You can destroy a whole army of enemies if you can control this power, but you might kill a lot of innocent people if you don't be careful.
summary: The ability to crush part of the tectonic plaques underneath you, creating an enormous explosion of fire and magma.
strengths: Can destroy a whole army of enemies if used wisely.
Can destroy nearly anything.
Hard to defend, because its attack is indirect.
weaknesses: Dangerous and hard to control.
Only Reapers can use this power.

name: Cleansing Flame
description: With this ability you will be able to fire wave of flame. The unique thing about the fire you create is that it does not affect helthy organic matter.
summary: The ability to fire waves of fire that do not affect healthy organic matter
strengths: Leave healthy organic matter unaffected
Burn out impurities
weaknesses: Cannot harm healthy people

name: Sonic Breath
description: You can emit a stream of wind from your mouth that is equal to a hurricane. It is very directional and the stream can be wide or focused.
summary: The ability to emit a jet stream of wind from your mouth.
strengths: Blow down buildings.
Launch sailing ships.
weaknesses: Can cause a lot of property damage.
Sneezing may be a problem.

name: Yokai: Kitsune
description: In Japanese mythology, kitsune were recognized as shapeshifting foxes with up to nine tails. With this ability you are able to become one of these vulpine tricksters. You will be capable of generating mystical flames or fireballs better known as "fox fire". The more tails you have the more powerful and wiser you are. Kitsune can also access temporary flight for long distances.
summary: The ability to undergo a transformation into a Japanese monster or spirit.
strengths: Shapeshifting is useful.
Use "fox fire" to fend off enemies without breaking a sweat.
weaknesses: You can't fly forever.
You can grow have up to nine tails.

name: Scotoma Creation
description: Whenever you are in someone's visual field, you just need to gesture the action of removing or moving away something in the air if you want to use this power on them. From their point of view, they will see you "removing" portions of their field of vision, creating blind spots in their vision. These blind spots will remain as long as you stay in their visual field. If not, they will slowly close themselves and disappear.
summary: The ability to create blind spots in someone's visual field.
strengths: Partially or totally obstruct anyone's visual field. Try removing the center - it's very hindering.
It affects all of their eyes (two in most cases), as long as the eyes were opened.
The blind spots follow their eye movements.
weaknesses: You can't hide something in a blind spot. They just need to look away a little and they will see it.
If an eye is closed, that one won't be affected.
The further you are, the smaller the blind spots will be.

name: Myth Power: Acheilos' Action
description: Acheilos (Akheilos, Acheilus, Achilos, Achilleus, Achilles), in Greek myth, was the god of sharks. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive, communicate with and command sharks at will. In addition, one can psychically mimic the features and abilities of a shark at will. Furthermore, one can transform oneself into any species of shark (or wereshark) at will (others by touch). One can even psychically teleport oneself and/or others to any location that is home to sharks at will.
summary: The ability to channel Acheilos' command over the essence of sharks
strengths: Psychically perceive, communicate, command and mimic sharks at will
Transform oneself into any species of shark (or wereshark) at will; others, by touch
Psychically teleport self/others to any location with sharks at will
weaknesses: Part 2 of Pro #2 requires touch until developed (NCN)
Cannot astral-project a water-independent shark-spirit at will, until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Poseidon's Prestige and MythPower: Amphitrite's Amity provide immunity (NCN)

name: Sonic Screwdriver Creation
description: The amazingly useful sonic screwdriver of the who-verse. You can create one a day. Open a electronic door,cut locks,control a elevator,charge a battery,unlock handcuffs,cut rope,crack ice,a makeshift flashlight and a 100+ more uses. Anyone can use them.
summary: The ability to create a sonic screwdriver.
strengths: One hundred plus uses including as a screwdriver.
Small and can be hidden.
One function is to store the consciousness of a person.
weaknesses: Some uses are only useful in the who-verse.

name: Missile Stop
description: With this power whenever you see a missile falling towards you or the area you're in you can freeze it in midair and keep it in the air until you want it to fall. Only you can cause the missiles you freeze to fall but you cannot cause missiles stopped by others with this power to fall. This power is useful if the world ever goes into nuclear apocalypse mode.
summary: The ability to prevent missiles from falling
strengths: You can stop missiles from falling
weaknesses: You cannot unfreeze missiles stopped by other people with this power

name: Realistic Air Guitar
description: With this power you can make it sound like your actually playing the guitar (with skill) whenever you air guitar. It doesn't even have look convincing the guitar sound will just come out of nowhere and automatically sound really good.
summary: The ability to make it sound like you're actually playing the guitar when you air guitar
strengths: Make all your friends thing you can play the guitar
Win any air band competition
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat

name: Myth Power: Hephaestus' Forge
description: Hephaestus (Hephaistos), in Greek myth, was the god of fire, metal, volcanic activity, the forge and craftsmanship. As such, channeling him allows one to gain skill in all of the numerous handicrafts. In addition, one can psychically manipulate fire and metal at will. Furthermore, one can psychically manipulate molten rock/metal (magma/lava) at will. One can also totally withstand the effects of fire and heat. One can even absorb heat and fire at will, to gain physical power and sustenance.
summary: The ability to channel Hephaestus' command over the forces of fire, metal, volcanic activity, and the forge
strengths: Gain skill in artisanry, metalworking, stonemasonry, sculpting, jewelry making, blacksmithing, etc
Psychically perceive and manipulate fire, metal and volcanic lava/magma (MOLTEN rock/metal)
Totally withstand the effects of heat (shared by touch); absorb heat to gain power and sustenance
weaknesses: Cannot generate and manipulate smoke and ash until the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot assume a form of fire, metal or molten rock/metal (lava/magma) until the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot teleport foes into volcanoes or volcanic faults by touch until the higher levels (NCN)

name: Aggregated Cells
description: The ability to make cells seem to be on drugs, they move around at intense speed in whatever place I want when I want, causing that place to be rendered chemically mixed. The buildings water, the ocean concrete.
summary: The ability to change all chemical cells.
strengths: The Ability to Alter Reality is Very Strong.
You make your friends into poop, litterally.
weaknesses: The chemical reaction onto certain objects may effect Earth itself.

name: Flowering Burning Anger
description: You use this power to thrash your enemies by tossing burning sharp blossoms at them, and then seperates to fry them. It can go right thourgh your opponent leaving behind charred holes anywhere in their body.
summary: The ability to fire off burning petals and scatter them at your opponent.
strengths: You can have the ability to control both Grass and Fire-type powers.
weaknesses: None.

name: Soul Twister
description: When you clench your fist, it will start to glow a foggy white color. When you open your hand in front of someone, a ghostly white hand engulfs the opponent, and sends their soul out of their mouth, and freezes the opponent in silver ice. Their soul starts to spin and expand, until it'a transforms into a full blown tornado and moves away. If the soul twister picks up the frozen host body, the tornado returns to the host by forcing itself through a crack, breaking the ice as well.
summary: The ability to eject the souls of yourself and others out of their body in the form of a large tornado
strengths: Highly destructive.
Tornado blows wind at 0 degrees Kelvin.
If ice is touched, the person who touched it is also frozen and their soul is ejected as well.
weaknesses: When broken ice melts, several little ghost hand silhouette seek out hosts to freeze.

name: Firewall Bypass
description: The person who has this power can go on any website on any device that they chose to, even if that website they is being blocked by parental controls or a firewall at school, without using any sort of proxy.
summary: The ability to get on any website regardless of whether it is blocked or not
strengths: Be able to go on any website they want.
Works on any electronic device.
weaknesses: You can suffer consequences if you get caught.
You might get a virus on your computer if you go on a bad website.

name: Rainbows
description: With this power you can cause rainbows to appear whenever and wherever you want. The rainbows can be used to distract people with their beautiful colors, blind people with their brightness or to create realistic nature scenes for movies, tv shows and youtube videos.
summary: The ability to cause rainbows to appear whenever and wherever you want
strengths: You can create rainbows wherever and whenever you want.
You can use them to distract people, blind people or to create realistic nature scenes
You can make the rainbows disappear when you're done with them
weaknesses: Some people think rainbows are a bad omen

name: Manmade Element Manipulation
description: The four evil elements--deforestation, radiation, smog and toxicity--are the corrupt opposites of earth, fire, water, and wind.  Deforestation is the ability to obliterate all tree life, radiation is the power to release electromagnetic energy from your hands, smog is the ability to launch a deadly ball of gas to your enemies, and toxicity is the power to unleash a poisoned green acidic spray.
summary: The ability to wield the four dark powers of pollution.
strengths: Gain four very effective abilities
weaknesses: You'll be forever corrupted

name: Acid Tide
description: You could swamp the entire battlefield with a giant wave, filled with powerful sulphuric acid. This acid can burn right through everything, but this power can also be used to cross pools of toxic (create your own layer of acid over the pool of acid).
summary: The ability to create a wave of acid that will burn through everything.
strengths: You are immune to your own acid.
Surfing on acid (even possible with a surfboard, as long as you touch it)
weaknesses: Falling of your surfboard means bye bye surfboard.

name: Arrow Creation
