Hard to be percise

name: Walk On Water
description: The ability stand on bodies of water without sinking .
summary: The ability to walk on Water
strengths: Cross ponds and lakes without detouring for a bridge.
Keep your feet dry when you step on a puddle.
Chase Ducks and Geese.
weaknesses: Unable to swim
Can't take a bath

name: Television Vision
description: With this awesome power, you can make any TV character appear out from the TV. 2D characters such as cartoons will still be 2D in our world. Also, the characters will be the size that they were in the TV. The TV has to remain on if you want your character to stay in our world. You can't actually take the character from the show, you can only make a duplicate of that character.
summary: The ability to make any television character appear out of thin air.
strengths: You can interview Spongebob SquarePants.
Can be the television master.
Can have a tiny army and take over the world HAHAHA.
weaknesses: The television has to remain on for however long you want your character to be in our world.
The characters are only going to be about six inches tall.
2D characters will still be 2D in our world.

name: Psychic Voodoo
description: Voodoo is a Cajun religion that places belief in folk magic, especially the infamous voodoo doll. A person with Psychic Voodoo can take the damage that they would have(fire, bullets, etc.) and give it to another person. While using this ability, the user takes no damage and has no pain. However, once the target dies, the link ceases.
summary: The ability to act as a living voodoo doll
strengths: Payback
While using, effectively invunerable
Unlimited range
weaknesses: Must know the person
When they die, the link dies too
Takes active concentration
tags: do that voodoo that you do

name: Half Kitsune
description: Someone with this power will have fox-like ears and tail(s). The more tails they have the more powerful they will be. Sometimes they won't have tails, instead their hair will naturally separate into 'ponytails' to signify the number of 'tails' they have. They will also have higher physical strength and speed. Their magical power will also be boosted for shapeshifting and fire magic.
summary: The ability to be half-human, half-kitsune
strengths: The more tails you have the less others will want to incur your wrath or fight you.
Rare versions of this power allow for control of Foxfire.
weaknesses: Some people will make signs to ward you off. Ex: the holy cross.
You are weaker than a full Kitsune (unless you have 9 tails), but more powerful than normal humans.

name: Fate Of Socrates
description: With this power you can turn any liquid into the poisonous hemlock. Whenever someone is about to take a drink turn it into hemlock. Whenever it rains you can turn some of it into hemlock. With a lot of practice you will be able to turn large bodies of liquids such as oceans, rain storms or even the human blood stream into poisonous hemlock.
summary: The ability to turn any liquid into hemlock
strengths: You can turn any liquid into hemlock
weaknesses: You have to practice a lot before you can turn a large amount of something into hemlock

name: The Cup Of Water
description: Imagine walking through a desert wishing you had something to drink, oh wait you have "The Cup of Water"! It's simple, it's practical, it's strange that few would have this I mean water is essential to life right? Just hold out your hand and instantly you can create a 12 ounce cup filled with drinking water, and by drinking I mean the good kind, so whether it's the desert or the sewers or wherever you have water. Oh and did I mention you get to keep the cup? That's right a free cup too!
summary: The ability to create a 12 ounce cup of drinking water.
strengths: Endless supply of drinkable water with no waiting time between
Costs no energy on the person using the power
You get a free cup when you are done
weaknesses: It's just water, nothing special
Not a lot of people can be affect by 12 ounce of water
Do you really need ANOTHER glass cup?

name: Myth Power: Thetis' Thought
description: Thetis, in Greek myth, was the goddess of the sea's buoyancy and the generation (spawning) of fish, as well as the Leader of the Nereids. As such, channeling her allows one to swim well and survive underwater, which may be shared, by touch. In addition, one can psychically manipulate water, at will. Furthermore, one can psychically manipulate matter's buoyancy in water, at will. One can even psychically perceive and communicate with fish, as well as users of aquatic MythPowers, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Thetis' command over the essence of the sea's buoyancy and the generation of fish
strengths: Swim well and survive underwater (may be shared by touch)
Psychically manipulate water, and matter's buoyancy in water, at will
Psychically perceive and communicate with fish and aquatic MythPower users, at will
weaknesses: Cannot gain Aqueous Shapeshifting (turn into water, then another subject) until developed (NCN)
Cannot astral-project water-independent fish-spirits at will, until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Poseidon's Prestige provides immunity and allows disruption/negation (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Bronte's Barrage
description: Bronte, in Greek myth, was the goddess of thunder. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically generate and manipulate thunder at will. In addition, one can conduct electricity, as well as absorb sound and electricity to gain physical power. Furthermore, one can listen to the boom of thunder to psychically divine past, present or future, at will. One can even psychically perceive, communicate with and compel those who fear thunder, as well as teleport to the site of thunder crashes.
summary: The ability to channel Bronte's command over the essence of thunder
strengths: Psychically generate and manipulate electricity; absorb sound and electricity
Listen to thunder crashes to psychically divine the past, present and future
Psychically perceive, communicate with, share senses with and compel those who fear thunder
weaknesses: Cannot mentally project illusory thunder to others' minds until developed (NCN)
No Sonic and Electrical Immunity until developed (NCN)
Electrokinesis, Electrical Immunity, MythPower: Zeus' Zenith, etc, provide immunity (NCN)

name: Amulant Eyes
description: With this power, you can use it to scare people, because this allows you to make fire come out of your eyes. It happens controllably until you get angry, then it pops out automatically. If you try to hold it in, then sparks will come flying out of your eyes each time you blink. These flames will make anything catch on fire. So, you have to keep them away from things. Also, if you're not careful, you could burn yourself.
summary: The ability to make fire in your eyes.
strengths: Can scare enemies away
Help you in a fight to the death
weaknesses: Can catch on fire
Happens automatically when angry
Can burn your house down

name: Halcyon Days
description: A person with Halcyon Days projects an energy field that drains energy off bad weather that comes into contact with it. The energy then expands the field, causing it to grow even larger. The basic field covers a 1 mile radius from the person with the power. This power also works on other weather manipulators, effectively reducing their powers to making rain showers & breezes while in the Halcyon's field. If two different fields come into contact the result is worse than hurricane class weather.
summary: The ability to project an energy field that neutralizes all bad weather
strengths: Neutralizes other weather manipulators
"Good" weather
Not affected by mood
weaknesses: No snow days
Hurricanes if two halcyon's fields come into contact

name: Wood Hardening
description: Your very presence can reinforce any wooden object or the wooden part of anything so they become extremely hard while still keeping their wooden appearance. They also become impossible to burn. With this, you can easily deceive people into thinking they are just dealing with plain simple wood, but they won't be able to scratch, cut or smash it.
summary: The ability to make wood as hard as diamond
strengths: Lumberjacks won't be able to fell trees, lovers won't be able to carve silly hearts into their bark.
No one will be able to smash through the wooden door you built
Hylian Shield or Master Sword are now less than Wooden Shield and Sword
weaknesses: Fighting against a wood manipulator.
You also reinforce your enemy's wood.

name: Lava Spit
description: You can spit lava from your mouth!
summary: The ability to spit lava
strengths: Can melt stuf
Works with loogies
Doesn't hurt the inside of your mouth
weaknesses: The lava can only go as far as you can spit
Can't kill someone with your spit
Spit doesn't taste good

name: Summon Charon
description: By calling his name and offering 2 coins, the ground opens up and Charon the boatman appears riding a wave of lava. He then grabs your enemies and drags them to hell.
summary: The ability to summon the infamous boatman, Charon.
strengths: Great way of getting rid of your enemies.
Good way to send people to hell.
weaknesses: The boatman doesn't work for free. You must pay 2 coins of any kind.
Damages the ground around you.
You must be in eyesight of your target.

name: Rube Goldberg Machine Creation
description: There are three requirements: you need to trigger the first action, there must be enough elements available and the reactions must be possible. If all these are met, you just need to think about a task and a chain of events will accomplish it. Living beings' reaction can be involved, such as someone opening a door to see what's happening, someone putting down an object in a convenient place when they stand up, or even a rat chewing on a rope that just so happens to connect a car to the ceiling.
summary: The ability to trigger Rube Goldberg-esque reactions to perform the tasks you want.
strengths: With experience, this power could even guide you to perform the first action perfectly.
Cause an incredible chain of reactions to perform even the simplest task without the need to set it.
Humans's, even animal's and plant's, reaction to what's happening can be elements of the chain.
weaknesses: If some reactions are impossible, the chain will break.
Complex tasks are very difficult to realize, especially if there aren't enough elements.
Unless you have precise aim and calculated move, you may fail to trigger the chain.

name: Air Lock
description: With this ability you are immune to weather changes caused unnaturally. So if it is a natural change if the sun is shining and it a beautiful day, you would be unaffected by that. But if another made the weather rainy, you would be immune to the rain and cold.
summary: The ability to be immune to unnatural weather changes.
strengths: Unaffected by weather changes.
weaknesses: If someone makes it ran down money, you would be unaffected by that.
Weather usually isn't that much of a problem.......

name: Superderm
description: With this ability, you will become immune to all injuries caused by friction. No more scrapes or friction burn. No more skateboard injuries. No more knee pads or elbow pads.
summary: The ability to be immune to injuries caused by friction
strengths: Be immune to all friction induced injuries.
No more skateboard injuries.
No more knee pads or elbow pads.
weaknesses: You are not indestructable.
Can still get hurt by physical attacks not involving friction.

name: Gale Breath
description: With this power you become filled with an unending supply of air. The air causes your body to expand so that it becomes bloated, almost like a hot air balloon. Having this air means you will never need to breathe because you are filled with the supply of air. You can also blow out the air with considerable force. The air you blow out could be either hot or frosty.
summary: The ability to be full of a considerable amount of air.
strengths: Have an unending supply of air.
Breathe gale winds.
Your body will not be hurt from containing the air.
weaknesses: Your body becomes bloated containing the air.
You could be popped.
Accidentally releasing the air.

name: Surf's Up!
description: Snap your finger and manipulate tidal waves, causing them to increase in size, decrease in size or otherwise change (including what direction they move in).
summary: The ability to create and control large tidal waves or Tsunami
strengths: Ride the waves with glory.
Make waves larger or smaller at will.
Even cause tsunamis.
weaknesses: Creates tsunami when pissed off (unintentionally).
Must have presence of massive body of water.

name: Taper
description: A person with this power has the ability to materialize any type of tape they have seen and can manipulate it. For example, you can use the tape as a chain when coming out of the air or change it into a lifeline before falling into a hole. You can also materialize it in front of a person's mouth to stop them from talking. You can only materialize about 2 inches per second but through practice you can materialize up to 100 ft per second. Also, you can later materialize constructs of tape.
summary: The ability to have an unlimited amount of tape that comes out of nowhere
strengths: You have unlimited amounts of tape
Duct tape is very durable and electrical tape is electric proof
Needs practice before becoming useful
weaknesses: No tape armor--how would you get it off?
Has all the weaknesses of the respective tape that you are using

name: Liquid Rain
description: With this power you can cause rain to turn into any liquid. You can only use this power on actual rain not just any water. This power works even if the rain is already on the ground as a puddle. You cannot turn the liquid back into rain water.
summary: The ability to turn rain into any liquid
strengths: You can turn rain into any liquid
weaknesses: It only works on rain

name: Ehecatl, The Sky Cycle
description: When activated, you change into Ehecatl's priest outfit with its noticeable red face and giant mouth. In this form, you can blow extremely powerful winds and tornadoes. Your winds are so strong that, if you direct them towards the sky, you can affect the paths of the sun, the moon and the clouds. However, the stronger the wind you blow, the more energy is needed. You can also blow a symbolic wind, being able to stir up people's emotion and magnifying their affection for their loved ones.
summary: The ability to embody Ehecatl, the wind God, who can create winds so powerful, they'll move the sky and hearts.
strengths: You can magnify love and affection in people's hearts.
You can create powerful winds and tornadoes you can use to fly and travel.
Your winds are so powerful, they can move the sky.
weaknesses: You look ridiculous whenever you activate this power.
Creating powerful winds is very tiring for your body.

name: Flutter Jump
description: With this power you can flutter jump. Meaning that when you jump you can stay in the air longer and propel yourself farther if you start flapping your arms around.
summary: The ability to flutter jump
strengths: You can flutter jump
weaknesses: You look like an idiot when you flutter jump

name: Angelic Hierarchy: Seraphim
description: The Seraphim, also known as "the burning ones", have six wings in total; two covering their faces, two covering their bodies (feet), and two with which they fly. As a Seraph, the light emanating from you is so bright that not even angelic beings or anything else can look upon you. Your primary abilities consist of utilizing pure light as your weapon.
summary: The ability to become the highest ranking angel in heaven.
strengths: Ward off demonic armies and other forces of darkness.
Vanquish and repel foes with the power of light.
Strike down enemies with blinding light.
weaknesses: You are still susceptible to harm and damage from higher demonic beings.

name: Heat Mouth
description: Everyone has heard about Supermans ice breath, but what about heat breath? Heat breath is different from fire because it is super heated air rather than flame. The temperature of the heat can range from average human temperatures to metal melting heats but does not harm the user because the heat only triggers once the breath leaves the user's mouth and is surrounded by oxygen. This power doesn't increase the user's lung capacity.
summary: The ability to blow super hot air from your mouth
strengths: Able to melt most metals known to man
Powerful and useful - can heat up water etc
You can fly by being your own hot air ballon
weaknesses: Using on humans can cause them to smell horrible
Running out of breath high in the air being a hot air ballon

name: Old One Power: Cthulhu
description: Cthulhu, the mightiest of the Old Gods slumbering on Earth. The green, squid-headed, dragon-winged reality-distorting sanity-shattering abomination grants you a portion of his power. With it, you have perfect control over dreams and tentacled sea creatures (squids and octopi). You can also sort of control people, by sending them dreams giving them an order, and then showing them the twisted geometry of Cthulhu's sunken city, horrifying them into obedience.
summary: The ability to channel the power of the Great Old One Cthulhu
strengths: Dream control powers for communication and control. And squids, whatever that's worth.
You will reincarnate as the first Star Spawn born after his awakening.
If the most horrifying possible armageddon comes to pass (Old Ones returning), you will be safe.
weaknesses: If Cthulhu himself didn't grant this power, he gets angry. Dreams and afterlife are unending pain.
Overtime, you start to dislike the laws of reality more and more, and become extremely malevolent.
Any attempts at finding your alignment via unnatural means always turns up "Ultimate Evil. "

name: Myth Power: Honor Of The Ourea
description: The Ourea, in Greek myth, were the gods and goddesses of mountains. As such, channeling them allows one to selectively perceive present and future weather conditions on any mountain throughout the Cosmos. One may also use this power to psychically perceive the layout of any mountain at will (including caves, tunnels, volcanic faults, etc within that mountain). In addition, one may teleport to any mountain at will, and one's attributes are enhanced as long as one is on (or inside of) a mountain.
summary: The ability to channel the Ourea and their command over the essence of mountains and mountain life
strengths: Knowledge of any mountain in existence (location, layout, present/future weather conditions, etc. )
Teleport to any mountain at will
Stats (strength, durability, reflexes, etc) are enhanced for as long as you are on a mountain
weaknesses: Cannot alter a mountain's weather until the higher levels (NCN)
Not every mountain is habitable
Pro #3 gets weaker the further you are from the mountain peak (NCN)

name: Hellfire
description: This flame has an orange-reddish color and burns the victim's soul while it is burning the body as well. This power can only be gained by way of full mastery of 'Ghostly Pyrokinesis'.
summary: The ability to create and control a fire that burns the soul as well as the body
strengths: Anyone killed by this power cannot be reincarnated because their soul has been destroyed.
weaknesses: Do not burn yourself with this flame. EVER.

name: Satisfaction Manipulation
description: You can emit an invisible beam that changes how much hunger or thirst the affected beings feel.  The effect fades away after some time.  Unless you reapply or remove it.
summary: The ability to change the feeling of hunger or thirst in another being
strengths: Increase the thirst or hunger of the clients. More profit for the bar or restaurant.
Remove the hunger of predators that want you as a meal.
Make your guests appreciate your food even more.
weaknesses: Your targets could overconsume when eating/drinking doesn't satisfy.

name: Toy Gun Affect
description: Simply point and fire (well not quite). Toy-gun Affect allows you to change an object, such as a gun like an AK-47 into the toy version of that same object, such as a squirt gun that resembles an AK-47, from a distance without having to actually touch the object (of course it has to be within vision). If used on a vehicle such as a car the passengers will be teleported automatically out of the vehicle before "toyification" of said vehicle. The toy state of the object only lasts one hour however.
summary: The ability to turn anything into a harmless toy.
strengths: Make any weapon useless
Fun for the whole family XD
Can be used from a distance (that's why it's the Toy-GUN Affect) and not just if touched.
weaknesses: Ineffective on people or animals
Only stays a toy for 1 hour before changing back
Not reversible (turning a toy such as a toy sword into a katana)

name: Bravery
description: Bravery is not the absence of fear, but the acknowledgment and conquering of it. One with this power, after facing their fear and mentally conquering it, will truly conquer it. Say your worst fear is fire. You must first face it, then conquer it(saving someone from a fire, remaining calm alone in the middle of a fire, etc. Only then will you be able to control fire and be totally immune to its effects.
summary: The ability to be truly brave
strengths: Mastering fear
Finding true bravery
weaknesses: Must first face your fear, and conquer it (which isn't always a bad thing, but is always difficult)

name: Meteor Call
description:
Its name says it all 'Meteor Call'
Summon a meteor from outer space like the asteroid belt and cause it to come hurdling towards the earth.
Also you can call as many meteors as you want.
summary: The ability to call a meteor from space to come hurdling towards the earth.
strengths: Can call as many meteors as you want.
Can cause the meteor to land on whoever you want.
weaknesses: Might get crushed under the meteors weight.

name: Power Burning
description: Be careful with this as it can burn only powers and does not differentiate between an ally's power and an enemy's power. Also do not let it touch you if you have Superhuman Strength or another power like that as it will burn the power and hurt as though 100 spikes have pierced your skin. To gain this power you must have had your powers negated 1000 times within one week.
summary: The ability to create a flame that can only burn other powers
strengths: Burn a curse to get permanently get rid of it.
It still will hurt if you touch the flame despite the fact that it won't burn the skin.
weaknesses: Warning: Do NOT use on a magical item that you want to use.
Gaining this power is somewhat comical for your enemies until you gain it.
When destroying a magical weapon's power, the weapon itself will also be destroyed.

name: You're Heat Resistant
description: With this power you can make people heat resistant (no snapping required). They will not get sun burns or be able to be hot even if they want to. They can still be burned by fire or lava however. You cannot make yourself heat resistant with this power.
summary: The ability to make people heat resistant
strengths: You can make others heat resistant
weaknesses: You cannot make yourself heat resistant with this power
You cannot make them fireproof or lavaproof

name: Myth Power: Astrape's Assault
description: Astrape, in Greek myth, was the goddess of lightning. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive, generate and manipulate electricity at will. In addition, one can conduct electricity, as well as absorb electricity to gain physical power. Furthermore, one can look at lightning strikes to psychically divine past, present or future, at will. One can even psychically perceive, communicate with and compel those who fear lightning, as well as teleport to the site of lightning strikes.
summary: The ability to channel Astrape's command over the essence of lightning
strengths: Psychically perceive, generate, manipulate, conduct and absorb electricity
Watch lightning strikes to psychically divine the past, present and future
Psychically perceive, communicate with, share senses with and compel those who fear lightning
weaknesses: Cannot assume a form of living electricity (Electrical Mimicry) until developed (NCN)
Cannot call lightning down from the sky until developed (NCN)
Electrokinesis, Electrical Immunity, MythPower: Zeus' Zenith and the like provide immunity (NCN)

name: Lonely God
description: Once the user activates this power, two things will happen. 1) you will recieve godlike power (nearly unlimited). 2) everyone else on earth (mankind/animals and insects) will instantly disappear and you'll be all alone.
summary: The ability to have godlike power along with complete loneliness
strengths: Godlike power
Loopholes are still fair game
Some people like being alone
weaknesses: Everyone else on earth (mankind, animals, insects) will instantly disappear and you'll be all alone

name: Living Music
description: Your cells elongate and vibrate as classical music that you control. But you still liv and can go back.
summary: The ability to turn your cells into sound waves of classical music that makes you living music.
strengths: Amplify yourself to deafen and shatter glass.
Intangible.
Escape through incredibly tight spaces.
weaknesses: You can be absorbed.
Limited to classical music.

name: Swimming Out Of Water
description: In a way it's like flying, except no wings. You have the same, light feeling that you do when underwater. You wont float off either because just like in water you can control where you go.
summary: The ability to float through the air as if in water
strengths: Traveling is made easy
You are more flexable
Makes it harder for opponents to attack when up in the air
weaknesses: You move slower
Dodging is harder

name: The Flaming Cage
description: Create small red orbs that will quickly surround someone and shot fire at each other and connect together to form and cage. This can work on groups of people and can be used as a good torturing method, mainly because fire can be shot from the orbs at the captive. If used underwater in stead of fire the orbs will release heat at very high temps(around 1000 degrease at times) and connect. The orbs can also trap moving targets on the run. The space in between the fire is 8 inches by 7 inches.
summary: The ability to trap an enemy in a cage of fire.
strengths: The orbs may also burst into flames and chase down enemies.
If water is sprayed onto the flames the heat will take its place until the water is gone.
Orbs will burn almost anything that touches them.
weaknesses: The larger the target the more orbs are needed and take about 3 seconds to create 5.
The space between the fire is small, but can still be passed through if one is quick enough
The orbs can be brooken by smashing them with about 3 tons of pressure.

name: 3rd Key Of Death
description: This key is able to raise dead animals. They are at command, and since they remain undead, they can't be killed. The key turns into a door that releases selected animals - like if you wanted to bring back a lion, but not an elephant. They can be unsummoned, as if they were in quicksand they slowly sink into the earth.
summary: The ability to summon a key that is able to raise dead animals.
strengths: An undying army of animals.
weaknesses: It is a small key, that can get lost or get destroyed.
Only animals.
No Con Negation or Inconvience Destroyer.

name: 7 Flames Of Purgatory
description: Theyre based on the 7 deadly sins: Satan(Wrath)- blue flames that incinerate any and everything. Belphegor(Sloth)- nullifies other powers. Mammon(Greed)- twin headed beast that comes in the form of twin swords; one of hot blue flame and the other of cold yellow. Beelzebub(Gluttony)- colorless/invisible flame reaching pass 1500 degrees Celsius. Leviathan(Envy)- the silver flame of Hades removes heat in the area ,allowing him to create ice.
summary: The ability to control the seven flames of Hell
strengths: Control of all 7 flames
Can use the flames for defense and offense
Can completely incinerate people
weaknesses: Takes up a lot of energy
Most of the flames have a strong backlash
Can hurt yourself if used improperly

name: Super Missles
description: You see a target, or targets, point your hand or hands at the targets, think of how many super missles and then that amount of super missles fires coming out of your hands. One super missle is powerful enough to hurt Superman, two missles double the power, three missles triple the power, etc.  You can create a gigantic missle that is as powerful as Thor's God Blast but it would also destroys a vast amount of the area. The super missles are the size of Baseball bats used in MLB.
summary: The ability to create Super Missles that fire from your hands
strengths: Can be Shoot underwater,on other planets, etc
Can fight Very powerful foes in the League of Darkseid, Mongul, Brainiac, Mephisto, Doctor Doom,etc
Something needs to fall you can use a super missle
weaknesses: Shields Can Prevent Super Missles from Hitting the Target
Super Missles Can be changed Using Telekinesis or other power to hit you, someone else, car, etc
If the target teleports away from the missle then the missle hits whatever it touches first

name: Monetary Rewards
description: This power allows you to "bless" someone so that, whenever they perform an act of selflessness and good will, that actions "value" in money will rain down on them from the sky. The money is that of whichever country they happen to be in at the time.
summary: The ability to have it rain money onto someone in responce to good deeds done.
strengths: Give someone an incentive to do good.
Give a reward to a down on their luck but honest person.
Get rich doing charity.
weaknesses: It falls from the sky in plain view of anyone.
The good deeds must be genuine, The power will NOT activate if you're only doing it to get the money
Don't hand it out to too many people unless you want to crash the local economy.

name: Claymore :  Phoenix Fire
description: (This clamore can creat and controle a phoenix fire that can torn its victims to ash. ) the sword is made from chrome steel. This claymore is weakest in the cold.
summary: The ability to possess clamore that can create and control a very hot flame
strengths: Torn your victims in to ash
Scare your victims to death
weaknesses: You can only have one claymore (no con negation)
You are not immune from the fire (no con negation)
This clamore is weakest in the cold

name: Aquacanthropy
description: This power gives the user the ability to become an aquatic werecreature of their choice but the rule is that it must be done near water or in water while the moonlight is reflecting over the waves. Your transformation may differ depending on the tides.
summary: The ability to become An Aquatic Werecreature
strengths: In were-seacreature form you're a faster swimmer.
Breathing underwater is easy.
You get a different transformation in correspondance to the tides.
weaknesses: Can't do it out of water.
You can't become amphibious.
Only fish and the like, no whales or dolphins.

name: Animated Techniques
description: This ability does not bring techniques, skills, or natural talent to actual life, but make them become physical and able to move by the user's will. They have no will or soul. They look like ethereal beings, not actual creature. The user can make his karate chop move in a remote controlled, long- range attack or cook's cutting technique into quick and precise air slices.
summary: The ability to give crude life to one's techniques, skills, or natural talent.
strengths: Make any techniques, skills, or natural talent be physical and animated
Remote control with one's mind
weaknesses: Could require a source to create crude life like one's own life energy.

name: Transposition
description: A person with Transposition is the hero of the band. Any song they've ever listened to, they can play. Everything from Mozart's Fifth to Ladies and Gentlemen, ska to rap, Blues Brothers to Rage Against the Machine. However, there are some limits. If you can't hit a high note, you'll have to take it down. And if you can't play an instrument, you'll have to learn. I recommend guitar or trumpet.
summary: The ability to play any song you've heard
strengths: Playing 'Ladies and Gentlemen' on an accordion
Playing the Blues Brothers album at a party
Listening to an amazing guitar solo and playing it perfectly
weaknesses: Having to learn an instrument
Must hear song first
If you can't play it high, you can't play it high

name: Food Rain

Farslayer then flies through the air, leaving a trail often confused with a rainbow or a comet. It ignores all obstacles, all barriers, and any protections. Once it hits the person, they will almost always die. And the sword will remain there, possibly to be used by their mourning relatives.

As such, channeling Theros (Therus- Summer) allows one to psychically manipulate the seasons to bring forth summer weather at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive and teleport to anywhere where it is naturally summer. Furthermore, one can withstand heat. One can even psychically perceive, communicate with and compel anyone born in the season of summer at will.

Say one indistinguishable word to a person and you will cause that person to never be understood when they speak, write or communicate in any way. Each person they speak to will fall prey to your power. The only cure to your confusing bedlam is getting the victim near an open flame. What if you could confuse the entire world?

Powers of total destruction, reality erasing, entrapping powers, powers that somehow freeze objects, matter control, matter manipulation, powers that control earth or crystals. Even without being drawn Coinspinner endows its user with superhuman good luck, it seems as if it is impossible for them to go wrong. But Coinspinner is the most intelligent of the swords. description: With this ability, you can repel liquids and stay dry. You can choose if your clothes also repel liquids. You repel paint, acids, corrosive liquids, water and most other liquids. The only thing you don't repel is sweat. The liquid is 1 millimeter away from you and drops of liquid that come in contact with the shield appear frictionless and hovers/slides off the psionic shield instead of sticking to it. You are still affected by the temperature and impact force of liquids. Can be turned off.
summary: The ability to repel liquids (including corrosive liquids, paint, and acids) and stay dry.
strengths: Repel liquids and stay dry.
Acids and corrosive liquids don't come in contact with you.
Never get wet paint on you again.
weaknesses: Only works with liquids.

name: Rain Stop
description: Now whenever it rains you can stop the rain while it's still in the air and it will stay in the air until you allow it to continue falling. You can keep the rain frozen in time for as long as you want and no new rain can fall while the rain is still in the air. Only you can allow the rain you stopped to fall.
summary: The ability to stop rain midfall
strengths: You can stop rain while it is falling
Only you can allow the rain to continue to fall
No new rain can fall while the rain is frozen in time
weaknesses: You cannot allow rain other people have frozen to continue to fall
Not much use in physical combat

name: Cloud Of Fire Smoke
description: This ability can be blown by smoke that looks like fire in the air and make music appear and a person to be calm
summary: The ability to make people calm and happy
strengths: Happy feeling
Munchies
And smile a lot
weaknesses: Get munchies
Get tired

name: Raindrop Walking
description: With this power the user can enter a raindrop and exit through any other raindrop falling from the same rainstorm that they so choose. The transportation is instant, like stepping though a doorway, and you don't even have to step all the way though. When you only go partially though a pair of raindrops, say by just sticking your arm though, then the raindrops it entered and exited from will remain hanging in the air until the user pulls their arm back or steps all the way through.
summary: The ability to teleport though raindrops.
strengths: Travel quickly while it's raining.
Engage enemies from multiple, unpredictable directions.
weaknesses: Power only works while it's raining.
You will always get wet.
Can only enter and exit airborne raindrops.

name: Baconus Createus
description: You can finally have any type of bacon at any time.
summary: The ability to make bacon out of mid air
strengths: Good Bacon
weaknesses: You may not like Bacon.

name: Nebula Manipulation
description: The user can generate and manipulate nebulas, multi-colored clouds of dust and ionized gases from where planets and stars are born. The nebulas themselves can be shot at foes to envelope them in a suffocating, burning dust cloud, as well as create small-scale planets and stars. These can be manipulated like the nebulas. Planets are essentially rocks with molten cores, while stars are of course burning balls of incredible nuclear energy. Needless to say, they make for powerful projectile attacks.
summary: The ability to create and manipulate nebulas, the clouds which form planets and stars.
strengths: Create beautiful, multicolored clouds of burning dust and gas
Create planets and stars of varying sizes from nebulas for various purposes
You're immune to the effects of the nebula (burning, suffocation, etc. )
weaknesses: Can only create enough nebula to fill the average ballroom, and are exhausted upon doing such a feat
You're not immune to the effects of the planets and stars you create

name: Myth Power: Horae (Seasons1)
description: These Horae (Horai- Hours), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of the four seasons; winter, spring, summer and fall. As such, channeling Cheimon (Kheimon- Winter) allows one to psychically manipulate the seasons to bring forth winter weather at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive and teleport to anywhere where it is naturally winter. Furthermore, one can withstand cold. One can even psychically perceive, communicate with and compel anyone born in the season of winter at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Horae and their command over the essence of the four seasons
strengths: Psychically manipulate the seasons to bring forth winter weather at will
Psychically perceive and teleport to anywhere it is naturally winter; withstand cold
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel anyone born in the season of winter
weaknesses: Cannot psychically Time Travel to future/past winters until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically manipulate time during NATURAL winter until developed (NCN)
Olympian MythPowers and elemental MythPowers related to cold/winter provide immunity (NCN)

name: Hand Of Galochio
description: Upon summoning, a large hand will appear from the nearest body of water to assist you. It can grab and drown enemies, blast high-pressured water, push you out of the depths, turn to ice in cold weather, and do a bunch more.  If the moon phase is 'new', the Hand of Galochio will be extremely weak; if the moon phase is 'full', the Hand will be very powerful. You must be near water to perform the summon.
summary: The ability to summon a nonsentient hand made of water
strengths: Doesn't require concentration after summoning
Can appear from any source of water
Cannot be harmed by physical attacks
weaknesses: Must be near water to summon at all
Moon phase affects strength

name: Bloodline (Unique Version)
description: This power reverses the powers when they are given to the inheritor except for itself. E.g. fire to ice, absorb to reflect. 2 cL of blood must be consumed for transfer. This power can only be used 10 times and you still have powers after transfer. Your powers are also unstealable and unmimicable. This power is unnegatable, but can be done against your will.
summary: The ability to pass along an opposite version of one's powers by way of blood
strengths: Different set of powers for inheritor.
Doesn't require much blood.
weaknesses: One power can have multiple opposites.
Vampires and dhampires.
This power could be altered.

name: Thirteen Treasures: White Hilt
description: One of the 13 treasures of Britain, guarded by Merlin the demon-wizard. When drawn from its scabbard by a well born man, or a man of royal blood, this sword will burst into flames from the hilt to the tip.
summary: The ability to wield White-hilt, the sword of Rhydderch the Generous
strengths: Evil Princes, Queens or Kings will not be able to wield this sword.
weaknesses: You can only wield this sword if you are low-born.
If you are able to wield this sword, it will not be on fire.

name: Summon Clarent
description: Carent is known as the blade that killed King Arthur, but few know that it is Excalibur's twin. With this power, you can summon Clarent and use its many powers. Clarent can shoot fire, burn any creature cut with it and absorb the most painful memories of anything killed with it, then transfer those memories to its user. It is also indestructible and can fuse with Excalibur to create new Ley Gates which are used as portals to other Ley Gate locations around the world.
summary: The ability to summon Clarent, the ancient stone blade of Fire.
strengths: Control of Fire
Can create Ley Gates
The Sword is indestructible.
weaknesses: Absorb the most painful memories of killed enemies.
The sword is evil and may corrupt you.

name: Substance: Creator's Memory
description: This power works well with 'Substance: Chemical Creator. With Chemical Creator, you can only make and manipulate elements or compounds that have not been made before, and after that you can never summon them again because they are old. With this power, you can make the element or compound again, and it will still have the same properties that you made it have last time. But you cannot make new substances, only old ones.
summary: The ability to form "old" elements
strengths: Make elements and compounds that have already been found or made.
Works well with "Substance: Chemical Creator".
You can manipulate the substance as well.
weaknesses: Can't make new and undiscovered elements, just old and dicovered ones.
You would have all the known elements at your disposal, but if a bad guy had it, so would he/she.
Radioactivity, heat, cold, etc.

name: Delete This Scorching Upper
description: You could turn quickly and uppercut a firey cyclone to set your foe in flames.
summary: The ability to create a flamming tornado while uppercutting.
strengths: Your opponent will get dizzy and burned.
weaknesses: None.

name: Delete This Triad Fury
description: You can do some damage by using both fire and ice hurricane kicks using both legs (fire on your right and ice on your left) on your foe in which they'll be burned and frozen and then connect with a shocking blow uppercut by putting both fists together in a vertical high fashion motion.
summary: The ability to use both flaming & freezing hurricane kicks to your foe, then deliver a shocking uppercut.
strengths: a fight combo is not a power
weaknesses: a fight combo is not a power

name: Shoop Da Whoop!
description: Just like the internet meme, you are able to fire a massive blue laser out of your mouth. You are able to do this for any amount of time, anytime and anywhere you please, as long as you are able to say "Shoop da Whoop" or "I'mma firin mah lazar".
summary: The ability to fire a massive blue laser out of your mouth.
strengths: Element of suprise because you can call upon it very quick.
Massive lasers are always good for destroying your enemies.
You can use your mouth laser to provide free energy for the world.
weaknesses: You must say the key phrase (being gagged stops this).
The laser is hard to control while out.
You face turns into the Shoop Da Whoop face while using it.

name: Myth Power: Ceto's Strength
description: Ceto (Keto), in Greek myth, was the goddess of sea monsters; monstrous sea creatures, including whales, sharks, piranha, leeches, eels, etc. As such, channeling her allows one to swim well and survive underwater, which may be shared, by touch. In addition, one can psychically perceive, communicate with and command aquatic monsters, at will. Furthermore, one can psychically mimic the abilities of any aquatic monster at will. One can even shapeshift into nearly any aquatic monster at will.
summary: The ability to channel Ceto's command over the essence of sea monsters
strengths: Swim well and survive underwater (may be shared by touch)
Psychically perceive, communicate with and command sea monsters, at will
Psychically mimic the abilities of and shapeshift into nearly any sea monster, at will
weaknesses: Power does not apply to nice/non-monstrous aquatic critters (NCN)
Cannot teleport subjects to areas infested with sea monsters, by touch, until developed (NCN)
Aquatic/water/sea/ocean-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Soupification
description:
Imagine you are wrongly imprisoned in a maximum security cell, starving, lonely, and with no hope of escape... 

Well, thanks to this power, you can kill two birds with one stone! Escape the cell by liquifying the walls, and fill yourself up with some top quality homemade soup while you're at it! What's not to love? 

The flavour of the soup is loosely dependant on the colour of the object, and physical contact isn't necessarily required, although it makes it *much* easier. Soupifying is tiring!
summary: The ability to melt anything into a delicious (and surprisingly nutritious) soup.
strengths: Can melt pretty much anything into a gastronomically awesome broth.
Would never go hungry again.
Could probably never get trapped either. Always a plus.
weaknesses: You could get tired quite quickly, especially with long distance melting.
No real control over what flavour soup you get (benefit of surprise perhaps? ),

name: Internal Shield Burning
description: You can fire a blast that when it hits a shield causes that shield to light on fire on the inner surface. Inner surface for this power is the side closer to the one using the shield. The fire will last until the shield is destroyed or the enemy stops using it, whichever comes first.
summary: The ability to cause the inner surface of a shield to light on fire
strengths: An enemy's shield is now a liability for them.
weaknesses: Your enemy can stop using the shield and then start using it again and it won't be on fire anymore.

name: Toxic Wasting
description: Like the overview sayd, this is the ability to use toxins to burn through anything and/or use it to make anyone pass out.
summary: The ability to use toxins to burn through anything and/or use it to make anyone pass out.
strengths: Can get you to the crime scene faster.
Able to make a robber pass out so police can take him away.
It can burn away bombs.
weaknesses: If you use it the wrong way, you could kill yourself.
If you try to burn away a wall in the wrong place it could fall and kill or hurt you.
You could be considered evil.

name: Krakens Rage
description: This ability summons the kraken that will help you on under water missions by attacking enemies. It can attack up to 100 enemies at once.
summary: The ability to summon the kraken
strengths: Protection
Strength
Agility
weaknesses: Death
Can't use for another minute
Can be defeated

name: Myth Power: Physis' Feat
description: Physis (Phusis), in Greek myth, was the goddess of the origin and ordering of nature. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive natural landforms (trees, hills, rivers, caves, etc), weather patterns, season shifts, etc, at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive and manipulate the elements of nature, at will. Furthermore, one can psychically adapt one's body to survive in any natural environment at will. One can even withstand all attacks based on the elements of nature.
summary: The ability to channel Physis' command over the essence of the origin and the ordering nature
strengths: Psychically perceive natural landforms (bodies of water, etc), weather, seasons, etc at will
Psychically perceive and manipulate the elements of four nature (earth, water, fire, air) at will
Psychically adapt one's body to survive in any environment; withstand elemental attacks
weaknesses: Pro #2 cannot branch out into other elements (metal, sand, plants, etc) until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically perceive, communicate with and command animals until devloped (NCN)
Cannot grant or gain a physics-defying wish (1 wish per use) until developed (NCN)

name: De Ethanol
description: This ability allows you to remove alcohol from drinks, living things, and other things. You do this by either turning ethanol (alcohol) into water or making the ethanol disappear. You can remove ethanol from drinks and then drink it. You can sober yourself or others by removing ethanol from their blood. If you don't use this power responsibly, you'll end up being a party pooper. You are not immune to alcohol. This power requires some concentration.
summary: The ability to mentally remove the ethanol (drinking alcohol) from drinks, people and other things.
strengths: Remove the alcohol from drinks and people's bloodstream.
Can also sober people or yourself up.
Can be turned off.
weaknesses: You are not immune to alcohol.
If you mess up, you'll be the party pooper.
Requires some concentration.

name: Flamabilitising
description: Your power makes other people or items flammable. This is useful if you want something burnt, but you can't produce fire and you can't control the flammability power.
summary: The ability to make others flammable
strengths: See painful deaths
Getting rid of obstacles easily
weaknesses: Can't produce fire
Can't control flammability amount.

name: Vibrating Hands And Feet
description: this power allows someone to vibrate their hands and feet.it is strong enough to reach 10.5 on the richtor scale and can demolish nearly any structure.one must be extreemly careful while using this power however because it can cause them harm via falling rubble or they can fall into the earth as it crumbles beneath them.they can also use the power to fire a shockwave from their hands to knock back objects or use this tecnique with their feet to jump very high.
summary: The ability to vibrate your hands and feet
strengths: demolish buildings or underground structures
cause a tidal wave
jump high
weaknesses: can harm self
less powerful in soft soil
can "accidently" cause a volcanic erruption

name: Tetris Rain
description: With this power, you can cause tetris blocks to rain from the sky around you. The tetris blocks can be rotated and moved telepathically. You do not choose the type of tetris block, but you can determine the size of the block. You can make it rain more than one block at once, though it is harder to control that many blocks. Anything caught within a row of tetris blocks will be destroyed like the video game.
summary: The ability to cause tetris blocks to rain from the sky
strengths: You can move the tetris blocks telepathically when they are still in the sky
You can walk on the tetris blocks with no problem
If the blocks create a row, anything within that row is destroyed, even non-blocks
weaknesses: The tetris blocks are not homing and need to be controlled
You cannot choose the shape of the tetris block
The longer you use this power, the higher you need to keep climbing

name: Human Fortress
description: While you look normal on the outside, you actually have an internal structure made of stone, similar to a fortress with passageways and rooms. Doors and windows of any size can be opened anywhere on your body. Whenever you allow someone or something to enter, they automatically shrink to half an inch on their way through the door. And whenever someone or something comes out of the fortress, they automatically return to their real size.
summary: The ability to be a human-size stone fortress for your allies.
strengths: You can become a headquarters, bunker and home for your allies.
While you look alone, you actually have an army with you.
You can store a lot of things in your body: animals, furnitures, weapons, food,...
weaknesses: Your body is VERY heavy.
If you move too quickly, it feels like an earthquake inside you.

name: Old One Power: Azathoth
description: Azathoth, the blind and mindless monarch of the Outer Gods. You can control the nuclear chaos to create blasts of potentially unlimited power. Even more potent is your ability to summon and command the Lesser Outer Gods. Dumb as bugs, but if you can get them to understand, their potency is unmatched by anything on Earth. They themselves are invincible, but they will flee if exposed to too much pain. If you use a flute, you can command stellar phenomenon, and gain much more control of your power.
summary: The ability to channel the power of the Outer God Azathoth
strengths: Your offensive power is unbelievable if the opponent can't block or divert it.
You can also summon GODS at will! Muhahaha! Unfortunately, while friendly, they're entirely muscle.
For once, the granter of your powers does not care AT ALL what you do. Just don't summon him.
weaknesses: Your vision clouds as you use your power, and it's uncontrollable in the first place.
The Lesser Other Gods are horror incarnate, and WILL destroy anything you love if you're not careful
Might become a LOG when you die, going insane and becoming utterly mindless. Or you just die.

name: The Krusader
description: The krusader is a combined element of a sword and shield, and it can be used for defensive purposes, but is also used as a offensive tool, but you can even slash your opponents with the krusader in an upward swing, spin it circularly around you knocking the foe up into the air if it connects, and/or slightly forward and delivers an open horizontal slice to your enemy. Can even deflect bullets and other projectiles.
summary: The ability to use it for protection and to slash your opponents.
strengths: Can use it for defence & offence.
weaknesses: None.

name: Yokai: Raiju
description: In Japanese mythology, the Raiju was recognized as a beast that fell to the earth as a lightning bolt. A raiju may appear as a giant weasel or a blue and white wolf wrapped in lightning or fire. As a raiju you are able to bound through the air crashing down upon your victims with a thunderous aftermath. Your claws also act as small lightning strikes.
summary: The ability to undergo a transformation into a Japanese monster or spirit.
strengths: Very destructive.
Strike down those who oppose you.
Let out thunderous howls that cause enemies to go deaf.
weaknesses: Could wipe out loved ones or friends that are in the way.

name: Neurotoxic Breath
description: Neurotoxic breath can do a number of things. You can manipulate it to paralyze, burn, freeze, melt, and even kill. This power is controlled so you don't accidentally melt somebody's eyes while walking down the street. But the effects are only momentary. So if you kill somebody, they will be revived in a matter of time, it depends on how much poison they have inhaled.
summary: The ability to emit poisons from your mouth when you exhale.
strengths: Great defensive power.
Great offensive power.
weaknesses: Only a range of 10 feet.
The effects are only momentary.

name: Water Sensing
description: You can sense where water is all over the world. You could also 'see' the water, kind of like x-ray vision. It appears as light blue lines with thickness depending on the amount of water. You know where water is all over the world in all its forms (ice, steam, mist etc) and know how much of it there is, where it is and how its being affected.
summary: The ability to sence water globally
strengths: Get some of the weather right
Won't hammer accidentally into a pipe
Just really cool if you like water
weaknesses: Not exactly dynamic
So you know where water is, then what?
If you don't turn it off, the information/blue glowing lines may drive you insane

name: Allergy Inducer
description: With this power you can cause people to be allergic to any food. You can only make people allergic to one thing each so you can't make a person allergic to everything. Additionally this power also only applies to food not liquids, pollen, air, animals etc. You are not able to cure a person's allergies once you infect them.
summary: The ability to cause people to be allergic to things
strengths: You can make people allergic to any food
weaknesses: You can't cure them
Only applies to food
One allergy per person

name: Icicle Rain
description: With this power you can cause giant icicles to fall from the sky. The icicles are super sharp and fall extremely fast so they can cut through a person pretty easily.
summary: The ability to cause giant icicles to fall from the sky
strengths: You can cause giant icicles to fall from the sky
The icicles are super sharp and fall extremely fast
weaknesses: You might accidentally kill an innocent person

name: Passive Clothing Empowerment
description: This ability allows the user to extend the effects of their abilities, particularly physical ones, to the items they wear. If you are immune to fire, so will your clothing. If you are bulletproof, your jacket will not get holes in it when fired at. The clothing, however, does not gain any powers or enhance your abilities in any way. The clothing has the same weaknesses as the one providing it with powers. The empowerment is instantaneous but fades just as quickly when clothing is removed.
summary: The ability to extend your abilities to your clothing.
strengths: Never accidentally destroy your clothing through use of powers again.
No longer need special equipment.
Some clothing may improve power use; clothing can now absorb sunlight for you, for instance.
weaknesses: The clothes do not gain any other power/s.
You are not additionally empowered in any way by your clothing.
Clothing is only empowered while actually worn.

name: Arceusforce: Icicle
description: The user of this ability can channel the cold heart of the Pokegod, Arceus, taking the form of its Ice-type. The user's skin turns light blue, their irises turn white. Under their frigid guise, the user has the resistances, weaknesses and immunities of an Ice-type Pokemon, translated to real world equivalents. They are also able to channel and manipulate many Ice attacks such as Ice Beam, Aurora Beam, Icicle Spear, Blizzard and more.
summary: The ability to channel the power of Arceus's Ice form.
strengths: The user can resist other ice-based attacks.
Generation and manipulation of ice, cold and aurora for Ice attacks
weaknesses: The user is weak to fire, supernatural combat, mineral and metal-based attacks.
This power may be too powerful for the user. May need to be unlocked from the default form.
Ice is probably the weakest defensive type.

name: Summoning: Amaterasu
description: Amaterasu, the Sun Goddess. Her power is now yours. She can use a flame that will never extinguish until those she targets are burned to ashes.
summary: The ability to summon Amaterasu.
strengths: Flames.
Powerful flame attacks.
weaknesses: Same as all Summons.

name: Myth Power: Notion Of The Nesoi
description: The Nesoi, in Greek myth, were the goddesses of islands. As such, channeling them allows one to selectively perceive present and future weather conditions and natural phenomena on any island throughout the Cosmos. One may also use this power to sense the layout of any island at will (including any supposedly hidden features, such as treasure and magical landmarks). In addition, one may teleport to any island at will, and one's attributes are enhanced as long as one is on an island
summary: The ability to channel the Nesoi and their command over the essence of islands and island life
strengths: Knowledge of any island in existence (location, layout, present/future weather conditions, etc. )
Teleport to any island at will
Stats (strength, durability, reflexes, etc. ) are enhanced for as long as you are on an island
weaknesses: Cannot alter an island's weather until the higher levels
Not every island is habitable
At the lower levels, stat enhancement gets weaker the further you are from the center of an island

name: Moon Manipulation
description: Moon Manipulators get great advantages with this power. With it they control it's distances; making it farther away or extremly close. Control the ocean tides, affect the rocks, and even control the moon's gravity.
summary: The ability to control the moon.
strengths: Have a great view at night by making a full moon.
Make tidal waves for offense by pulling the moon closer.
Make night come faster.
weaknesses: Moving it too much will knock it out of orbit.
Changing the axis and creating dangerous climate.
If it's destroyed you have no power over it anymore.

name: Human Fire Extinguisher
description: With this power, you can be like a human fire extinguisher (hence the name) and shoot fire retardant foam from your hands. The foam comes out rather quickly and with a lot of force, so it can also be used to injure enemies or push them away or into walls.
summary: The ability to shoot fire retardant foam from your hands
strengths: You can put out fires
You can injure your enemies
You never run out of foam
weaknesses: It doesn't hurt that much

name: Power Backup
description: This power lets you burn to CD any power you have(including this one). All you do is hold a CD between your palms for 20 minutes and you've got a backup power. Make multiple copies of any power. A lost power(including this one) can be restored in 2 minutes by holding the CD between your hands. These CDs only work for you. Someone else with this power could detect them if he was 10 feet or closer. Your CDs can't be affected by any power-altering power. You can use rewritable CDs.
summary: The ability to store copies of your powers on CD
strengths: Make multiple copies and hide them anywhere you might go
Carry them with you
These power CD's work even if badly scratched.
weaknesses: You break the last copy of a power and you've just lost that power
You keep them all in one location and someone finds your stash
If you can't afford to buy blank CD's.

name: Lava Rain
description: With this power you can cause scolding hot molten lava to fall from the sky wherever and whenever you want. The lava can burn through almost anything and once the lava hits the ground you cannot make it disappear.
summary: The ability to cause lava to rain from the sky
strengths: You can make scolding hot molten lava to fall from the sky
The lava can burn through almost anything
weaknesses: You might harm innocent people
Once the lava hits the ground you cannot make it disappear

name: Pizza Maker
description: You can create pizza out of thin air. In battle, you can have a slice of pizza whenever you want.
summary: The ability to create pizza out of thin air
strengths: Tasty pizza whenever you want
weaknesses: You can't control the toppings

name: Red Rain
description: You are able to create a burning crimson rainstorm that affects all things everywhere and can hit several times before disappearing.
summary: The ability to create red-colored raindrops that dissolve everything
strengths: No one is invulnerable to it, especally like golems and androids.
weaknesses: If it gets out of control, it'll try to dissolve everyone, even you might get burned by it.

name: Panontic Arch:Panhydri
description: Panhydri,the entirely liquid dimension. You gain immunity to water pressure and dehydration. Your body acts as a sponge. You can soak up anything liquid. Your body acts a conduit to the panhydri dimension. You feel no effects of any liquid you soak up. Poisons,acids,liquid nitrogen won't affect you. You could absorb a liquid being by touch. You could in theory absorb the oceans of the world.
summary: The ability to gain powers the Panhydri dimension.
strengths: Immunity to liquid based attacks.
You can absorb water elemental types.
weaknesses: While you can explore the deepest areas of the ocean,you still need oxygen.

name: Crodo: Ban Hammer
description: Once the user of this hammer hits the selected target,it will be banned from earth either sending them to heaven or hell.
summary: The ability to wield a ban hammer.
strengths: Ban someone from earth.
weaknesses: Easy to dodge.

name: Two Headed Dragon Summon
description: With this power you can summon a two headed dragon that is under your complete control. The dragon has a quirk though (aside from the two head thing) one of it's heads breathes fire while the other one breathes ice. The dragon can also fly, is super strong and has extremely sharp teeth in both of its mouths.
summary: The ability to summon a two headed dragon
strengths: You can summon a two headed dragon.
One of its heads breathes fire while the other breathes ice.
It can fly is super strong and has really sharp teeth in both of its mouths.
weaknesses: You can only summon one so if it dies you loose this power.

name: Darkcalibur
description: With this power, you can possess Darkcalibur. Perhaps one of most disturbing powers, Darkcalibur is a very large, black-grayish silver sword in the stone attributed with evil magical powers or associated with the dark arts.  Thrust it and a dark, nocturnal beam comes out to damage your enemies.
summary: The ability to possess the Darkcalibur sword. It fires a powerful dark beam to damage your enemies.
strengths: None to be exact.
weaknesses: It can only be used by Evildoers.

name: Myth Power: Ceraunobolia Strike
description: Ceraunobolia (Keraunobolia), in Greek myth, was the goddess of the thunderbolt (simultaneous lightning flash and thunder crash). As such, channeling her allows one to psychically generate electricity at will, which simultaneously amplifies all ambient sound. In addition, one can absorb natural sound and electricity to gain physical power. One can even psychically perceive, communicate with, and compel those who are afraid of thunder and lightning, and teleport to the site of thunderbolt strikes
summary: The ability to channel Ceraunobolia's command over the essence of the thunderbolt
strengths: Psychically generate electricity, simultaneously amplifying all ambient sound into a sonic boom
Absorb sound and electricity to gain physical power at will; teleport to thunderbolt sites
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel those who fear thunder and lightning
weaknesses: Pro #1 does not automatically home in to strike only foes until developed (NCN)
Cannot cause sounds to automatically produce accompanying electricity until developed (NCN)
Electrokinesis, Electrical Immunity, MythPower: Zeus' Zenith and the like provide immunity

name: Dr. Octagonapus
