description: With this power you can cause bowling balls (of any weight and color) to fall from the sky wherever and whenever you want. You can cause very heavy bowling balls to fall from the sky (though pretty much any kind of bowling ball will probably kill somebody when falling from the sky) in order to kill your enemies or smash car roofs (or any roofs really). You cannot make the bowling balls go back up into the sky
summary: The ability to make bowling balls fall from the sky
strengths: You can cause bowling balls to fall from the sky
You can make them any weight and color you want
weaknesses: You can't send them back up into the sky

name: Crop Circles
description: With this power you can create crop circles with your mind. Your range spans the entire Earth, so you don't have to be near the place.
summary: The ability to create crop circles with your mind
strengths: You can scare farmers and the government
weaknesses: No real use that I can think of for combat

name: Celtic Invocation: Habetrot
description: By calling on the power of Habetrot, the invoker may weave thread from anything. Fire, light, wool, flax, gold, shadow, etc. Those items woven out of 'unnatural' thread have obvious properties, for example, shadow clothing allows the wearer to blend into darkness. However, normal thread can be given unique properties also, especially regarding health and healing. Those who wear the clothing spun and woven by someone who uses this ability never get sick, and heal at ten times the normal rate.
summary: The ability to call on the power of Habetrot, a Celtic goddess of spinning.
strengths: The clothing you wear can be a weapon.
No need to spend so much money on brands now.
Make great gifts for friends and family!
weaknesses: The powers only work through thread spun and woven by the invoker.
Not much offensive use-only the objects made have use.
One must always be aware of fashion and it's constant changes.

name: Water To Soda
description: With this power you can turn water into any type of soda. This power works with both fresh water and salt water and you can turn any amount of water into any soda. So you can change an entire ocean into Coca Cola or just a cup of water in Pepsi or any other amount of water and soda.
summary: The ability to turn water into any type of soda
strengths: You can turn any amount of water into any type of soda
weaknesses: You cannot change the soda back into water

name: Myth Power: Glaucus' Glance
description: Glaucus (Glaukos), in Greek myth, was the god of seafarers (sailors, fishermen, divers and castaways), the shore's shallow waters and shipwreck. As such, channeling him allows one to swim well and survive underwater, which may be shared, by touch. In addition, one can psychically perceive and teleport to any body of water at will. Furthermore, one gains numerous seafaring skills. One can even psychically generate and manipulate a magic herb that may be smelled or chewed for different effects.
summary: The ability to channel Glaucus' command over the essence of seafarers, shallow waters on the shore and shipwreck
strengths: Swim well and survive underwater (may be shared by touch)
Psychically perceive and teleport to any body of water at will; skill in fishing, sailing and diving
Psychically generate and manipulate magic herb; smell= psychic insight, chew= aquatic transformation
weaknesses: Part 3 of Pro #3 produces a RANDOM Aquatic Transformation until developed (NCN)
Cannot give self a mermaid tail at will (others by touch), until developed (NCN)
Aquatic/water/sea/ocean-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Summoning: Susanoo
description: Susanoo, brother of Amaterasu Tsukuyomi, god of storms. He can control fierce winds and terrifying lightning.
summary: The ability to summon Susanoo.
strengths: Summon Susanoo.
Power of wind and lightning
weaknesses: Same as all Summons.

name: Myth Power: Satyromania
description: The Satyrs, in Greek myth, were the randy gods of wilderness fertility. As such, channeling them allows one to communicate with animals as though by normal conversation, tempt subjects into unleashing their wild sides, and sing, dance and play music entrancingly (especially on panpipes). Natural features also respond to your emotions (fires growing in intensity, winds stirring up, etc).
summary: The ability to channel the Satyrs and their command over the essence of wilderness fertility
strengths: Speak to animals
Your music, dancing and singing inspires loosening of inhibitions and heightened sexuality
Nature responds to your emotions
weaknesses: Entrancing singing, dancing and music-playing makes people ADORE you (not always a good thing)
People with MythPower: Nympholepsy are extremely attracted to you
Cannot actually control animals (just communicate to them, and they understand you, and vice versa)

name: Piemaker
description: The Piemaker ability lets you make pies that give superpowers to the eater, depending on the special ingredient. Putting gold in a pie could give you the Midas Touch, putting stones in a pie could give you Rock Skin. You are also immune to poisons, or anything that could kill you as long as it is in a pie.
summary: The ability to make superpowered pie
strengths: You can have any superpower you want.
You can give anyone else a superpowered pie.
You are immune to death or injury by anything pie-related.
weaknesses: Pests may eat the pie, and get superpowers.
The pies may poison other people. Arsenic Pie is okay for you, but not for others.
It kinda sucks if you cannot cook.

name: Summon Joyeuse
description: Joyeuse is the least famous of the four swords of power. Its abilities include moving earth and turning enemies to stone with one cut. It is indestructible and can fuse with its twin, Durendal, to create new Ley Gates which act as portals to other Ley Gate locations around the worlds.
summary: The ability to summon Joyeuse , the ancient sword of Earth.
strengths: Control earth
Turn enemies to stone
Create Ley Gates.
weaknesses: Must be fused with Joyeuse to summone Ley Gates.

name: Myth Power: Pact Of The Potamoi
description: The Potamoi, in Greek myth, were the gods and goddesses of rivers. As such, channeling them allows one to selectively perceive present and future weather conditions and natural phenomena at any river throughout the Cosmos. One may also use this power to sense the layout of any river at will (including any supposedly hidden features, such as treasure and magical landmarks). In addition, one may teleport to any river at will, and one's attributes are enhanced as long as one is in or on a river.
summary: The ability to channel the Potamoi and their command over the essence of rivers
strengths: Knowledge of any river in existence (location, layout, present/future weather conditions, etc. )
Teleport to any river at will
Stats (strength, durability, reflexes, etc. ) are enhanced for as long as you are in or on a river
weaknesses: Cannot alter an river's weather until the higher levels
Not every river is habitable
At the lower levels, stat enhancement gets weaker the further you are from a river

name: Copper Crown
description: The Copper Crown is a powerful, mystical and very dangerous object which is worn upon the head. It confers the ability to fire pinkish flames from it and attack anything and everything in its path. With each victim, its power increases. At a point when it becomes powerful enough, the crown can animate all its copper statue victims into a mindless, obedient zombie-like army at your control.
summary: The ability to use it turn people in shiny red-orange statue zombies.
strengths: It can erase memories.
It can read and control minds (anyone within the sound of the voice of the one wearing the crown).
weaknesses: It is weak against fire and electric types.

name: Snow Stop
description: With this power you can stop snowing from falling to the ground while it is in the air. You can keep the snow frozen in time for as long as you want and while it's stuck in the air no new snow can fall. Only you can unfreeze the snow and allow it to fall to the ground.
summary: The ability to stop snow midfall
strengths: You can freeze snow in the air for as long as you want
Only you can allow the snow to continue to fall
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat

name: Society Degredation
description: At will, an event will cause the whole of civilization to become less advanced in science, philosophy, and morality. This leads open the chance for the user to become a leader with their knowledge as it would be advanced compared to the rest of the world. Something will physically happen for society to degrade, such as a terrible plague or famine, a devastating war, some crazy fanatic religious destruction of knowledge, or a virus that hijacks all known electronics and destroys them.
summary: The ability to intellectually and morally downgrade society
strengths: You soon become the smartest and most advanced person on Earth
You can easily rule the world with the knowledge you already have
You could be long remembered as a great teacher to all mankind
weaknesses: People become mean, stupid, and ignorant
If you overuse it, people may become so stupid they will never learn anything from you
It would be hard to find a good friend or start a relationship with everyone being idiots and jerks.

name: Summon Leviathan V2
description: With this power you can summon the robotic crab like monster from the movie Atlantis. It can operate on land, water and air. It has large claw like arms that can crush ships and presumably people. It is under your complete control. You can send it back whenever you want.
summary: The ability to summon the robotic crablike monster from the movie Atlantis
strengths: You can summon a robot crab minion
Its under your complete control
You can unsummon it
weaknesses: It can be destroyed

name: Boulder Rain V2
description: With this power you can make boulders fall from the sky. However unlike the original Boulder Rain power these boulders are not round and therefore cannot roll once they hit the ground. You can make them any other shape you want so you can build fortresses, statues or just crush people or things.
summary: The ability to cause boulders to fall from the sky
strengths: You can make boulders fall from the sky
You can build fortresses out of the boulders
You can crush enemy fortresses
weaknesses: They are not round so they will not roll once they hit the ground

name: Zodiac: Pisces
description: By drawing the sign of Pisces the Fishes in the air, you create 1 fish that bestows a random power upon those whom it touches. The fish looks slightly holographic and can swim through the air. The fish can look like any type of living or extinct fish. You get to choose the species.
summary: The ability to create fishes that bestow random powers by drawing the sign of Pisces the Fishes
strengths: Can give powers to those who want them.
You get to choose the species of fish.
weaknesses: The power is always random...
Have to draw the sign of Pisces each time you want to create 1 fish.

name: Delete This Ard Whirlwind Kick
description: You can proceed on to deliver a barrage of freezing hurricane kicks, horizontally across anywhere and then finish them off with a final, most damaging frosting hurricane kick to freeze them solid and they'll shatter when they hit the ground.
summary: The ability to send the opponent to the edge with an Icy Hurricane Kick.
strengths: The move can also pass through projectiles and also wears them out.
weaknesses: None.

name: Zman Box Shields
description: With this superpower, you can have boxlike transparent shields. The shield only permits objects that move below a certain speed to enter. Because you need air, the speed limit can only be set at 3mph or higher. The only way to get past the sheild is to move slower than 3mph.
summary: The ability to have boxlike transparent shields that protect you from objects that move faster than a certain speed
strengths: Shields
Protected from fast things
Defying/altering the shields takes more time than passing them at 3mph
weaknesses: Shield allows slow enough objects to enter.
Speed limit of shield is 3mph or higher because you need to breathe.
Sheilds are boxlike.

name: Indigestibility
description: With this ability, you can not be digested when eaten by another being, whether if swallowed whole or in bites. Immune to digestive acids and enzymes, you will pass through the digestive tract unharmed. This power works best if swallowed whole by something really big. Chunks of you could rejoin together if paired with regenerative abilities. Most digestive tracts are anaerobic, so depending on other powers, you may have to hold your breath or have an air supply.
summary: The ability to be indigestible
strengths: Don't really have to worry about being eaten
weaknesses: The egress may be icky

name: Firefly Hunter
description: You can summon fireflies out of any material, and if they already exist, they flock to you.
summary: The ability to summon fireflies at will
strengths: You can make light without energy bills or fire hazards
Always have a lamp handy
Bug your enemies
weaknesses: You are swarmed at night constantly

name: Vam Power: Akasha's Demise
description: This power makes vampirism of ANY kind extremely dangerous. If a normal vampire drains your blood, or a psychic vampire attempts to drain your intelligence, or a life-drainer attempts to rob you of your life-force, they will feel compelled to drain you (or any other victim) to the dregs. However, when they are done, they will turn to stone, just like the vampires in the movie "Queen of the Damned". And a few minutes after they're done draining you, YOU come back to life, completely unharmed.
summary: The ability to bring death to anyone who attempts to drain the essence from you or others
strengths: Resist vampirism, life-force drain, knowledge absorption, power absorption, psychometry, etc.
Help others resist vampiric/draining/absorbing attacks as well
ANYTHING that causes a drain on the body will be turned to stone (if it isn't already)
weaknesses: Makes blood donation awkward...
Immutable vampires or vampires with Reanimation powers... O,O
If you have Endless Blood, this power's kinda moot...

name: Claymore: Ability Absorption
description: This gives you a set of claymores; anyone who is struck by the sword will lose every single power that they have, unless they have power protection. The claymore looks like the cold steel Italian long sword.
summary: The ability to posses a claymore that can steal powers by striking them
strengths: You can absorb all of there powers by striking them
Anyone who gets close to this sword will die
Arthur Petrelli version but without physical contact
weaknesses: dont touch your friends with this sword
You live by the sword you will die by the sword
you can only have one claymore (no con negation)

name: Hailraiser
description: You can create a deadly hailstorm that affects all things everywhere, can even send down shards of barraging hail that fall down both horizontally & diagonally.
summary: The ability to call fourth a long lasting hailstorm.
strengths: The attack lasts for a prolonged period of time.
As you would expect this power is devastating to opponents caught in it.
weaknesses: It will not affect fire/magma type enemies.

name: Touch From Hell
description: Anything that come contact with the user's palm will be set ablaze, even if the object touched is something that shouldn't burn, such as seawater. Only the user's limbs are unaffected by this.
summary: The ability to set anything ablaze just by touching them.
strengths: Touch anything you hate and watch them burn.
Has some entertainment value.
weaknesses: Everyone will panick with you around.
Anything that's set ablaze is irreversible.
No touching yourself (rubbing your tummy)

name: Myth Power: Palaemon's Playtime
description: Palaemon (Palaimon), in Greek myth, was the god of ports and harbors. As such, channeling him allows one to swim well and survive underwater. In addition, one can teleport to any body of water at will. Furthermore, if one falls or is thrown, one is teleported on impact into an extradimensional 'Harbor Space' at will. One can also step into the Harbor Space at one location, and step out of it at another location, at will. One can even psychically perceive impending dangers (storms, etc) at will.
summary: The ability to channel Palaemon's command over the essence of safe ports and harbors
strengths: Swim well and survive underwater
Travel into customizable 'Harbor Space', and use it for shelter/storage/capture or Teleportation
Psychically perceive impending dangers (attackers, poison, storms, etc) at will
weaknesses: Cannot psychically access boating/sailing/fishing knowledge until developed (NCN)
Cannot gain favor with sea creatures or turn vehicles into boats, by touch, until developed (NCN)
Automatic favor with sea creatures (mythical or not) means they LOVE you

name: Fire Flower
description: These flowers are able to spew fire, similar to a flamethrower, but these are shorter and spew more fire.
summary: The ability to turn normal flowers into flowers that spew fire.
strengths: This fire burns through most things.
weaknesses: The fire doesn't burn through everything.
This power is negated if close to someone with Water Flower.

name: Myth Power: Doris' Delight
description: Doris, in Greek myth, was the goddess of the mingling of freshwater and salt water, which makes for ripe breeding grounds for fish. As such, channeling her allows one to swim well and survive underwater. In addition, one can psychically manipulate water, at will. Furthermore, one can change fresh water into salt water, by touch, at will. One can also teleport to any body of water (fresh or salt) at will. One can even psychically perceive, communicate with, replicate and command fish, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Doris' command over the essence of the mingling of freshwater and salt water
strengths: Swim well and survive underwater; psychically manipulate water (produce salt/fresh water, etc)
Psychically teleport self and others to any body of fresh or salt water, at will
Psychically perceive, communicate with, replicate and command fish, at will
weaknesses: DO. NOT. DRINK. SALT. WATER.
Cannot manipulate salt content in subjects' blood until developed (NCN)
Aquatic/water/sea/ocean-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Summon Head Of Medusa
description: With this power you can summon the head of the Mythical Gorgon, Medusa. You can use her decapitated head to petrify your enemies. You cannot reverse the effects of the head and if you look at it yourself you will turn to stone.
summary: The ability to summon the Head of Medusa
strengths: You can petrify your enemies
You can sell your petrified enemies as super realistic sculptures and make some money
weaknesses: Medusa's gorgon sisters might come after you for revenge
You cannot reverse the effects of the head
If you look at it yourself you will turn to stone

name: Transformers: Inferno
description: With this power you can shoot rockets from your hand. The rockets blow up as soon as they hit anything causing a good amount of damage and chaos. And the rockets are on fire! The fire doesn't actually do much except for look really cool and maybe provide some light. A side effect of this power causes you to want to become a fireman; how this is reconciled with the whole flaming rocket thing is up to the user.
summary: The ability to shoot flaming rockets from your hands
strengths: You can shoot rockets from your hands
The rockets are on fire
weaknesses: The fire doesn't really add much to the rockets

name: Reincarnation 3: Object
description: This power allows the user to put an "anchor" into an object. This allows your soul to remain on earth unless all anchors are destroyed. However, to do this, you need to "link" someone else to the anchor. It will then become an anchor when they die. However, they have to agree to this for it to work. Also, it has to have a special connection or meaning to both of you. Unfortunately, Con Negation and similar powers do not work for this.
summary: The ability to save sections of your soul in objects.
strengths: Live forever, if you protect the anchors well enough.
Save the lives of others while doing this.
Object-affecting powers which apply to other objects will work on these objects.
weaknesses: Need people to work with you.
Must be symbolic, significant or special to both of you.
Losing your body with no way of reviving or interacting with the outside world.

name: Water To Blood
description: With this power you can turn any amount of water into undrinkable blood; this doesn't just apply to normal humans; this blood is also undrinkable to vampires and other blood-drinkers, and will cause even them to fall sick if they try to ingest it. It's not viral or bacteria-infected, just not drinkable. Fortunately, you can reverse the effects of this power anytime you want.
summary: The ability to turn water into blood
strengths: Can turn enemy water supplies undrinkable (and reverse the process anytime)
Turn random people's water into blood then charge them a dollar to turn it back
Make tons of money at the blood bank (can't be drunk, but it can still be used otherwise normally)
weaknesses: Can't use this to feed your vampire friends
Some people with this power can't reverse it
Some people with this power can only turn small amounts into blood at a time

name: Zombie Chicken Army
description: With this power you can raise an army of zombie chickens from the dead. All you have to do is find a dead chicken, look at it, snap your fingers and the dead chicken will become a green zombie chicken. The zombie chickens are under your complete control and you can use this power on as many dead chickens as you want. The only way these zombie chickens can die is by fire or explosion, nothing else.
summary: The ability to create an army of zombie chickens
strengths: You can raise an army of zombie chickens from the dead
You can have as many zombie chickens as you want
They can only be killed by fire or explosion anything else and they will come right back to life
weaknesses: If they are killed by fire or explosion, you are not able to resurrect them
Can't find any dead chickens to begin with
They are stupid and weak; if you don't constantly tell them what to do they'll just mess things up

name: Kusanagi
description: The Kusanagi Sword, or Ame-no-Murakumo (Heaven's Cloud), is a ceremonial weapon not meant to be primarily to be used in hand to hand combat. In the hands of someone with high magical potential, it shows its true colors. With it, you can manipulate the air to create blades made out of air. If you have enough magical power and control, you can manipulate the static in the air to create electricity. At its max, this sword can control the weather.
summary: The ability to wield the Kusanagi sword
strengths: Manipulates air to achieve multiple affects
A divine level weapon
weaknesses: Consumes lots of magical energy
Needs to be at a distance to unlock full potential

name: Delete This Giga Apocalypse
description: You can start off by turning yourself into a powerful tornado and your eyes'll glow white-silver. Once you connect, it'll attract your opponents towards you. If caught, your opponents are hit by a storm of blows and are sent out flying and falling once the move is done.
summary: The ability to start spinning towards your enemies. Then, they'll be sent flying and falling.
strengths: a fight combo is not a power
weaknesses: None.

name: R.P.S.
description: When you play rock paper scissors, you can get one of the following powers along with their weaknesses. If you win with Rock: You can control rocks, turn into rock, and smash any sharp object(but not through paper). If you win with Paper: You can control paper, morph into paper, and wrap anything in paper(except sharp edges). If you win with Scissors: You can manipulate metal, morph into metal, and cut anything except rocks.
summary: The ability to make rock, paper, scissors real
strengths: Each power is useful in different scenarios
If your enemy subconsciously holds out a fist or hand or claw it is treated as playing
You can play as many times as you want until you get your power
weaknesses: Each power has obvious weaknesses
You must play Rock, Paper, Scissors to activate this power and you cannot ask someone to lose
You must "win" in order to activate the power

name: Budget Limited Superpowers
description: This power allows the user to use special effects that work in real life. For example, they can fly because of strings attached to their back. However, every time they use their power, they lose money to pay people. You can use telepathy relatively easily with this power. However, flying and fire is limited, and explosions are limited as well, but immortality is definitely doable.
summary: The ability to be as powerful as your budget or your sponsors allow
strengths: Have superpowers that do not cost a lot of money to emulate(telepathy, etc.)
Pay to have telekinesis or flight
Be the most sought after stuntperson in Hollywood
weaknesses: Some of the cooler superpowers are expensive to use
You need to shell out cash to use your powers

name: Enhancement: Windy
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached it surrounds the created item or transformed body part with wind. If stolen, it will permanently enhance the power it is attached to. This power can only be attached to one power at a time.
summary: The ability to surround an item created or transformed body part with wind
strengths: Surrounding something with wind will help give protection or increase amount of damage possible.
Previous pro is based on how the wind around the object is utilized.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
The wind cannot move more than two centimetres from the item.

name: Freezing Kiss Of Death
description: You would blow an icy kiss in the direction of your opponent, freezing them solid, but it can affect them in many ways, like if they are in a frozen state, their heart can be seen beating at an abnormally fast rate in their chest for a few seconds before it bursts, could fall over and shatter upon contact with the floor, leaving it in a mess of ice and bones, or you can give your enemy a kiss on the cheek, that'll instantly turn them into an icy statue which explodes.
summary: The ability to blow a kiss that would freeze your opponent.
strengths: You could do it sadistically, like exhaling an icy mist at your opponent which freezes them dead.
weaknesses: This power can only work for females.

name: Demonic Weaponry: Fuujin
description: You can summon the fan of Fuujin, a mighty metal fan that can summon tornadoes and winds that are able to cut through stuff. Boosts the power of air elementals.
summary: The ability to use the fan of Fuujin.
strengths: Control over wind.
Strong boost to air elementals.
weaknesses: Can be too powerful for some people.
If overused, you might kill yourself.

name: Mood Ring V3
description: If you're angry, your hair will turn bright red (and I mean real red). If you're sad, it'll turn light blue. If you're happy, it'll turn blonde or brown (depending upon your original hair color). If you're in love, it'll turn purple. If you're excited, it'll be black with streaks in every color of the rainbow.
summary: The ability to change your hair color based on your mood
strengths: Possible to gain a new power whenever your hair changes color
If you're uncertain whether or not you're in love, look in a mirror
weaknesses: Obvious when you're using it

name: Myth Power: Horae (Seasons2)
description: These Horae (Horai- Hours), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of the four seasons; winter, spring, summer and fall. As such, channeling Eiar (Ear- Spring) allows one to psychically manipulate the seasons to bring forth spring weather at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive and teleport to anywhere where it is naturally spring. Furthermore, one can withstand electricity. One can even psychically perceive, communicate with and compel anyone born in the season of spring at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Horae and their command over the essence of the four seasons
strengths: Psychically manipulate the seasons to bring forth spring weather at will
Psychically perceive and teleport to anywhere it is naturally spring; withstand electricity
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel anyone born in the season of spring
weaknesses: Cannot psychically Time Travel to future/past springs until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically manipulate time during NATURAL spring until developed (NCN)
Olympian MythPowers and elemental MythPowers related to electricity/spring provide immunity (NCN)

name: Celtic Invocation: Cailleach
description: Those with the invocation can, by tapping a fist, staff or other object against the ground three times, summon a storm common to the winter in the area. According to the climate, it may be a monsoon, a hurricane, a blizzard or a thunderstorm. The invoker may also be able to freeze objects, to call ice and frost by chanting, and to lay curses upon people or objects. These curses may cause instant death, illness, misfortune, pain, or any other negative, destructive effect.
summary: The ability to invoke the power of the Cailleach, the Gaelic goddess of winter and destruction.
strengths: One of the most destructive invocations. The invoker will become winter personified in person.
The invoker's powers are stronger in late autumn to early spring.
Highly respected among the Invokers and people whose powers involve cold and destruction.
weaknesses: The invoker's powers are weaker from early spring to late autumn.
Those who have power over heat, light and fire.
The storms affect all people, including friends and family.

name: Soquidkinesis
description: A soquid is a state of matter between a solid and a liquid. This ability allows you to control soquids with your mind. You can control magma (but not lava), slushies, peanut butter, semi-melted glass, honey, a Wendy's Frosty, and anything else that is a soquid. A soquid shares properties of both solids and liquids. 50% solid, 50% liquid. You can only move magma at less than 1 mph. You can only control soquids. If the soquid magma solidifies (and it will), you can't control it.
summary: The ability to mentally manipulate and control soquids.
strengths: You can mentally control soquids.
You have complete control over soquids.
Control slushies, peanut butter, semi-melted glass, and magma (not lava).
weaknesses: Can only control soquids. Lava is a liquid.
People who can manipulate solids and/or liquids can still slightly manipulate soquids.

name: Mermaid Friend
description: Mermaids love to party and sing, so it's great anytime  you feel like having fun.
summary: The ability to summon mermaids.
strengths: Having someone to hangout with all the time.
weaknesses: You have to be in or near water for it to work.

name: Sh33
description: With this superpower, you know how to make SH33. You make it and when injected(or drank), can allow you to survive without water for a day. Just one dose a day and you'll never need water again. It has to be kept at a constant 40 degrees fahrenheit or below. Above 40 F, it decomposes into SH46, causing extreme thirst and temporarily increased need for water(more than normal) when used. SH33 has a distinct green-yellow glow that glows in the dark. When it glows less and becomes yellow.
summary: The ability to make and use it to survive without water forever.
strengths: Make SH33 and survive without water.
Each dose lasts 24 hours.
A dose a day and you'll never need water again.
weaknesses: It must be kept at a constant 40 F or it'll decompose into SH46.
SH46 causes extreme thirst.
Someone might want to sabatage the SH33 project and hide it from the public.

name: Hot Tub Effect
description: Never take a cold bath again! You could immeidatley turn any pool into a hot tub, and make any water so unbearably hot and bubbly that it scalds the foe!
summary: The ability to create a stream of bubbles or churning warm water when fingers placed in water.
strengths: Hot tubs! No more cold water!
Bubbles!
Boil a foe alive!
weaknesses: Nice relaxing tub can become a horrible bubbly mess!
Boiling yourself alive.

name: Claymore : Sand
description: (This claymore is fun ) the blade is made from Hiduminium. You can only control sand. You have to be near sand.
summary: The ability to posses a claymore that can only contral sand
strengths: You are sandman with a claymore
Barry people in sand
You can make a sand castle
weaknesses: You can only have one claymore (no con negation)
Any power that uses water
Any power that uses fire

name: Greater Kystian Morph #5
description: A zyl, a giant hummingbird-like kystian with a 50-foot wingspan. You can fly at mach 10. You can hover in place and choose to generate a 300-mph fire storm with a radius of 300 feet. You can just generate 300-mph winds if you choose to do that. The fire storm has a temperature of 1500 degrees. You have slow-motion vision.
summary: The ability to become a unsummonable giant hummingbird kystian.
strengths: You fly at mach 10.
You can choose to create a 300-mph fire storm around your body.
weaknesses: A giant form that you can't use everywhere.

name: Rise Of The Skeleton Archer
description: With this power you can turn into a Skeleton Archer. A Skeleton Archer is a ten foot tall skeleton with a bow and an unlimited amount of arrows to go with it. The Skeleton Archer's weakness in that it burns when it is in the light so you can only use this power in dark places or at night.
summary: The ability to turn into a skeleton archer
strengths: All of the pros are mentioned above
weaknesses: All of the cons are mentioned above

name: Vouivre Hair
description: You permanently have an extremely long, flying, razor-toothed and fire-breathing serpentine creature attached to the back of your head. While resting, it is disguised as very long uncuttable hair, but if it feels threatened, it will instantly morph back into the dragon-like creature to attack and defend itself--and you--on the same occasion. While it will never attack you, you still need to tame it if you want to have some control over it.
summary: The ability to have a serpentine creature on the back of your head, disguised as your hair
strengths: Excellent defense and attack mechanism
You can fly on its back
It will never attack you.
weaknesses: If untamed, it won't differentiate friends from foes.
If it is too violent, it can injure your neck, or worse, break it.
You are stuck with very long hair for the rest of your life.

name: Bunny God
description: Bunny God gives you the power to control every bunny on Earth, including toys and dead ones. Only bunbun my toy bunny can withstand the effects and override your power for he is the true bunny god and maintains balance and order in the bunny universe.
summary: The ability to control every bunny on Earth
strengths: Make your toy bunny come to life
Win bunny competitions by getting your bunny to hop over the hurdles
weaknesses: Not complete control

name: Frostbite
description: This power gives one the ability to bite someone and cause them to freeze.
summary: The ability to give a bite that makes someone freeze
strengths: Can freeze people
Can instantly freeze them or slowly take your time
Their reaction time is slower
weaknesses: No love bites
Watch out for who you are biting.
You might freeze yourself if you bite yourself (e.g. tongue).

name: A Gun That Shoots Guns
description: You are given a gun that, instead of shooting bullets, materializes other guns out of thin air and launches them at several hundred mph. The type of gun it "shoots" is random, ranging from a tiny pistol to even a rocket launcher. The speed of guns launched range from 100-1000mph. The gun does not need ammunition, but the ones that it launches don't come with ammunition either. The gun itself must look like an actual firearm of your choice. There is no changing its appearance once you do.
summary: The ability to own a gun that shoots other guns
strengths: Sometimes the guns launched have bayonets at the end
Very hard to trace murders back to you
Very intimidating weapon , if your lucky the weapon that it launches survives impact for you to use
weaknesses: If you shoot a large pile of guns and somehow drop it there it would be hard to find
If you miss your enemy, and he has ammunition, he can shoot one of the guns back at you
He could also charge at you with a bayoneted gun, if you miss and a gun lands close to him

name: Myth Power: Ganymedes' Gain
description: Ganymedes (Ganymede), in Greek myth, was the god of rain, the rain cloud and (somewhat) homosexuality, as well as Cupbearer of the Gods. As such, channeling him allows one to induce, amplify, reduce, suppress or prevent rainfall at will. In addition, one can stand on clouds as if standing on solid ground. Furthermore, one can coalesce ambient moisture into a small cloud, on which one may stand and fly. One may even induce, amplify, reduce, redirect and negate homosexual affection/urges by touch.
summary: The ability to channel Ganymedes' command over the essence of rain, the rain-cloud and homosexuality
strengths: Induce, amplify, reduce, suppress or prevent rainfall at will; when developed, manipulate rainwater
Stand on clouds as though solid ground; form a cloud on which one can stand and ride
Induce, amplify, reduce, negate and withstand homosexuality (homosexual urges or affections) at will
weaknesses: Cannot teleport self/others to rainy areas at will until the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot perceive, communicate with, share senses with or compel homosexuals until the higher levels
Love/affection-based MythPowers provide immunity; may attract those with MythPower: Zeus' Zenith

name: Summon Darana
description: Darana look like 15 foot tall hybrids of rhinos and armadillos. A darana can lift 500 tons. A darana is summoned with a weapon that might or might not be dangerous to you if fired near you. A darana can run 20 mph and has a below average IQ. Its claws will go through admantinium like it was paper.
summary: The ability to summon an battle-designed Kystian.
strengths: A darana can lift 500 tons.
It can rip/dig/tunnel through through practically any material.
weaknesses: A darana could be armed with a weapon that could hurt you indirectly.
Below average IQ

name: Shiver Point
description: With this power you can cause people to shiver uncontrollably just by pointing at them. The person will continue to shiver as long as you point at them and will not be able to stop until you stop pointing at them.
summary: The ability to cause people to shiver uncontrollably
strengths: You can cause people to shiver by pointing at them
weaknesses: They stop shivering when you stop pointing

name: Sand Sculptor
description: With this power you have amazing skills at sculpting things out of sand. This power includes but is not limited to creating sand castles and fortresses and whatnot.
summary: The ability to be a master sand sculptor
strengths: You are amazing at creating things out of sand
You can use this power to win money from sand castle building competitions
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat

name: Myth Power: Underworld Assault3
description: The Underworld, in Greek myth, was composed of three levels. The third was Tartarus. As such, channeling the realm of Tartarus, one can banish foes to a world of storms and chaos. The storms are unruly, and vastly worse than in the mortal world. The landscape is inhabited by the worst of criminals... Including the Titans themselves. However, a still worse fate awaits. Should one ever be chased into the right area, they may well be caught up into a monster's grasp, tossed into an unending abyss.
summary: The ability to channel the hellacious power of the Greek Myth Underworld's third level, Tartarus
strengths: Banish foes to a realm of stormy chaos, where weather is more intense than normal
It is inhabited by criminals of all kinds, including various evil spirits and the Titans
Good chance the foe will end up tossed into a bottomless pit, doomed to fall for eternity
weaknesses: Cannot free spirits of the dead from Tartarus (no Con Negation)
People with death/underworld/necromantic based MythPowers are immune to this ability
People with law, order and justice based MythPowers are immune to this ability

name: Weapon Strike: Firestorm Ops
description: If you have seen Transformers 2, you saw the missile strike "Operation Firestorm" (right before Megatron killed Sam). With this power you can summon that strike shot. It's power can wipe out a Toys r us shop, and have enough missiles to wipe the parking lot.
summary: The ability to summon a Missile strike.
strengths: Missile strike
Toys r us's are big,
weaknesses: Full effect is only achieved if you use all of your missiles
Collateral damage

name: Television Precognition
description: This ability allows you to know when a new episode of a series will come out even before the TV network announces it. This works for any TV series, in any country, in any language. All you have to do is concentrate on your chosen TV series and your power does the rest. It's also quite precise. You get the year, date and even time it will air.
summary: The ability to know when a new episode of a series will air on TV
strengths: You never have to wonder when your fave series will be on
You have a TV guide in your head
You will know in advance if a show is cancelled
weaknesses: You have to know the full name of the series
You can only concentrate on one at a time

name: Tooth Bullets
description: With this power you can shoot your teeth out of your mouth at high speed, as though they were fired from a gun. They can be shot individually, or all at once like a shotgun blast. Shooting teeth is not painful, and a perfectly new tooth grows back almost immediately.
summary: The ability to shoot your teeth out of your mouth.
strengths: Shoot out cavities to be replaced with new teeth.
Have a weapon you can carry anywhere, with effectivly unlimited ammo.
weaknesses: Make sure to smile wide when you shoot so the teeth don't shred your lips.
If you don't take care of your bullets they become weaker.

name: Snowcat
description: A snowcat is a enclosed-cab, truck-sized, fully tracked vehicle designed to move on snow. It's treads are designed to move across soft ground such as snow or peat bog easily. The cap is very well heated and warm. They are usually filled with a plow on the front because they're commonly used for maintaining ski trails.   While in snowcat form, your front windshield acts as your eyes (good because they're designed to not ice up) and your numbed to the cold. You also don't need gasoline to run.
summary: The ability to transform into a snowcat.
strengths: Turn into a big vehicle.
Shelter people from the cold with your heated interior.
Easily cross snow.
weaknesses: Not the fasted vehicles, snowcats.

name: Compendium O Useless Knowledge
description: You simply know every random fact in the universe. The speed of glacier degradation in the arctic, the mating call of the African Water Buffalo, how to speak a language so old that no remnants of it are available in modern history, and so much more. But none of it is worth anything in present day life.
summary: The ability to know every useless fact in the universe.
strengths: You just KNOW random facts.
The knowledge is automatic, and requires no activation
Finally, you know what the word "floccinaucinihilipilification' means!
weaknesses: You don't know any useful facts, just useless ones.
Knowing the innermost thoughts of the creepy cat lady down the street
Knowing what slugs think about being sprinkled with salt, isn't very useful in a fight

name: The Never Blink
description: Torture your enemies by preventing them from blinking as long as you want. Watch their eyes water and become dry as they beg you for mercy! You can't blink either without breaking the effecting.
summary: The ability to control when people blink
strengths: Cause severe eye damage to your enemies
Bring the strongest to their knees
weaknesses: Have to stare into the eyes of the victim

name: Delete This Volcano Uppercut
description: It is a special maneuver, performed by you, that lifts your opponents up with a powerful awesome blow with an illusion of magma around your fist.
summary: The ability to rise up in the air and deliver an uppercut with an illusion of magma flowing through it.
strengths: It doesn't burn them, but rather knocks them out hard.
weaknesses: a fight combo is not a power

name: Green Man
description: You are the ultimate ecologist. When you touch something, you will be able to change it in some way that makes it eco-friendly! You can change a gasoline powered car into an electrically powered car, or an oil drilling plant into a wind farm! This ability works especially well on things that harm the environment, but it does apply to anything you can touch.
summary: The ability to change anything into an eco-friendly alternative.
strengths: You can help save the world!
And cut down on gas prices!
weaknesses: Not much use in combat
Must be able to touch your target

name: Candy Beam
description: Like the infamous Majin Buu, you can fire a beam that turns anything or anyone on the recieving end into a delicious sugary treat of your choosing. It is sometimes reversable in case you hit someone with it by mistake. Also this power doesn't necessarily need to come with a pink antenna on your head, instead you can fire the beam from your eyes or hands. The beam will still be pink though.
summary: The ability to fire a beam that turns people and objects into candy.
strengths: Eat your enemies!
Candy you like whenever you want
weaknesses: Candy is bad for you in large quantities
Beam can be deflected or reflected back at you
Don't take on Majin Buu (or Uub) with this power alone, you'll lose!

name: Rolling Stone
description: When you tumble, you turn into a boulder of twice your size with appropriate weight. While you are a boulder you are immune to damage that would not destroy a boulder, feel no pain, but at the same time can not move on your own. Like a real rock, you must rely on outside force if you wish to keep rolling after your initial tumble. You can change back at any point.
summary: The ability to become a boulder when you tumble.
strengths: Become a boulder and roll at things.
You become a rock, so there's no need to eat, breath, drink, or feel pain while in boulder form.
Despite not having any means to, you still comprehend things going on around you in boulder form.
weaknesses: You're a rock, so you can't move on your own after the initial rolling force of the tumble.
You must be able to tumble to use this power.

name: Myth Power: Acratos' Action
description: Acratos (Acratus, Akratos, Acratopotes, Akratopotes), in Greek myth, was the god of unmixed wine and incontinence (lack of self control, with drinking). As such, channeling him allows one to psychically summon undiluted wine, at will. In addition, one can psychically manipulate wine at will. Furthermore, one can psychically empower wine, by touch, to draw subjects like a beacon, and psychically compel anyone who drinks it. One can even withstand wine intoxication (and share immunity by touch).
summary: The ability to channel Acratos' command over the essence of making and drinking unmixed wine, and incontinence
strengths: Psychically summon unmixed wine at will; psychically manipulate unmixed wine at will
Psychically empower undiluted wine, by touch, to attract subjects; compel anyone who drinks it
Withstand intoxication by ANY wine, mixed or not, which may be shared by touch
weaknesses: None of the above applies to beer, or any other liqueur/liquor; ONLY wine (NCN)
Cannot disrupt urinary/bowel function (induce incontinence in foes' bladders/bowels) by touch, until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Bacchanalia allows one to withstand (and disrupt) this ability (NCN)

name: Superacid Rain
description: You can summon superacid rain from the sky that destroys everything and everybody. You can control the degree and the duration of the rain, and you can control in what area it hits the surface - you can limit it to hit one object or enemy.
summary: The ability to summon superacid rain that corrodes everything and everyone in a minute
strengths: Destruction from the sky
Destroys buildings, too - almost nowhere to hide
weaknesses: It doesn't look so cute when you use it
Bad effect on the environment

name: Effervescence
description: This ability is quite a whimsical one to have. It allows the user to do numerous things pertaining to bubbles. It allows the user to make liquids bubble at will with/without heating them (which can cause numerous problems with a foe's blood circulation), it allows the user to generate and manipulate bubbles of breathable air (underwater, or anywhere else that has air and moisture), as well as assuming a form composed of bubbles, similar to Water Mimicry.
summary: The ability to produce numerous "bubbly" effects
strengths: Everyone loves bubbles
Generate/control bubbles, cause liquids to bubble (with OR without heating it)
Assume a bubbly form that can reconstitute if any of the bubbles pop
weaknesses: Superhero alias sucks (Bubbles, Bubble Buddy, Bubblebutt, et. al)
Vulnerable to Hydrokinesis
Strong winds are not your friend

name: Rpg Vision
description: With this you can shoot two rocket-propelled grenades from your eyes at a time.
summary: The ability to shoot two rocket propelled greanades from your eyes.
strengths: Long ranged destruction.
weaknesses: The explosion is massive so it requires complete control.
As accurate as your normal accuracy (better have Superhuman Accuracy, or...)

name: Freezing Hair
description: The temperature of anything touhing your hair will decrease to below the freezing point of water and your hair will turn blue while using this power. You are immune to the cold created by this power.
summary: The ability to cause one's hair to freeze what it touches
strengths: Enemies will never want to grab your hair.
weaknesses: Very obvious when you're using this power.

name: Allergen Inducer V2
description: With this power you can cause people to be allergic to anything. You can make them allergic to air, food, water or anything else but you can only give one allergy per person. You also can't cure them of their allergies once you give it to them.
summary: The ability to make people allergic to anything
strengths: You can make people allergic to anything
weaknesses: You can only give a person one allergy
You can't cure them of their allergies

name: Past Climate Change
description: With this power you can change the weather in the past such as preventing past hurricanes or creating more snow days in your past
summary: The ability to change the weather in the past
strengths: Can change the past for the better
weaknesses: Meddling with the past can have disastrous effects on the present

name: Myth Power: Horae (Seasons4)
description: These Horae (Horai- Hours), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of the four seasons; winter, spring, summer and fall. As such, channeling Phthinophoron (Autumn/Fall) allows one to psychically manipulate the seasons to bring forth autumn weather at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive and teleport to anywhere where it is naturally autumn. Furthermore, one can withstand wind. One can even psychically perceive, communicate with and compel anyone born in the season of autumn at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Horae and their command over the essence of the four seasons
strengths: Psychically manipulate the seasons to bring forth autumn/fall weather at will
Psychically perceive and teleport to anywhere it is naturally autumn; withstand wind
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel anyone born in the season of autumn
weaknesses: Cannot psychically Time Travel to future/past autumns until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically manipulate time during NATURAL autumn until developed (NCN)
Olympian MythPowers and elemental MythPowers related to wind/autumn provide immunity (NCN)

name: Power Of Toast
description: With this super power you can create toast in thin air and control them to do your bidding also when they are alive please are still able to eat them with the same toast flavor
summary: The ability to create toast in thin air and if you choose bring toast to life and make them do your bidding
strengths: Eat as much toast as you want
Make toast attack your enemys
Make toast give bad guys wedgies
weaknesses: Toast poeple can still eat them with the same flavor
If it rains your toast falls apart
The toast might attack you if you miss use them

name: Delete This Treme Blender Kick
description: The extreme blender kick (Patada extrema de Licuadora) is a special attack with various names. You can jump out and, while rotating both of your legs in the air, move accross anywhere in sight and kick your opponents a thousand or a million times. It sucks your enemies into it, causing them to explode violently.
summary: The ability to execute a tornado kick using both legs and suck your opponents into it. Can hit them multiple times.
strengths: a fight combo is not a power
weaknesses: None.

name: Condiment Rain
description: With this power you can turn rain into any condiment like ketchup, mustard, relish etc. You can only turn rain that has already started to fall into condiments you can't do it whenever you want.
summary: The ability to turn rain into various condiments
strengths: You can turn rain into various condiments
weaknesses: You can only use this power when it is raining

name: Beyblade Wave
description: You will be able to create a total of 50 Beyblades and hurl all of them in one direction at once. Usefull to hit many enemies or slow down pursuers
summary: The ability to create a wave of metal tops and through them in one direction.
strengths: Can hit many opponents
weaknesses: Can be deflected
Damage dealty is limited

name: Vehicle Rain
description: With this power you can cause up to ten different vehicles fall from the sky everyday. It can be any kind of vehicle you want including space ships, boats, bikes, planes, cars, trucks etc. As long as they exist in the real world. You can cause the vehicles to fall anywhere so you cause trucks or submarines to fall on your enemies or cause a sports car to fall on top of your old jalopy and have a sweet new ride. You cannot make the new vehicles disappear.
summary: The ability to make vehicles fall from the sky
strengths: You can cause any type of vehicle to fall from the sky anywhere you want
weaknesses: You can only make ten vehicles fall per day
You can't make the vehicles disappear

name: Halitosis
description: With Halitosis you can make someone's breath go from "Dear God, its like little baby angels prancing around a waterfall of peppermint gumdrops! " to "Dear God, here's $1,000! Go buy as many tic-tacs as you possibly can!! " Oh, they can do whatever they want to freshen it, but it will eventually go back to the level at which you set it. This also works vice versa, it also works on you. So ruin someone's reputation, and seduce people with your sexy breath. For you are THE GOD OF FRESHNESS!
summary: The ability to increase or decrease the freshness of someone's breath
strengths: Seduce people with good breath
Threaten people with crap breath
Ruin Reputations!
weaknesses: May develop a slight god complex
If someone catches you freshening their breath, they might think you're a tool

name: Root Beer
description: Generates unlimted cold root beer forever!
summary: The ability to generate unlimted cold root beer
strengths: It's cold
weaknesses: No cup

name: The Hand Of Buddha
description: By meditation, you can control the right hand of Buddha. The hand comes out of the sky in a puff of clouds. And the hand can be controlled in size, it can be like a mouses paw or enormous. This means you can crush enemies or lift airplanes that are crashing. The hand can also shoot bolts of lightning, and that can be use for many purposes.
summary: The ability to control the right hand of Buddha through meditation
strengths: Clouds and hand are portible
Hurl bolts of lightning
Pick locks with a smaller hand
weaknesses: It's only the right hand
Have to summon it throught meditating
You're vulnerable when controlling the hand

name: Thumb Lighter
description: By quickly brushing the tip of your thumb against the inside of your forefinger into a thumbs-up, you can create a small fire on the tip of your thumb. The tip of your thumb is fire-proof. Both your left and right thumb can be used.
summary: The ability to light your thumb like a cigarette lighter
strengths: Can light cigarettes for smokers who forgot their lighters
Can wave your lit thumb at concerts
Useful for lighting candles for a romantic mood, barbecues, etc.
weaknesses: Only the tips of your thumbs are fire-proof
Others can accuse you of encouraging smoking
People will keep on asking you to do it at parties

name: Rockslide
description: A person has the power to think of a rockslide along with the size of the rocks,the person, people or the thing or things that the rockslide will tumble down hitting with exceptions if the foe has telekinesis, can freeze them, etc.
summary: The ability to create a Rockslide
strengths: A powerful attack that can knock a foe or foes down
Could be used to break through Something
The Limit is a target or targets 63 yards away
weaknesses: A Foe with Telekinesis could make it hit bystanders, property, etc
The target can move so you could miss and hit a car, fire hydrant, etc
The rocks can be transmuted or destroyed by a foe or foes

name: Epidemic
description: It is the ability to make people sick by exhaling viruses or bacteria which cause deseases. You may make it as bad as a cold or as serious as Cancer. Also you can control the range. More gas exhaled, wider range. But you can't give diseases which have a more complicated way of being obtained. Such as AIDS which is from "having fun in bed." You could also give them diseases by stimulating cells such as in cancer but a lot more concentration is needed.
summary: The ability to give diseases to living things.
strengths: You can kill opponents with diseases and watch them suffer.
You can control the seriousness
You can control range
weaknesses: You can also get the disease
Certain diseases might need a lot more concentration
STDs can't be transmitted through breathing or touching but by ya know

name: God's Magnifying Glass
description: This weapon is well-rounded in magic and strength. It can see things from great lengths. When small, it is used to deal out powerful light attacks in sunlight, and use dark magic in moonlight. When it is struck, it glows red for a brief second, and then turns giant and seeks out the person who angered it. When the person is found, it hovers over the enemy and seals the enemy in a dome. The enemy is left there, until the suns rays burn the enemy to death. It has a reverse effect in the moonlight.
summary: The ability to wield a giant magnifying glass
strengths: Wield a magic based weapon
Have a giant minion at times
Better then any pair of binoculars you will ever get
weaknesses: Don't drop it, just don't.

name: Disco Disco Boom Boom
description: With this power you can make disco balls that explode when they hit the ground fall from the sky. You are not immune to the effects of the explosion so make sure you make them fall a safe distance away from you.
summary: The ability to make exploding disco balls fall from the sky
strengths: You can cause exploding disco balls to fall from the sky
You can make them fall whenever and wherever you want
weaknesses: You are not immune to the effects of the explosion

name: Weapon: Caladbolg
description: Caladbolg is a powerful weapon that can very easily destroy a city in one swing in the hands of a worthy wielder however this sword is slightly weaker than Excalibur and its counterpart DarkCalibur.   Like other swords this sword can be stolen but the sword in the stone rule applies and no one else can pull it out of the sheath.  Since this sword always destroys cities when unsealed it is best not to use it unless needed
summary: The ability to wield Caladbolg
strengths: A very powerful sword that rivals Excalibur
If unsheathed, this weapon can destroy cities or armies in one blow
Sword in the Stone Rule when sheathed, anyone can use it if unsheathed though
weaknesses: Not useable in the long run unless in times of war(or fighting in the sky)
Can still be stolen

name: Paper Mimicry
description: You can use the properties of paper to fold yourself into a paper airplane, paper boat, tube, etc. Make yourself flat as paper so you can slip through very narrow spaces. Bend & curl yourself any way you want, like a sheet of paper! But beware, if you are cut or ripped in too many pieces, you will die.
summary: The ability to mimic paper or turn youself into paper
strengths: You can fold yourself like a sheet of paper.
You can slip yourself thru very narrow spaces.
Because the density of paper is so low, you can even fly in a windy breeze as it blows you.
weaknesses: Sharp objects (like scissors) can cut you to pieces! Ouch!
Paper isn't fire-proof either.
Enemies could easily rip you to shreds if they wanted to!

name: Gizmo
description: This power allows you to take a usual object and turn it into a WMD deadly weapon, nuclear weapon,etc.  Other powers allow you to kill people easily while this one goes one step further than killing.  Say a fire extingusher, with this power you can turn it into a jetpack, a nuclear explosion, or even a small military tank.
summary: The ability to have the talent of Gizmo.
strengths: You basically are MacGyver.
weaknesses: Since you depend on Technology so much, you get less exercise.

name: Animal Rain
description: With this power you can cause any animal to fall from the sky. The animals automatically survive the drop from the sky but once they hit the ground they lose their invincibility. The animals are not under your control but can be mind controlled or trained. You can summon as many of any kind of animal as many times as you want. You are not able to send the animals back into the sky.
summary: The ability to cause any animal to fall from the sky wherever you want
strengths: You can cause any animal to fall from the sky wherever you want
They can be mind controlled or trained
They automatically survive the fall
weaknesses: They are not under your control
You can't make the animals go return to the sky

name: Uncontrollable Fire Breathing
description: You know how the X-Men (X-Man? ) Cyclops has lasers shoot out of his eyes whenever he opens them unless he wears he special glasses? Well this power is kind of like that except with fire shooting out of your mouth whenever you open it and wearing special glasses doesn't do a dang thing. You can't even talk or breathe through your mouth without flames shooting out of it. Eating is a disaster as well and you'll probably have to be fed through special tubes to avoid burning your food/drink to crisp
summary: The ability to have flames shoot out of your mouth whenever you open it
strengths: You can shoot fire out of your mouth
weaknesses: It happens whenever you open your mouth
Special glasses will not help you at all

name: Situation Intensifier
description: So you're watching the news and you see a report that a ship has gone out of control, boring. Well, at the snap of your finger, the news gets a live report that the ship is a damaged military vessel carrying a large amount of dangerous chemical and personnel, and that it has been hijacked by terrorists. Still not intense enough for you? Snap your fingers again and the news gets a new report that the ship and its cargo are going to crash into a dam that will contaminate all the rivers in America.
summary: The ability to make any bad situation worse.
strengths: Useful if you are a superhero in need of a job, a news reporter in a slow news day, or a terrorist.
weaknesses: If you use it too much, you might cause armageddon... Or worse
You don't know how bad the situation could get
You have to be able to snap, and know where, when, and what event is taking place.

name: Delete This Frosting Upper
description: When your fist becomes surrounded by a light-bluish aura, you can powerfully uppercut your enemy and then they'll be frozen and shattered when they hit the ground.
summary: The ability to uppercut and freeze your opponent at the same time.
strengths: a fight combo is not a power
weaknesses: a fight combo is not a power

name: Popcorn Machine
description: This is perfect for movie night. With this power, you are like a walking popcorn machine.
