name: Type Ii Pneumocyte Mimicry
description: Pulmonary surfactant is a substance which acts similarly to soap. It lowers the surface tension of water by allowing water and a hydrophobic substance (air, oil,... ) to mix. It also has antibacterial properties and, if you coat someone in it, they become easier to restrain and absorb by Macrophage Mimics. Additionally, you have the abilities to undergo mitosis and to switch this power for Type I Pneumocyte Mimicry. The latter ability is irreversible: you will lose Type II Pneumocyte Mimicry.
summary: The ability to produce and release pulmonary surfactant.
strengths: You can produce and release a substance which acts just like soap.
You can duplicate yourself to outnumber an opponent.
By coating a foe with the surfactant, you can help a friend with Macrophage Mimicry to eat them.
weaknesses: You may help a foe with Macrophage Mimicry to eat a friend coated in your own surfactant.
You have the power to lose this power for another one which is relatively less useful.

name: Fire Truck Levitation
description: With this power you can levitate fire trucks and then hurl them at enemies or juggle them in the air whatever you want
summary: The ability to levitate fire trucks
strengths: Can levitate fire trucks
weaknesses: Only works with fire trucks

name: Pine 'o Plenty
description: Using this power, you can transform at will into a Pine Tree.  While in Pine Tree form, you may survive as a tree would, however, you may fire your needles and you may walk with your roots, uprooting and rooting at will.
summary: The ability to transform into a pine tree that may move.
strengths: Lob Needles up to 100 feet
Survive without food through Photosynthesis
Resistances to blunt objects and lack of humanoid anatomy
weaknesses: Lack of Speed
Reliant on Sunlight, Water, and Soil
Inability to hold items

name: Fashionista
description: Tired of looking for clothes which match? With this power, you can simply wave your hand and you clothes would come out of your closet with a nice match. The match depends on the controllers personality and mood. You can also turn people into the laughing stock because of their funny fashion. You can also create other heroes' costumes.
summary: The ability to control people's fashion and how they look
strengths: You'll never have to waste time matching clothes.
Embarass your enemy with poor fashion
You can win a fashion designing contest easily
weaknesses: That's all you can do
You'll find yourself making costumes for other heroes' for free
You'll have poor names

name: Sandwich Master
description: With this ability, you can eat a sandwich whenever you want. It can be any kind of sandwich, and it will just appear in your hand, ready to eat. Only YOU can eat the sandwiches you create.
summary: The ability to eat a sandwich whenever you want.
strengths: You will never go hungry.
Good party trick.
weaknesses: Sandwiches might get old.
You can't share it.

name: Pb: Bad Breath
description: 'PB' stands for 'Power Boost'. With this ability, all of your breath-related powers are doubled in effectiveness (Power, effort needed, etc). Just a few examples are Dragon Breath, Sonic Breath, Neurotoxic Breath. List goes on.
summary: The ability to have all of your breath-related abilities doubled in effectiveness.
strengths: Doubles effectiveness of all breath-related abilities (ex: Dragon Breath)
weaknesses: If you don't have any breath abilities.
Or superpowers at all.

name: Delete This Sleep Tight
description: Your arms are engulfed in a purplish-pink energy, and you can stand behind the opponent and use one arm to place the opponent in a cobra clutch. You could lock your hand to their wrist behind their neck to make them submit or lose consciousness. For the finale, you can start out by lifting them off the ground high into the air and slam them down to the ground.
summary: The ability to apply a glowing Cobra clutch on your foe then force them into a Leg trap chokeslam.
strengths: It is very powerful and has great range to it.
weaknesses: None.

name: Caffeination
description: This power allows you to satisfy one of your basic primal urges--the urge for caffeine! Whether you've missed your morning cup o' joe, you've got a 20 page paper due in 2 hours, or you just want to go completely insane for a while, this power will be your saving grace.  You can caffeinate any substance, even water, to any level of caffeination desired.  As an added bonus, you will be immune to caffeine overdose, and, with practice and concentration, can impart flavors of coffee and tea!
summary: The ability to caffeinate any food or beverage
strengths: Never miss your daily dose of caffeine
If the waitress accidentally gives you decaf
Cramming for exams
weaknesses: Caffeine addiction
Heart attack
Being annoyingly hyper

name: Human Shimmering Shanty Shack
description: You are pretty much a human firework launcher. You can launch any firework at anytime as long as it is a shimmering shanty shack of any size.
summary: The ability to launch a shimmering shanty shack at any time
strengths: People like you at parties
You can catch things on fire
You can save money on the 4th of July
weaknesses: You can potentially explode at anytime
You can catch things on fire
You are considered contraband in any state where fireworks are illegal

name: Saucery
description: Saucery is the ability to create and manipulate sauce. Any kind of sauce you can think of can be created from thin air with minimal effort. Additionally, existing sauce can be changed to suit your purposes. In combat, consider creating torrents of boiling sauce, consider filling someone's lungs with sauce or consider turning ordinary sauce into poisonous sauce and forcing it down your opponent's throats - the possibilities are only limited by one's imagination.
summary: The ability to create and manipulate sauce
strengths: Delicious food where ever you go
Surprising combat ability (molten sauce torrent)
Sell the sauce, make money
weaknesses: Maybe not the best combat power
Unsubtle

name: Herbology: Umbra Flos
description: The Umbra Flos is a scary-looking thing. Shape-wise, it is a rose, but the petals are black, the stem red, and the petals give of pure shadow(black tendrily smoke). Its full powers are yet to be discovered, but its best known is the power of its essence. By crushing the seeds and petals together, and combining the liquid created with water, you create the Umbra Flos essence, which will cause the drinker to become a creature of shadows for a short time, while retaining some physical form.
summary: The ability to summon an umbra flos.
strengths: Can use the Umbra Flos for its essence.
Might even discover its other powers.
weaknesses: Creating the essence takes much time(hours, at the very least)
Without herbology, this ability may be hard to discover, let alone use properly.

name: Warm Ice Cream
description: This power allows you to warm up ice creams, but they will still hold their shape and consistence. So, instead of tasting 'cold', they will taste 'warm' or even 'hot', and won't melt when it's hot. However, they will melt if it's too cold.
summary: The ability to i didnt make thos power what is going on?
strengths: Warm ice creams don't cause you brain freeze.
You can now eat ice creams in winter too.
They won't melt if it's really hot outside.
weaknesses: They will melt if it's too cold outside.
The temperature affects how the tongue perceives tastes.
The ice creams may taste a bit weird when warmed up.
tags: was edited as it was too similar to another power

name: Musical Rain
description: With this power you can as many of any kind of musical instrument to fall from the sky where ever and whenever you want. Make tubas fall on people and cause their heads to get stuck in them. Cause entire drumsets or pianos to crush your enemies. Or cause instruments to fall into your hand so you can rock out.
summary: The ability to cause musical instruments to rain from the sky
strengths: You can cause musical instruments to rain from the sky
weaknesses: You can't make the instruments disappear

name: Naviskinesis
description: The ability to be on a boat with T-Pain at any given moment (flippie-floppies optional).
summary: The ability to be on a boat with T-Pain at any given moment
strengths: Being on a boat.
Being with T-Pain.
Doin' flips'n'sh*t.
weaknesses: Exiting the boat will cancel out all effects from being on a boat.
Dolphins may or may not be available for doing flips'n'sh*t.
Sinking the boat will result in immediate penalty, and everyone will think you're a total tool.

name: Ramjet
description: With this power you can point at any person and have the word Ramjet appear on their forehead. This will then cause the next plane that flies overhead to crash into the person. Before the plane crashes into the person anybody who was on the plane is teleported back to the airport that they departed from.
summary: The ability to point at someone and have the word ramjet appear on their forehead
strengths: You can point at people and cause the word ramjet to appear on their forehead
You can cause planes to crash into people
weaknesses: The person will probably be killed

name: Condition Change: Fire
description: This power changes the condition(s) of activation of a power to requiring the target to be on fire in order to work. This power is tactile.
summary: The ability to make a power work only on things that are on fire.
strengths: Just keep things from catching on fire.
weaknesses: Have to touch opponent and each touch affects only one power.
Enemies with fire-based powers.
Telekinesis is much, much, much more deadly.

name: Poof, Beer!
description: Turn anything you want into beer!  Any kind of beer you want.  Any color bottle.  Any temperature.  Any percentage alcohol.  Surprise yourself, make it a random beer.  All that matters is, where there was no beer, beer appears.  You can change any non-living object into a frosty, delicious brewed alcoholic beverage--but be careful, once you change it into beer, it can't be changed back.
summary: The ability to turn ordinary objects into beer.
strengths: Impress and intoxicate your friends with your magical beer
Get your buzz on with a bar tab of $0
Changing clothing into beer
weaknesses: Sometimes, shots are the way to go
The infamous beer belly
Expensive jewelry probably shouldn't be changed into beer.

name: Charity Bell
description: With this power you can turn objects into bells when you physically touch them. The objects you touch will resonate like a bell until their atoms shake apart. The sound waves produced when the object is turned into a bell can also severely damage anything around the object, as if the object exploded, except the user of this power. The object does not have to be immediately turned into a bell but it must be within a hour.
summary: The ability to turn objects into bells.
strengths: Atoms will break apart after resonating like a bell.
Sound waves could destroy multiple enemies.
Can not be hurt by bells you create.
weaknesses: Must physically touch object to turn into bell.
Those with sound based powers could be immune.
The resonating sound waves would destroy nearby objects.

name: Detect Non Kystian
description: This power lets you sense a non-kystian existence. This is similar to the sense all kystians have. Dead, undead, living, mortal, immortal, non-divine or divine beings can all be detected. The power works by making you feel a wave of hatred go through your body when you see such a being. A lifeless rock-nothing, animated rock-slight hate ... all the way to a living rock man who is immortal and divine-total hatred. The prolonged use of this power will make you behave like a kystian.
summary: The ability to detect non-kystians as kystians do.
strengths: Spot those pretending to be kystians.
Know the existential status of a foe-it may help you fight them.
weaknesses: This power may lead to an irrational hatred of anything non-kystian.

name: Goft
description: Goft is the ability to make objects fuzzy, carpet-like, and shadowy. This could be used to confuse somebody in a house or block somebody's view by making the air fuzzy and such.
summary: The ability to make objects "fuzzy", "carpet-like" and "shadowy"
strengths: Make everything soft
Confuse foes
Create carpets
weaknesses: Could accidentally make something electronic and important into a carpet
Could hurt somebody
Mess up your house

name: Elemental Move: Kamehadoho
description: Literal translation: Turtle Wave Motion Fire. It's a fire manipulation technique invented by master Marayo, which starts off cuffing your hands together to charge your fire element energy, while shouting out the technique to create a stream of fire in the shape of a turtle shell. With practice, it can be combined with other elements to make new variations and capable of control to wipe out hordes of enemies and even a whole planet.
summary: The ability to fire a flaming turtle shaped shell for your hands
strengths: Can be combined with other elements
Defeat many enemies with fire
weaknesses: Have to have the fire element
Have to probably learn it from Marayo

name: Gate: 40 Rods Of Darkness
description: Must have Gate: Eight Gates to get this power. When this power is activated a rod that absorbs all light spectrums and gives none off is fired from each side and the center of each gate. These rods are 2 metres long and can be used to encage an area in order to seal it off from the outside world.
summary: The ability to fire rods of darkness from the gates
strengths: "Best offense is a good defense"
weaknesses: Requires Gate: Eight Gates. This is unaffected by Con Negation.
Cannot change areas the rods of darkness are fired from.
Rods have no offensive value.

name: Myth Power: Adreus' Address
description: Adreus (Adreos, Hadreus, Hadreos), in Greek myth, was the god of the ripening of corn. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically generate hot weather (needed to grow corn), at will. In addition, one can shed one's skin, like the husk of a ripe ear of corn, to reveal skin of a new makeup (wood, stone, metal etc) at will. Furthermore, one can psychically summon corn kernels, and detonate them with power like bombs, at will. One can even psychically summon food made from ripe corn, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Adreus' command over the essence of the ripening of corn
strengths: Psychically generate sweltering-hot corn-growing weather
Shed 'husks' to reveal new skins beneath; psychically summon corn kernels, explode them like bombs
Psychically summon foods made from corn (cooked corn, popcorn, tortilla chips, etc) at will
weaknesses: Cannot summon indestructible Cornstalk Staff (shoot exploding kernels) until developed (NCN)
Corn often increases power in numbers (one kernel may be only a firecracker), until developed
Agricultural/economic/cooking/food-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Ver (Worm)
description: If you're a worm hybrid, you can eat through any earth to make tunnels.
summary: The ability to eat through earth
strengths: You don't have to eat anything else
Tunnels can be used for infiltration of enemy bases
Make traps
weaknesses: Extremely dumb
No offense capabilities
No defense

name: Myth Power: Potter's Potential3
description: The Ceramic Daemons (Potter's Daemons, Daimones Keramikoi, Daemones Ceramicoi), in Greek myth, were the gods who plagued the craftsman and potter. As such, channeling Smaragdus (Smaragdos, Smaragos, Smaragus- Smash) allows one to summon clay and ceramic statues in mid-air to fall like rain. In addition, when one throws/drops objects, they will shatter like clay, even if not actually clay. One is even rendered immune to petrifaction and involuntary separation abilities (vaporization etc).
summary: The ability to channel the Ceramic Daemons' command over the essence of pottery and ceramics
strengths: Summon pottery to fall around oneself like rain (space will bend, so they never hit the user)
Drop/throw non-clay items, causing them to break like clay (even if made of dense metals, paper)
Totally withstand the effects of petrifaction and separation type powers (vaporization, etc)
weaknesses: Pro #2 does not apply to living things until the HIGHEST levels (NCN)
Only teleport foes into midair (breaking them like clay as they hit the ground) at the higher levels
People with earth-based MythPowers are immune to the direct effects of this ability

name: Kidney Stoned
description: Users of this power can give their enemies kidney stones, which are freakishly painful and take forever to get rid of.
summary: The ability to give people kidney stones
strengths: Make your enemy double over in pain.
Laugh heartily while your enemy is doubled over in pain.
weaknesses: People will laugh if you tell them you can manipulate kidney stones, as opposed to, say, telekinesis
You can only create two kidney stones each day.

name: Red Eggs
description: Red Eggs are hollowed out poultry eggs that were filled with milk bush, glass powder, pepper juice and painted red. They are used to blind and irritate your enemies by throwing them or their contents at the target's eyes and skin, contact with the eyes & skin causes severe burning & pain to mouth, lips, and tongue. Red Eggs are not the most lethal weapons, but the amount of irritating pain the opponent suffers leaves them wide open for attack.
summary: The ability to use them to throw at your enemies so they would be permanently irritated and blinded.
strengths: The opponent's will be blinded and have their skin irritated leaving them wide open for the attack.
weaknesses: None

name: Pie
description: Pie allows the hero or heroine to instantly form a flaky, delicious pastry crust around any significantly organic object. For example, a person wearing normal clothing can instantly be encased in a flaky pie crust, while an airplane full of passengers would be unaffected. However, passengers within the vehicle could be individually encrusted. The oven hot pie crust completely encloses and can temporarily immobilize a human adversary, as well as scald unprotected areas of skin.
summary: The ability to form a flaky, delicious, cooked pastry dough shell around any organic object.
strengths: No ingredients or pastry skills or implements required
Pie crust materializes instantly and is oven hot (350-450 degrees F)
An "ingredient belt" can be utilized to augment pie crust mass and volume
weaknesses: Pie does not prepare, cook, or otherwise affect the target "filling. "
Pie must form around an object; pie shields, pie walls, pie projectiles, etc. Are not possible

name: Paint Rain
description: With this power you can cause paint to fall from the sky anytime, anywhere. The paint can be in any color and can be any kind of paint.
summary: The ability to cause paint to rain from the sky
strengths: You can make paint fall from the sky
weaknesses: You might ruin your clothes

name: Mageirovakyriakinesis
description: With this power, you can fry an egg on Sundays of your own accord! No need for troublesome pots, pans, fires, or lighters!   Frustrated Housewife: "There's GOT to be a better way!" "Well now there is, with Mageirovakyriakinesis!"
summary: The ability to fry an egg on Sundays.
strengths: Fry an egg anywhere on Earth with your mind
You'll never need your own heat source or kitchen equipment
Heck, you don't even need a kitchen!
weaknesses: ONLY works on Sundays
ONLY works on eggs
ONLY fries eggs, no boiling or scrambling

name: Hula Dancing Power
description: Every hula dance tells a story and someone with this power can cause any part of those stories to occur while dancing that part or summon something associated with the part of the dance. Ex. If they dance a part about a volcano erupting, a volcano somewhere could erupt. Dancing a hula dance about Pele, Goddess of Fire and Volcanoes, will actually summon her. Can only be gained by having some knowledge of Hawaiian myths, legends, and folklore.
summary: The ability to be able to dance any hula dance and be able to cause things to happen while hula dancing
strengths: You can choose whether or not to cause things to happen based on the hula dance.
The effects of the dancing can be quite powerful.
Note: Hula dancing can be done by both males and females. One of my male friends has done hula.
weaknesses: You need to know what each movement means to be fully effective.
Can take some time to do a dance to the point you want.
You need to have the hula dancing outfit on for this power to work.

name: Laser Bow Tie
description: With this power you benefit from wearing formal attire as any bow tie you wear is now a weapon. This power allows you to fire lasers from any bow tie you are wearing.
summary: The ability to shoot lasers from your bow-tie
strengths: Fire lasers from your bow tie
weaknesses: Doesn't work if you don't have a bow tie

name: Potato Salad
description: If you are in the mood for a potato salad, just make some pop up. It requires a lot of thinking because it's awesome.
summary: The ability to make potato salad come out of thin air
strengths: Potato salad whenever you want
Never have to worry about being hungry
Throw at someone's face and they'll be distracted
weaknesses: You could drop it on your new clothes or something

name: Just Like Daddy
description: You can do anything! Weather it's shooting up the badguys or fixing a monster truck with your eyes closed, nothing is too hard for you. You are better than anyone else's dad. Every boy wants to be you when they grow up. You never cry. You never bleed. You are invincible. You stay up as late as you want and watch scary movies because you aren't afraid of anything!
summary: The ability to be as awesome as the man you believed your father to be when you were five.
strengths: You can kick anyone's ass.
You can bench press tanks.
You get all the girls and all the respect.
weaknesses: You are nothing more than a shallow caricature of adulthood, a bombastic facade with no substance.

name: Peanut Butter Vision
description: With this power you can shoot peanut butter from your eyes (onto bread or at enemies)
summary: The ability to shoot peanut butter from your eyes
strengths: You have an unlimited supply of peanut butter
Good with Jelly Vision
weaknesses: If you're allergic to peanuts this is a bad power for you

name: Canimageirkinesis
description:
This power is useful if the supervillain tends to have armies of guard dogs, but can be downright evil in the hands of those who hate dogs. 

Topping the list of PETA's "most hated powers" list, its limits are unknown, but are assumed to only affect the genus Canis, but not Chupacabras. 

An ongoing debate in the Canimageirkinesis community is whether or not it can be used against Cerberus. The issue being whether Cerberus is a dog demon, or a demon that happens to look like a dog
summary: The ability to set dogs on fire.
strengths: Take out wolves from a helicopter.
Set those annoying yappy dogs aflame with your mind.
Piss off PETA.
weaknesses: Not useful on anything but the genus Canis.
Doesn't work on Chupacabras.
Piss off PETA.

name: Fountain Head
description: This power allows you to pour any type of drink from your head by turning your head sideways. The drink comes out of your ear (minus the earwax) Whenever you turn your head sideways. This power is always turned on so if you do not want a drink, do not tilt your head.
summary: The ability to pour drinks from your head.
strengths: Drinks when you want.
Any type of drink.
Never worry about being thirsty
weaknesses: Drinks leaking out of your ears when you tilt your head.
Drinks might be too cold or too hot coming out of your ear (Ex: Coffee)
People may not want to drink your ear liquids.

name: Summon Alot
description: The Alot is an imaginary creature that is a mix between a bear, a yak and a pug that you can summon into reality. The Alot can be made out of many different substances, such as Alot of Fire, or Alot of Mist (like elemental familiars, but not limited to elements). You can summon as many Alots as you wish and unsummon them at will. The Alots will be friendly towards you and help you but they have their own free will.
summary: The ability to summon the mighty Alot.
strengths: Can Summon Alot to help you.
The Alot can be made out of anything.
Your own Bear/Yak/Pug pet.
weaknesses: They have their own free will which may not be helpful.
Might need to take care of them a lot.
A lot of Alots might become confusing.

name: Knuckle Spark
description: With this power your knuckles act as a flint and steel, capable of producing a spark of fire when you knock them together. This also makes your knuckles hard and flame retardant, and repeatedly sparking in quick succession cause them to become very hot.
summary: The ability to spark flame by knocking your knuckles together.
strengths: Always have a source of fire on hand.
Hard, flame retardant, hot knuckes.
weaknesses: Knocking your knuckles together only produces sparks, you still need fuel for a proper fire.

name: Luke Warm!!
description: Everything you come in contact with will become luke-warm instantly! Tables, lobster, people, hamsters, carrots, you name it! You must come in contact with the item for it to become luke warm!
summary: The ability to turn things luke warm
strengths: Never have a cold meal again
Baths will always be luke-warm
Your bed will be luke warm during the cold seasons. All two of them.
weaknesses: You can never have hot food.
Your beer will be luke-warm.
Never get to feel other temperatures such as cold, hot, and schwarm.

name: Delete This Thursting Knee
description: While you are engulfed in an burning aura, you would fly and ram towards the opponent with your knee leaving behind a flaming streak.
summary: The ability to strike towards your opponent with your knee.
strengths: a fight combo is not a power
weaknesses: a fight combo is not a power

name: Soda To Water
description: With this power you can turn any type of soda into pure drinking water. You can use any amount of any type of soda for this power and it automatically turns into pure drinking water.
summary: The ability to turn soda into water
strengths: You can turn any amount of any type of soda into pure drinking water
weaknesses: You cannot turn the water back into soda

name: Delete This M.C. C.
description: A burning red-orange aura glows around your right arm, that gives you the opportunity to put your foe in a powerbomb position and lift them up in a inverted powerbomb. You move your arm from around the opponent's neck, grabbing hold of their throat that'll cause them to be instantly burn, finally lift them high into the air slam the opponent down to the ground back first.
summary: The ability to grab hold of your opponent's neck, set them ablaze then end it with a devastating chokeslam.
strengths: a fight combo is not a power
weaknesses: a fight combo is not a power

name: Muppet Power Beaker's Talents
description: Over the years the Muppet Beaker has been shown to have a variety of talents, from being mostly fire proof to beat boxing to making funny videos to shrinking Jack Black's head all the way down to being an assistant stage hand and dj. With this power you will be able to harness all of these abilities and skills. A side effect of this power is that hair turns bright red.
summary: The ability to have all of the talents of Beaker
strengths: You can beat box, be fireproof, play the guitar, make funny videos, shrink peoples heads, be a dj...
Your hair is bright red
weaknesses: Your hair turns bright red and cannot be turned any other color even with dye or some sort of power

name: Rise Of The 3 Head Vampiric Sheep
description: With this power you can turn into a three headed vampiric sheep. You have all of the attributes of a normal vampiric sheep except for the three head part. One of the heads is a normal vampiric sheep head, the second head is a vampiric sheepacron robot head that shoots rockets from its nose and the third head is a super vampiric sheep head which breathes fire.
summary: The ability to turn into a 3 headed vampiric sheep
strengths: You can turn into a 3 head vampiric sheep
You can shoot rockets from your nose
You can breathe fire
weaknesses: You crave human flesh

name: Acid Tears
description: Secrete nitric acid tears when needed, good for burning through metal and items affected by acid.
summary: The ability to secrete nitric acid tears on command.
strengths: You are immune to the effects of your own acid tears.
weaknesses: If upset, crying could prove bad results.

name: Xylem Removal
description: Xylem are specialized tunnels in a plant that move water from the roots to the shoots and leaves. Removing the xylem will hinder the plant's ability to photosynthesize and its ability to cool down by way of evaporation.
summary: The ability to permanently remove xylem from plants
strengths: Good counter against plant manipulators.
weaknesses: Takes a long time for the effects of this to be felt.

name: Fire Fart
description: With this power you can cause people to burst into flames when they smell one of your farts. You can this power on and off so people aren't constantly bursting into flames when they smell your farts. People who are not able to smell and people who have this power are immune to this power.
summary: The ability to cause people to burst into flames when they smell one of your farts
strengths: You can cause your enemies to burst into flames
You are immune to this power even if it is used by another person
You can turn it on and off
weaknesses: If your enemy is not able to smell or has this power he is immune

name: Brunner's Gland Cell Mimicry
description: Just like Goblet Cell Mimics, you can produce and secrete mucin (cf. Goblet Cell Mimicry), as well as shoot water, except your mucin has alkaline (antacid) properties. It has a pH greater than 7 and, when it comes in contact with an acid, they neutralize each other. You are of course immune to bases. You also have the power to inhibit the powers of Parietal Cell Mimics and Gastric Chief Cell Mimics. Additionally, you can undergo mitosis, that is the creation of identical copies of yourself.
summary: The ability to shoot alkaline mucus.
strengths: Not only are you protected from acids, you can counter them too!
You can put a lid on the dangerous abilities of Parietal Cell Mimics and Gastric Chief Cell Mimics.
You have an immunity against the effects of both acids and bases.
weaknesses: You can't use your mucus to protect others.
You are not immune to the risk of drowning in your own mucus.
The water you shoot comes from your body. It's not created out of thin air.

name: Claymore : Volcano Eruption
description: (This claymore is very dangerous) this claymore was created during the eruption of Mount Vesuvius. This claymore can make a random volcano erupt. The blade of this clamore burns whit hot when a volcano erupts.
summary: The ability to possess clamore that can make a random volcano erupt
strengths: Revenge
Hold the planet for ransom
Mass destruction
weaknesses: You can only have one claymore (no con negation)
Any power that uses water
You can only make a random volcano erupt

name: Kyst: Emergency Power #6
description: Land-based weapon carrying kystians are good, but flying ones are better. A zelet looks like a hybrid of a whale and a squid and is 650 feet long. Zelets have telescopic vision and sonar. Each is armed with one massive rifle weapon. Kyst will call for up to 100 zelets. The weapons can work through atmosphere and have a range of 40 to 50 miles, so zelets could fire downwards while in the Earth's orbit. In the atmosphere, zelets move 700 mph. In space, 10000 mph. In water, 100 knots.
summary: The ability to have Kyst call for air support.
